venues.name: Imperial Treasure Fine Chinese Cuisine
venues.description: From Beijing's finest to London's tables - authentic Chinese cuisine with modern flair. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Dined at this restaurant twice. First time was lunch dim sum which was amazing. Would easily say it's the best dim sum in London and that inspired me to go back for dinner, which was very good but not amazing.  Definitely recommend going there for dim sum.  Excellent service, something you would expect in a Michelin star restaurant. The atmosphere feels like a very luxury fine dining restaurant, very relaxed and calm but very attentive.
I've also had dim sum in their Guangzhou restaurant (Tianhui) and I would say the dim sum is better at London restaurant.

This is the best fine dining Chinese restaurant I've ever experienced. We tried the Peking duck, which we'd reserved in advance, accompanied by Burgundy red wine. The dumplings that came with it were also very good. I can't wait to come back.

We had the Imperial Treasure tasting menu and the food was exceptional! All of the dishes were outstanding! Our top three were the peking duck, black truffle lobster and the steak with garlic chips!
Our waiter Stephen was soo attentive and gave us some good tips on how to enhance our soup! We had such a wonderful time and we will be coming back

One of the best Chinese dining experiences in London! The signature Snow Mountain BBQ Pork Buns were absolutely outstanding – perfectly crispy on the outside and soft inside, with rich, flavorful char siu. The Seafood Tofu Soup was also excellent, full of fresh ingredients and very comforting.
Special thanks to our waiter Johnny, who was incredibly attentive and friendly. His professional recommendations made the meal even more enjoyable. Definitely a place I’d love to revisit and highly recommend to anyone looking for authentic, high-quality Chinese cuisine!

The dining experience at Imperial Treasure Fine Chinese Cuisine was amazing! Authentic Cantonese dishes, fresh ingredients, and refined presentation. The staff were attentive and polite. A must-try restaurant in London for anyone who loves high-quality Chinese food!

venues.name: Hutong
venues.description: Upscale spot with lanterns, silk curtains and city views, serving dim sum and northern Chinese fare.

reviews.text:
It was a last minute booking as my other half couldn’t decide where he wanted to have dinner but since we’ve been at Hutong before, it was an excellent go to for any occasion.
Maybe I’m just getting too old but my boyfriend and I wasn’t impressed with the volume and choice of music.
Food and service were otherwise excellent as always. Also, always leave room for dessert!
Many thanks for making my boyfriend’s birthday a special one!

Celebrated our anniversary dinner here and it was worth it, 5 star on all categories. We were well assisted by Alan who’s not just a great staff but also a very good photographer, very attentive to our needs and details on all his service, the foods was great especially the duck, all I can say is wow, all the foods we got was amazing & freshly cooked, and the dessert was excellent, the best mango dessert I had so far in the UK, really tasted like sweet mango from Asia. And we were surprised with the free dessert to greet us for our special day, and they were also able to accommodate our request regarding the seating arrangement. Thank you to all the staffs! Really enjoyed our dinner from start to finish 😁

From getting to the shard to reaching the restaurant upstairs every single member of staff were so friendly. When we got to the restaurant our table was ready despite us being 10-15 minutes early, we were taken to our table and we had booked the skyline experience so was seated next to the window with a great view. The meal we had was amazing and the portion sizes were very fair, not too small and not too much. The duck was the best thing as they bring it out and cut it in front of your table for you to see. We was here celebrating a birthday and the staff even prepared a little happy birthday treat for my partner which was ever so kind. Well worth the money and I would come back here for sure

Wonderful treat for my daughter’s birthday. Our server was excellent. There are probably better, less expensive places if you want Chinese food here in London, but we wanted to treat ourselves to The Shard! The two highlights were our server who was lovely and the King Of Dragon cocktail which was amazing! Thanks to all the staff there!

Service was amazing and cocktails were 10/10. Dessert was lovely and the birthday treat was a nice touch. However, it would have been helpful to know there’s a cut-off 30 minutes before your booking ends, which did take away from the experience. I also found a staff comment about ordering more food a bit unnecessary — if I want more, that’s my choice and what I’m paying for. The food was just okay, nothing special, and the view felt quite far away (would have been better by a window). Overall, some highlights but not sure it’s worth the money.

venues.name: House of Ming
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Serving 2 difference halve and refried pecking duck, it was dry and no favouring even the duck skin isn’t crispy. The waiter said they make their own pecking duck pancake, we received factory made pancake .

I can taste the Honey roast pork char siu was frozen and reheat by microwave, It was dry and chewy.

£75 for a Lobster tails laid in giant lobster shell with the almost 70% butter I could not taste any lobster meat at all.

For Dim sum we have scallop and prawn har gao, it might be handmade but it usually comes with big pieces of scallop i guess I got a newborn. Har gao should be at least few pieces, we got some in finely chop.

It was a treat from my friend so I have to be polite and not to complaint . For the same price we paying in central london you can get much better quality and services.

Fried rice with xo sauce was nice not greasy but xo sauce should have dry scallop and spiciness.

Noodles with mushroom is slightly salty but it is the most decent food of that meal.

The waiters aren’t seem to know what are they serving and the ingredients. Foods aren’t serve as what we being told.

I was with a group of friends for a special event so I have to be polite and nice on that day.

My husband and I were staying at the Taj and as it was or 45th wedding anniversary thought we would have a nice meal. We chose House of Ming as we had heard good things about it, on arrival we were greeted warmly and showed to a lovely booth with curtains. Staff were attentive and the food was really nice, especially as we were vegetarian for that period, it was Navratri and we don't go vegetarian for the nine days. My husband (who isn't vegetarian normally) was also very impressed and as he's also a very good chef it's a huge relief when he finds the food excellent. We were given complimentary cocktails and a beautiful dessert in honour of our anniversary. Thank you to B. Prasad and everyone who works for House of Ming for making our evening extra special.

The service was lovely, the manager and all staff members were really kind. Celebrated a birthday and they bought out a mini cake and sang which was incredibly sweet. The staff went above and beyond to ensure we were taken care of and the food was delicious. Would recommend others try.

We had a wonderful evening at The House of Ming! The food was absolutely delicious, and the customer service was truly exceptional—definitely a 10/10 experience!

A special thank you to Shah, who made our dinner even more memorable. You looked after us throughout the entire evening, and your attentive, professional, and warm service really stood out. Your hospitality was truly commendable!

We’ll definitely be coming back soon!

House of Ming at the Taj St James Court London delivered an absolutely exceptional lunch experience!
From the moment we stepped in, the ambiance was perfectly serene and elegant, creating a truly special atmosphere.
We started with the Golden Fried Prawn, which was crispy and bursting with flavour, followed by the perfectly seasoned Chicken Salt and Pepper, and the delicate Prawn Har Gao Dimsum. Each appetizer was a testament to the kitchen's mastery of Chinese cuisine.
For our mains, the Hakka Noodles were cooked to perfection, the Chilli Oyster Fish was rich and satisfying, and the Veg Fried Rice was a delightful accompaniment. The delectable flavours of each dish were truly memorable.
A special mention must go to Dexter, whose warm welcome and attentive service made our lunch even more enjoyable. His care and professionalism ensured we had a truly wonderful time. We can't wait to return to House of Ming for another incredible meal!

address.formatted: County Hall, Westminster Bridge Rd, The Queen's Walk, London

venues.vicinity: County Hall, Westminster Bridge Rd, The Queen's Walk, London

reviews.text: We booked this Chinese restaurant for lunch which was located at the very prime tourist location.  Initially we thought it was a place mainly for tourists.  Upon arrival, we were led to a window table that had a great view of the Bog Ben.  They were having a summer special that a whole Peking Duck was at a reduced price from £118 to £68.  With no second thought, we ordered the duck right the way.  Along with the duck, we also ordered a few dim sum which were very nicely presented.  It's a pity they didn't cut up the duck in front of us.  Price wise, it was higher than those in Chinatown by 20-30% but it was still reasonable for this location.  Their wait staff were very friendly and helpful.  The two hours of dining went by quickly.  I  would love to try their abalone on my next visit.

Tasty dishes in pleasant atmosphere. Some of the tables have great view to Big Ben. Friendly and polite staff.
But; we were a group of 25 guests. The staff should take time to present the set menus and how to eat the dishes because not all the guests were familiar with Cantonese food. With such big group, they should have a lead staff to coordinate the tables. Pity!

Excellent authentic Chinese food, beautifully presented.   The location on the river opposite Westminster is great, from our table we looked out the window across the tanes and Westminster Bridge  and Big Ben and Parliament House. Price wise very reasonable, I have paid more for Pub Meals no where the quality of the food we ate here.Our favourite dish was the lamb with cumin.

Delicious Chinese with a breathtaking view!
Popped in while visiting London for the first time and I loved it. I would recommend booking to secure a spot with the view, I hadn’t but luckily there was a spot and the lovely staff let us sit in one.
The food was delicious, particularly loved the beef with black bean sauce.
I will definitely be coming back and recommending this place to anyone popping over to London.

Amazing views of the London Eye, Parliament, and the Thames made this dinner special from the start. The food was next-level — flavourful, beautifully presented, and far above your typical Chinese restaurant. Staff were friendly and professional throughout. A fantastic experience all around. Highly recommended!

venues.name: Noble Palace
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Best dim sum we have had. We went for lunch and were well taken care of by the servers and host. We enjoyed the pumpkin dumplings, sea bass, taro croquettes, and steamed pork buns. The standout was their crispy prawns wrapped in noodles served with a light soy sauce. We even went back to order another, but with iberico pork.

The restaurant and vibe itself was a standout. Very comfortable and elegant. We came with our 2 year old and everyone was very welcoming and even brought him special shrimp chips which kept him occupied. Special thanks to the Hungarian manager who I didn’t catch his name. Us hungry parents were very much appreciative we could enjoy a fine dining meal with the kiddo.

We will be back again and highly recommend you make a visit!

My husband booked Noble Palace for my birthday and what an experience. I was craving dim sum (baby wants dim sum) and wow what an amazing selection we had. The staff were really attentive and friendly and the ambiance of the restaurant was beautiful. Will definitely come back once baby it out!

Last month I been in Noble Palace
These  two dish are new and good taste

Pan-Fried Wagyu Beef Dumplings
Tempura Soft Shell Crab with Hot & Sour Sichuan Sauce

The whole experience was great.

I had a fantastic dining experience today. Yuri and Kara, our servers, were friendly and attentive, ensuring we had everything we needed. They even asked about allergies, which was thoughtful. The food was delicious, and the beautifully presented dessert was the perfect finishing touch. Highly recommend for great food and excellent service!

P.S. The dessert is a special order, so I recommend ordering it in advance. Don’t miss out on their special dessert—highly recommended!

Went here for a baby shower and everything from the customer service, food, and ambiance was great. Can’t say much about the price because we were a big group so I paid fairly for what I got. They adjust for dietary restrictions, were constantly refilling water/sparking water based on your preference, and kindly handed bags for leftovers. One of the nicest baby showers I’ve been to! Thank you!

venues.name: The Sichuan Restaurant
venues.description: Standard destination offering Chinese set lunches and a la carte dining.

reviews.text: Nice Sichuan Restaurant in the city. They have good selection of regional Chinese dishes and they served the orders quite promptly.  I just wished that if the menu indicated 3  hot or spicy levels, the dish should be really in hot and spicy level the way Sichuan dishes have in China. Staff are all attentive and accommodating.  They have clean washrooms as well.

Overall the food is really good, using straight away and said down a straight away. Food came in good pace and it genuinely felt like you're in China. We ordered a range of food for two with sparkling water. My favourite was the roasted duck and the noodles.  We also ordered the cucumber salad which was a bit of disappointment. Authentic, good price and service.  Would go again
Decent spot for Sichuan between Old Street and Moorgate stations. We had crispy duck and soft shell crab starters, followed by dan dan noodles (nice and spicy) and crispy shredded beef.

We had a great experience at this Chinese restaurant! The food was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. Highlights of the meal included the dry-fried green beans, which were crispy and savory, and the stir-fried onions with pork, which had a delicious balance of sweetness and spice. The eggplant dish was rich and tender, soaking up the sauce beautifully. The fried rice was light yet satisfying, with a nice mix of chicken, ham, and vegetables. Portions were generous and the service was friendly. A solid spot for authentic Chinese food—we’ll definitely be back!
The food was super nice. Everyone service was very nice and friendly ( Ellie Cindy Backy Ruby and Head ) very nice team. Will come back for sure

venues.name: Min Jiang
venues.description: Swish, 10th-floor Chinese restaurant in a high-end hotel, with lofty views of Kensington Gardens.

address.formatted: 2, Royal Garden Hotel, 24 Kensington High St, London

venues.vicinity: 2, Royal Garden Hotel, 24 Kensington High St, London

reviews.text:
Excellent fine Chinese dining.

Wide range of very tastey Chinese food. They're moderately priced and the service from entry to exit to tops.

There are some superb canopy type views of the city at night, which makes for a charming view of the city.

I've eaten there several times in recent years and the service is consistent and Excellent.

Try out their duck specialty, you'll enjoy it.

‼️book your Peking duck ‼️ Wonderful view and the food was really great.  We would have appreciated if the fact that we needed to make a reservation for Peking duck was advertised when we booked.  But the dishes we ordered in lieu were beautiful executed nonetheless.  The staff were lovely also - will come back again still!

More than average food for fair price, great location with amazing view.
The duck was better than average you can get in europe, the execution of the chef not so much. Doesnt say hello, doesnt explain anything, rushes to the table and starts cutting, leaves a lot of meat behind, which is then used to make 6 tiny bites. I wished he would just let ne debone the duck myself, thats how poor the execution was.

Min Jiang is one of my go-to favourites in London. I’ve been many times with different friends, and everyone has always been impressed. The food consistently meets expectations, the Beijing duck is especially outstanding, perfectly crispy and carved at the table, the price definitely matches the quality.

The view overlooking Hyde Park is stunning, a reliable spot for a memorable meal every time.

So we came here for my birthday. Expressly for the Peking Duck. With the backdrop of Kensington Gardens (which was stunning and must be wonderful on a sunny day) and elegant surroundings. It’s v relaxed though for some reason our food took longer than expected for which the server apologised. I would rate food 4 stars. It’s expensive but it was all delicious and well flavoured accompanied by tasty and plentiful sauces. It’s fabulous having the succulent juicy duck carved in front of us and it was all very enjoyable. Could the skin been a tad crisper and flavourful - perhaps! But it was still delicious. I would say that the second serving (we chose fried rice) didn’t contain much duck at all and we didn’t get the leg. So that was a bit disappointing.  But again the fried rice was perfectly cooked.  It got quite busy for the lunchtime and that added to the atmosphere. I liked the little gift bag for Chinese NY which was a nice touch at the end.

address.streetAddress: 2, Royal Garden Hotel, 24 Kensington High St, London

venues.name: Ma La Sichuan
venues.description: Sleek restaurant serving Chinese Sichuan cuisine, along with dim sum.

reviews.text: What a lovely vibrant atmosphere, authentic Chinese food and really good portions of food! I did not expect to find a place like this at all behind the huzz and buzz of Big Ben and Westminster areas!  We were sight seeing with our friends from Canada and Belgium and we stumbled upon this restaurant, with 8 of us walk in and no reservations on a lunchtime and was quite busy but we’re still accomodated despite  the circumstances that we had. The location was only a few meters away from Westminster abbey which someone would thought this place did not exist . The food was served quick and fast and simply irresistible flavours . The service was simply handled by Judy , genuinely attentive, respectful and friendly. Food prices I thought was expensive which I thought it’s London price but I was proven wrong as the portions were actually for 2-3 people eating and I was gobsmocked to see the quality and quantity of it! It was indeed a very good value of our money !  Definitely will be back here if we are in London and it was truly an amazing experience! Highly recommended.

The restaurant is lively and always decently full which is a great sign. The service is efficient and friendly, and the waiters are all very attentive with regards to drinks. I will say that the food is rather good, the fried noodles, squid, and soft shell crab all recommended. Will be back soon!

Loved this asian restaurant, we ate all sorts of plates (all to share, group of 7) and they were all quite yummy. We walked in without a reservation and they treated us very politely, sat us down immediately. The food was great, our favorite was the fried rice and the sweet and sour chicken.

Definitely will be returning soon!

Excellent service!! as somebody who has worked in the hospitality industry almost my whole working career, I can tell they take pride in their customer service and attentiveness at this restaurant.

Food was delicious as well! My friend and I got the sim sung platter, prawn Singapore noodles, a bottle of wine, and duck spring rolls. We both agreed we’d definitely coming back soon, we loved everything.

And again, I don’t think I’ve ever had such attentive staff! They didn’t let us lift a finger… Even on such a busy evening, they were completely full!

Thank you for a lovely evening🫶🏽
Really nice food. We love that we can adjust spicy level according to ability. Really friendly staff. The fish tasted fresh and sooo soft and fluffy. The chicken was very nice too.

venues.name: Golden Dragon (Chinatown)
venues.description: Spacious restaurant set over 2 floors serving Cantonese and Pekinese cuisine with dim sum lunches.

reviews.text:
Golden Dragon is everything you want from a Chinatown restaurant. Fast, attentive service, great food, and a buzzing atmosphere. From the moment we walked in, the table we had booked was ready for us straight away, and despite the restaurant being fast-paced and busy, we never once felt rushed. There were so many staff on hand that we never had to wait for anything—credit to the team for running such a slick operation.

We ordered the Oriental Set Menu, and the restaurant was more than happy to accommodate a swap from beef to chicken for one of our party, which meant everyone could enjoy the full menu together. A thoughtful touch that really stood out, and one they were within their right to not need to accommodate.

The meal began with a comforting chicken and corn soup, before the array of mains arrived. The standout for me was the Sweet and Sour Pork which was perfectly balanced, crispy, and packed with flavour. My friends raved about the Stir-Fried Diced Chicken with Cashew Nuts and the Spicy Szechuan Prawns, both cooked to perfection. The duck dish was also excellent, rich and tender, and rounded off the meal beautifully.

Overall, Golden Dragon delivered a brilliant Chinatown dining experience being efficient yet friendly service, excellent food across the board, and a lively atmosphere. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be returning.

A faultless dining experience today...came here on a Thursday as part of a trip. We regularly dine in Chinatown but so far hadn't experienced this restaurant. Filled with lots of Chinese (always a good sign..no offence meant) . We ordered a large array of dim sum and 2 a la carte dishes. Food arrived super quick and was really good one of my favourite char su pork I have ever eaten. Staff were friendly attentive and helpful. Definitely recommend this venue for both seasoned and novice dim sum eaters.

Golden Dragon in Chinatown is a lively spot known for its authentic Cantonese and dim sum offerings. The average main course is reasonably priced, usually around £12–£18, making it good value for both casual meals and special outings. Drinks are varied, with a mix of traditional teas, soft drinks, and a decent selection of wines and beers to pair with your meal. The atmosphere is bustling, especially at peak times, and the staff keep things running smoothly despite the crowds.

The food stands out for its freshness, with dishes arriving hot and well-prepared, especially the seafood and dumplings which are customer favourites. Golden Dragon also caters for accessibility, offering disabled facilities that make it easier for all guests to enjoy their dining experience.

I love my Chinese foods , and Golden Dragon didnt disappoint ..

Stopped in after the theater for something to eat. Large menu offering a great variety of food was good, not great. Was clear the staff wanted to go home even though there was still quite a crowd inside eating.

Authentic Cantonese cuisine in quite large portions. We had fish & tofu stew and shredded duck vermicelli soup, both were tasty and comforting
Edit: we came back for dim sum, and everything was wonderful. The egg pudding is a must try!

venues.name: Speedboat Bar
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Oh my word. My husband and I came here with high expectations for our anniversary. Firstly, a sincere shoutout to the friendly and highly attentive waitstaff. We reserved in advance (which I recommend doing as it gets busy!) and they had actually read my booking notes. In the notes I mentioned I was pregnant and so they double checked I was happy with the preparation and ingredients of certain dishes. The menu leans towards the spicy and salty side, but at the same time is very fragrant and aromatic. Quite addictive really! I’ve seen viral videos of that Tom Yam deluxe noodle dish so obviously we had to get it. It was delicious, but to my surprise, my favourite dish was their Naem fried rice. It’s been about a week since our visit and I’m still licking my lips thinking about it. To top everything off, we got a surprise scoop of taro ice cream. How adorable is that? Lots of love to Speedboat. We’ll be back, and definitely before our next anniversary!

hyped up place for sure and while the interior lives up to the hype and certainly some of the dishes do they are unfortunately inconsistent and I don’t think pay attention to detail… possibly because it gets so busy. Don’t get me wrong it was nice and tasty but just a little inconsistent and not insane value. The rice was overcooked and actually clumped together which I wouldn’t expect from a Thai restaurant- especially when paying £4 extra.. the purple aubergines were really nice, tender and flavourful. However for £12.50 I got one long purple aubergine- eight pieces. Would’ve said id happily pay £9, as it wasn’t mind blowing but very very nice. Would’ve been nicer with better rice. Good spice level, even though we received warning it was actually perfect. Channah got crispy egg noodles with gravy pork and squid and was pleasantly surprised with two different types of squid and she said good value for the amount of squid, as she’d expect more pork and less squid but it was the other way round. The spice also could’ve been higher and she wanted more greens in the mix and garnish. She really enjoyed though and felt it was good value for central London £17. Staff are possibly a bit overworked and overwhelmed but they are all so lovely. Happy to have come but wouldn’t rush to come back.

Food and drinks were great!! I am obsessed with Tom yum mama noodles and regularly have the instant version at home so this boujee version was fantastic!! The fried rice was very flavoursome and even better with the sauces! Pour the beef tongue curry sauce on it and it’s even better! The pineapple pie was a nice way to end the meal

I have lived in London for 6 years and tried all kinds of good or bad restaurants. However, this is the first time I have written a review for a restaurant. First of all, I would like to thank the patient waiters and their drinks are good. However, what puzzles me is that the pricing of your restaurant's dishes is like a joke with customers. Your specialty dish "yum pot" is priced at 29 pounds. In fact, it is pitifully small and the contents are only some fried pork and convenience-based bargains, and a bowl of small rice costs 4 pounds. In addition, as for your taste, as an Asian, I can responsibly tell other consumers that the taste level of your food has only reached the middle and lower reaches. Then, your dining environment focusses on the style of "market flavour” and " street food", so your dining environment is actually pitiful. Finally, in short, you don't have the dining environment and service experience of a high-class restaurant, and you don't make the food delicious. Overall, you have only achieved the level of 8 pounds per person. I don't understand why you have such a high Google rating.

I was a little bit underwhelmed with this place - huge potential with such a unique and cool vibe to the place. The only thing is it gets so crowded even the staff seem stressed with the hot plates darting around people. I wouldnt come back on a Thursday-Saturday night. Because it was so crowded I think the staff felt overwhelmed.

If it wasnt crowded I wouldve had a better experience for sure as the food was pretty good and the vibe was cool! Definitely recommend the noodles but sizzling seafood was average!

venues.name: Kolae
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my visit over the weekend. I was very keen to try Kolae as it had been recommended by a friend and on the whole I was not disappointed.

We didn’t order a lot of the food on this occasion so I’d definitely like to go back and try some other dishes what we did have was incredibly flavourful and in some instances, very spicy,  the pepper chicken made me lose my voice. It was so spicy but so delicious. Luckily, our server recommended a cooling drink to soothe my throat.

I really liked the building and the place had a really nice vibe, although as is often the case, the toilets were a bit messy.

We were on the top floor and I don’t think there was a lift. I think we went up three flights of stairs to a smaller, lovely space, so do you bear that in mind when booking.

We felt rushed at the end but we did have a two hour booking limit. Another 15 mins would have been good.

Stand out was the kale, surprisingly, and the pork.

Recommended.

One of the best meals we've ever eaten. The lunchtime set menu is a brilliant deal, the prawns, butternut squash, fish curry and rice pudding dessert are all total world class.The guy from Alsace who looked after us was brilliant, friendly  helpful and kind. He did a brilliant job.One of the worlds best restaurants in my book, it was amazing, thanks for a lovely and memorable afternoon Kolae.

We had reservations for this very popular place near borough market. We ordered two curries and one salad for our meal. We ordered a wine and a beer. The prawn curry was super spicy which is fine as I like spicy but the curry was too thin and it was okay. We ordered a fish curry which was very good. The mango and cucumber salad was very good and so was the coconut sorbet. It was a good refreshing finish after the meal.

Utterly exceptional! Genuine Thai food, should come with a warning for how good it is! I had the set menu which had a fantastic mix of the general menu. Great drinks selection, especially curated to complement the food. Lovely atmosphere, super helpful staff. I would eat here ever day if I could. My new favourite place for sure!

Really great meal at Kolae today. Real punchy Thai flavours, all fresh and very well presented. Mussel skewer, crispy kale fritters and stone bass curry our favourites but everything was really good. service was also very good and helpful. Would definitely recommend

about.text: Thai · in Central London — Kolae (Rated 4.6★ · 893+ reviews · FSA 5/5) Kolae delivers confident thai plates with a London edge. Order: pad thai, green curry, and tom yum soup. Great for date night, small groups, or a relaxed catch-up. Fair pricing for the quality.

venues.name: Nua
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
A relatively new and nice modern Thai option in the area. The staff are really lovely from the moment you arrive and remain attentive throughout. The main menu is large and varied with photos to help aid any selection, but there’s also a reasonably priced lunch menu, offering either one or two courses from a concise range of options. From this menu, both the staters and main are served together on a single plate, presented well, and although not a massive portion is good for a lunch.

The pork skewers were delicious and a shame they only serve two, and the green curry was very tasty with a nice level of spice. The draught beer was a little slow to arrive but served ice cold which was great.

The decor and background music doesn’t give the most traditional or authentic atmosphere but fortunately everywhere is clean. I’ll certainly be returning and would recommend for a more unique independent offering.

Our group of four had a fantastic experience at Nua, enjoying a night of excellent Thai food. We started with the Nua Platter, which included Duck Spring Rolls, Chicken Satay, Steamed Thai Dim Sum, and Chargrilled Pork Skewers. A major positive is that they provide one of each item per person, avoiding the awkwardness of splitting dishes, something many other places don't get right. The accompanying sauces (satay, chilli and a hoisin-like sauce) were also spot on, adding extra depth to the starters.

For mains, we ordered a variety including the Pad Kra-Pao and Massaman Curry. Every dish was full of flavour: the pork was rich and juicy, the chicken was perfectly tender, and the boned-meat easily pulling away from the bone. The Sticky Rice and Jasmine Rice we had alongside complemented the mains beautifully.

Service throughout the meal was polite and courteous, though we did find it difficult to get attention when asking for the bill, waiting around 10 minutes.

Pricing is slightly on the higher end, but given the central London location and quality of the food, it felt reasonable enough.

Overall, Nua delivers delicious Thai food in a relaxed setting. A great choice for a treat or a special night out!

Overall the place was good. The food was tasty but not exceptional. The starters were tasty - the skewers, the tempura shrimp and the spring rolls were all good. The grilled chicken was fine but the portion size was small and the salad was not to my taste. Overall I’d love a rich sauce there instead of just a hot one. The service was extremely slow and it took them a lot of time to cook our order. What stands out is the wide selection on the menu.

We wanted to try this Thai restaurant and were not disappointed. We booked in advance as the space inside was limited. The food was great in flavour and portions. Service was slightly slow but the staff was super friendly and helpful. Toilets are on the lower ground floor with stairs.

Came for dinner to a quaint Thai spot in Fitzrovia.
It was a great evening, the restaurant was not too packed and they brought food efficiently. We ordered two Pad See Ews,
one with tofu and one with crispy chicken, and they were both delicious and quite flavoursome despite looking quite pale.
The highlight however were the duck spring roles, they were perfectly cooked, crispy and flavoursome, and not too oily.
Nice spot

venues.name: AngloThai
venues.description: Thai cuisine that's as vibrant as Bangkok itself - bold, beautiful, and delicious. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: They did something truly great with this restaurant. Incredibly gorgeous, delicious and balanced food. It’s definitively British food with Thai influence, not vice versa - very original and creative. Don’t think there was a bad dish here, I’d definitely recommend to NOT skip the supplement as that was one of the best bites. The curry as well as the oysters and sausage starter were additional standouts. I was literally cleaning off the plate with their homemade brioche. Even the cucumber broth amuse bouche was delectable. Only two dishes that didn’t wow me were the Thai tea dessert and the side of greens that was very very salty. Other than that this restaurant is exactly the type of cooking I’d love to see more of in London. Unfussy interior and service, very friendly and felt cozy but not rugged. Will definitely be returning!

This was one of the best tastings I have done in London. And at a very competitive price point. A couple highlights were the crab and caviar course and the bbq octopus. It may have been the best octopus I have ever had. The Thai spices were unique and fantastic across all the courses. They also had excellent ice cream in both of the dessert courses. The ambiance could be a bit more elevated, as it was quite tightly packed but the food makes it more than worth the visit!

Took my wife for her birthday dinner and we really enjoyed our meal. Every dish had a unique Asian spin that was flavorful and delicious. I usually don't like fish but all the fish dishes were spectacular. Can definitely see why they got their Michelin star! Staff were all very friendly and they gave us a great seta by the window as well as a beautiful dessert to celebrate the birthday. Thank you for such a memorable meal

What a wonderful meal and experience!  It could not have been better. The staff were understanding and always helpful. Their explanations and suggestions greatly enhanced the meal.

We’re so happy that we saw the feature on CBS ‘The Dish’ and were able to visit while in London.

Definitely looking forward to our next trip! And thank you so much for the note on the menu. It’s a lovely keepsake!

Stunning dinner experience. Star of the night was the spiderweb crab. I think it's their signature. HUGE fan. Second close was the bread curry. Something in that bread. Appetizer beetroot was a pleasant surprise for me too as I usually hated beetroot. But it didn't taste like it. Will be coming back! Riesling that our sommelier pick was really nice too. Unfussed vibe despite the michelin star, some dishes can be spicy for English taste but it didn't bother us

venues.name: Plaza Khao Gaeng
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
My fave Thai restaurant in London!
I’ve been going here for the past three years and I love the fact that they always have a special menu that changes. It keeps the food exciting and different.

The flavours always burst in your mouth and I love spicy food too!

Truly authentic and amazing food!

The service was really good with helpful staff in making your decisions.

Truly a gem!

Was really impressed by the flavours of the dishes here. The roti bread and Morning Glory had a divine, delicate in flavour. The crust quails egg was good, but the accompanying sauce made it an excellent dish. The Massaman curry had rich flavours, and even though I didn’t sample the fried chicken dish, the other diner said that it was amazing. Many of the dishes do have a kick to them, so be mindful of that if you’re not good with hot food.

The staff were nice and attentive, they also treated us to some coconut pudding due to it being one of our parties birthday.

The only qualm I had was the fact that we were a party of three, sat at a table for two and it was quite cramped. I had to sit with my legs to the side and we couldn’t easily fit all our dishes on the table.

The food tastes really good and very authentic 🍽️ Portions are okay for the price. Service wasn’t the best, which does affect the overall experience, but would I return? Yes haha, I believe one fish can’t make the whole sea rotten ka!

Amazing Authentic Thai Food in a Buzzing Spot

Absolutely fantastic Thai food in a lively and vibrant setting. We tried three dishes, including several that are rarely found in typical Thai restaurants abroad each one was packed with flavour and clearly made with care.

The atmosphere is casual and no-frills, reminiscent of a Bangkok street food canteen. It feels like a little piece of Thailand transported straight to London. The soft drinks were also a highlight; refreshing and not overly sweet. I highly recommend the Thai iced lemon tea.

The staff were friendly and provided great customer service throughout. A must-visit for anyone craving truly authentic Thai dishes.

Tip: Make sure to book if you’re going in the evening — seating is limited. We walked in and ended up sitting at the bar facing the wall, which wasn’t ideal for sharing multiple plates, but the food made up for it

Very authentic Thai food! Highly recommend the iced milk tea, glass noodles, and pork belly – all were delicious. Although seating is limited to a set time, the service was excellent and the restaurant had a lively atmosphere with affordable prices. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more from the menu!

venues.name: Patara Knightsbridge
venues.description: Upscale venue with chic, sleek decor offering an innovative contemporary take on Thai cooking.

reviews.text: Absolutely incredible Thai food. Highly recommend the lamb massaman curry and wok fried noodles with beef. The Patara passion cocktail is also fantastic if you want to enjoy a nice refreshing beverage with your meal! We will definitely be back!

Excellent service and food!
It’s my second time dining here I really like the fried sea bass! You can tell the chef did a great job with his knife skills.
Highly recommended! It’s close to Harrods so if you are craving some legit Asian cuisine, should definitely try them out!!

reviews.author_name: สุภัทรสร ขุนเเก้ว
reviews.text: I came here for my husband’s birthday and we both had a wonderful meal! The food was sooooo tasty and all of the staff were great. I highly recommend Patara if you are looking for a Thai restaurant in London.!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Beautiful Dinner with My Husband at Patara
My husband and I had a wonderful dinner at Patara to celebrate a special evening. The atmosphere was romantic and refined, perfect for a couple’s night out. The food was outstanding—elegant, full of rich Thai flavors, and beautifully presented. We especially loved the grilled sea bass and the beef panang curry. The service was warm and attentive without being intrusive, and they made us feel truly welcome. It was the perfect setting to relax, connect, and enjoy an exceptional meal together. Highly recommended for a special night out!

Went to this fantastic restaurant last night. Went there with my wife. Upon entering the restaurant there was this foul smell of wet cloth. Anyway we were shown our table and menu given. We sat down and the smell was more intense. Basically smelly cloth was used to clean the tables. That smell was horrible.

We ordered our food from the menu. The beef and chicken is halal. The food came within 20mins. Service was excellent. The restaurant was nice and calm. It felt cosy.

The food was 5 stars. Everything we ordered tasted so good. Coming from holiday in Thailand very recently, I can say the food here is authentic. I will definitely come back here again.

Order: pad thai, green curry, and tom yum soup. Great for date night, small groups, or a relaxed catch-up. Fair pricing for the quality.

venues.name: Champor-Champor
venues.description: Thai-Malay restaurant with candlelit balcony, decorated with exotic artefacts, silks and statues.

reviews.text:
We booked a Friday evening table for a birthday dinner, and the place was buzzing! The ambience is absolutely beautiful — very warm and aesthetic.

I’m a vegetarian and ordered the tofu butternut squash green curry with jasmine rice. It was scrumptious, filling, and served hot with a lovely touch of basil oil. The portion size was generous too.

My friends had the king prawn pad thai and chicken massaman, and they really enjoyed both — the massaman was their favourite of the night.

For dessert, we shared the chocolate chilli cheesecake, which we completely devoured!

The only downside was that the service was quite slow. I understand it was a busy evening, but it did take away a bit from the overall experience.

Still, the food and atmosphere made it a lovely evening overall. I’d happily come back!

We brought our guests here for dinner and everyone left with a smile, truly happy. Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. One of our guests had never tried Thai cuisine before, yet they loved it! We were impressed as well. The team was genuinely friendly and the food was fantastic thank you!

Really enjoyed my chicken green curry, and my friend loved her vegan version too — both were delicious! It was a lovely evening overall. Just a heads-up: the restaurant gets very busy, and there’s a 2-hour dining limit, so worth keeping in mind when booking. We went on a Tuesday evening and the place was absolutely heaving.

Quick Lunch Catch-Up Done Right!
Stopped by for a quick lunch and a girls' catch-up and wow, what a treat! The food was absolutely amazing and the customer service was warm and attentive. We had the Massaman lamb shank with rice and the Massaman grilled chicken curry with roti. Both dishes were bursting with flavor, and the presentation was spot on. We’ll be back in a heartbeat!

Been here twice now and the second time was even better. Really tasty food. Great interiors with lovely, attentive staff. We had the calamari, beef salad to start and then the prawn pad Thai which was definitely the stand out! Highly recommend this place.

about.text: Thai · in Central London — Champor-Champor (Rated 4.5★ · 1,281+ reviews · FSA 5/5) Champor-Champor delivers confident thai plates with a London edge. Order: pad thai, green curry, and tom yum soup. Great for date night, small groups, or a relaxed catch-up. Fair pricing for the quality.

venues.name: Kin + Deum
venues.description: Contemporary cooking of Bangkok with cocktails in a stylishly spare, dog-friendly dining room.

reviews.text: Kin + Deum offers a warm, cozy ambiance paired with genuinely friendly service. The Thai-inspired dishes are flavorful and thoughtfully presented. The noodles were cooked to perfection, with rich, balanced flavors that really stood out. Desserts were a delightful surprise—light, creative, and satisfying. It’s also dog-friendly, making it a perfect spot for pet owners. A great choice for casual dinners or catching up with friends. Highly recommend for anyone seeking comforting food with a modern twist.

Tried their special manual, pink lychee martini, pandan chicken. All so good. The stuff here are supper helpful, and friendly. We don’t know what to order. They provided so many good recommendation. Definitely will came back.

Really delicious Thai food and generous portions. Each dish had so much flavour and the meat dishes were so tender. Standout dish was the grilled honey tamarind spare ribs and the mango cheesecake. Service was friendly and the restaurant itself was spacious, would recommend booking ahead as it does fill up in the evening.

Kin+Deum is a hidden gem that brings authentic Thai flavours to the heart of London. The menu is creative yet comforting, offering both classic dishes and modern twists that highlight fresh, high-quality ingredients. Each plate feels thoughtfully crafted, with bold spices balanced perfectly for a memorable dining experience. The atmosphere is warm, stylish, and welcoming—perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. Service is attentive and friendly without being overbearing, adding to the overall charm. Whether you’re after a quick lunch or a relaxed dinner, Kin+Deum consistently delivers delicious food and a genuine sense of hospitality. Nan really made my service enjoyable. Highly recommended.

The vibe was low key but upmarket at the same time. It was cozy and a perfect evening dinner spot. The food was fantastic- you can certainly taste each ingredient. I highly recommend the mango cheesecake! I never order cheesecake but it was recommended by my server. It absolutely fantastic!

The service was perfect- so kind and attentive! I will certainly be back!

venues.name: Chet's
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: Union House Shepherds Bush Green, 65 Shepherd's Bush Grn, London

venues.vicinity: Union House Shepherds Bush Green, 65 Shepherd's Bush Grn, London

reviews.text:
I visited for both breakfast and lunch. The restaurant is located toward the middle of the building on the ground, but it's filled with natural light and has a bright, welcoming atmosphere. There are various types of seating, and if it's not too crowded, the staff will kindly let you choose the kind of seat you prefer, which makes the experience even more pleasant.
Everyone from the reception to the servers was polite and warm, and I truly appreciated the thoughtful and graceful service. Every dish I tried was carefully crafted and absolutely delicious. This is definitely a place I'd love to visit again.

We had prawn toast, pineapple fried rice, pork ribs and coconut yellow curry hake fish clams - they were all absolutely banging! Wouldn’t miss out on coconut rice & mango and banana roti. Every bite felt like we’re instantly transported back to Asia. The ambiance was cozy & service was great! The staff and the chefs were quite friendly. We will definitely come back to try their other food!

I tried Chet’s BBQ pork belly and wagyu fried rice, and I was absolutely blown away! The fried rice was full of flavor due to having so many different components and seasoning, and every bite felt like an incredible, new experience. The pork belly was also very enjoyable and my only complaint was that there wasn’t more of it on the plate! I was also quite surprised by the serving size of the fried rice; it could have easily fed 3! The service was also perfect, my waitress was attentive and helpful throughout (as I had a few questions). Definitely a 5-star experience!

Great service! Our waiter was very attentive and the food arrived quickly.

We got the hot chicken burger for £18 which came with chips, and the pineapple fried rice for £23 (which came served in a pineapple)…fun, but not the most practical to eat from!

Both were tasty, but overpriced in my opinion! They were normal portion sizes, and in my experience, you can order similar items for around £15-18 from other Thai restaurants for similar quality…

Side note, both had lots of coriander mixed in, so tell your waiter if you don’t prefer that!

Great venue with delicious food and next level service. We came here for the tingling onion and famous smash burger. Based on a review we watched.
We weren't disappointed, in fact we loved the food so much & the service stood out so we're reviewing it ourselves.
Why is it the only place in London serving the whole onion this way? Whatever, Chet's do it and do it well. That smash burger, with coriander and green chilly was juicy and delicious! Highly recommended.
Danny and Vikram have earned a shout out as they did everything to make us feel welcome & enjoy our meal.

address.streetAddress: Union House Shepherds Bush Green, 65 Shepherd's Bush Grn, London

venues.name: Patara Oxford Circus
venues.description: Modern Thai cuisine in a contemporary dining room with traditional motifs and stone sculpture.

reviews.text: I went here for my birthday and the food was amazing, definitely up there with some of the best Thai food I’ve ever had. The massaman curry was absolute perfection and the service was good as well. Highly recommend a visit if you’re a big fan of Thai food like me!

We popped into this place on a whim since it was nearby and had great reviews- it absolutely lived up to the hype!

Our waitress was incredibly kind and attentive, making the whole experience even better.

The food was fantastic and tasted genuinely authentic. My friend ordered the prawn Thai Green Curry and declared it the best she’s ever had and for someone who always orders Thai Green Curry- that’s saying something!

I went with the Vegetable Rice Noodle in brown soy sauce it was perfection.

For starters, we had the Fried Tofu and the Garlic Okra, both of which were excellent.

We’re already looking forward to coming back and trying more dishes!

This restaurant is wonderful. The service as soon as you step through the door is amazing - the staff are very friendly and attentive and make you feel very comfortable. The decor is tasteful and the furniture is comfortable.

The food is amazing, 10/10. Myself and a friend ordered 2 starters (sweetcorn fritters and vegetable spring rolls). They came out piping hot and tasted extremely fresh in the best way. For mains, 1 got the pad thai (really good, the chick was great and the noodles and veg really pulled it together so well. loved the addition option that allowed to add peanut pieces at my own pace). Second main was the chicken masseman and egg noodles (the chicken came over lit candles which allowed it to stay hot the whole
meal and as someone who doesn't always enjoy rice, the noodles were an excellent accompaniment). The portion sizes are really good too.

For drinks, lychee martini and mock tail lychee drink. They were both really tasty.

No complaints on this meal at all, will be back again for sure.

Can’t believe I just found the cheapest and most authentic Thai boat noodles in London, only £3.75 a bowl at Sen-Sen Thai Boat Noodle Shop (basement of Patara, Maddox Street)! The thin noodles are perfectly chewy, the broth is rich and comforting, and the meats are spot on. On top of that, the crispy pork crackling is addictive, the crispy prawn dumplings and fried tofu are amazing, and the longan drink with chunky fruit is the perfect finish. Honestly, this place feels just like eating in Thailand – you have to try it!

I had an amazing meal here. It was my first Thai meal experience and it was worth every penny spent. The staff are amazingly courteous and friendly. The atmosphere is serene and cozy. The bathrooms are cleaner and hygienic. And the food,….my goodness…the food. I had the lamb with coconut rice. Let me start with how quickly they came out with the food. I was expecting to stay longer than I did waiting. The presentation was very good, my appetite rose exponentially on merely sighting the food.

When I dug in, the experience was much more exhilarating! The rice was perfectly done, the grains well cooked that they just rolled off your tongue into your throat! The curry sauce….awwww. Every single spice was alive in that sauce. It has a distinct sweet taste that went straight to your brain, bursting open sacks of serotonin and dopamine.

And lastly came the lamb itself, so succulent, it was like a being extending its hands to you to be lifted off its bone.

venues.name: MASA TURKISH RESTAURANT
venues.description: A taste of Turkey in the heart of London - sophisticated, authentic, and absolutely delicious. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

address.formatted: One Fine Deli, 617 Fulham Rd., London

venues.vicinity: One Fine Deli, 617 Fulham Rd., London

reviews.text: Highly recommend Masa. The food was wonderful, the people were so friendly and welcoming and the place was beautiful. Also everything was reasonably priced and big portions.

This restaurant is just recently opened may be couple of weeks ago.Since it has been opened,This is my 3rd time to come and try them.

Let me start with their menu;This is traditional Turkish cuisine however with loads of choices which is not many other Turkish restaurants have.This is one of the important detail that makes them privileged.They use fresh ingredients and daily preparation is taken place.
They are you experts what they are doing

I was lucky and had a chance to talk to owner and chef.
Owner has been in this industry more then 40 years which shows the outcome anyway from the location,taste to ambiance as well as the service.He is also fantastic chef as he also prepared something special to me by himself.
He is really very down to earth and very friendly
Also very funny guy.
I really loved the way he runs the business and also hosting his guests in his restaurant.

I also talked to the main chef  as he was standing behind the open kitchen.He is very approachable.He has been industry around 35 years.He said he used to work in hotel industry and was preparing variety of dishes for around 2000 people in one go and this was just for one round and everday.This is something incredible and beyond the admiration.I did all my best to try everything on the menu and even chef’s specials.They were soo delicious.

Plus,waiters are so lovely there.They are prompt,quick,responsible,smiley and friendly.
They really know what they are doing.
I admire them.

Quality wise from a to z is that this restaurant can be one of the top 3 not just in London also all across the UK.
They deserve the best and it is a must at least to be visited once in a life time.

Highly highly recommended
The most attentive and amazing staff, ambience and incredible food. We absolutely love this restaurant, live music( but not too loud) and the wine and food is incredible. It’s a must for all foodies!
Great restaurant with amazing staff! Mustafa and Alex are professional, friendly, and truly care about quality and service. Highly recommended!
Perfect food, service exceeding perfect. Great place, I would definitely come again. Everything tasted great and we felt very well served. Would definitely come again.

address.streetAddress: One Fine Deli, 617 Fulham Rd., London

venues.name: ANA Turkish Restaurant and Bar
venues.description: Turkish hospitality meets London sophistication - where every meal is a celebration. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
As a big fan of Middle Eastern cuisine, I can confidently say Turkish cuisine holds a special place in my heart, and this restaurant delivered wonderfully on that front. The food and quantity were amazing every cold meze we tried had a great balance of flavors, though I personally found the salt to be a pinch more than my preference. Nonetheless, well done to the chef for putting together such a delightful spread.

The atmosphere was decent not over the top, and not in your face, just right for a comfortable meal.

Service wise, it was fast and efficient, which I appreciate. However, there’s a difference between being served and feeling welcomed. While the male server was warm and smiling, the female server seemed like she was simply going through the motions, without much warmth or hospitality. These little touches make a difference, especially in an otherwise empty restaurant. Still, overall, the experience was great, and I’d happily come back for the food.

We had a fantastic experience at Ana Turkish Restaurant in Kensington! From the moment we walked in, we felt warmly welcomed. Our server Moh was absolutely wonderful – friendly, attentive, and genuinely kind. He made us feel at home and looked after us throughout the meal with such grace.

The food was incredibly tasty and truly authentic – every dish was full of flavour and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into the cooking. Whether you’re a fan of Turkish cuisine or trying it for the first time, this place will not disappoint!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for delicious food, great service, and a lovely atmosphere. Thank you, Moh, and the Ana team – we’ll definitely be back!

What a find! A truly delicious experience. The food is so well cooked, beautifully seasoned with such a freshness that is hard to beat. We had the best time here and the service was outstanding. Highly recommended.

Had mid-afternoon meal, very quiet but attentive service. We ordered the Ana sharer for 3/4 people and an extra side, the food was beautiful, taste and presentation! Came with a huge, tasty salad and a large side of chips. The meat was cooked perfectly and we finished everything. Finished off with some Turkish tea and baklava. Highly recommend this restaurant.
We had the cold Meze and Ana set for 2-3 persons. The food was very tasty, big portions and enjoyed my first Turkish beer. They're a relatively new business, and I would recommend supporting them.

venues.image_alt: ANA Turkish Restaurant and Bar — British

venues.name: Gökyüzü Green Lanes
venues.description: Informal family-run Turkish spot serving classic dishes cooked in a traditional oven.

reviews.text: Visiting in the UK, this restaurant was recommended by family members living in the neighborhood. It was an excellent suggestion. The food was delicious, savory and flavorful. The portions were much larger than the menu suggested and we enjoyed it all. Your most difficult choice is narrowing your selections from their extensive menu. You won't regret this meal.

My friend who lives around Hampstead introduced me to this place last year and since then we’ve been regular here to enjoy some genuinely good Turkish food!! The service here is always nice and the mixed platter is very generous and serves delicious meats alongside salad and Turkish rice! A must have and definitely bring your friends along! Good value for money!

This time we were served by Havni & Yaren who were great hosts and we recommend them for their attention to detail and hospitality

A proper Turkish restaurant. It was such a nice experience. Nice food full of flavour and cooked properly, nice service and friendly. Really big portions. We tried a lot of dishes and apart from one dish we liked all the rest.

We celebrated my dad's birthday at Gokyuzu, and it was a truly wonderful experience from start to finish. As soon as we walked in, the atmosphere felt warm and inviting, filled with a vibrant energy that made the occasion even more special.

The food was, without a doubt, the highlight of the evening. We ordered a variety of dishes, and everything was cooked to perfection. The lamacun, Adana kebab, and Turkish grilled beef cubes were incredibly tender and flavorful, clearly made with high-quality ingredients and expert grilling. The accompanying rice was light and fluffy, while the grilled peppers added a delightful touch. Each dish truly showcased authentic Turkish cuisine.

In addition to the amazing food, the service was exceptional. The staff were attentive and friendly, going out of their way to ensure we had a memorable evening. They even surprised my dad with a little something special for his birthday, which was a thoughtful gesture.

Gokyuzu is more than just a restaurant; it's a place where you can gather with loved ones and enjoy delicious food in a vibrant and welcoming setting. It was the perfect venue to celebrate my dad's birthday, and we left feeling happy and full, already looking forward to our next visit. If you're searching for a fantastic Turkish meal in a great atmosphere, look no further than Gokyuzu! Highly recommended.

We visited Gokyuzu and tried the breakfast sharing platter—it was absolutely amazing! Everything was so fresh and flavorful, and there was plenty for everyone to enjoy. My little one especially loved all the fruit and had so much fun dipping the simit into all the little spreads and treats they served. The service was also fantastic—friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. We can’t wait to come back!

venues.name: Efes Premium
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Food was amazing, top quality! Interiors and atmosphere were also great. Staff were lovely. Andrea served us, she was very patient, explained the menu and gave us recommendations, she was super friendly. Had the best time here :)

We visited for a birthday celebration and had a really lovely evening. The place itself is nicely decorated—modern, clean, and stylish, with a relaxed vibe that made it a nice setting for the occasion.

The food was delicious, full of flavour and well presented. You can tell a lot of thought goes into the dishes, and there was a good variety to choose from, which made it easy for everyone to find something they liked. The “Chocolate Dream” cake was a real standout—rich, indulgent, and the perfect way to end the meal.

A big shout out to our servers Ayten and Molly, who really made the evening special. They were so kind, respectful, and attentive throughout—nothing was too much trouble, and they looked after us really well.

Overall, it was a great night, and everything went smoothly. Would definitely recommend

We had a lovely breakfast here with my parents and two children. Ordered the Turkish breakfast, very tasty ! The restaurant is beautiful and the tea at the end of the meal was perfect. Will be back for lunch or dinner next time, thank you !

Efes Premium in Wimbledon is an absolute gem! From the moment we walked in, without a booking, we were greeted with such warmth and genuine hospitality – the customer service was truly outstanding. The team made us feel incredibly welcome and attended to our every need with a smile.
But it doesn't stop there; the cuisine is simply on another level. Each dish was a delightful exploration of authentic Turkish flavours, prepared with such care and precision. The quality of the food shone through in every bite – fresh ingredients, expertly seasoned and cooked to perfection. It's clear that Efes Premium takes immense pride in their culinary offerings.
If you're looking for a top-notch Turkish dining experience in Wimbledon, with exceptional service and truly high-quality food, look no further than Efes Premium. Highly, highly recommended!

I went here for lunch with my friend because I pass it everyday on my way to work and always loved the look of it.
It didn’t disappoint from the moment we arrived we were greeted with a very warm welcome.
We had the set menu (sorry I forgot to take any food pics)
I had the lamb donor wrap with chunky chips and it was absolutely flavoursome and seasoned well and cooked to perfection.
We are definitely going back soon in the evening  and will order from the main menu ( I will remember pics next time)
I will give everything about Effs a 10/10

about.text: Turkish · in Central London — Efes Premium (Rated 4.8★ · 921+ reviews · FSA 5/5) Efes Premium delivers confident turkish plates with a London edge. Order: adana kebab, mixed grill, and baklava. Great for date night, small groups, or a relaxed catch-up. Fair pricing for the quality.

venues.name: The Mantl
venues.description: Turkish restaurant offering traditional cuisine & a 6-course taster menu in an easygoing setting.

reviews.text:
I highly recommend this restaurant, we ordered many different dishes, and all of them were amazing. The meat was juicy and tender, and I liked the hummus. However the salad was simple, just punch of vegetables, and the rice was alright. The bread was amazing and remarkable, we asked them to give us some more bread for takeaway, and they gave it to us for free!, which was really nice from them.
The restaurant was clean and there was attention to details, for example the bathroom soap seems to be from an expensive brand. The staff were nice with us.

The service at The Mantl was absolutely lovely – especially one waiter who spoke Turkish with us and was extremely friendly and attentive. In terms of hospitality and staff, it’s definitely a five-star experience.

However, we were a bit disappointed with the value for money. We ordered two starters and one main dish, and although the food was decent in taste, the portion sizes were very small – even for starters. The main dish was also quite minimal, and considering the prices, the portions felt overpriced.

The quality of the food was good, but not exceptional – for example, the cooking level wasn’t perfectly on point. So overall, while the service was excellent, the food experience didn’t quite justify the price tag.

Rated as one of the best Turkish restaurants in London and boy did Mantl disappoint. They took great care of each dish, from 24-30 hour marination of the best cuts of meat to delicately presenting it when serving. The food blew us away and lived up to the hype. We were well looked after by Jacob upon arrival who explained the concept and preparation of the dishes. Whilst Ali, went out his way to make us feel hospitable and looked after our children which was quite welcoming - making us want to come back.

If you're in Knightsbridge, make sure to eat something here. You will not be disappointed.

A perfect setting to explore Turkish flavors, where the food offers original notes of lesser-known but incredibly delicious tastes.
The service is also attentive. We asked for recommendations on what dishes to order, and I believe the experience was so enjoyable thanks to that.

Celebrated my birthday at Mantl and it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The mixed grill for two featured premium, perfectly cooked meats that truly impressed. The atmosphere is warm and inviting - ideal for special occasions or anyone looking to savour authentic, high-quality Turkish cuisine.

Attentive service completed the package, making the whole evening feel effortlessly special. A definite 10/10 and one of the best dining experiences I’ve had recently, and will easily return again

venues.name: Cirrik 19 Numara Bos
venues.description: Contemporary, family-run ocakbasi barbeque restaurant featuring natural wines & cocktails.

reviews.text: Food was amazing! Great atmosphere and service. The owner recommended their dishes and the recommendations did not disappoint. Thank you for having us - we’ll be back.

One of the best restaurants I have ever been to. Outstanding food, incredible flavours and the staff were so attentive, kind and lovely. Couldn't fault a thing! A must try. I'd recommend every day of the week.

⭐️⭐️⭐️✨ (3.5/5)
⚖️ 5/10

Ordered via Deliveroo 🚴‍♂️ — with a promo applied, the total came to £23.25 for the Et Beyti Yoğurtlu (£15.05) and chips (£2.80) 🍟. For the price, I can’t complain — it felt fair enough 💷. Delivery took just over an hour ⏰, which was reasonable, but by the time it landed the food had already lost its freshness.

The chips were limp and stale 🥱, lacking any crispness or warmth. The rice was standard 🍚 — no seasoning, no aroma, just a plain filler on the plate. The Beyti itself was decent but uninspired 🥙: yoghurt gave it tang, the meat had some flavour, but nothing that stood out or carried that fresh-off-the-grill vibrancy 🔥.

Overall, a mediocre, mid-tier experience 😐. Edible, yes — but uninspired. I genuinely think the food would be far better fresh at the restaurant 🍽️, where the grill and seasoning could actually shine.

Would I order delivery again? ❌ Doubt it.
Would I visit in person? ✅ Most likely.

Speechless!!! Outstanding food, couldn’t fault anything! Very authentic turkish food and the most lovely staff. Will be returning on our next visit. Just try the patlican ezme (roasted aubergine) and the hummus is to die for!! A hidden gem in Dalston. Super affordable they do a lunch deal for 13.50 per person
This was the first restaurant in London that I would say was actually very good. Nice personal, interesting flavours.

venues.name: Liman Restaurant
venues.description: Mediterranean specialties dished up in an understated destination with a warm vibe.

reviews.text: I’ve been here twice for lunch — and it’s honestly out of this world! Such a cozy, welcoming atmosphere, and the staff is incredibly friendly. The food is absolutely amazing: you must try the meatballs and the chicken kebab — they’re perfection. And their fish was fresh and beautifully cooked. This is one of those places you just keep coming back to 🙌Highly recommend!

Absolutely fantastic! The lamb chops were the best lamb I’ve ever had. Succulent and cooked perfectly. The hummus starter with crispy pitta was beautiful too, and the service was brilliant. Couldn’t recommend any higher! I asked for some more sauce for the lamb because it was absolutely beautiful. Gizem was a super helpful waitress!

What a great find! I recently had dinner here and was thoroughly impressed. I kicked things off with the calamari, and let me tell you, it was a home run. It was perfectly crispy and flavorful, and they certainly don't skimp on the portion. The real star of the show, though, was the lamb shank. It was cooked to perfection—so tender it practically melted off the bone. On top of all that, the service was top-notch. The staff were on the ball, always checking in and more than happy to help with anything we needed. Highly recommend!

An absolutely wonderful experience here at Liman restaurant! We held a 70th birthday celebration and the staff were amazing, so accommodating and helpful. We were able to decorate the place to our liking and the ambience was incredible, intimate and classy. We had the set menu for our guests and the food was sooo good! A good variety, well presented and delicious. Our guests are still raving about it days later! Even when they ran out of our dessert option, they were able to pivot smoothly and offer a lovely alternative. A truly wonderful experience, we highly recommend 👌

One of the best dinners I’ve had in a while! We ordered the calamari for starters and had complimentary Turkish bread which was delicious!
The main dinner was mixed grill, lamb skewers, lamb chops and shanks which was so lovely and cooked to perfection 😋

venues.name: Antalya
venues.description: Lavish, colourful frescoes adorn this vibrant restaurant for classic Turkish and Mediterranean fare.

reviews.text: Antalya Restaurant was a fantastic find in the heart of London. We sat outdoors on a warm summer evening, and the setting was perfect, relaxed and inviting. The food was full of authentic Turkish flavour, beautifully presented, and made with fresh ingredients. From the grilled meats to the baklava, everything was delicious. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great Turkish food, especially in the summer. Thank you again for the amazing food and service! We will definitely come back again ☺️🙏

Stumbled above this restaurant on the way from the train station to our hotel and what a wonderful find it was!! Lunch was beyond a bargain. The chicken wrap was delicious and as for the Rosè… stunning. Our waiter Fatih was so friendly and welcoming. Such a gorgeous start to our holiday in London.

Tried the lunch deal and opted for the mezze meal option, definitely not worth almost £20 for the quantity given. Food was average, I was expecting a lot more considering the high reviews. The other dish in the picture is the lamb iskander, which was also alright, again not worth nearly £25. I'd probably skip this and get better value for money + better tasting food elsewhere.

My husband and I dined at Antalya last month when we visited London for two days. It was near the hotel we were staying in so we decided to try it. What a culinary delight! We were greeted immediately and made to feel welcome. Our phenomenal server was Fatih. He was attentive, friendly and a joy to talk with! He made our experience extra special!!

The food was delicious and fresh. I love lamb and had the lamb lokkum the first time we visited. I also had the Antalya heal, which was amazing!!

We went back for the second time on our last night. Much to our delight, we got Fatih again!! It was like seeing an old friend!

If we are ever in London again, we will for sure dine at Antalya!! It was a very special place for us and we have fond memories of the food and Fatih!

I would highly, highly recommend this classy and authentic Turkish restaurant. A bonus is that it is near the British museum!!
I’ve been there several times. The food is delicious, the staff is welcoming and kind. When I go to London, this is the first restaurant I choose. Service is fast and menu has variety of options.
