venues.description: Peruvian BBQ, ceviche and pisco cocktails served in a bright environment, reminiscent of urban Lima.

reviews.text:
Senor Ceviche is a fantastic spot for anyone who loves vibrant, flavorful food. The dishes are absolutely delicious, packed with fresh ingredients and bold tastes that really stand out. Pairing the food with their fantastic selection of drinks makes the experience even better, whether you’re after something refreshing or a little stronger.

On top of the great food and drinks, the atmosphere of the restaurant has such a great feel—warm, lively, and welcoming. The lovely staff go above and beyond to make sure you’re well looked after, adding to the overall charm. It’s the perfect place to relax, enjoy, and come away feeling like you’ve had a really special meal.

This was our first experience with Peruvian food and we had no expectations going in. To our surprise, we loved it! It’s the best food we've had in London so far! Every dish was incredibly delicious and the drinks were great too. The restaurant gets fully booked quickly, but they do accept walk-ins. It's the perfect spot for a date or a dinner with friends. We will definitely return!

I went to this restaurant for my birthday and everything was fantastic—the service, the atmosphere, and the food. If I could give it more stars, I definitely would. It's a bit pricey, but every bite was worth it—the food was absolutely delicious. A truly delightful experience.

At the end of the meal, the restaurant took a Polaroid-style photo of us for my birthday and gave it to me as a keepsake. Such a thoughtful and lovely gesture. I totally recommend this place. I had an amazing time and enjoyed every moment.

I have been coming to Señor Ceviche for YEARS and I can’t believe I’m only leaving a review now! I have never been disappointed, they have some of the best ceviche I’ve ever had and their chifa chicharrones are to die for. Service is always so nice and impeccable and today had the pleasure to be served by Diana who tempted me into trying the brunch menu, which was amazing value for money! The chocolate mousse for dessert was outstanding. A great choice and pretty much everything on the menu is a safe option cos you just know it’s gonna be delicious! Can’t wait to be back!
Lovely vibe in restaurant. Waitress explained the menu & was very knowledgeable. Fantastic food, every dish was 10/10. The cocktails were so tasty too! Will be returning.

venues.name: Kricket Shoreditch - Kafé, Restaurant & Bar
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Very friendly waiter and exquisite food. We asked the waiter to surprise us. That worked out very well! Indian with modern touch/feel to it. Fresh and comforty food, with subtle flavours as well as small explosion bombs, without being heavy or fatty. Loved the color scheme and the space. Hope to come back. In the meantime I hope the will consider a restaurant in Amsterdam.

Nice place and it did get very busy! The waiter telling us we only had 30 minutes to eat out mains was not good. Otherwise food is good, I recommend the venison. The coconut lassi was not for me and also if you order their chai tell them you want it hot otherwise they will serve it cold! Odd but true.

Went to Kricket in Shoreditch for dinner and had a really good time. The vibe was cool and relaxed, and the staff were friendly. Food was packed with flavour – a great mix of traditional Indian with a modern twist. They even brought out a grilled squash dish on the house, which was a nice surprise (and actually really good!). Everything we ordered was tasty and well put together.
Great Indian food. The best biryani I have had in a long time. The shrimp and chicken were delicious as well. We liked this place better than Dishoom.

Delicious and unique flavours of India with a twist. Beautiful pink decor. Friendly service. Recommend the pork neck curry, samosa and all the naan breads. The fried chicken could have been crispier and more flavourful. Overall a great experience

Order: butter chicken, dal makhani, and fresh naan. Great for family gatherings, spice lovers, or a comforting curry night. Fair pricing for the quality.

venues.name: Blacklock Shoreditch
venues.description: Set in a renovated furniture factory with mid-century, industrial interiors & modern, British menu.

reviews.text:
Fantastic food and generous portions.

My wife said it was the best lamb she’s ever had, and even as someone who doesn’t usually eat lamb, I thought it was perfectly cooked.

The brisket was tender, flavorful, and fell right off the bone.

The cauliflower mac and cheese was delightful as well.

Drinks were spot-on – balanced and not too sweet., and my server was extremely helpful in choosing the best ones.

The atmosphere has a lovely old English pub feel, which really adds to the experience. Highly recommend!

Delicious Sunday Roast Dinner! They sat me quickly & food was brought out hot & savory.  Very nice cuts of beef and yummy gravy.  Yorkshire pudding was phenomenal.  Carrots,
potatoes, and cabbage were perfect sides.  Nice wines by the glass and the martini was perfect. Great service.

We had an absolutely amazing dinner here! We did the all in which was £28 for some starter bites, 3 pieces of deliciously cooked meat, flatbread and a side each. Everything was cooked perfectly and flavoured so well. The staff were super friendly and helpful with the order too. Definitely recommend!

I'm going to be dreaming about the next time I eat here again. Everything from the food, service, and atmosphere was amazing! I loved how prompt the service was despite it being busy. We got the All-In Sunday Roast and it was so delicious. The meat is super tender and the potatoes have such a crispy texture. Not to mention the unlimited gravy refills. The drink flavors there are really unique and refreshing. Large assortment of different alcohol as well. The atmosphere here is really bustling and laid-back, and I would recommend going here for a date or just to hang out with friends and family.

First but not last visit to Blacklock for Sunday roast. Great food in (very) generous portions with equally generous servings of gravy, as well as attentive and friendly staff. The star of the meal was the meat and the roast veggies. Recommended to book a table!

venues.name: Popolo Shoreditch
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Great menu and a little overpriced, Italian tapas style. Loved the freshness and quality of the ingredients, really top notch.
Only natural wines, which was a deciding factor for me.
Overpriced for the size of the dishes and the size of the restaurant, and they will put the bill on the table as soon you put your fork down.

We went to Popolo because it was recommended in the local Michelin guide. The food and service was good, but we would not come back a second time, as we expected a bit more in this price range. Especially the size of the portions was a bit disappointing (£20 for 9 Gnocchi and £7.5 for 3 slices of Focaccia).

The food is nice. Favourite is actually the bread and pork cheek pasta. However, I find it hard to justify the price, especially the smaller portion you are getting. I mean the asparagus is fresh and juicy but 17 pound is a bit too steep. And the 6 piece of pasta for 28 pound. Ummmmm..

We were lucky to score two seats at the bar around 9pm on a Thursday evening and what a treat it turned out to be!

We ordered the focaccia, burrata with chickpeas and olives, the crab pasta and the beef with salsa verde. Everything was beautifully prepared, but the standout by far was the crab pasta, unbelievably good and packed with flavour. It’s the kind of dish you want to go back for!!

What also stood out was the open kitchen. It’s a compact space, and with the bar seating wrapped around it, you get a full view of the action. Despite the pressure and pace, the chefs remained impressively calm and focused, quietly producing plate after plate of delicious food. It’s no small feat to work in such a visible and intense environment, hats off to them.

One lovely personal touch: I didn’t manage to get a photo of the fish (which was excellent), but when the chef noticed I was struggling a little with the bones, he kindly came over and helped us debone it. Such thoughtful service.

Highly recommend Popolo—great food, a cosy vibe, and seriously talented chefs who make it all look effortless.
Food was great , absolutely loved the pork cheek agnolotti I. Particular and the basque cheeses cake is a must have!

venues.name: SMOKESTAK
venues.description: A smoker and grill take centre stage at this stylishly rustic barbecue joint with a bar and terrace.

reviews.text:
We shared this feast among 5 people, and it was absolutely perfect.

The brisket, pulled pork, and ribs were all smoky, tender, and rich in flavour — each with its own character but balanced beautifully together. The sausage added a nice contrast, juicy and slightly spicy. Everything came with thoughtful sides: pickles, chili slices, and that signature house BBQ sauce that ties it all together.

The charred greens with feta, pomegranate, and nuts were a great fresh counterpoint to the meat platter, and the fries with aioli disappeared instantly. Drinks were excellent too — the house lemonade with chili and lime was surprisingly refreshing and unique.

Service was friendly and efficient, the vibe industrial rustic and warm, and the food came out perfectly timed for sharing.

If you’re visiting with a small group and want to taste a bit of everything, go for the shared meat platter — it’s spot-on in both portion and variety.

📍 SMOKESTAK, Shoreditch
🔥 Perfect for: small groups, casual dinners, meat lovers, and anyone craving authentic slow-smoked BBQ in London.

Fantastic meal. The meat was outstanding, and the starters and sides were just as good. Service was great, with spot-on recommendations. Portions are generous and the prices match the quality. It’s a busy place, so booking ahead is wise if you don’t want to gamble on a last-minute table. We ended up outside since that’s all that was left, but with perfect weather it turned into a highlight rather than a drawback.

We absolutely knew the food was going to be top tier, but it was the service that really smashed it out of the park here. From the moment we were greeted on the door by Kitty and Cristian, the rapport and bonhomie was already a dead cert: Charming, cheerful and a little cheeky in all the right quantities, we were promised VIP treatment from the get go, and boy did we get it. The equally charming Alexandra took our order, but sat opposite the pass, even the chefs engaged us in a deeply convivial manner, only ever enabled by an open kitchen like this.

Attentive, affable, and amusing, the team put on the perfect display of service with a smile, with a dash of well placed humour to really make us feel like part of the furniture or family….. not sure which.

Go here, eat well, and enjoy the experience created by an exceedingly well-matched team who love their jobs (I hope)!

The toffee dessert and the pork dishes are amazing. They are juicy and tender, especially the pork belly, highly recommended! Beef is a bit tough. Reasonable price. We sat downstairs and it was a bit dim. The taste of eggplant is subtle and there is too much raw green onion. Its strong flavour overpowers the dish.

May come back for the pork dishes.

Super cool place. Exceptional service from David!!! Very knowledgeable and attentive. We got a starter, 2 mains and one dessert 🍮 and a sorbet 🏠 super full for 2 people.

Definitely the sticky toffee pudding stood out the most. Good combo and not greasy. Warm dessert on a cool day. Otherwise beef brisket, beef ribs (super soft) and oxtail are all recs from us.
Great thanks to David again very observative, when the starter came he realised we were waiting so he asked if we preferred all dishes to come together, and also when the bottles were empty he bought a new one without us saying or asking 💓. Super lovely and made us feel very welcomed. Definitely a revisit soon.

venues.name: Camino Shoreditch
venues.description: Colourful, eclectic venue with a relaxed ambiance for inventive Spanish tapas and interesting wines.

reviews.text: The food was generally very good, but the mushroom coca was truly unique and special — the best mushrooms I’ve ever tasted. The succulent pig was a little on the dry side, but everything else was excellent. The service was outstanding, and the atmosphere was beautiful, with wonderfully tasteful décor.
Firstly, the service was top notch. Lovely, friendly staff. The food was as good as I’ve had in Barcelona. They even got it out to me in a couple of minutes as I was in a rush. 10/10 will be back.

Ended up going twice on two consecutive nights! Really nice tapas, selection wasn't huge but everything I had was really well done. Ended up trying both the tomato bread, tortilla, ox cheek, flattened pork, croquettes, bravas, padron peppers and the cheesecake. Everything was really tasty. Cheesecake in particular was incredible - creamy but not too sweet. Prices were about what I expect for the area. Service from Sergio and the other guy (sorry didnt catch his name!) was really friendly and attentive. Will 100% be back when I'm in the area again.

Went to Camino a while back for a bit of dinner with an old pal and it was a really enjoyable experience. The place was quiet (which is why I’ve only given 4 stars for atmosphere) but the food was great, the wine was delicious and the over experience was top notch.

Highly recommend Camino if you are looking for somewhere for good quality tapas that’s centre to the City or Shoreditch

Really good tapas dishes with decent portions. We had 6 plates between the 2 of us and that was enough to fill us up. It was relatively quiet as it was a sat afternoon but would expect it to be busy in the evenings. Would definitely recommend

venues.name: 34 Mayfair
venues.description: British game and world meats cooked on an imported Argentinian grill in art deco-inspired brasserie.

address.formatted: 34 Grosvenor Sq, S Audley St, London

venues.vicinity: 34 Grosvenor Sq, S Audley St, London

reviews.text:
Went here on day 1 of our London trip for anniversary dinner.

Fancy interior and utensils.
Food was delicious, particularly hummus and broccoli.

Staff were friendly and kind and they also have live music.

Definitely recommend for dates/friends gathering/family dinner.

This place is amazing. We had outdoor seating which I highly recommend if the weather is nice. My wife had the lemon sole, which was the special of the day and I had the ribeye. Both were very good, but the real winner here were the desserts. We had the chocolate fondant tart and the homemade donuts. I'm not sure how both of them can rank in our top 10 desserts ever, but they do. We're in town for a week and are already planning to go back for dessert again. Highly recommended!
And a word about our server, Remus - he was fantastic. Very attentive, helpful with suggestions and quick to clear dirty plates. While we were there a lady at the table next to us (seating is very close) complained to him about a menu item that was not available. He responded apologetically but she wouldn't take no for an answer she continued on and on and made mention of how betrayed she felt and that she felt like she was lied to by the receptionist she spoke with earlier in the day. Remus maintained his composure and continued to respond kindly to her. The situation was clearly beyond Remus' control. Much respect to him for handling the situation with grace.

Today, we had lunch at the 34 Mayfair in London. The food was not that great but not bad either. However, the portion sizes were very, very small. The octopus was minuscule. Avoiding gluten was impossible no matter how carefully one orders. The matcha-based non-alcoholic drink was quite disappointing – it was overpowered with lemon and didn’t taste like it had any matcha. Additionally, the salad looked limp and the leaves didn’t seem very fresh. Also, all bread was sweet. Riffle with chicken tasted good but the coating on the chicken didn’t stick well and the croffle was too sweet to be in that dish. The sole was good. Overall, it was just an okay meal, not really a great experience.
An average fine dining. My favorite Mac & cheese. Others liked the steak but we all agreed that the burrata salad wasn’t a great choice.
One of my best dinner experience in London. Definitely coming back. My wife loved it so much. The food is top notch and the staffs are awesome.

venues.name: Gaia Mayfair
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: The foods don’t worth the price！The seafood pasta was way too sweet and the broccoli was not even cooked. Raw prawn (50pounds per)and scallops (28-29pounds per scallop and we ordered 2) def don’t worth their money …. As well as I feel I am spending money for a Michelin but I literally sat in a noisy pub🤯Having my friend birthday here and both of us were super disappointed .we did not order a drink so no comment lol..

Gaia in Mayfair is a stylish and upscale Greek restaurant with a fine-dining atmosphere. The place has a chic, modern vibe — exactly what you’d expect in this part of London. The food is exquisite, with authentic Greek flavours and a sharing-style concept that makes the experience more enjoyable and social. The quality is excellent, and the service is just as impressive. Overall, it’s a fantastic spot for a refined Greek dining experience in the heart of Mayfair.

The food and atmosphere were nice, we ordered the seafood orzo, mousaka, truffle potato’s, sea bream, and frozen yoghurt for dessert. All these dishes tasted lovely. We had to return the chicken dish because it had a smell, was chewy and quite tasteless. The manager was nice enough to speak to the chef and cut it from our bill as we weren’t able to eat it and had it returned to the kitchen. The only reason I’m rating it 4 stars was due to the fact we felt a little rushed to place our orders. The service was good, but the front of house reception staff member was rude as we arrived 15 minutes late to a reservation which we did call in advance to let them know we were running behind schedule and they told us that it’s fine and they would hold our reservation, baring in mind when we arrived the restaurant it was half empty and there was lots of space as we left a couple of hours later. Other than that experience, the staff allocated to serving our table were kind and knowledgeable about the menu. The wait staff good suggestions and recommendations and they were attentive to our table. Really friendly and polite.

perfect ambiance. the service was amazing and our waiter helped us so so so much. she was so friendly and we loved her service. the food was SOO good and i loved it. the mousaka is AMAZING. the grilled prawns were the best ive ever had. these two, you CANNOT miss! i really recomend the taziki and greek salad as they are so yummy, fresh and perfect staples. for mains, we got the grilled chicken to share, which was so fresh and marinated so well. the side, the truffle potatoes are amazing and a must try. ofcourse, the froszen yogurt is also amazing and i really recomend. overall really yummy and great place.

Gaia is one of the London restaurants that you want to go to, the food was nice and the waters were so welcoming, they took us to our table and we requested to change it and they helped directly.

The atmosphere was nice with a little bit noise but you can easily talk and hear..

For the food we tried the steak and it was juicy and perfect, the linguine pasta was nice with the lobster also.

Generally i like the place and for sure I will come again to try different dishes.

venues.name: Corrigan's Mayfair
venues.description: Modern gourmet cuisine in a high-end destination highlighting thoughtfully sourced ingredients.

reviews.text:
Had a lovely lunch at Corrigan’s. The ambience is elegant but welcoming, with a classic interior that makes the experience feel special without being overly formal. Service was smooth and attentive, creating a relaxed pace to enjoy the meal.

The food was fresh, simple, and well executed. Each dish was cleanly presented with good ingredients allowed to shine — from the light starters to the perfectly cooked fish and thoughtful desserts. A refined lunch that balances comfort and finesse.

Just stunning! Service was exemplary, perfectly attentive but not at all intrusive. Everyone was charming and extremely knowledgeable, from the barman who served our drinks beforehand and chatted to us, through to all the waiting staff. Our food was sublime (shellfish cocktail, asparagus; whole rabbit for two; souffle and ice-creams), each dish was technically excellent, tasted amazing but also generously portioned. The sommelier's suggested wine pairings were lovely and didn't take advantage in terms of price per glass. We can't fault the evening.

I think this was the most delicious meal that I have ever eaten!! Every mouthful was sumptuous. This restaurant is a real treat of a place, not only wonderful food, but lovely, kind and attentive staff. I could have stayed all day. Thank you for such a fabulous experience. I felt truly spoilt. If ever you get a chance to go here - take it!

What a wonderful meal and experience. Service was attentive and friendly, the food was truly excellent, the wine pairings superb. We were using a Virgin Experience voucher, but were treated as honoured guests. The rooms are beautiful - a perfect background for a romantic lunch. No hesitation whatsoever recommending Corrigans for a (very) special occasion. Pricey, sure, but worth every penny.

So impressed with this restaurant! We made a last-minute reservation near our hotel and felt so lucky to have the opportunity to dine here. The food was amazing and we tried dishes that we had never had before under the recommendation of the staff. Presentation and taste was absolutely excellent. The shining star of the night however was the sommelier. His recommendation was perfect for our palette and the courses we selected. I felt the restaurant was upscale, yet warm and welcoming, regardless of what you were wearing or where you were from. Highly recommend you check this place out if you are in London!

venues.name: Hakkasan
venues.description: Dim sum, Modern Cantonese delicacies and signature cocktails on 2 floors with designer decoration.

reviews.text:
I first came to Hakkasan back in 2016 — nine years ago — and I’ve been in love with this place ever since. Few restaurants in London have managed to maintain such a consistent level of excellence over time. Every visit feels just as special as the first.

From the moment you step in, the atmosphere envelops you: dim lighting, elegant music, and that signature balance of modern luxury and intimacy that only Hakkasan can create. The service is always refined yet relaxed, perfectly matching the restaurant’s understated sophistication.

The food remains absolutely outstanding. The crispy duck salad, the black truffle roasted duck, and the legendary pipa duck are on another level — perfectly cooked, flavourful, and beautifully presented. The dim sum selection and wagyu beef dishes are equally impressive, with every bite showing precision and artistry.

Over the years, Hakkasan has never lost its magic. It continues to set the standard for contemporary Cantonese cuisine in London — a place where perfection feels effortless. Whether for a celebration or a quiet dinner, it remains one of my all-time favourites.

Simply exceptional — from the duck to the cocktails, everything is top-tier.

We had an amazing time at Hakkasan Mayfair. We visited before but came back again. Love this place. The dimsums are just amazing. The food is amazing as usual. But what’s also really great is the ambience and the warmth with which you are received and hosted every single time. It was an amazing meal from such amazing hosts.

I am deeply disappointed by my experience at this restaurant. The environment was far from pleasant — the basement dining area was extremely noisy, with loud music and people shouting over each other. It felt more like a chaotic market than a restaurant.
Despite the place not being full, the food took an unreasonably long time to arrive. When I asked about it, the waiter casually said the kitchen was busy. I ordered the second most expensive set menu, expecting a quality meal, but it was a complete letdown. None of the dishes were tasty or authentic. The roast duck and dim sum were just acceptable, but everything else was barely edible. At least three dishes were so unpleasant that we asked the waiter to take them away after just one bite. Most of the food was overly sour, strange, and unbalanced — the so-called “champagne honey fish” even tasted rotten.
When we told the waiter that the food really wasn’t to our taste and asked for the dishes to be removed, he simply took them turned away without any reaction. The service throughout the meal was slow and indifferent. And to make matters worse, they still added a 15% service charge.
Overall, it was one of the most disappointing dining experiences I’ve ever had — poor food, poor service, and a completely unpleasant atmosphere.

Upon entry, we were greeted by exceptionally polite security staff who felt more welcoming than typical security. Inside, the wonderfully decorated space, bathed in dim lighting, offered a convenient bag and coat check. The front desk staff provided a warm greeting, and since we were early, we had the option to sit at the bar or proceed to our table. Naturally, I checked out the bar, which was pleasant with good service.
Descending the stairs, past the nicely segregated dining areas, it was impossible not to notice how busy and well-organized the venue was. At our table, the waiting staff introduced themselves and presented menus, including various options (if you're on a budget, it's wise to plan your meal in advance). The service was good, though there was a little room for improvement. The food, however, was excellent and cooked to perfection.
As I had mentioned it was a special occasion when reserving and confirming, our dessert arrived with a lovely personalized touch, which was much appreciated. Overall, we felt we got what we paid for, and I would highly recommend it.

The atmosphere was nice, although the lighting was a little dim, but that wasn't a problem. The service was excellent and professional, and the food was delicious. The first course, the dim sum, every bite tasted different and was very delicious. The steamed Chilean sea bass, it tastes delicious, you can't stop eating it. In short, dishes with no mistakes. Although a little expensive, I highly recommend it to those who love food and special flavours.

venues.name: Bluebird Chelsea
venues.description: European food and cocktails in smart spot with monochrome floor tiles, feature lighting and terrace.

reviews.text:
Coming to Bluebird was a great experience from start to finish. The ambiance was vibrant yet relaxed, making it a perfect spot for both casual outings and special occasions. One of the first things we noticed was how warm and welcoming the staff were—friendly, attentive, and professional. The service was truly top-notch, easily a 10/10.

We appreciated the flexibility of having both indoor and outdoor seating options, which is always a plus depending on the weather. We chose to sit outdoor this time as the weather was lovely plus they had the heaters on .

For our meal, we ordered a beautifully cooked salmon dish and a plate of gnocchi. Both dishes were excellent—flavorful, well-presented, and satisfying. The portion sizes were just right, leaving us room to try dessert. We couldn’t resist ordering one to share, and it turned out to be a great decision—the dessert was absolutely delicious and provided the perfect end to our meal.

Given the central location and the high quality of food and service, we found the prices to be quite reasonable. We paid roughly £90 in total, which included a beer and a cider.

We’d definitely come back again and would recommend Bluebird to others!

Took my mum here for a birthday lunch and it was such a lovely experience. The food was absolutely delicious (Caesar salad was perfect) and the team were so friendly and welcoming. They really spoiled my mum and made it feel special, and we never felt rushed.

The salmon here is absolutely outstanding – truly the best I’ve ever had. Perfectly cooked, tender, and full of flavor, it really shows the chef’s skill and attention to detail. If you love salmon, this place sets a new standard!

A spacious restaurant with a very good decoration but the food was average and expensive compared to allow other similar in the are.
The worst of all at least today was the service. Our waiter was exceptional but something was wrong in the kitchen. Although at the time we have been there almost half of the takes were free or under reservation however it took more than 20 minutes to serve us even when we asked for additional drink.

We sat outside, table for 5. Really friendly service. We had two steaks, burger and chips and I also had the crab starter - all were excellent. Looking at the other guests, next time I'm going to order from the bar snacks instead of a main meal because the chicken burger and burger from the snack menu was very reasonably priced compared to the full menu and they looked a good size too!

about.text: British · in Central London — Bluebird Chelsea (Rated 4.3★ · 4,674+ reviews · FSA 5/5) Bluebird Chelsea delivers confident british plates with a London edge. venues.name: The Chelsea Corner
venues.description: Polished Italian restaurant prepping pizza, pasta, meat dishes & fish, plus cocktails & wine.

reviews.text: As a tourist, I felt absolutely welcome here. The service, and our waiter, Rose, were nothing short of amazing. We first ordered drinks and they were very good, and then we ordered our food. Rose forgot to put in our orders at first, which wasn’t a big deal. We are all humans, we make mistakes, but in light of that, she gave us a free round of drinks. Rose was a very great waitress. Very cordial, professional, and friendly. Our food was absolutely delicious and it was overall a 10/10 experience. If I’m ever back in London, I will for sure be coming back here.

We were having dinner at The chelsea corner in the spring in 2023.
Love the Lamp chops and the vibe of the restaurant. We also ordered a bottle of wine that’s really highlight the meal up to the next level.
The staff provides good service when we were there, thanks a lot.

Our dinner tonight at the Chelsea Corner was hands down the best dinner we’ve had on our 9 day trip to London. Carl and Francis took excellent care of us and made sure we were well taken care of. The Mozzarella garlic bread with caramelized onions was the perfect start to our meal. The pasta was fresh with perfect portion and  presentation. I had the prawns, another had the bolognese special, and my daughter only wanted chicken Alfredo, which wasn’t on the menu, but they made it for her and it was delicious! We finished with sorbet and tiramisu which were both light and refreshing. Gent, the bartender, poured excellent drinks and remembered our special orders. If you’re like us and tired of pub food and want something different and satisfying, look no further than Chelsea Corner! I wish it wasn’t so far away from New Jersey. It’s saved for next time though!

What a fabulous meal. Delicious, freshly prepared and tasty food, buzzy restaurant, and lovely staff.

Vee our server was very attentive, always there to check in, bring us another drink and just generally an all round friendly guy.

Very reasonably priced and worth the trip!

Our server Carl was AMAZING. Tough night after a Chelsea loss, but he made it so much better for us! Asked if they could do spaghetti carbonara and he was able to ask the chef who said yes! Service, drinks, food, all 5 stars. A win is a win! Thank you Carl!

address.formatted: Our Most Holy Redeemer, 50 Cheyne Walk, London

venues.vicinity: Our Most Holy Redeemer, 50 Cheyne Walk, London

reviews.text:
So, we went for Sunday lunch the other day at No 50 Cheyne. The food was seriously yummy, the place itself was gorgeous, and the people working there were mostly nice.

But, and it's a big but, the wait times were just awful. We got there maybe five or ten minutes early, but still had to hang around for like twenty minutes before our table was even ready.

After we finally seated by staff, it took another 20minutes for our drinks to show up.

I get that Sundays can be crazy busy, you know? But, we waited, get this, 50 to 60minutes for our food to come after we ordered! That meant we didn't eat until about an 1hrs and a half after we were supposed to.

It was especially tough with a 5year old child with us. The only reason they gave us was that the steak needed to be cooked, which is the most hilarious excuse I’ve had for a long wait for a meal, and I didn't really buy that, to be honest.

Basically, we liked the food and the vibe, it’s a bit pricey for a Sunday roast, but the long waits made us feel a little… unappreciated, I guess.

It's a real pity, because it could have been a fantastic experience.

Having seen a review by eatingwithtod, we were looking forward to Sunday Lunch. As nice as it was, it unfortunately didn’t quite live up to expectations.

Nice welcome and lovely server. Order was taken quick enough and the trio of meats was served fairly quickly too. However, the chicken was dry and the lamb and beef were tough. Shining light was the roast potatoes and chocolate mousse for dessert. But for the price, I’d expected better and we kept having to ask for our Prosecco to be topped up! The waitress who initially served us seemed to be rushed off her feet.

Staff were really pleasant and very professional they made us feel welcomed. The beef wellington was great. As well as the lobster. The deserts were delicious to. The decor was beautiful and the washing facilities were very clean of a very good standard. The only thing we didn't really like was the prawns but they weren't too bad but probably won't get them again. But I really would go back again even just for the wellington.

We were in London for 8 days. We had dinner at your restaurant the last night. It was by far the best dining experience we had. The Beef Wellington was cooked perfectly!  Everyone was so nice. To the gentleman that we spoke with who had been to Alabama (sorry, we can't remember your name), you were very welcoming and nice to speak with. Thank you for allowing us to take a menu to commemorate our perfect dining experience!  Sincerely, Jason and Mary Jo Montgomery.

Me and my Girlfriend has a Sunday dinner there. The food was amazing the service wonderful. I had the lamb and it melted in my mouth, she had the roast beef. We both had sticky toffee pudding for dessert.

A couple nearby had a shared beef wellington that looked amazing. We will be back in the future to try it.

venues.name: Granger & Co. Chelsea
venues.description: Eclectic fare with an Australian flair served in a simple setting with a sophisticated vibe.

reviews.text: The atmosphere and service are excellent, and it’s truly enjoyable to sit here. I’ve been here many times and come frequently, as the breakfast options are amazing with plenty to choose from. The main courses are decent, though not as impressive as the breakfast, but overall it’s a place I would definitely recommend.

No matter how many years pass, this branch maintains the same great quality and service. I always have at least one breakfast there whenever I visit London. The ricotta pancakes, scrambled eggs, and coffee are excellent. My all-time favorite side is the roasted miso mushrooms, though they seemed less seasoned during my last visit.

Good brunch spot in London. Granger & Co served some delicious food if not overpriced in my opinion for what it is and portion size. I definitely recommend reserving a table as the wait for it is around 30 minutes for late breakfast/lunch times and then we waited quite a long time for the food itself. I really enjoyed my corn fritters however I had to order extra bacon with it. Good thing I did as without it I would find a dish a bit lacking, hence paid more than £20. However, I would say once in a year or so I could treat myself. Thank you, delicious 😊
Great service. The menu feels very basic and I honestly don’t get the hype. The one thing that might bring me back is the location. Sitting on Pavilion Road on a nice day is truly irreplaceable.

I really enjoyed this restaurant. The food was fresh, flavorful, and a bit out of the ordinary.

They add a 12.5% service charge, but it’s worth it—the staff are attentive, offering water and making sure you’re well looked after.

venues.name: The Cadogan Arms
venues.description: Modern British gastropub with darkwood interior and mounted stag antlers, plus upstairs pool room.

reviews.text:
The Cadogan Arms – Sunday Roast

This was easily one of the top two restaurants we visited on our trip.

Reservations: Highly recommended—this place gets busy, especially for Sunday roast.

Service: Friendly, fast, and attentive. No complaints at all.

Food: My wife and I shared the Native Rump of Beef Roast, which was excellent—flavorful, tender, and well presented. Our friends went for the Sunday Sharer Board, and it was a hit. Even though it was a large portion, they enjoyed it so much they said they could’ve eaten more.

Drinks: Well-prepared and paired nicely with the meal.

Overall: A must-visit if you’re looking to enjoy a traditional Sunday roast in London. Great food, warm service, and an atmosphere that makes the experience special.

This pub is the real thing. From the moment you arrive, you realise it’s the place to be on the King’s Road. Whether you want a drink at the bar, eat at the restaurant or watch a game downstairs, this spot has everything to offer.

I came for the food. Actually food was so good, I came back the following week again. One thing to note is that the Cadogan Arms is part of the JKS Group which owns some of the best restaurants in London including Gymkhana, Brigadiers, Sabor, Bao, etc.

Food review:
-onion bhajis for starters 10/10 super flavours
-fried chicken for starters 10/10, coating is just superb
-tried the mushroom pie 9/10, some extra gravy would have hit the spot but the tarragon gave it so much flavour
-ham steak with egg 8/10, their specialty it seems, very good but wasn’t my fav

I also tried some dishes from others and everything was delicious so I really think you can’t go wrong.

Service is super professional, staff are on point and you’d hope so for the 13.5% discretionary service charge they add.

Overall I love the vibe, love the food and it’s really a top gastro pub. Can’t wait to come back. Book in advance!

Lovely birthday lunch.
Food is fab, cauliflower onion bhaji, fish and chips and world class sticky toffee pudding. Pub classics done to perfection.
Great choice of wine and cider.
Great friendly young staff, all doing a great job. All kind and helpful.
The Cadogan Arms is a great pub and we had a brilliant afternoon there and we recommend 100% and look forward to our next visit.

A classic, beautifully  British pub with that timeless Chelsea charm. The atmosphere is incredible, it genuinely feels like stepping into a scene from Billy Joel’s Piano Man. The gastro menu is top-notch, with dishes that are both refined and comforting.

Sadly, the experience is let down by the service. The staff are noticeably rude and inattentive, and the pace is painfully slow, which takes away from what could’ve been a perfect evening. Prices are also on the steep side, making it hard to justify given the service.

Such a shame. A stunning spot with great potential, but in serious need of better hospitality to match its beauty

My son and I visited recently as a birthday treat. We chose this place after seeing a YouTube review and thought wow, we need to try the Ham, Eggs & Chips.
It was the hottest weekend in London this year, but still decided we need to try.
We weren't massively hungry so just bought one main to share.
Food was amazing and we were so pleased we tried the ham, it was lovely smoked flavour, tender and fell off the bone.
Friendly service and lovely decor.
It's not the cheapest pud/restaurant but that isn't an issue for us and we will be back 👍

venues.name: Baba Restaurant Chelsea
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
An unforgettable experience!
I visited this beautiful restaurant with my dear friend Silvan, and we were truly impressed. The food was not only delicious but also beautifully presented. Every single dish was full of flavor and prepared with such care.
The team was incredibly warm, attentive, and welcoming, they really made us feel special.
The ambiance is elegant yet cozy, with lovely details and a peaceful vibe.
We had a fantastic evening and can’t wait to come back again.
Highly recommended! 🙏🏼❤️

This place is incredibly cozy with an amazing atmosphere. I went alone for a solo dining experience, and it was quiet, relaxing, with a lovely breeze and great music in the background. The food was absolutely delicious. I had chicken cordon blue and it was full of flavor. The customer service was also top notch. I got a 50% discount for not finishing my food 😍. Definitely recommend this spot if you’re looking for a peaceful and satisfying dining experience.

When searching for the perfect place to hold a celebration of life, we stumbled upon BaBa Restaurant on Fulham Road.

From the very first contact, Ali and Ege were welcoming, compassionate, and completely accommodating. They went above and beyond to make our family and guests feel at home, showing a level of kindness that touched all of us deeply. The ambience was warm, intimate, and filled with heart—the kind of place that invites both comfort and connection.

As we arrived, we were moved to see a beautiful placard outside the restaurant displaying details of the event. It was such a thoughtful, respectful gesture. Inside, they had created a custom menu for the celebration of life and guests couldn’t stop commenting on how special and personal everything felt.

And the menu—absolutely outstanding. Guests raved about the food, each dish flavorful and prepared with care. It wasn’t just a meal; it was an experience that brought people together around the table.

We truly cannot thank Ali, Ege, and the entire team at BaBa Restaurant enough. Their attention to detail, their warmth, and their respect made what could have been a heavy day feel full of light, love, and remembrance. It was more than just a venue—it became part of our story.

To anyone looking for a place to gather, celebrate, or simply be surrounded by good food and good people: BaBa is a gem. And for us, it will forever hold a very special place in our hearts.

The food is absolutely delicious every dish was full of flavor and prepared perfectly.
The owners, Ms. Ege and her husband, are incredibly friendly and welcoming. Their hospitality made us feel right at home. If we could give ten stars, we would!

I haven’t been surprised by food in a long time and wasn’t expecting anything special when I went to the restaurant.
But this was simply magical.
The best fish I’ve ever had.
The best octopus – it was just delightful.
The aubergines were simply wow.
I only regret one thing: that I can’t eat more.

Amazing people and atmosphere.
Definitely highly recommended ❤️

venues.name: Blacklock Covent Garden
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Just brilliant! Tasty steaks and Sunday roast served quickly and with sauces that truly add to the flavour rather than only add fat to the dish. Definitely the best mint sauce I have ever had.
The service was amazing.
I would recommend the All In Sunday roast with a Beefy Mary.
I love it when a restaurant does what it should right (serve great food) without pretentiousness.
The apple crumble and white chocolate cheesecake were excellent conclusions to a lovely roast.
The atmosphere could be a bit less noisy, but to be fair, that is just my preference and some people might consider that good vibes of a busy restaurant.

Visited Blacklock for the first time. Girlfriend booked it for a group of us based on reviews and location. You go in and down into the main area where it is all happening. This was busy and the atmosphere was buzzing. Service was excellent. I went for the 300g fillet and it was good ... very good! Had the crayfish salad for starter and was surprised at how good that was ... the avocado in the base salad is sublime. I did see the beef ribs starters coming out though and admit to some food envy but cannot complain as the crayfish salad was good and quite light before tucking into the steak main. I had the low alcohol beer served in an iced beer glass - nice!. Next time I'm going for the porterhouse! Will definitely be going back to this place and cannot recommend it enough. Superb.

Went around 5pm on a Thursday. They were able to seat us from walking in.

The steak was super lovely. Would recommend the prime rib. The Denver was nice but a tad chewy, however the chips and the bone marrow was lovely and would highly recommend.

We ordered dessert and got the cheesecake and crumble. Would recommend as well.

Had a very good experience at the restaurant but we were made unaware that the restaurant needed the table back at a certain time and it was towards the end of the meal that the host told us that they needed the table back asap which surprised us as we were not told at the beginning and were still waiting on our dessert.

We had the most amazing Sunday Roast at Blacklock Covent Garden – hands down the best we’ve ever had!

We ordered the All In Roast, which came with pork, beef, and lamb – all perfectly cooked and paired with delicious apple sauce, mint sauce, and mustard. The crispy pork crackling was a standout, and the vegetables were roasted beautifully. The giant Yorkshire pudding soaked in rich gravy was absolutely divine.

For dessert, we had the apple crumble with hot custard – comforting, warm, and exactly what we wanted to end the meal.

The atmosphere was vibrant and cosy, service was lovely, and the place was packed – so definitely book in advance to avoid missing out.

It had everything we love about a classic British Sunday Roast, done to perfection. Highly recommended!

Service was fantastic and very accommodating. It is definitely a busy place but considering how busy went very smoothly .

We went with the recommended "all in" but kind of wished I had not.

Don't get me wrong it was delicious but the bulk was 1 large pork chop which though delicious had a massive chunk that was all fat.

You then got a smallish sized lamb chop and a very small serving of steak.

It did however come with 3 crackers with different toppings each and 1 side each.

Next time I would probably just pick a separate meat from the menu then build around it.

I also ordered the bone marrow which I had never tried before and that was tasty.

All in all I do recommend however

venues.name: Da Mario Covent Garden
venues.description: Italian classics in a simple dining room with framed art, black-and white photos and exposed bricks.

reviews.text: Yummy yummy yummy! Had the seafood pasta and bread with olive oil and balsamic and was absolutely delicious. Definitely on the pricier and upscale vibe but such a lovely place for a nice dinner, date, or professional meeting. My limoncello spritz was also good. The service was amazing too!

A brilliant experience start to finish. The staff were extremely attentive and went above and beyond. The food was 10/10, a very traditional Italian restaurant. Couldn’t recommend enough to anyone visiting the area. Thankyou!

Great food, good service! Apart from when we had to pay and the amount of money shown on the paying device was £143 instead of £56. It's a good thing my husband checked the sum on the device. Otherwise, it would have been a very expensive meal. We want to believe it was an honest mistake.  The staff were friendly and polite. The music on the speaker hanging from the tree was a nice touch.

This is a typical Italian restaurant located in a very Posh District of London. The prices are way above average, and the space inside is very little. Tables sit very close to each other, so you can hear what others are talking about. The food did not meet my expectations unfortunately. The service though is very attentive and fast. After 5 PM, there is a minimum order of a starter and a main dish. Keep this in mind.

We heard great things from reviews but da Mario restaurant in Covent Garden was above and beyond that. Entering we met Andrea who greeted us with a friendly handshake and made us feel at home. He gave us prosecco as we were celebrating our retirement.

The entire staff exceeded expectations and the food and drink as well as ambiance were all exceptional. We highly recommend you come to this Covent Garden gem. The staff and food will not let you down. Every table was enjoying themselves, as were we. We definitely will be back. Thank you so much for a wonderful experience.

venues.name: Inamo Covent Garden
venues.description: High-tech tables & menus in a cool Pan-Asian restaurant that has a games room.

reviews.text: Dinner with the family. We had high expectations because we love Asian food. The menu on the computer table looked cool and attractive so we had high expectations. We entered the restaurant, our order was waiting for us. The menu was easy to use and matched the pictures and description. The service was very good. A little hot in the restaurant space but reasonable. Then the dishes arrived at the table. There were 4 of us and we ordered 9 dishes. We said if we wanted, we would take more. Very small dishes arrived. Most of them were not tasty. Strange and unbalanced seasoning. The main dish. which was delicious was the fried cauliflower. We decided not to order anything else. We went to finish our dinner somewhere else. We left very disappointed

We visited Inamo Covent Garden in September 2025 and tried the all-you-can-eat menu (£49 per person). The concept and interactive tables are quite unique and fun, and the staff were friendly and efficient.

However, the food didn’t fully meet our expectations — a few dishes lacked the freshness and flavour we were hoping for. Overall, it was an interesting experience, though the value for money could be improved.

The sushi tastes OK, but I’d avoid fried things because they are too oily. The spring rolls were dripping lots of oil. Prepare pills for the heartburn.

The service was friendly and they smile, but I have to give it a low mark because they didn’t do their job properly. We had to ask for plates several times. Only half way through our dinner they finally brought plates. Also, we ordered salmon with yuzu ponzu dressing, and it had no dressing. We asked about it, and they took it away, and we had to keep asking until 20 minutes later they brought it back… still with no ponzu or any other dressing. I think the staff doesn’t know what ponzu is so to avoid any further explaining, we put soy sauce on it and ate it like that.

One of the waiters was often asking “is everything OK?” but as I was saying “well, actually…” she was already gone.

The tables are touch panels from where you order. But they were sensitive to some of the plates we put on it and it was hard to order at times.

We were charged a technology fee for using the table menus while no other menu alternative was offered. While ordering the table menu crashed multiple times and everyone in our party agreed that we would have preferred paper menus. Several of the staff didn't really listen to us. We arrived with our party and needed to wait 5 minutes to be seated which was not an issue, but during that 5 minutes the same staff member irritably asked us 3 times about our reservation and each time we said "we're already waiting to be seated, thank you". Another staff member decided to show us how to operate the screens which was not necessary at all because one of our party had eaten there previously. A quick "have you eaten with us before?" would have been useful here. The food arrived fairly quickly but not always to the correct table. I asked twice if the dish I had just been handed was vegetarian and the server said "yes both times" only for my first bite to clearly reveal meat. I passed the dish along to a friend, but it was frustrating experience. All in all, some of the dishes were delicious, the Tamarind Mushrooms were beautiful! But with the unexpected (and mandatory) technology fee (£7.96 per table) + 12.5% service charge on top of already over priced dishes and infuriating table menus and checked-out staff this is not a place I'll be recommending to anyone.

We make an effort to visit this place every month, and the entire team consistently delivers an amazing experience, particularly Sumana, though everyone is wonderful. The food options are delightful, even for someone like me who enjoys milder flavors. There’s truly something for everyone. The modern atmosphere and interactive touchscreen ordering system are outstanding—definitely a step up from using an app at other restaurants!

venues.name: Cora Pearl
venues.description: Hearty comfort food & handcraft cocktails served in a historic, chic Covent Garden townhouse.

reviews.text: Came here after a long day of walking in London for dinner. Stumbled upon this restaurant and had dinner. They admired our 7:30pm deadline to Adelphi Theatre, and helped us pick a good quick meal. We had the pork, salmon, 2 coconut soups (strongly recommended) and chips. It took 25 minutes for our food to get here, and for a restaurant that was not that empty, it was very pleasant. Prices are a little above average but the benefits outweigh the cons. Definitely worth visiting and will come back if i go to london again.

We were in town for some wedding shopping and stumbled cross this charming little bistro, so made a booking to return for lunch

The place is small, but you don’t feel like you are sitting on top of other guest.

The food was simply outstanding and who knew marmite butter could taste so good.

The service started well with attentive front of house staff but as the meal progressed, became slow and at times we felt ignored. This was disappointing given the place was not busy. At one point we had to ask for empty plates to be removed

Very nice and generous Sunday beef roast, the fish was also very good, just very small portion, the potato was very good and the coffee was also very good. They made a nice chocolate thick mousse stuff for birthday celebration which was very nice touch and very tasty, overall would definitely recommend it!

We had the sunday roast and it was heavenly. Worth it 100%. The chips were crunchy, the cauliflower cheese so cheesy. The service was really good too. They don’t have a kids menu but they tried there best to accommodate my daughter by offering half a roast.

Very enjoyable supper in a lovely room with stylish cocktails and food you really want to eat. The team were charming and we chatted about the courtesan Cora Pearl. Standout food was the cheese and ham toastie starter and the chips, which were recommended as ‘the best on London’ they were scrumptious and outrageously decadent ( reminded me of the Quality Chop House’s legendary chips) there is a set supper for pre theatre. Our cocktails were delicious and we split a carafe of dry Riesling. Lots of nice touches.

venues.name: Osteria Napoletana
venues.description: Area-sourced Neapolitan-style eats & an ample wine list in a cool eatery featuring outdoor seating.

address.formatted: 186 Kensington Park Rd, Notting Hill, ES

venues.vicinity: 186 Kensington Park Rd, Notting Hill, ES

reviews.text:
Lovely restaurant with delicious food! Make sure you book online, it requires a credit card to secure the booking on OpenTable.

Mattia was our waiter and absolutely lovely. He was very efficient and humorous too! I appreciated his help with the menu and it was a pleasure watching him masterfully mixing drinks!

The food was all lovely. The seafood was all done beautifully and not at all overcooked. All of the pasta was fresh and very tasty. Highly recommend the calzone, I loved the contrasting textures and how the tastes blended together beautifully in each bite! I thought that perhaps the salad could have done with a touch more salt, however it was a nice contrast to the other dishes. Note the other dishes were all seasoned wonderfully.

We particularly enjoyed the complimentary basket of bread. Really delicious selection and it had the perfect amount of sea salt. The tomatoes there were absolutely great, far beyond the normal ones you can get. Adds to the authentic feeling of this Italian restaurant!

The toilets are located downstairs. They are very clean and pleasant. It’s in keeping with the rest of the restaurant, which is well decorated both inside and out.

If you require one, there is a baby seat, it is located downstairs. I don’t believe there is a kids menu. The ragu is very good though and a good size for two young children to share (YMMV).

Prices are a little high here, however you definitely get what you pay for! Highly recommend for anyone looking to treat themselves!

Absolutely delicious! The pomodoro was authentic and full of flavor, but what really made the experience stand out was the special touch of having fresh basil cut right into the olive oil for dipping bread—simple, but unforgettable. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and every bite felt like a little trip to Naples. A truly lovely experience and a meal I’ll be thinking about long after London.

A lovely family gathering at this cozy Italian restaurant. All the dishes were perfectly prepared and well cooked. I recommend the Paccheri alla Scorfano and La Parmigiana di Melanzane. My daughter loved the Pasta Ammiscata Patate e Provola. The service was excellent as well.

WOW! 🤩 What a wonderful Neapolitan restaurant! Highly recommended! We had a stunning dinner for 2.
Everything we ate was gorgeous. The atmosphere is nice.
The waiters were lovely with lots of little attentions (though we were sat by the door and therefore were forgotten about on a few occasions for little details, but it doesn’t detract from my 5 ⭐).

Authentic italian taste

Small but very cozy place. Great attention, food delicious.
I would point offer free water.

Ticket average $40eur, kind expensive.

Recommended.

venues.name: Granger and Co. Notting Hill
venues.description: International dining with an Aussie accent in airy, no-reservations dining room with large windows.

reviews.text:
Queue moved quickly and great service.

Nice cocktails and lattes. Unfortunately we'd just missed the brunch menu. Ordered the avocado with poached egg on toast which was really well made but simple.

Starting the day at Granger & Co. was such a treat. The ricotta hotcakes were the fluffiest things ever.. . absolutely delicious. I dined alone and found the atmosphere so welcoming and enjoyable. A perfect spot for a solo breakfast!

I had a wonderful breakfast experience at this lovely restaurant. The service was so warm and welcoming ♥️ it truly made my morning. The poached egg was absolutely the most delicious I’ve ever had, perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The pancakes were something special too, so unique and unlike any I’ve tried before. A perfect spot to start the day with a smile ♥️

We stopped by Granger & Co around 3pm for an afternoon snack and coffee. There was no wait, though the restaurant was lively and buzzing. We ordered a pot of fresh mint tea, a latte, and their famous hotcake. The ricotta hotcakes were incredible—super fluffy, not too sweet or greasy, and perfectly paired with caramelized bananas. Latte was fantastic as well. Service was excellent, with attentive and kind staff. Looking forward to coming back to try more of their dishes!

Came here after a long day to sit & enjoy some delicious looking food (website). Upon arrival, seating was tight so they offered to seat us outdoors which was appreciated. They took our drink order and by the time the drinks & water came, we were ready to order. The table water was brought in a pitcher with 2 small cups, they filled them halfway which I was okay with thinking they'd leave the pitcher but that wasn't the case. This was also the last time we were served water. We promptly ordered and the food arrived relatively quickly. I asked for a condiment for my fries. The burger had a great flavor but the bun was either old or completely over toasted. So much so that it overtook the burger flavor which was a shame. The fries were not what I'd expect from a restaurant. I'm sure the side condiments would've helped had I received them before the entirety of my meal was completed. We also never saw another server again before having to go inside and ask for the ticket. The server apologized repeatedly for "forgetting they had tables outside" but didn't offer to make anything better. I'm not too terribly sure how they forget there are outdoor tables when they have very large windows at the front of the restaurant offering a view. All in all, unfortunately, I wouldn't return and would be hard pressed to recommend the experience to others.

venues.name: Gold
venues.description: Seasonal, thoughtfully sourced plates are served in this cool eatery that has a bar & a terrace.

reviews.text: Discovered this restaurant randomly while walking along Portobello road with my husband and can’t say I was disappointed. We walked in on a weekday afternoon and the place was relatively packed. Staff were very warm and friendly. Lots of vegetarian options, food was delicious and you could really taste the freshness of the ingredients. Excellent for a date or a business lunch!

Each dish showcased impressive detail, variety and complexity, though a couple felt like they were missing something but overall very tasty. Service was great, wonderful decor inside with decent music in the background which we didn’t expect. The vibe was great.

Gold Notting Hill delivers a memorable meal in a beautiful setting. The ricotta toast was light and flavorful, the sweet potatoes packed with depth, and the pastas—the veal tortelloni and ricotta ravioli—were both refined and delicious. The space itself is stylish yet welcoming, making it a spot I’d happily return to

Overall great food and lovely service. Wait staff were super helpful and honest re portion sizes etc. The burrata salad was great, the hispi cabbage is really different and grows on you as you progress through the meal. The sauce served with the squid is also very good. Nice mocktail options too. Lovely bathroom & overall environment.

We had a very nice dinner here. We sat upstairs, which felt more intimate and relaxed than the buzzy ground floor. Shared three starters - sweet potatoes, ricotta with sourdough, and a feta salad - all fresh and well-balanced. Mains were equally solid: the steak with aubergine sauce was rich and satisfying, and the sea bream was cooked just right. Only letdown was the cocktail, which didn’t quite hit the mark for us.

Quietly rated: worth stopping.

venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We had such a lovely experience today. The food was of excellent quality. The staff were also very warm and welcoming, which made the meal even more enjoyable. We’ll definitely be coming back again！☺️

Complete perfection.

Our waiter Chris was super welcoming, warm and knowledgeable.

The food was genuinely immaculate. The waygu was so good we immediately ordered a 2nd plate.

Highly, highly recommend.

The team advised us on food and were incredibly kind.

Thank you
I highly recommend Lush and Hush, incredible menu with super tasty food and very authentic dining experience. The staff are very attentive and polite. I can’t wait to visit again.

This is a lovely new bistro . We enjoyed a satisfying seafood paella with a crunchy socarat base, prawns and squid, followed by  a baked lemon sole with a medley of tomatoes, onions, and ginger. The flavors bespoke remarkably high quality ingredients and a deft blending that left each taste distinct and delightful.  A Wagyu spring roll with a mustardy dipping sauce and a heavenly Spanish pan con tomate preceded the mains. Jack was a welcoming and congenial host. We will return.
Super warmth local restaurant and loved the Wagyu beef & lobster pasta 🍝

venues.name: The Barbary Notting Hill
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We had the best experience at The Barbary Notting Hill! We tried everything and every single dish was full of flavor and beautifully prepared. The atmosphere is vibrant and stylish, and you can really feel the energy from the open kitchen. The service was absolutely amazing, friendly, attentive, and made the evening feel special from start to finish. Highly recommend for anyone looking for delicious food, great vibes, and outstanding hospitality. We’ll definitely be coming back!

Absolutely scrumptious meal. The service was excellent from the start. I particularly enjoyed the 7 Spice Lamb Rib, the Coffee Rub Chicken & the Orange wine to wash it down. I also loved the extra effort by the whole team when they signed a birthday card for me. Will definitely be back.

We recently stopped in for a martini and a light lunch at The Barbary Notting Hill, and the experience did not disappoint. We were greeted by the friendly head chef, who works behind the open fire grill, creating the most delightful smells of rich Mediterranean flavors. The light from the large windows lets in the busy city outside without the noise, and the architecture is modern and beautiful. The cherry and sumac sorbet was a great way to finish the meal. We will return and add The Barbary to our "favorites" list.

We had been planning to go there for a long time. Maybe we expected too much, but the food wasn’t very tasty(sashimi was good). It was good, just a bit too greasy for me, and the portions were quite small. Overall, it’s a nice place, but I was expecting more.

We had an amazing time at Barbary!
The food was absolutely delicious, and we loved the idea of sharing dishes.
The only minor hiccup was that we didn’t receive our main course on time, but the manager was super helpful and quickly rectified the situation. He even offered us dessert on the house as a gesture of goodwill.
We paired our meal with a couple of martinis and later with a lovely red wine, which was the perfect complement to the food.
Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience!

venues.name: Taqueria - Notting Hill
venues.description: Tacos & Mexican street food small plates, plus margaritas & blue agave tequilas.

reviews.text: Friendly staff, delicious tacos and cocktails. A true margarita paradise, with the pisco sour being top-notch. On Friday evening there was live music, which made the atmosphere really warm and soulful. Highly recommend!

A Hidden Gem in Notting Hill. We Didn’t Know We Needed This!

My group of friends and I were wandering around Notting Hill recently, not really sure where to grab a bite. Honestly, we hadn't heard of Taquería before, we actually came across it online while walking nearby. It looked close and promising, so on a bit of a whim (and with some help from a little AI suggestion), we decided to give it a shot.

And wow, what a fantastic decision it turned out to be!

From the moment we walked in, we were impressed. The place is just as good in person as it looks in photos, vibrant, cozy, and full of character. It instantly felt welcoming, which was made even better by the absolutely amazing staff who treated us like old friends. They were warm, attentive, and always checking in to make sure we were enjoying everything, it really elevated the whole experience.

Now, onto the food: this is the real deal when it comes to authentic Mexican cuisine. The tacos were bursting with flavor, tender meat, fresh toppings, and warm tortillas that tasted homemade. The nachos were a highlight too; crispy, cheesy, and perfectly seasoned. And the drinks? So refreshing! We tried a few different options, and each one was delicious and well-made.

Beyond the food, we genuinely had a lot of fun here. It’s the kind of place that feels like a little escape, great vibes, great people, and great flavors. You can tell they put love into every part of the experience.

I can’t recommend Taquería enough. Whether you're a local or just passing through Notting Hill, do yourself a favor and stop by. We’ll definitely be back, next time maybe with more friends (and less wandering)

Staff was very friendly and gave quick service. The food was delicious and great value for money. Would definitely recommend order a variety of plates to share so you can try everything.They had a range of vegetarian/vegan options too.

tacos sooo tasty.. tho please some more vegan options this is very important!! the churros apparently tasted like a kit kat (5*) the little cocktail stand kept falling over and i appreciated how they had a barcode to go straight to the reviewing

Its a lovely restaurant with a Mexican Cuisine! It’s not too big or too small. We were greeted with a smile and the staff was very accommodating ~ and always tending to us! The food was amazing! We loved everything. I really recommend the fried Calamari and the Pork/Pineapple tacos! Also the drinks were delightful! We got the “Piñata” and it was amazing! Really really recommend!

venues.name: Andy’s Greek Taverna
venues.description: Whitewashed taverna with a rustic style and beamed ceilings, serving classical Greek dishes.

reviews.text:
Lively Greek restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating. Authentic and varied menu, good options for vegetarians.

The food was all delicious - you can taste the olive oil and lemon, and it was freshly prepared.

The service was very good, and they don’t rush you. They were helpful and friendly.

I would return to try other things on the menu!

They have set menus as well which seem good.

We went here for a cross-generational family lunch on a Sunday and we had a great time. The food was delicious and everyone in our party was very happy. The staff were friendly and helpful and the prices were very reasonable for the area. Definitely recommended! Reserve a table.

wonderful restaurant! a popular spot in the neighborhood but not touristy. been here a few times in the last year and it’s great every time. service is wonderful and the employees are very nice. they give you a shot of amaretto at the end too. seafood is delicious.

Visited for my daughter's birthday meal and was pleased with the whole experience.
The staff are really welcoming and make you feel like family, the food is   great and the atmosphere makes you feel like you're on holiday.
All in all, it's great value for money and an experience we'll definitely be repeating.
Great food, very reasonable prices. The mixed grill was delicious. The owner is also very friendly, and gave us a round of shots on the house! Great option for a non touristy restaurant in Camden.

venues.name: The Blues Kitchen Camden
venues.description: Dedicated blues bar serving hickory-smoked comfort food, plus regular live music & DJs.

reviews.text:
I was welcomed by the lovely girl named Helen who searched for a table for me and seated me while I was still waiting for my partner.
The atmosphere was amazing, great vibe and music.
The decor is very cool and unique even inside the rest rooms.
The food was good.
We had two burgers- vegan and beef with extra bacon.
My vegan one was good but could have had more vegetables inside. It was just like piece of salad and pickle. Could be something more.
In general very good experience.
The staff was great, we were looked after.
Thanks .

Food was delicious 😋 enjoyed the tuna starter & squid. Unfortunately the chicken wings were dry for me. We had burgers as mains, nice portion took some home. The dessert was a  dark chocolate ganache with honeycomb. Strangely served in a drinking glass - nice, rich but small portion.
Venue was gorgeous inside, unfortunately not enough staff, despite going up to pay I was told I had to await a server - that took age's!!.
As part of First table.

First time coming here, but definitely won’t be my last. The food was absolutely DELICIOUS and affordable prices, and had a live band. I got the chicken burger with mac and cheese and it was definitely a hit! 😍😍I went on Tuesday and was able to get the £6 Tuesday tequila and tried margarita for the first time😍. I want to also thank my lovely waitress Sadie, I believe she said she was new, but she was  the BEST host all night and made sure we were taken care of every time. She made us try the lovely Oreo doughnuts which is DIE for. She has also made me a tequila fan from her recommendations. I will definitely be visiting again and hope to see Sadie’s lovely smile. Thank you for making my anniversary more enjoyable🤩

Came for late lunch, seated after a little wait at the bar,  by a smiley host, staff having a laugh but attentive to us and other tables around. Food was great for all of us, pretty much had everything on the menu for the 5 of us.

Rounds of Guinness came in constantly, just what we love.

Been before, will come again next weekend, see you soon Mattie, best server this side of the river!

Great vibes, amazing live music, and delicious food! The atmosphere is lively yet relaxed, perfect for a night out. The staff were super friendly and the cocktails were spot on. Definitely a Camden gem! will be back!

venues.name: Daphne Restaurant
venues.description: Polished, long-running haunt adorned with photography & traditional decor executing Greek recipes.

reviews.text:
The food was AMAZING!! Tasted and felt very authentic, from the meze to the mains and the lovely Greek service.

Taramasalata is a MUST — best we’ve ever had. Had the lamb chops and was delicious!

Only thing is it’s a small place so can get cramped and a bit loud. However still a great place to go for special occasions or any occasion really!
Great 2 course lunch special for £15. The mixed dips you can choose how ever many you want (fits a small plate). The meat moussaka was great.

Seems extreme to label all 5⭐️s but I had no plans to come here. I was meant to go across the street to another restaurant where I had a booking, peeked in here on the way over & ditched all plans. The food was phenomenal. I had a lamb shank which melted off the bone. We had a seafood starter and the haloumin which was grand. Nicholas was a gem. One of my fave nights in my new neighbourhood. 100% RECOMMEND!

Superior food and service. This restaurant is 5 stars plus! The shrimp appetizer, grilled swordfish steak special and Greek salad were all perfectly prepared and delicious! Such a great find in Camden that I asked for a reservation the next night as well.
Amazing food!!! Very authentic. I lived in Cyprus for many years and just took me back to my happy place.

venues.name: La Patagonia
venues.description: Exposed-brick, barrio-style setting featuring hearty homestyle Argentinian cuisine.

reviews.text: This is such a hidden gem in Camden. The restaurant is very intimate which makes it perfect for date night. We had a party of 6 and all of our food came out just the way we ordered. All the Steak was cooked to perfection. The waiter was extremely attentive. Highly recommend.

Went here on a Saturday. My friend chose the place and I generally like Argentinian.

First, service was exemplary. Especially with my friend’s daughter. Lovely chap.

Onto the food.

Chicken Empanadas - not bad. OK portion size.

Ribeye steak - not bad. Reasonably well cooked. Flavour a bit lacking.

Lomo - the fillet steak that just tasted average. The peppercorn sauce was decent.

Fries - good, can’t mess these up really.

Creamed spinach - bland. Didn’t really enjoy it. Need more flavour, herbs.

Overall it was…not bad. That is to say, not good either. Rather pricey given the quality.

Would I return? No.

What a great place to eat, we were a party of 4 and one of out party was from Argentina so I wanted an authentic experience which we got! The owner has their own range of Malbec which goes superbly with the various cuts of meat cooked to perfection!  If you love steak, you definitely have to visit this place!

It was a random find in the "taste for all" Camden town. The venue did not disappoint. Atmosphere was chill, argentinian themed. Staff was corteous, present but not overwhelming, accomodating, smiling and giving advice as requested. Food was tasty, arrived hot and on time. Tasty, everyone enjoyed their choices. Excellent place worth repeating.

Excellent quality restaurant with good service and even better dishes. Popular on a Friday evening with people walking in trying to get a table so booking is recommended. The table service is enthusiastic without being overbearing, it's easy to get attention for another round of drinks. It's a mainly meat menu (that shouldn't come as a surprise) with my dish being well cooked (medium rare), well presented, and tender to cut and eat. There are home made pasta options as well if meat is not your thing. There is also a good selection of Argentinian wines and beer to compliment the dishes. So whole heartily recommended.
