venues.name: Jamon Jamon
venues.description: Classic tapas, paella & sangria served in a contemporary dining room with wooden tables.

reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience at Jamon Jamon Camden! The tapas were delicious, the chorizo and chicken paella was perfectly cooked. The staff was incredibly welcoming, and a special mention to the new manager, Isa, who gave us great recommendations and made us feel at home.

If you love authentic Spanish food with excellent service, this is the place to go!

Staff were nice enough and did came out in a timely way, it was hot. Had 5 plates, 2 were good the others were OK. The bravas is best described as small cubed fries with two sauces on the side. At nearly £7..well...so I would say the food was average compared to other Spanish tapas I have had at this price point. No major complaints but first visit for 5 plates and that will be my only visit.

My interest in visiting this place was because I saw that Amy Winehouse loved to eat there.
That's why I went there and I eat Spanish food (I had already tried Spanish food when I was in Barcelona and Madrid).
So this place is very nice, the atmosphere, the food, the service and the music and it’s close to the bus station, metro, pubs, etc. I love it.

I thoroughly enjoyed the delectable dishes at the restaurant.

The culinary experience was exceptional as we indulged in a variety of items

1.  gamas
2. Chorizo
3. Paella with seafood,
4. paella with ink,
5. calamari.

Each dish left a lasting impression with its incredible flavors, making the overall dining experience immensely satisfying.

The service and ambiance added to the positive experience; everything was simply outstanding, leaving no room for complaints. The staff provided excellent service, contributing to the overall pleasant vibe of the place.

Tip: Reserve to dine at Soho for a delightful experience.

We chanced upon this when we were looking for a place to eat. And we are really glad we did. The food is good. And the restaurant feels airy and inviting. I particularly like the natural daylight coming through the glass roof. The mushrooms and the prawns are highly recommended.

venues.name: Purezza Camden
venues.description: Easygoing place offering a range of vegan sourdough pizza, salads, raw dishes, pasta & desserts.

reviews.text:
We had the Black Truffle Pizza and the Parmigiana Party — both were sooo flavourful and perfectly seasoned! The vegan cheese made the pizzas super creamy and delicious. The dough was soft with a little chew, just right for that perfect crust texture. 🍕✨

I love how they use the real pizza oven — makes everything taste so fresh and amazing. The vibe in the restaurant is really good too.

Honestly, this is the BEST pizza I’ve ever had in my life 🙌 whether you’re vegan or not, you gotta try it. I’d definitely go back again!

I’m Italian, and I can say with absolute certainty it’s one of the best pizzas I’ve ever eaten. The taste is just like a real, authentic one, yet it’s completely plant-based. They offer different types of dough, and the sourdough is incredibly delicious, light, tasty, and it leaves you feeling great, without any bloating.

The staff are very nice, friendly, and professional. I had the pizza Parmigiana and the tiramisù, and both were absolutely mouth-watering. I only wish I could stay longer in London to go back there again!

If you’re looking for the best vegan Neapolitan pizza in London, this is the place to be! Warm and welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. The pizza is soft, flavorful, and made with the freshest ingredients — a true hug of taste in every bite. Perfect for a friendly evening out with friends!
Try pistachio and parmesana!

TL;DR: I liked it! Not all my friends did.

1. If you are not used to vegan pizza, you might find it quite different from the classic one (e.g. the cheese didn't taste like the standard counterpart)
2. The standard wholemeal dough was really good 😋
3. We really didn't like the gluten-free one ❌
4. We liked the parmigiana pizza and the veggie, but not the margherita 😢
5. We liked the starters (parmigiana and meatballs)
6. The service was really great: Greg was very helpful and kind, and he even offered to take the gluten-free pizza off the bill when we complained about it

Joe was our server and was very helpful with recommending toppings for my pizza and service was so friendly and welcoming, the food was also very delicious as were desserts. Definitely will come back. Thank you !!

venues.name: Frida Camden
venues.description: Mexican & Spanish cuisine in a rustic, cantina-style space with colorful chairs & patterned tiles.

reviews.text:
Frida Camden is an absolute gem for anyone craving authentic Mexican cuisine. The flavors are bold yet balanced, with every dish feeling like it’s made with care and tradition. The menu celebrates the richness of Mexican food while keeping everything fresh and vibrant, making each bite a real treat. Whether you’re indulging in tacos, enchiladas, or one of their specialties, the food feels both comforting and exciting—easily some of the best Mexican fare around.

What truly sets Frida Camden apart is their salsa. It’s not just a side—it’s an experience on its own. The traditional recipe bursts with freshness, the right amount of spice, and that homemade touch that’s hard to find elsewhere. Paired with warm, crisp tortilla chips, it’s the perfect way to start a meal and sets the tone for the flavorful journey ahead. For those who love genuine Mexican flavors, this spot is a must-visit.

I passed by Frida one month ago. I was attracted by its decoration. Today my friend asked me do you have any new restaurant want to explore? I said I have one! So we are here! We ordered spicy beef nachos and Chicken Fajitas , passion fruit and mango Margaritas! Absolutely delicious!!!! I highly recommend!

Table for 5 booked for 5pm on a Saturday evening. It wasn't too busy when we arrived and they were expecting our arrival which was nice.
Service was great and food arrived promptly. Good vegan and veggie options too. We really enjoyed the experienceand we left full. We're looking forward to coming back here. It might be our new favourite place in Camden
Overall the experience at Frida was average. Not bad but just not great either. The food was okay but over priced for what it was

We came here for breakfast on a recent trip to Camden as the other cafes were busy, I'm glad we did as the food and service were very good. The young lady waiting on our table was very polite and efficient. There was a good choice of food for both meat eaters and vegetarians.

venues.name: Band of Burgers, Camden
venues.description: Local chain grilling burgers on charcoal and serving them with cocktails, fresh juices and shakes.

reviews.text: Surprised at how quiet it was. 5 of us popped in for their lunch deal, it was dead. Waitress had 'popped to the shop' so a slight delay in ordering, but other than that it's a great value for money lunch, given it's location. £11.99 for a choice of burger, chips and a can.

So, I was looking for a quick bite to eat before a gig over the road at KOKO.
Found this little place, on arrival it looked great from outside and in. I stood at the front of the restaurant and waited for a while, even though there was a lady cleaning a table infront of me and the place had lots of spare seats. I had to ask her if I could sit down, and she wasn't too friendly either.

Onto the food, I had burger, chips and squid.
All of the food was delicious, hot and flavoursome. The food didn't takelong to come out.
The service was disappointing and then to be hit with a service charge was a kick in the teeth. Hence the 3 star review.
Customer service is huge, definitely needs looking at.

All food we ordered was delicious, service was good. Shame they don't serve alcohol, but they did say you can bring your own.
Staff are friendly and polite.
The tortilla chips used for nachos were really good, different to the standard ones we get here. Coleslaw was tasty. Sweet potato fries were lovely a crispy. I had the Mexican chicken burger, was really good.
My friend had beef burger, which he said was good.
We did order too much food, but you can take leftovers home!
Good value lunch deal for a burger, fries & drink. The burger and fries were great. Ordered wings as well which were average. Good portions overall. Good service.

Came in here on a whim on a Sunday evening just before a gig. One of the best burgers I've EVER had. The meat was perfectly cooked, it was so juicy and fully of flavour! The portions of fries were very generous and the milkshakes were delicious - ice cold and with a healthy amount of whipped cream on top! Definitely will come back here when I'm in Camden and need a bite 👍

venues.name: Made in Brasil
venues.description: Brazilian and Latino cuisine in colourful beach shack-style restaurant and bar with live music.

reviews.text: Food was delicious, especially the deserts WOW did they taste so frickin good let alone looked just as good as they tasted. Food was taste I think they could have gone less on the cress for presentation didn’t needs so much green grass but it all tasted beautifully. Cocktails were nice. Would highly recommend the bottomless brunch.
Fantastic place! Friendly, welcoming staff, amazing drinks, and food that’s simply out of this world – fresh, flavorful, and top quality. Can’t wait to come back!

We had a mixed experience. My partners food was great. Well cooked and full of flavour. Mine was dry and overcooked. Also they replaced our beans, when one of the waiters noticed it didn’t look right (why they served it to begin with, I dont know).

It should be noticed I’m a “gringo” in these places, but my partner is Brasilian and it was clear, “locals” get special treatment and better service.

Also very expensive! Use Fork or some other discount app!

Made in Brasil in Camden brings a lively slice of Rio straight into the heart of London. The atmosphere is vibrant and colorful, with samba rhythms, warm lighting, and a menu bursting with authentic Brazilian flavors. From feijoada and picanha to creative small plates, the food feels both hearty and festive, while the cocktail list—especially the caipirinhas—is a highlight that adds to the fun, easygoing vibe.

The restaurant balances energy with comfort, making it just as good for a casual night out with friends as it is for a celebratory dinner. Service is friendly and relaxed, and while it can get busy in the evenings, that only adds to the buzz that makes Camden dining unique. Altogether, Made in Brasil delivers a genuine taste of Brazil with an atmosphere that’s hard not to get swept up in.

I had lunch with a friend on a Tuesday at this charming Brazilian restaurant in lively Camden and it was a fantastic experience from start to finish.

From the moment we arrived, the warm and welcoming staff made us feel at home. Despite the restaurant being busy, the service was attentive and engaging, with friendly interactions that added to the overall experience. The interior was richly cultural and inviting, creating a perfect setting for a relaxed meal.

The menu offered a great variety of options, and we especially enjoyed their starters and tapas-style dishes, which were full of bold and exciting flavors. While I can’t speak to how authentic the food is, it was definitely delicious and satisfying.

To top it off, we booked through The Fork and received a wonderful discount, which was applied smoothly with no issues.

Overall, it was a delightful dining experience and I’d highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy a flavourful and welcoming atmosphere in Camden.

venues.name: Brother Marcus Canary Wharf
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at Brother Marcus Canary Wharf. The food was outstanding – fresh, high-quality ingredients, full of flavour and beautifully presented. What really made the visit exceptional was the service. Lisa was amazing – warm, attentive, and genuinely passionate about making sure everything was perfect. A restaurant that truly delivers on both food and service.

I really liked Brother Marcus!
The staff were really lovely. We asked for Marcus's Choice, and the experience was great. Food kept coming, so we were both so full, and they kept asking if we wanted more or anything specific.
The food was all delicious, I'd especially recommend the aubergine because I've never had them cooked like that before.
I'd definitely recommend!

This place is great for dinner. The atmosphere is lovely. Soheil was very friendly and gave us recommendations. The food was really good, good portion, very delicious - I would recommend the rips & dips and the crispy aubergine skewer. Definitely will come back

Stumbled upon this incredible spot by chance and what an unforgettable experience!
The food was an absolute 10/10. Brunch and dessert were both outstanding some of the best I’ve had. If I’d had the time, I would’ve come back the very next day, even just for dessert.
The service was exceptional truly faultless. A huge thank you to Ivan, Anna, Ada, and Danielle for making it so special. I’ll definitely be returning!

Absolutely fantastic experience! From the moment I walked in, the warm, inviting atmosphere made me feel right at home. The staff were friendly and attentive, providing excellent service without being overbearing.

The menu  offers a wonderful mix of Mediterranean-inspired dishes, with something for everyone, whether you're a meat lover or a vegetarian.

The atmosphere is vibrant yet laid-back, making it perfect for a casual dinner with friends or a more intimate date night. Whether you're after a relaxing meal or a lively night out, this place truly has it all.

Overall, I can’t recommend Brother Marcus enough—wonderful food, excellent service, and a fantastic vibe. I’ll definitely be back!

venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant. First week of opening but you wouldn’t have known as everything was so slick. Food was some of the best I’ve ever had. Highly recommend

Such a great spot! The pizza crust was crispy and light, the pasta was packed with flavor, and everything tasted so fresh. The staff were friendly and made great recommendations. You can tell they really care about quality here. Five stars all the way!

A different Italian!
My husband booked this place for my birthday dinner. He kept it as a surprise. The restaurant is within few metres of Canary Wharf tube station.
Upon arrival we received a warm welcome. I received a birthday card signed by the squad of the restaurant. That was quite unique. I liked it!
The interior is impressive, nice decor and the lights - all give it a posh look.
For starter we ordered normal bread and garlic bread. With the first bite of each, I felt like it's completely different than any of them I have ever tasted. It was so good!
For the mains, my first choice was not available, hence I went with the sea bass option "Branzino in Guazzetto". I was sceptical with the thought of tomato sauce being too tangy. When it arrived and I took the first taste, I felt like I have never tasted a sauce like that before. It was tastebud-awakening! So delicious!
My husband had the pizza "Some Like It Hot", that was quite different tasting as well. It was slightly on hot side as it says.
They don't have a kids menu but we went with the recommended one "Spaghettoni al Ragù di Agnellowhich". It was perfect for the little one.
For the dessert we went for Creme Brulee, that came with a candle on top 😊
The service was superb throughout.
Altogether it was an amazing dining experience and a perfect birthday meal! Thank you!

I had a wonderful experience at Barbarella restaurant. From the moment we arrived, the staff gave us a very warm welcome and made us feel comfortable. They also gave us good recommendations from the menu, which helped us choose the best dishes.

The food was more than excellent, fresh, tasty, and full of flavor. The portion sizes were just right and generous. Every dish was prepared with care and beautifully presented.

The atmosphere of the restaurant was cozy and friendly, perfect for enjoying a nice meal. I will definitely come back again and recommend this place to anyone who loves real Italian food.

Another amazing big mama restaurant! Honestly the best one out of them all in London! Great service by the Dr. , who gave phenomenal and attentive service! Food hit the Italian craving and the ambience is perfect. Went for lunch but will definitely come back for dinner.

venues.name: Gaucho Canary Wharf
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I had an exceptional evening here! The food and drinks were spot on, and the service was simply outstanding—our server greeted us warmly and knew the menu inside out, which made choosing our meals a breeze. The vibes in the place were perfect, and everything was spotless. I really appreciated how the team checked in on us and even recommended dessert—it was such a nice touch. I can’t wait to come back!

I usually challenge such expensive restaurants as I believe it is difficult to justify such amount of money for one meal... yet Gaucho deserves a 5 star.

They have it all. The location at Canary Wharf might not be ideal, yet it is right in front of the river with amazing view over centtal London skyline, so a plus already for terrace sitting if weathwr allows.
Next is service. Perfect. Polite, attentive, not intrusive yet always there whenever you need something.
Finally the food. We went for Gaucho's classic: Argentinian meet. We took different cuts and ALL of the were cooked according to each one request, from filete to ribeye steaks, different sizes and some marinated. All amazing.

We went for Argentinian malvec... quite overpriced yet very good.

All together in a cosy place.

Just excellent experience end-to-end.

Illustration: 400 ribeye steak for 52£

Labels: 2eat, $$$$, #Argentinian, #romantic, #privees, #terrace, #views, #must Go

I visited recently and had an exceptional experience, thanks to the team's top-notch service and their excellent menu knowledge. The food and drinks were absolutely delightful, and the atmosphere made it even better. While I felt the prices were a bit on the high side, the quality of what I had definitely justified it. Overall, I walked away with a full stomach and a big smile, thanks to the warm greetings and thoughtful recommendations throughout my visit. I'll definitely be returning!

We went here for my birthday lunch.  The greeting was lovely & friendly.
The restaurant wasn’t very busy, which was good. Gauchos is a restaurant that I had been to before, many years ago & the presentation of the restaurant is still very good.
We ordered cocktails which were ok. I don’t usually drink but as I was celebrating I had a pornstar martini which was nice but I usually feel a little tipsy after one of these but with this one I didn’t. The others like their cocktails but they also said they lacked any taste with regard to alcohol content.
We all ordered from the set lunch menu. It was 3 courses for £19.95
We had the Prawn Chicharron for starters. It was lovely! I would definitely order this from the main menu, if it guaranteed that I got a bigger portion😊10/10
Mains, we had Rump & chips. I also ordered a side of tenderstem broccoli. The steaks were nice, not amazing, but nice. I was hoping for home made chips, even if I was only given a few chips presented nicely. Sadly, it looked like we were given McCain chips 6.5/10
They tasted ok though.
The broccoli was weird. It had peanuts crumbed on it & some sort of drizzled sauce. We didn’t like it 2/10
For dessert we all had Chocolate Brownie with  white chocolate ice cream. I love desserts. It was adequate. We were all unsure on the taste of the ice cream 7/10.
Ooh..! They did write happy birthday on my plate with my dessert & put a candle in it, which was really nice. Thank you ❤️

Only gripe is, when we were eating dessert not all of us had finished & the plates were collected. He then made one of our party feel rushed & uneasy.

I will say that the aesthetics of the restaurant are lovely. The staff were pleasant. The food, for the price, was really good.

P.s your bathrooms could do with a little bit more light.

I would definitely return to this restaurant

A hidden gem and the best Gaucho of the franchise. Excellent value, sharp service and a divine setting for any occasion. For a mid-week treat, try the three course set menu. For dinner, our favourite steak is the ribeye, every time.

venues.name: Blacklock Canary Wharf
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)
Dinner at Blacklock Canary Wharf – Tuesday Evening

I went for dinner at Blacklock Canary Wharf with a friend on Tuesday evening, and we had a lovely time. I ordered a well-done steak (that’s how we eat it where I come from), with gravy, sweet potatoes, kale with parmesan, and ice cream for dessert, along with a glass of red wine.

The food was excellent. The steak was a bit chewy, as you’d expect from well-done, but still full of flavour. Everything else, especially the sides and dessert, was absolutely delicious. The staff were amazing throughout; very friendly and attentive, though I didn’t catch the name of the person who served us.

The only slightly disappointing moment was when we were asked to give up our table after two hours, not rudely, but simply because of their policy. To be honest, it’s a sign of how much we were enjoying ourselves that we didn’t want to leave! We would have happily stayed for another round of drinks.

Overall, a great evening with excellent food, warm service, and a vibrant atmosphere. I’d definitely go back — maybe I’ll just book a longer slot next time!

Absolutely delicious Sunday roast—the meats were full of flavor, and the gravy was simply outstanding. The only reason it’s not five stars is the portion size: despite looking large, about 80% of the plate was vegetables, leaving the actual amount of meat underwhelming. For two people, the portion for three is ideal.

For dessert, we had the white chocolate cheesecake, and it was pure heaven. Unlike the roast, a single portion of dessert was more than enough for two people.

12 out of 10.
10 for the food — from starters and steaks to desserts, they consistently surprised us. Highly recommend the pork’s head on toast, triple-cooked chips, broccoli and walnut salad, prime rib, white chocolate cheesecake, and mango sorbet (alright — that’s nearly everything we ordered!).

An extra 2 points for the friendly and attentive service. Thank you to the lovely Jess and Ryan — their recommendations were spot on.

We really enjoyed it! Definitely recommend!

One of the best Sunday Roasts I’ve ever had in London! The gravy was amazing totally impressed🤩🤩 The dessert is a must-try!! I can’t remember the name, but it was some kind of white chocolate treat and it was so good!! If you’re planning to come, I’d definitely recommend booking ahead

Went here with a work group and had a fantastic feast. The steak was excellent — not the oversized kind, which made it perfect for sharing and trying different cuts across the table. Appetisers were solid too, well-prepared and a great way to kick things off.

We had a round of drinks at the bar while waiting for our table, which set a nice tone before dinner. Service during the meal was friendly and efficient, but once the dinner rush picked up we did feel a bit hurried to vacate the table — understandable for such a busy spot, but worth knowing if you’re looking for a more leisurely evening.

Overall, Blacklock Canary Wharf delivers on quality food, lively atmosphere, and good group dining — just be prepared for a bustling pace.

venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ – Elegant Atmosphere & Great Vibes
Brera Lounge is the perfect spot for a night out in London. The vibe is classy yet welcoming, with stylish interiors with luxurious feels. The music is great- DJ was lit. Food great- pizza- mouth watering and the drinks were crafted beautifully. I had such a great time. Will be back!

The music and vibe made it a perfect place to have fun with friends over drinks and good pizza. Great service and lovely atmosphere. Highly recommend if you're looking for great time out with great food! ✨🥳

Brera Lounge in Canary Wharf absolutely nails it. The pepperoni pizza was spot-on—crispy crust, rich sauce, and perfectly cooked pepperoni with just the right kick.

The cherry on top? The vibe. They had 90s classics playing for tonight—TLC, Biggie, Aaliyah—which made the whole experience feel fun and laid-back. Great food, great music, great spot.

Amazing Drinks & Service
I had such a great time at Brera Lounge. The cocktails are some of the best I’ve tried in the city, and the staff really go out of their way to make sure you’re having a good time. It’s the ideal mix of sophistication and fun. Highly recommend if you want a memorable night.

Ordered 3 Gelato Mantecato... One of these was almost pure fluid, not even frozen.  Mixed nuts on all three turned out to be just salted peanuts.    The food was drop and run.  Will not be coming back their again!

venues.name: Dishoom Canary Wharf
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We were looking forward to this place for a while and heard/read all the reviews about this restaurant. It did not disappoint. The moment we walked through the doors, we knew this would be an authentic Indian experience. Hussain (manager) and Monica (waitress) went above and beyond to deliver an exceptional service. They were attentive, very knowledgeable about the food and helpful. The dishes served were 10/10 and the portion sizes were perfect. I would highly x 2 recommend this restaurant for a date night, meet-up,  a group gathering or any occasion. This place delivered and the chefs done good!

Overall amazing! Truly cannot fault a single thing we were served. The service was just so lovely and inviting, the food was some of the best south Asian I’ve had that Is not authentically home made!
I’m so gutted I didn’t take pictures of the ruby biryani and the mutton curry, because they were faultless We just couldn’t wait to dig in!
Those prawns were honestly spectacular! Spicy and just the perfect grill. Think it was by far the best on the menu.

There’s nothing that I didn’t like about this place. The food was amazing. The lamb chops were out of the world. Okra fries (5)are a must. Chicken ruby(5) was amazing. Daal (4.5)was great too. Naans were thin and yum. The paneer roomali roll was great roo (4.5/5)
Our server Massimo was amazing too

Best restaurant for modernized Indian food. Service is amazing, staff is very friendly and helpful. The food also is very good, and not your standard Indian food, but thoughtfully put together modernized versions of it. They have a separate vegan menu for breakfast, lunch and dinner. It's well worth a visit.

We wanted to visit the Canary Wharf
Branch as we have enjoyed other branches
Especially Shoreditch.

We got lost on our way to the area
But once we got to Canary Wharf Station
It was fairly easy to find.

We liked the ambiance & Decor
Everyone we met was very welcoming
Even though it was near to closing time

We were offered water to drink
& Were served very quickly

The Up-To-Date Pau Bhaji was delicious
But we struggled to finish the portion
So requested to box the leftovers

The server was polite & Said
That He will have to check with
The manager

Then He gave us the packaging
To fill up the containers ourselves.

We were happy not to waste
Such delicious food.

We definitely enjoyed ourselves
& Will try to come visit soon

Although we liked where we sat
We would prefer to sit maybe
Outside next time, As it was very dark.

Happy 15th to the Dishoom family
Compliments to the Manager

Thank you to Alex for serving us
& The delightful lady for giving us
Water to drink.

Best wishes to everyone
At Dishoom Canary Wharf.

venues.name: Six by Nico Canary Wharf
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We had the absolute best time enjoying the Space menu at Six for my birthday celebrations. Staff were fantastic throughout and all of the food and drink was delicious. The cocktail pairing menu was tasty and great value! All of the food was well-considered and beautifully presented. I couldn’t recommend it enough, we had a fantastic time. Thank you!

Really enjoyed our experience today for their space themed menu.

I think from reading reviews and hearing other experiences. I think people are expecting what they’d get from a Michelin star restaurant.

I’ve eaten from Michelin star restaurants before and doesn’t compare? No,. But it’s close. I think this is more budget friendly for people who want to enjoy a similar experience but not pay the cost that comes with it.

Was it cheap?  No but you can opt out of extras and would maybe £60pp. We got staters and the wine pairing for each course (they are pretty generous with wine portions)

But it was busy. It was a tad noisy but the staff were amazing and friendly. Very knowledgeable on the menu and wine pairings for each course And I would 100% go back.

The food portions look small, but we had six courses and was full by the end and I have a pretty big appetite.

I think it’s definitely worth a visit And I will be going back for their Christmas menu.

Had such a great evening at Six by Nico Canary Wharf trying their Space themed 6-course tasting menu with wine pairing. Every dish was creative, beautifully presented, and full of flavour; the wine pairings really lifted the experience. The service was warm, attentive, and made the whole night feel easy and enjoyable. Standouts for me were the Zero Gravity Oyster and the Solar Flare and the pairing that went with it. The pacing between courses gave us time to enjoy without ever feeling rushed. Big thanks to the team, we’ll definitely be back again for the next menu!

This was my partners and I second time here at Six by Nico. We had the APOLLO 11 course meal and the experience was absolutely fantastic! To the detail of flavours and presentation it was an experience to say the least. I would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for a dinner with a fantastic experience!
Had the San Sebastián tasting menu - what a real treat. Food was beautifully presented and tasted amazing, service was great and the price was good value. Definitely plan to go back.

venues.name: Amerigo Vespucci
venues.description: Italian restaurant with a classic menu and an outdoor terrace, set among the towers of Canary Wharf.

reviews.text:
Chill vibes, and a small, quaint atmosphere, makes this place a romantic-like dining spot.
Great service, great food.
We enjoyed the 24hr skimmed ragu spaghetti.  Super yummy.
Brownie and pear desert were a nice finishing touch.

One of the best Italian restaurants, period. My half Italian side was very happy.

It's not that the food was absolutely delicious and outstanding, no, it's not supposed to be! The food was put simply, perfect! Wine selection is ok too.

5 stars for food and service. It shows their strong tradition.
Would give 5 stars to atmosphere as well, it it wasn't for the cigarette smoke coming from people sitting outside, it kinda of ruined the amazing taste of a well made Italian pasta...

Perhaps they should invest on a HVAC or tweak the sitting for the smokers outside, because eating an ash tray is not cool.

We really enjoyed going to this restaurant.  Location is great with views of the wharf. Food was delicious.  Well presented and tasty. Wine list and cocktails is great as well.
And the service, especially for us a party of over 20, was superb.
Highly recommended for big or small parties.

"This fabulous London Italian spot is a must-visit whenever we're in town!
Incredible food, impeccable service (special thanks to Oskar for his warmth and help). We devoured the starter and main too quickly for photos, but the stunning, delicious dessert made the shot.
Pro tip: always reserve in advance!"

Very good food. Enjoyed the pasta very much (and that’s said by an italian). Decent portions and very very tasty. I also probably had the best rum baba I’ve ever had in London. The service very nice. Was much better than was expecting.

venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Amazing first visit!
This was my first time at Efes Restaurant (Whitechapel) and it was such an amazing experience. The customer service was the best I’ve experienced they were so welcoming and even brought a few complimentary dishes (bread, sauces, salad, and tea at the end) which was such a nice touch. We had a lovely small chat with the waitresses, which made us feel right at home. The food was delicious, with generous portions. I would definitely recommend this place and will absolutely be coming back!

A recent, first time visit to this restaurant with family including our 11 year old grandaughter. The prices are reasonable and the staff were so friendly and accommodating to our varied, dietary needs. The food was so delicious, I am bringing some friends along for a social get together evening meal

One of my favorite Turkish restaurants in the area!
I’ve been here many times, and the quality is always outstanding. The food is consistently fresh, flavorful, and truly authentic a great example of traditional Turkish cuisine done right. From the tender grilled meats to the perfectly seasoned sides, everything is prepared with great attention to detail.
The service is friendly and efficient, and the overall atmosphere is relaxed and pleasant. It’s also a big plus that the restaurant stays open late, which makes it a convenient option for a delicious meal, even in the later hours.
Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy high-quality, authentic Turkish food.

We had a lovely night at Efes Whitechapel.
The food was grilled to perfection.. loved the shish and adana! Great flavours. The sides complement the meal, and it was great value for money. Service was excellent, the staff  really look after you 😊
Really, really good food and service. Lamb ribs, chicken wings and lamb doner were excellent. Charcoal grilled makes a huge difference, and we were very impressed. Highly recommend.

venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Excellent food and top-notch service. Everything was full of flavour and cooked to perfection, especially the grilled meats. The atmosphere was lively but comfortable, and the staff were welcoming and attentive. Definitely one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in a while. Highly recommend!

Lovely evening spent with friends in an amazing restaurant, a full range steaks available, absolutely delicious and done to perfection. I would absolutely recommend the buffalo wings! I would have given 5 stars if there was more veggies on the plate.
Jamal and team were very friendly and attentive

Very tasty and spicy, super large portions. Dark interior and poor lighting, though, and poor ventilation was coughing the charcoal smoke. Service great, good for family events as very large restaurant with clean amenities. Book table in advance.
One of my favourite places to eat in East London! Tried the beef short rib today amazing so soft and tender! Lamb fillet steak is my fave! Service by the lovely Omar at our local Whitechapel branch!

I have never experienced such bad service in a very long time. We were served by a young man who looked like he was forced to work there. Absolutely miserable and made us feel like a burden. Please understand that good food comes hand in hand with good service. The service needs improving because it’s a big put off. The first individual that dealt with us became irritated when we wanted to change tables so that we can fit highchairs even though we told him we will need two. A big part of running a successful business is good service.

venues.name: Mr. White’s English Chophouse London Whitechapel
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I went with a couple of friends on 12th Sept. The staff were really polite, patient and very helpful. The food was on point. My steak was cooked perfectly and the mash was absolutely delish! A relaxed vibe and a great place to visit with family or friends. Super easy to get to via public transport, only a 5 minute walk from Whitechapel station. Definitely plan on visiting again with the family.

We went there for our son’s birthday and what a wonderful choice it was! The menu is uncomplicated and the staff are friendly. There’s absolutely no compromise on taste and each dish was booked to perfection. Loved the béarnaise sauce! The Cheesecake with most moreish blueberries was a perfect end! Definitely going back for more.

We were 4, 3 of us celebrating our birthdays. So we decided to get us some good halal steak. The Chophouse popped up and the menu was very attractive.

Loved the vibe of the place and how well isolated it is from the hustle and bustle outside.

We had a reservation, the restaurant knew why we were coming. The initial impression was that the place was very clean and in prep mode for dinner service. We were seated promptly and were handed the menus as well. I liked that we were not rushed in making our choices for any of the drinks or courses. Kudos to the service for observing and being patient.

We got a few mocktails first and scanned the menu for our starters: calamari and camembert duos. Camembert slapped but calamari while crispy felt a bit light on the calamari. It would be good if the restaurant would go for a little bit thicker cut. I would pay a bit more for it if need be.

For the mains we shared a tomahawk with some garlic prawns and a selection of chips/fries and sauces.

Steak: Good size for our appetites but more aimed at being shared between 2 people I would say. We made up for it with the garlic prawns which were very well cooked, dressed and chef's kiss all around. Chunky chips and the fries were very very good as well. Highly rate. Sauces wise the bearnaise and garlic butter combo was my fav with the steak. Also, cute note: the ketchup & mayo pots!! Such a nice touch!

Dessert wise we went for sticky toffee pudding all round and that was the perfect end. Lighter than I'd expected and not too sweet. Really well balanced for my taste.

Overall, I would go here again for such group dinners as there are few great halal steak places around here and this is certainly a contender in the top 10 in London.

Just...more calamari plz.

Shout-out to Ahad for the exemplary service all round!

A solid choice for a dining experience in London! The restaurant offers a menu with classic British and Italian influences, and the quality of the dishes reflects the care in their preparation. The steak and pasta options stand out for their flavor. The atmosphere is stylish and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed evening. While the service is generally good, it could be a bit more attentive during busy times. Overall, a delightful spot worth trying. Recommended 👌.

First time trying this Whitechapel branch. Excellent cut of meats. Chose the mixed grill and the lamb chops were divine, so tender. Really loved the beef fillet and sirloin steak. The green beans are also good and the steak cut chips were fat & crispy. Our server was friendly and hospitable.

reviews.text: Hotto Potto was a great experience. You do all the cooking yourself, which makes it fun and different. The food was full of flavour and really fresh. The menu can be a bit confusing if you haven’t been before, but the staff were helpful and kind, explaining how it all works. Overall, it’s a unique and tasty halal meat experience. I’d definitely go again.

Me and my friend came here last Friday and it was an amazing experience. The lady Sama (I think that’s her name) she personally came and explained how long to cook each dish for. She made us this special dipping oil sauce that had garlic, coriander, scallions, sesame oil, oyster and soy sauce. She even made some of our food and personally plated it for us in our bowls and she did such a lovely gesture of giving me and my friend a cute freebie which was this tote bag. She was genuinely so sweet and lovely and I just wanted to give her a special shout out. Thank you so much if you’re reading this Sama! I also want to thank Vivinz and Alan (again, I think that is their names), they were very lovely and were so welcoming, any time our hotpot needed more water we didn’t even have to ask and they would come immediately and re fill it. Honestly, I loved it so much I told my friends about it and I will definitely be coming here again. The food was so good I literally crave it, especially that dipping oil sauce. They also have a halal menu that has a range of options. Thank you so much guys!! :)

Had an amazing hotpot experience at Hotto Potto! We went for the two-flavour broth with the spicy chilly and tomato soup base, perfect balance of numbing heat and rich, comforting flavour.

The ingredients were super fresh, especially the lamb rolls, lotus root, mushroom platter, and hand-cut chicken. The wide variety made it great for sharing and experimenting with different textures and spice levels.

The sesame and garlic dipping sauces were a great touch, and I appreciated the option to customize everything.

The table setup was clean and efficient, with a good pace of service even during a busy evening.

Total came to about £185 for our group including drinks and a generous 12.5% service charge, which felt very reasonable considering the amount and quality of food.

Definitely a fun, interactive dining experience, will be back, maybe with a group for karaoke next time.

Vivian was our host and she was an excellent host,.

Amazing hot pot in the center of London, I lived in Taiwan for a year and it wouldn’t be surprising if I was still there right now.

Good selection of hot pot soup base, meats, veggies and even some BBQ options.

Literally everything I had was yummy.

There is no sauce bar but they offer some free options on the menu, remember to pick them.

Also, some of the meat preparation are really cute and great for photos!
Vivian was lovely. We loved it here. Asked if we ate halal. Recommended us amazing options. Topped us up without asking. The service and food was amazing. Definitely recommend.

Beef filet carpaccio is delicious 🤤 beautiful presentation as well 👌😋

Authentic Italian Gem in London! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Fantastic Italian spot with delicious handmade pasta, great taste pizza,  The buffala is rich and creamy, and the truffle risotto is a must-try! Cozy atmosphere, friendly service, and authentic flavours make it perfect for any occasion. Highly recommend! 🍕

venues.name: Rasoi Ghar
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: My first time trying Indian food in the UK, and it did not disappoint! Very flavorful and great service too. Try the paneer appetizer, it’s great. The butter chicken was also excellent.

I visited this restaurant recently and was really impressed. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were attentive without being intrusive. The food was fresh, beautifully presented, and full of Indian flavour. I especially enjoyed the butter chicken however, it would have been even tastier if the dishes were a bit spicier.
Best Indian/Goan food I have ever tasted. Highly recommend. Service slow but waiters very friendly.

Absolutely come! The atmosphere feels so perfect, and a great representation of the neighborhood. Everything was clean, delicious, and the service was amazing. The owner and waiters are truly so kind. The owner is actualy the one who offered to take our photo. The food was again, delicious bursting with flavor and spices.

Absolutely fantastic experience! The Indian food here is the best I've had in London, bursting with flavor and authenticity. But what truly sets this place apart is the service. The owner is incredibly sweet, serving each dish with genuine warmth and a smile. You can feel the love and care that goes into every meal. Highly recommend!

venues.name: Lahore Kebab House
venues.description: Turkish hospitality meets London sophistication - where every meal is a celebration. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I came with a friend on their recommendation and I loved it. It's not a fancy place though and it's popular so it does get busy and a bit noisy inside. We came on a Monday evening and we were able to get a table without waiting.

As I can't tolerate too much spice, I went for the safe option of a mild butter chicken and ordered a side of the rogni nan. The food came pretty quickly and also with a complimentary side salad.

The butter chicken tasted delicious and the rogni nan which I'd tried for the first time was the perfect accompaniment. The bread was a little thick and buttery and fairly big so it was enough to go with the curry and I didn't feel the need for any rice on top.

One thing to note is that it is a cash only establishment so do make sure you have enough cash with you.

I am still thinking of that rogni nan in particular, and I would definitely like to return.

First time to this unassuming restaurant but won’t be the last. Fantastic lamb chops, dry meat curry and butter nan. Oh and the chicken korai went down a treat as did the mango lassi. Friendly staff and a nice relaxing atmosphere. No frills but one of the best lamb meals we’ve had.

Don't let first impressions fool you at this local gem. Sure, the neighborhood isn't the most picturesque, and the interior feels like it hasn't been updated since the 1990s. But step past the dated aesthetics, and you'll discover why this place has earned its reputation as a beloved institution in the Pakistani community.

The chicken tikka masala here is exceptional – rich, aromatic, and clearly made with care. Each dish arrives bursting with authentic flavors that transport you straight to the subcontinent. The prices are refreshingly reasonable.

A few practical notes for first-time visitors: they don't serve alcohol, but the BYOB policy means you can bring your favorite beer or wine. Come prepared with cash – while they technically accept cards, the reader has a habit of being "temporarily out of order." Fortunately, there's an ATM just around the corner for those caught off guard.

In short, this isn't a place you'd bring someone to impress with ambiance, but if you're seeking genuine Pakistani cuisine at honest prices, it's hard to beat. Sometimes the best food comes from the most unassuming places, and this neighborhood institution proves that point beautifully

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warmth and genuine hospitality from Usman/Ozzy. His patience and honesty in explaining the dishes, and even catering to our spice level, made the experience extra special.

The Mutton Tikka was hands down the best I’ve had in London...sizzling, distinctive, and bursting with authentic Lahore flavour. Succulent and cooked to perfection, it transported me straight to Pakistan and was even better than Tayyabs, Needoo or any other Lahore restaurants.

The Lamb Haleem was equally unforgettable ...rich, mouth-watering, and perfectly balanced in flavour without overpowering spice plus generous lamb rather than daals and flour mix.

The home-made rotis, made with mixed flour, were not thick or raw...so good they facilitated taste of curries rather than fill you with thick flour!

The Saag Chicken was another standout – tender, juicy chicken enveloped in aromatic, perfectly seasoned fresh saag. What I loved most was that every dish was full of flavour rather than just heat – no “bum-burning” chilli, just pure, authentic taste.

For me, Lahore Kebab House is simply unbeatable for Indian and Lahori food in London. Nowhere else comes close! Don't waste money anywhere else. Just try Mutton Tikka here you'll be craving for more!

I recently visited this restaurant and had a great experience. The food was delicious, with excellent quality and a wide variety of dishes. In my opinion, this is one of the best places in London for Asian food lovers, including Pakistani, Bengali, and Indian cuisine.

venues.name: Du'aa Diner
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: My husband and I love this place! As a niqabi, it can sometimes be difficult to find a good restaurant with private seating but Duaa Diner as very accommodating and so good for niqabi sisters looking for a private seating area as they provide dividers. Our favourite spot for dining out. Food is 10/10 too. May Allah bless your business, ameen.

The food here is absolutely delicious, and the atmosphere makes the whole experience even better. The staff are very friendly and welcoming, which adds to the charm of the place. On top of that, it’s great value for money. Definitely worth a visit!☺️

I recently visited this restaurant. The interior was beautiful, and we ordered a family platter. The meats were good, but the chips tasted as though they had been fried in old oil, and the rice seemed reheated; it was cold and stale.

When it came to payment, I asked if they offered an NHS discount. The staff member said no, even though the restaurant’s social media highlights that they appreciate NHS workers and offer a Blue Light discount. My sister-in-law then asked about a student discount, and the staff member confirmed it was 15%. Our bill was £70, so it should have come down to £59.50, but instead she told us to just pay £65. This made no sense at all.

I believe management should consider retraining this staff member, as she seemed unable to handle a very basic calculation.

This is now my second visit to Du’aa diner. We really enjoyed the food the first time, so we decided to pay another visit.

We ordered the same food, beef rump steak and the loaded box. Unfortunately however, the second time around the standard of the food was not the same.

The Beef rump steak had no seasoning. I had asked for salt and pepper but they told me they ran out of pepper. Disappointing because the first visit it was actually really nice. I do find it strange that they offer salad on the side, instead of vegetables or should offer tenderstem broccoli which would compliment this dish more.

Last time we ordered the mango habanero wings, which was more sweet than spicy. We added the chilli sauce they provided at the table which made it taste much better. Habanero is supposed to be spicy so I would recommend to add spice into this as it does defeat the purpose.

This time we thought we would try something new and we ordered the Spicy Chicken wrap. But I’m sorry to say, I would not pay more than £3.50 for this. It was super thin, the chicken was cut up into small pieces so for it be £10.99 was outrageous.

The Heaven Mojito was really nice along with the complimentary ice cream.

I have to say the ladies who work there don’t seem to speak even when severing the food. It’s very strange. All the staff are polite so would be really nice if they all had a more friendlier approach.

Would I go back? I don’t think so, but would say if you go on a good day it’s decent.
The food is quite nice, steak with chips in mushroomsl sauce nice they cut the steaks in pieces, I came here with family. They ordered their type of food they liked.

venues.name: Tayyabs
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Tayyabs is one of those London spots people always talk about, and after going, I get why. The Punjabi food is bold, full of spice, and cooked with real character. The lamb chops are the dish everyone raves about for a reason…smoky, juicy, and packed with flavor. The karahi curries are rich, hearty, and perfect for sharing around the table. Portions are generous, so you won’t leave hungry.

The atmosphere is buzzing and energetic. It’s not a quiet or intimate restaurant, but that’s part of the charm. It feels alive, with big groups, sizzling plates, and constant movement. Seating can be tight, and it does get noisy, so don’t expect a calm dinner. This is more about enjoying the food and the energy of the place.

Service is quick, sometimes a little rushed, but that matches the pace of the restaurant. Food usually comes out fast and fresh, which is impressive given how busy it gets. The interior is simple and functional…it’s clear the focus here is all about the food.

You might walk out with your clothes carrying the smoky aroma of the grill, but honestly, that’s part of the experience. Overall, Tayyabs is a London institution worth visiting. Go with friends or family, order plenty, and enjoy the flavors.

The place was busy and busy means good vibes! Somewhere whenever you want to dine with family or friends. The service was great didn’t take more than 5 mins to be seated and quickly served water and salad and some poppadoms with we election of sauces. The food came very quickly and hot too! The naan bread was cooked so fluffy!
Overly experience was great, and very busy that I don’t think I saw the same waiter twice!
Thank you and see you again.

One of the best Punjabi restaurants in London! The lamb chops is a must try and mango smoothie. The curries were packed with flavours. Generous portions and good value for money.

The service was good, friendly staff and the venue is usually very busy so it can be loud. Expect long queues even though if you have a booking.

I would definitely recommend this place if you fancy some good curry and willing to wait for a table and like loud atmosphere.

Tayyabs is an East London icon — loud, lively, and unapologetically flavourful. It’s the kind of place where the energy is electric, the aroma hits you the moment you walk in, and the food speaks for itself.

The lamb chops are hands down the star of the show — smoky, tender, and perfectly charred with just the right amount of heat. The chicken tikka is another winner — juicy, well-marinated, and fresh off the grill. Pair that with hot, pillowy naan or their crispy, buttery garlic paratha, and you’re in for a treat.

The Mutton Karahi is rich, robust, and deeply spiced — a proper hearty dish that’s full of depth. The Chicken Saag, with its creamy spinach base and tender meat, brings a lovely balance to the table.

Service is fast-paced but efficient, and the staff know the menu inside out — they’ll happily guide you if you’re unsure. Whether you’re here for a big feast or just a plate of those iconic chops, Tayyabs never disappoints. Just be sure to book ahead — queues are real, and rightly so!

from beginning to end we were received with amazing service, being seated almost immediately and having water, poppadoms, dips & salad being delivered in minutes. our highlights were definitely the sizzling lamb chops, the lamb and spinach (saag meat) & the lentils with baby aubergine! love that it’s BYOB, would most definitely recommend.

venues.name: Dilpasand Restaurant
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I've had takeout as well as eaten in, this place never disappoints.

Last time we got the Chili Kebab (Lamb) --- good, but spicy as advertised, as well as the Desi Tarka Daal, the Lamb Biryani, and the garlic naan. All were great, but the garlic naan wasn't really a favorite. Plenty of garlic and ghee, but the base bread could have been better.

Service is exceptional, fast and attentive. The best Pakistani/Indian food I've had in Whitechapel.

My first experience trying Pakistani cuisine. They made food specially less spicy for us although it was still spicy for me because I normally only use salt and pepper, and some herbs😅. Food was still very delicious and full of spices. Service was excellent, actually one of the most attentive services I had recently. At the end of the meal we got a very delicious dessert, not sure what it was but definitely memorable. For our mains we ordered lamb dishes. The portions were very generous and we couldn’t finish them so took the leftovers home. Looking forward to revisiting this places and trying different dishes.

Came all the way from Dallas after seeing this place on YouTube. We were not disappointed. Meat was melt in your mouth and very flavorful. Chat was finger licking good. Wish we had more room to enjoy everything.
9/25/25: Amazing gola kebab and behari boti, the best I've ever had. Complementary kheer is a great touch. Pani puri was good but not sure I'd get it again here.

Wow! What a amazing experience!

When I went it was super busy and lively. They accommodated me and my friend very quickly!

The food was so delicious and I have no idea what those balls were. I think it was A good dessert so forgive me. But wowwww I'd come back just for those!

Next time I come back to London I'm definitely getting those tasty balls!

Thanks for the kind staff and very nice and caring owner.

venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Food was good but on the platter they had one of the fish dish missing, they did replace it with something else.
Some of the fish lacked flavour so had to add some salt. The prawns were the highlight.

The service was good but a bit slow. Good customer service and mostly attentive. Might have been understaffed.

The decor was good as you can see from the pictures. The restaurant had a good atmosphere. The group I came with might have been a bit too loud (sorry).

I would recommend this place to visit and might even come again

The chicken and lamb grill were unbelievably juicy and full of flavor, and the baklava was the perfect sweet ending. The interior is beautiful with its colorful lanterns and cozy vibe, and the staff were very polite and welcoming. A must-visit spot for amazing food and great hospitality!

I'd call it a hidden gem. It's tucked away in Brick Lane, pretty easy to miss.
Atmosphere is good and food is right on spot: juicy, great mix of rice and vegetables and don't let the salad fool you. I wanted spicy and it was one of the spiciest I had in London.

We enjoyed our lunch at Babel. Chicken was well marinated, mixed grill had mixed reviews from our group, lamb was yummy, rice could be improved, sea bass was a little dry but tasty. Well seasoned food overall, just needed a bit more sauce / juiciness.
Nice decor, good hospitality, took 35mins to serve 9 of us which was ok but a challenge for a work lunch.

Wowwww this place was amazing. Cosy interior, really tasty, authentic food. Polite service, big portions and good vibes. Enjoyed a birthday treat here with family and would recommend to everyone! The best knafeh we’ve had.

venues.name: DanDan Aldgate East
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
It was my first time visiting Dan Dan, and I was so impressed! The prices are super reasonable, especially for London, and the food tastes authentically Sichuan/Shang Chuan — bold flavors, perfectly balanced spice, and truly comforting for someone from Asia.

Yesterday was the Mid-Autumn Festival, and the restaurant gave out complimentary mooncakes with salted egg yolk filling — not just one yolk, but two! The mooncake was delicious and not overly sweet, which I really appreciated.

Warm atmosphere, friendly staff — I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend this place!

Had a lovely lunch with my friend here. The staff are fantastic! They’re so friendly and warm. I felt so comfortable to ask questions about the menu and make small changes to my meal. The food was delicious, I enjoyed every bite. It was flavourful and aromatic. The atmosphere was comforting and I will be back again. Thank you!

Great spot to hang out with friends! Authentic Chinese food. We ordered grilled fish, signature dandan noodle, beef with preserved egg. One thing to highlight is their lunch menu (12-4PM) very affordable, lots of choices, only cost u 8.6 pounds. Can’t believe this offer is available in London

Excellent as usual. Ordered the pork rib noodles and the soup had loads of depth, a good level of spice and a decent amount of meat. The tea is also great value - £2 for a big pot with a choice of 4 varieties. Service is always quick and attentive too.

After we came back from holiday we decided to do a gym day and then go to dinner. With some leftover cash burning my pocket I was desperately trying to find a place that accepted cash, which is a lot harder in the city than anyone or least I thought. After calling no less than 12 places who all said no, I finally found one nearby so we decided to check it out. It's a cute modern Szechuan Chinese restaurant in aldgate. To my surprise it was very busy for a random Wednesday mid afternoon. We got a tabel asked for some recommendations and ordered. Food came out quickly, everything was tasty and made fresh. Our waiter and their whole team was friendly and welcoming and helpful with suggestions. We got to learn that there is some sort of a discount before 6pm on a weekday which gave us a bit of an explanation for the constant people coming in and numerous takeaways. It's a nice, clean, friendly restaurant with a lot of options. They also have a dedicated halal menu, so they cater for their neighbourhood. We had a great time, the food was tasty (highly recommend the peanut chicken dish and the pumpkin dessert!) and the tea was nice. It is our new to-go Asian place in Aldgate now. We will definately be back soon.

venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I’ve never had cuisine from this area of the world and omg best first time I think I could have. The sauces are so good and flavorful. l wanted to try allll the cake options! visit if you’re in the neighborhood or at the Wombats Hostel. Was much needed after traveling all day to get to the hostel

Very friendly staff, colorful and flavorful food. Somali tea is a slightly better, slightly sweeter version of pumpkin spice chai latte (almost same taste from pret a Manager). Chicken was tender, with a unique spice blend. Bathroom clean and modern. Feels like a warm hug after a day of falling in tourist traps in Central Lodon.

This is my second time at this Somali restaurant, and once again, everything was perfect! The food is incredibly delicious, full of authentic flavors, and the portions are generous. The service and the staff are always so welcoming, kind, and attentive. It’s a place where you feel truly well taken care of. I’ll definitely keep coming back — highly recommended!

Janna Cafe is a great spot for a delicious meal. The lamb was tender, fell right off the bone, and was really nice. The sauces were on point, adding great flavour to the dish. The rice was cooked perfectly—light, fluffy, and well-seasoned.

Service was also on point, with friendly and attentive staff. They accept both card and cash payments, making it convenient. Overall, a solid experience and definitely worth a visit!
The food was good, the portions are huge and the price is very affordable.

venues.name: Halal Restaurant
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I found myself warmly welcomed by the staff, especially as a rare Hong Kong local who truly appreciates their Indian cuisine. My brother had been eager to visit this place for a very long time, and I’m glad I was able to fulfill his wish. I’ve dined at this restaurant three times, and each visit has been consistently perfect. The staff are polite and attentive, and the food is always served hot. After paying the bill, they even offer orange slices and delightful candies as a finishing touch. They also took a photo for me and brought me water without me having to ask.
Ordered veg curry , chicken Biryani with dhal and a curry set (meat curry and rice). They had 30 percent off , for £16, ain’t bad food was good quality and nice, decent flavours.

Excellent old school Indian. Used to be a regular haunt of mine when I worked in the city in the 1980's before I moved overseas. Visited for the first time in about 20 years and was delighted to find that it had hardly changed and the food and service were still exceptional.

While visiting London from the US, four locals took me out for a great bit of curry at Halal Restaurant.  The host was super funny and the service was top notch.  It's no wonder that the locals schedule monthly visits here.  Great job!
Very authentic 👌 taste, service is very good and just 15 mins walk from Tower bridge.

about.text: Turkish · in Central London · halal-friendly — Halal Restaurant (Rated 4.3★ · 902+ reviews · FSA 4/5) Halal Restaurant delivers confident turkish plates with a London edge. Order: adana kebab, mixed grill, and baklava. Great for date night, small groups, or a relaxed catch-up. Fair pricing for the quality. venues.name: Grounded London
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Was here for lunch on a weekday. Quite cozy and staff were friendly and helpful. Ordered smoked salmon with poached eggs and a side order of sweet potato fries which were great. The area is quite busy.

Delicious halal breakfast! I ordered the egg & turkey bacon breakfast, and my wife ordered the full English. Loved the fresh Acai smoothie and delicious cappucino. £45 for two is well worth it!
Take note, no reservations here so if you're coming with a party of more than 2, you'll be waiting a while.

The food here was excellent – very filling and full of flavor! Great value for money as the portions are generous for the price. The atmosphere is also really nice and makes it a great place to enjoy a meal.

The only thing I’d suggest improving is the size of the restaurant, as it feels a bit small and can get crowded during busy times. Other than that, everything was great! Definitely recommend.

I don’t know how to start, but the classic beef English breakfast really needs improvement. The beef sausage was flavourless, felt like something from Tesco just cooked and served. The only things I liked were the scrambled eggs, sourdough, and tomato. Honestly, it was just alright, and I don’t get why it’s so popular. I’d recommend picking something else other than the classic beef English breakfast.

Can't really say anything very amazing or very negative about Grounded in Whitechapel. When we arrived it was very busy and were lucky to get a table as there was only 2 of us. The seating layout is quite tight as the location itself is not overly big, we sat at a long table shared with 3 other pairs which was fine. Due to how busy it was the overall atmosphere was just come in, eat, and leave ASAP as the tables were being flipped constantly, and you could see the staff were just trying to manage the level of busy, with that fair play to them but because of this you didn't get that feeling that you could just sit and spend some time at the cafe.
In relation to food, the food was good, but nothing exceptional, the pancakes were okay, if anything the eggs benedict was better.

venues.name: Hichki Indian Restaurant
venues.description: From royal kitchens to London tables - Indian cuisine elevated to an art form. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Great find in Whitechapel for a quick, tasty meal at good prices and good portions.  I was dining alone 7 opted for the mixed grill, chips and naan.  All were nice, hot and tasty.  Service was quick and the staff were friendly.  Some of the decor like the wallpaper is worn, peeling or been stuck back on with tape so the place could do with some investment on it's maintenance, as it did seem to be busy, so getting it spruced up can only attract more people.

The restaurant looks new, with excellent ambiance. I have been to all the Indian Restaurants around Budapest but the staff and food here is one of the best. Excellent location, close to the Chain Bridge. I suggest trying their South Indian food.

Wow, what a fabulous feast!! We were greeted by a very warm welcome from Sristi and presented with a tasty and compact menus with great prices and very generous dishes full of authentic Indian flavour. The signature grill was an exceptional choice. Highly recommended restaurant and will come back again for sure.

We visited at the beginning of July and were warmly welcomed by the friendly staff offering gelato samples outside the shop. They were incredibly kind and helpful, guiding us through the flavors and letting us taste a few.

Before leaving, we asked for a takeaway bag — and to our surprise, the guy handed us an extra cup with the two best flavors to try. Such a thoughtful and generous gesture!

Amazing service and truly delicious gelato. We'll definitely come back!

Last night, I ordered food through Uber Eats. I’m not usually someone who leaves negative reviews, but I felt this needed to be said.

Unfortunately, the food was quite disappointing. Despite the positive reviews that got me excited to order, the experience didn’t match the expectations. The lamb chops were burnt, the Peshwari naan was very dry, the garlic naan lacked any garlic flavor, and the butter chicken tasted overwhelmingly of tomato.

venues.name: Dragon's Den Oriental Kitchen
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Dragon Den’s Oriental Kitchen – A Soup Lover’s Experience

As someone who adores a good bowl of soup, I’ve always had a soft spot for Dragon Den’s Oriental Kitchen. The first time I tried their Tom Yum soup, I was blown away—it was flavorful, comforting, and honestly one of the best versions I’ve had in a while. Naturally, I couldn’t wait to bring my friend and brother along so they could experience it too.

This time, however, things didn’t quite live up to my expectations. We ordered two Tom Yum soups, but the broth tasted a little different than I remembered, and the mushrooms weren’t cooked through. It wasn’t bad, but it didn’t have that same magic that made me fall in love with it before.

On the bright side, their fried dumplings and wontons were excellent—crispy, flavorful, and a definite must-try if you visit. These small bites really delivered and left us impressed.

Despite the hiccup with the soup this visit, I still stand by my love for Dragon Den’s. I’ve had enough good experiences here to know that this might have just been an off day. When I’m craving a warm, comforting bowl of soup, this is still one of the first places that comes to mind.

Verdict: Dumplings and wontons are a win, and the Tom Yum soup—when it’s on point—is something I’ll keep coming back for.

We have been here plenty of times and it is one of our go to places for date night!
Staff are incredibly friendly and are always greeted warmly by staff member called Angel.
Food is always spot and and always great value for money. Affordable meals and generous portions.
We love their chicken katsu curry and their egg fried rice.
See you guys soon!

A lovely place to enjoy Chinese food. Everything was delicious and flavourful. The only reason I gave 4* and not 5 for the food is my personal preference is I prefer my rice with less soya sauce. There are no bells and whistles, just good food done simply. The atmosphere was nice and clean but perhaps a little dated. The toilet facility is clean, however, there is one toilet for both male and female (which is not a problem if not busy). Customer care was great! Angel greeted us and ensured we were ok from start to finish, thank you for being so kind to us. I would recommend and will definitely be returning.

Service was amazing! The lady was very helpful and friendly. She kindly explained the menu items and altered dish to my preference. The food tasted good and the portions were generous, big enough to feed 2-3 people. I would recommend the salt and pepper platter. Very reasonable pricing. Good selection of drinks. Very clean store.

Delicious food! I always come here with my friends, the customer service is the best. Ordering from home just the same! Very big portions and could easily be shared with 2-3 people. Highly recommend for families, friends or even going by yourself!

venues.name: Naan Staap®
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
We had been on our way to get take away kebab rolls from Tayyabs, which is our go-to place in the area.  However, it was raining and miserable and we didn't fancy eating out in the rain. I hate eating in at Tayyabs but that's another review, so we saw this interesting looking place with amazing looking karak chai in the window so we ducked in. It was quite empty when we arrived and we had a ponder and ordered a stuffed bread each and a couple of chai.
We were 4 people and we had the achari chicken naan, potato and cheese naan, lamb qeema masala naan and lamb dum paratha. We tried both the masala and karak chai, and it was great there are full flavour, less sugar and no sugar options!
We had the less sugar, and it was plenty sweet enough!
There's a clean loo and nice clean tables and booths.
We were still hungry so ordered a portion of bhatura, which is 3 pieces and only £1.95!
We had channay, with egg on top, but the flavour wasn't one we were used to, so that was the only dish we weren't so keen on.
To finish, we had to try the karak maska, which wasn't on the menu, but we saw it on a screen advert, which was clotted cream sandwiched between 2 pieces of brioche bread loaf, and a cutting chai cupful of karak chai to pour over the top.  You then eat with a spoon.
Utterly divine!
Would highly recommend and would also go out of my way to go here. There are a few branches around London, but none really in convenient locations to me, just like with some of the other mini chains of desi places. :(
The service was very polite and super patient with the inevitable uncle complaining about the cost of a cup of chai, but seriously the quality of the chai was top notch, possibly made with condensed milk, and so delicious and mouth watering, I couldn't fault it at all.

Excellent food, service is pretty quick and food is made to order, very fresh. Fantastic service, the cashier was keen to explain the menu and incredibly helpful. He was very polite and accommodating. Thank you.

We visited NaaAn Stap and ordered Aloo Paratha, Palak Paneer Paratha, Lamb Gravy, Cajun Naan, and Karak Chai. The Aloo Paratha was decent, and the sauce on the side was nice. Unfortunately, the rest of the food was quite disappointing. The Lamb Gravy was far too oily — it felt like it had way too much ghee, which made it heavy and unpleasant. The Palak Paneer Paratha wasn’t good either. On top of that, the customer service was slow, which made the experience less enjoyable. Overall, apart from the Aloo Paratha and sauce, the food and service left much to be desired.
Peri Peri Chicken Naan and Chicken Qeema Masala Naan was yummy! Freshly made, crispy and fulfilling! Mango Lassi was also good. Staff was friendly. Would definitely come back again!

Had the samosa chaat, aloo masala naan, and the chicken keema naan. The samosa chaat was unparalleled - extremely flavourful and delicious.

The naans were crispy on the outside and super soft on the inside. Best had when hot.

It cost me around 18.5 pounds which was pretty decent for the portion size!

Will definitely visit again for the soul-warming food.
