venues.name: Indi-go Rasoi Westfield Stratford
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Dear Indi-Go Rasoi, if I am going to spend £21.20 on hunters lamb chops and pilau rice, you should be nice enough to not burn my lamb chops.

We all already know that lamb chops doesn’t have as much meat, but over cooking it until it’s burnt and dry (no meat juice) and then serving it is awful, the entire meal tasted bitter because of the burnt ashes on the lamb chops. It was so bad I had to ask for chilli oil from Mrs Chew’s to make the meal taste OKAY!

I can never return to your restaurant to buy anything because this entire experience was awful.

Tried chole bhature here , the curry is burned its overcooked and you can feel it in every bite. Burning smell is so strong But they still served burned curry to customer. Very disappointing, never going to visit again.

Indi-Go Rasoi at Westfield Stratford offers a variety of Indian street food, including dishes like butter chicken, lamb biryani, wraps and various tandoori items. I felt there is a scope for service-related drawbacks. Getting seat for dining will be a challenge especially during peak hours. Was an average dining experience.
I love Indo's street food. Full of flavour. My favourite has to be the Samosa Chaat

Extremely appropriated Indian food. Quantity was alright but there was a general lack of salt and flavour in the paneer wrap. The chutney was sweet too so literally felt like chewing wet sweet bread with paneer and unsalted fries.

venues.name: Cafe Rasa Malaysia
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: It is an ideal restaurant to go to eat after being several hours inside the mall, although it is a small restaurant, it is open and very cosy. Their staff is very friendly and attentive. Although I had never tried Malaysian food, I found its menu attractive and very colourful. After ordering I can say that the Malaysian food is delicious, I really liked its presentation, its flavours and aromas. I especially loved the fried chicken because it was delicious and crispy, I loved it. What would improve is the coconut shake, because it is too sweet and the palate becomes cloying, it seems to me that the bottom had toffee or caramel. Soups are also very tasty. Upon leaving the restaurant they were very kind and generous to give us some jack fruit chips typical of Malaysia.

This is the real deal! Excellent authentic Malaysian food with warm and thoughtful service.

I passed by several times and almost all seats were filled, for good reason. Despite the density of tables, the staff ensure you have plenty of space and move things around for you.

We shared roti with chicken curry (delicious and plenty of chicken pieces), king prawn laksa, beef rendang nasi lemak, karipap and chicken rice.

All were delicious and the sambal served with the nasi lemak was perfect (I reckon the owner is well aware, as they also sell jars for you to take home!). The fried chicken skin was paper thin and crisp, served with flavourful chicken rice.

My only gripe is I wished the nasi lemak was served with more beef rendang as the portion was disproportionate to the amount of rice.

The price is higher than the fast food joints around the corner, but is a much better choice by far.

The restaurant is clean, tidy, comfortable, small, bright, sleek, vibrant but no walls for privacy which was not ideal for my friend. The food was delicious, mouthwatering, tasty, colourful, well presented but it can do with more flavour and can do better according to my friend. The staff are friendly, polite, kind, knowledgeable, respectful, understanding, supportive, well mannered, professional and helpful what I liked a lot in this place. The price was £51.22 which includes service charge of £5.02 but food and drink was £46.20 for my friend and I at this place. If you want to go there you can but keep in mind that is small place and it will remind you of Malaysia although you are not in there and you smile when you’re in the restaurant.

Absolute gem of a restaurant in the shopping centre. The food and the decor is top notch with a great courteous staff and the owner of the restaurant is a fantastic person to have a chat with. Also the business is in a positive limelight with the local community was a great piece of information. Staff were great to talk to and felt that I was in Malaysia for a while. The vibes were that good. Thank you!

I ordered the fried chicken leg rice set. The chicken leg itself had a nicely crisp skin, but the meat was bland and lacked any tenderness or bounce. The yellow rice was overly salty and didn’t carry the fragrance or richness of chicken oil that you’d expect. As for the soup, it tasted mainly of star anise and salt, with none of the depth or comforting flavour of real chicken broth. Considering the price, the overall quality felt very disappointing and not worth it.

venues.name: Al zayt Restaurant
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I have been there with family of four and tried their Beef Koduttam and garlic naan as a stater. We saved the Al Zayt special plater for the mains. The food was good and delicious however we ask for some spice with the a beef Koduttam and was denied. Highly recommend their Lemon juice Jug. That one is 10/10. The tables and cutlery was clean but could be polished and that applies to the glassware as well. Will be back to see if there is any progress. Thanks for having us as a walk-in guest today. Keep up the good work

We had an incredible dining experience! The food was bursting with flavor we ordered the mandi and alfahm chicken, both of which were outstanding. My only suggestion would be to increase the size of the alfahm chicken plate, as the plate was a bit small and made it challenging to enjoy the meal properly. The restaurant was a bit smoky, but the delicious taste made it worth it. We also ordered black tea, which took quite a while to arrive. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I definitely plan to come back!

Tried the Honey Alfaham Mandi and Chicken Pollichathu and both were absolutely flavorful! 🍗🔥 The mandi came with perfectly spiced rice topped with juicy, smoky chicken glazed in a touch of honey – rich and satisfying. The chicken pollichathu was bursting with bold spices, tender meat, and a beautiful hit of herbs. 🌿 Each bite felt like a burst of authentic taste.

If you’re craving a mix of aromatic rice dishes and spicy grilled delights, Alzayt is a must-visit! 🙌

I had the afgani chicken which was absolutely delicious as well as the naan bread! The rice dish was also good but not superior. Atmosphere was okay. All in all still a good experience and would recommend.

The food at Al Zayt Restaurant is absolutely amazing! We regularly order their peri peri, alfaham, and mandi, and it's always so yummy and packed with flavour. While the atmosphere inside can be a bit congested, the staff are very nice and friendly. The delicious food and budget-friendly prices make it our go-to spot. Highly recommend!

venues.name: FAT CHEF (Authentic Indian Kitchen) Halal
venues.description: Authentic Indian cuisine that's as vibrant as the streets of Delhi - bold, beautiful, and delicious. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: My husband went to collect food today from this Indian takeaway. We ordered a king prawn jalfrazi and chicken vindaloo, and it was absolutely delicious! The food was full of flavour and cooked to perfection. Definitely ordering from Fat Chef again!

Was really yummy. One of the best Indian food’s I’ve had in London, at a really affordable price with big portions and fantastic value for price. Will definitely come again! Delivery was also very quick!
Ordered a few dishes from Fat Chef and Alhamdulillah the food was 10/10 Allahuma Barik and also the customer service was 10/10 would highly recommend

Starballers Academy approached the Fat Chef team to cater for us on two separate occasions. They provided us fantastic services in all aspects even though we requested the orders with short notice. The orders were for 45 people and food was great on both occasions. Their customer service, professionalism and communication was excellent. They exceeded the expectations and executed their services to a high quality. We would recommend Fat Chef to all those requiring catering that is inclusive of tasty food and exceptional customer service.

I recently ordered from Fat Chef and it was a delightful experience. The flavors were authentic, bold, and vibrant, capturing the essence of traditional Indian/bangladeshi cuisine.

If you're craving delicious, authentic Indian food, I highly recommend this place. The dishes were flavorful, portions were generous, and everything was cooked with care. Perfect for a cozy night in or a quick meal on the go. Will definitely be ordering again!

venues.name: HS & Co
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Had a lovely experience here. The food is fantastic, and amazing recommendations from our waiter, Hamid, who recommended us the Honey & Jalapeño chicken wings.  We also had the garlic prawns, and steaks. All of it was a 10/10. The mocktails are amazing too. We also tried the sticky toffee pudding, as recommended by Hamid. Will definitely be coming again. Thank you to all of the staff, and Hamid, for giving us such a lovely anniversary dinner.

Amazing food and service! The rib eye steak was cooked perfectly and the Sunday roast in a Yorkshire pudding was delicious. Also really liked the halloumi fries. Big thanks to Hamid for looking after us so well — highly recommend checking out HS&Co!

I had such a beautiful experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely stunning — every dish was full of flavour, perfectly presented, and clearly made with care. But what truly made the visit special was the service.

There was one guy working on the shop floor, and he was just incredible. So lovely, welcoming, and genuinely kind — his hospitality really stood out. Even though he was running the floor on his own, he was fast, efficient, and so calm under pressure.

A true hidden gem, definitely will be backzx

Absolutely loved this place! The hospitality here is on another level – it was one of the first things that stood out for me. Ahmed was outstanding, super welcoming and really knew what to recommend – his suggestions were spot on. The food was delicious, full of flavour, and everything is halal so no worries there at all. They’ve even got a prayer space, which just shows the extra thought and care put into the experience. Overall, hospitality gets a 10/10 from me. Can’t wait to come back again – this place is a gem!

Beautiful restaurant with great atmosphere and decor! We ordered two mocktails one was a cherry one with lime and the other was mint mocktail both drinks were amazing ! For the starters we had ghost wings and calamari which was amazing for the mains we had beef roast dinner and baked salmon both were very good very filling all in all good food for amazing pricing and would defo be returning again the staff were excellent friendly and helpful.

venues.name: Steakout Stratford
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I’ve eaten here a few times now, and to be honest it has been very consistent. The steaks are always cooked exactly how I like them and the flavours are fantastic. Customer service is also very good. I can’t really fault this place. It is a little pricey but it’s not an everyday thing. The meat is all halal.

recently had the beef steak here, and honestly, it was one of the best I’ve had in a long time. The steak came out perfectly cooked…juicy, tender, and full of flavor with every bite. You can tell they really know how to handle good quality meat and cook it just right. It wasn’t overdone or underdone, just spot on, which is rare to find these days.

The portion size was generous, and it felt like real value for money considering the quality. The seasoning was simple but balanced, letting the natural flavor of the beef shine through. I didn’t feel like it was drowned in sauces or overcomplicated …..it was just a proper, well-executed steak.

The sides complemented the meal really well too, fresh and not greasy. Together with the steak, it made for a satisfying plate that leaves you full but not heavy.

Service-wise, everything was smooth. The staff were friendly, attentive, and quick without being intrusive, which makes a big difference when you’re out to enjoy a meal. The atmosphere of the place added to the experience cozy, welcoming, and comfortable enough to sit back and enjoy without feeling rushed.

Overall, this is the kind of spot I’d recommend to anyone who appreciates a good steak. It’s definitely worth coming back for, and I’ll be doing exactly that. If you’re in the area and craving beef cooked properly, this place won’t disappoint.

Ok wow
What an experience- we didn’t know what to expect. The place was dead. To put it politely. Although it was a Monday night. There were a few people in for deliveries but yeah. They also had no Coca Cola or Pepsi, so we had the new thing. It was great.
The pictures will tell the story but only so much. The food here is fantastic: Layla served us, she was so attentive throughout, entertaining and charming. Really lovely young lady
Now for the starter - I had the Nachos with oozing cheese and spinach- this reinvented the concept of nachos for us. And we aren’t going back to crisps on a plate with splodges - this is the only way to have them.
Mike, my love, he had the onion rings, these were hand made, crispy batter with a lovely sauce.
Then for the meat, we both had lamb with the house sauce and it was unbelievable and excellent value as well especially for the area.
Highly recommended

In terms of atmosphere that was all fine. No music playing which is what I prefer and the place wasn't loud. The waiters don't annoy you. I liked the atmosphere very much.

The service was great. Everyone was helpful and accommodating. I did make a small complaint about the chips which I'll elaborate on later but the guy just said okay and did nothing about that which I thought was poor hence the 4/5 star rating. Besides that it deserves a 5.

We started off by sharing a few mix grills between 6 people, you basically get in one mix grill, 3 lamb chips, 3 chicken strips and 3 wings. The wings were the highlight for me the chicken fell off the bone and all of the food had good levels of heat it wasn't overly spicy but perfect amount of spice and there's home made chilli sauce on the table which was delicious and gives you extra spice if you want it. You can even ask for spicy if that's what you want.

For mains we all had the 340g fillet mignon steak cooked medium. They cooked it perfectly as we asked. It was a nice big heavy portion a lot of smaller people will struggle with that but it'll fill you up till bed time. It was juicy, tender and we had the one marinaded with steakout spices so it has solid flavour, I cannot fault the steak. We also tried the chicken steak which was juicy and wasn't dry. The spice level was perfect and it was butterflied so it wasn't thick. No issues with this either.

For the sides we had macaroni cheese which was good, nothing special. It was cheesy and tasted like decent macaroni, I've had a lot better but it's still decent. We also had steak chips but we found a lot of our steak chips were raw from the center, they were busy so they probably rushed it. I personally think they should have taken this off the bill but they just played it off. I didn't argue it, I definitely could have but the rest of the food was solid hence why I didn't bother.

The garlic sauce for the steak was very garlicy which garlic lovers will be happy about it was nice but too strong for me. The peppercorn sauce was my favourite really flavourful and complimented the steak and chips perfectly. The mushroom sauce was nice too maybe a little watery but not bad like it was inedible, it still tasted good. Personally, I would say have the peppercorn sauce and the home made chilli sauce which is on the table. The table also has heinz ketchup and Hellman's mayonnaise.

The kids had chicken strips and fries and pop corn chicken and fries. The chips were skin on fries which were perfectly cooked. The chicken strips were delicious and the popcorn chicken was fine perfect for kids.

We also had the guava mocktail which was delicious unfortunately I have no picture of this. I would recommend this drink it's quite sweet so if you don't like sweet drinks it won't be for you.

The place I would say is a bit pricey but worth it if you love steaks. I've had it before and the chips were fine but this time they weren't so this isn't a regular problem I imagine and you can just send them back to cook properly. Also, everything is halal and no alcohol is served here so perfect for Muslims. A lot of seating is available, additional seating downstairs. I would say make a reservation after 6pm they get very busy they had queues outside today but that might be because it was Eid.

I'd give this place 9/10. Some minor improvements can be made to make this place better and I'd appreciate if they took the initiative to rectify problematic food instead of me having to push for that, it's basic customer service. Again, I know I could have sent it back but they were busy and the steaks were out I couldn't be asked waiting for chips whilst my steak got cold or eat chips alone. On busy days maybe get fries to avoid this.

This is the third time we have visited steakout and each time improves! Both previous times we went an hour before closing yet the staff still served us and were friendly but today we decided to visit earlier and we were pleased we did. Both Ibrahim and Bazil (apologies if spelt wrong) were beyond kind and helpful. Not only did Bazil inform us of a deal for us to save money and get more out of our order but he also corrected a mistake made immediately after it was mentioned and let us keep the extra food! Very attentive and often came to ask if everything was okay which shows how much they care about their customers. The steak was cooked to perfection, the rice soft and packed with flavour, the vegetables soft and paired perfectly with the food and the pepper sauce was a delight!! Thank you to the management and staff that were working today for making the experience wonderful!

venues.name: BABABOOM
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Bland and lacked flavour. Ordered the Chicken Shish Power Bowl. So disappointing! The crunchy pitta crisps were nice (although they looked like potato) so I cannot say for certain if it really was pitta.

Service was good. Food looked good but had zero taste unfortunately.

I ordered without the slaw and pomegranate seeds but was given so much salad leaves which I did not want. It was take away so didnt realise once I got to my destination. The menu did not mention any salad at all! See attached pic.

Food looks colourful but did not have any flavour. They were generous with the chicken however.

Waste of £10.95 especially with the variety of food options available at that food court.
Halal food
Service was standard wait time

We only wanted chips! Waited 20 mins just for chips. There are five people working here but all five seem to be working on one order at a time. So many inefficiencies going on!

The chips are delicious! But was it worth the wait? Sadly not. I won’t be returning. If you’re hungry, I wouldn’t bother. The blind leading the blind! Somebody needs to take charge and give each member of staff their own job and create a process otherwise we are going to see the back of this eatery.

If dry kebab and rubbery chicken shish are your thing, congratulations — you’ve found your paradise. The meat had all the flavor of a damp paper towel, and the sides looked like they gave up halfway through existing. Service? The beef brisket kebab was just a sausage served on some off bread. Never again.

I came to Westfield on one of the busiest days of the year, and was treated lovely by all the workers in Bababoom.
They kindly gave me recommendations for me and my vegetarian friend. I was pleasantly surprised by the multiple vegetarian options they had in store.
The food was absolutely delicious, I tried the beef powerbowl and my friend has the falafel kebab. The sweet potato hummus really stood out to me.
Thanks to the whole team, will be coming back soon!

The restaurant was clean, tidy, big enough for the staff to cook in, hygienic, bright, good equipments and organised safely which is amazing because they did well keeping it clean when they make food for people. The staff were friendly, kind, knowledgeable, polite, well mannered, sociable, respectful, honest, helpful, trustworthy and thoughtful people who understood people needs in food especially with dietary restrictions like only halal food which is amazing for Muslims. The food was well served, balanced, portioned, healthy, flavourful, colourful, delicious, mouthwatering, fresh and had bit of everything from salad to meat. The food and drink for 2 people cost £33.35 and it was worth paying for it because they did so good preparing and making the food. My friend and I went there today with expectations they would make it good and we were not wrong, you should go there whenever you can because they have options for everyone including one with dietary restrictions. Make sure you can find a table in advance because once they run out you got to go somewhere else to eat your meal.

venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Whilst heading to London Stadium for an event we were seeking somewhere to get food quickly. The menu seemed great so we ordered and were told that it would take about 10 mins to make and that they would call out when our order was ready. I said that we would be at the tables 10-15 yards in front of the van, out of the rain- he said that would be fine. Both our burgers were well made and tasty, and the fries were delicious. The price was competitive for the area. The only let down was the service regarding collecting our order. I stood within view about 15 yards from the van and watched as other customers who had ordered after us were signalled over to collect theirs. After about 25 mins I came up to ask if ours was ready to which the server in a disgruntled manner said he had already called out to us. Even though I was wearing a distinctive hat he had not beckoned to me (as he had to other customers) and if he called out the burger menu names it was not audible at 15 yards away. What would make this a 5 star review next time would be an improvement notifying customers the order is ready- either saying please stay close to the van due to not being able to remember customers/say orders loudly or changing to a system that has order numbers that can be clearly said or displayed once they are ready to collect.

I tried the beef loaded brim box, in all honesty it was that bad. However it was not worth £8.95, especially since it came in a small bowl. The fries were nice but didn’t have any salt on them, but it was alright because they gave me a generous amount of cheese which didn’t make me miss the salt. The mince also didn’t have any salt on it, or seasoning to be honest, but that wasn’t my problem with the mince.

My problem was the fact that it was burnt and hard, and not just some but majority of the beef was burnt and hard. The bbq sauce was amazing I really loved it. I had the yellow square cheese and extra cheddar cheese on top, the amount of cheese was good and made the meal that much better. It doesn’t leave you full and I don’t think I’ll order from here again due to it being overprice. The staff, were nice but one of them (the man) also had a bit of attitude.

I tried the loaded brim box, in all honesty it was that bad. However it was not worth £9.95, especially since it came in a small bowl. The fries were nice but didn’t have any salt on them, but it was alright because they gave me a generous amount of cheese which didn’t make me miss the salt. The mince also didn’t have any salt on it, or seasoning to be honest, but that wasn’t my problem with the mince.

The bowl the food was served in was nice and I really appreciate that they still do plastic cutlery, as I have been suffering out here with all the rubbish wooden cutlery. Overall it wasn’t bad, but definitely not worth it.

The brim box is delicious! But £8.95 for small bowl is annoying. Used to be £7.95 and even then it was too expensive for the amount of food. Service is top, very good customer service and they were quick to serve
Great staff, great food. The stax box was absolutely amazing. Must have if you’re ever in Westfield Stratford.

BRIM is expanding big style and with a strong quality focussed vibe through its marketing materials and a decent local following i had to check it out.

We will start with the fries: Despite being a sweet potato fries fan, which are on offer I decided to opt for regular cheese fries. Because I love cheese and I know most people will go for regular type potato fries. At this price point I was a bit disappointed. The fries themselves were pretty basic and cheap feeling. Certainly okay, but not noteworthy. No where near as good as Five Guys on a good day. The cheese sauce was also cheap and way worse than a Shake Shack cheese fries sauce. 10p of materials for £1 price uplift and whilst pleasant enough, did not feel like good value.

Let’s talk about the burger. They have a fun concept that any burger type can be ordered with either single patty at 4oz, 2 patties at 8oz or 3 at 12oz. They even have a crazy 5 patty burger for an unnecessary 20oz = 566g of beef. I had the Brim burger in the 12oz version which gives you 3 patties and I believe 3 cheese slices, but it was pretty melty and seemed like less cheese overall than a regular Five Guys 2 patty burger. The pickles were reasonable. But the sauce was a little bit jammy and sweet for my taste. The beef quality was good and the fat and salt content hit the burger spot very well.

I will add that if you hang around the van whilst they are cooking your burger, you get to swirl quite literally in the delightful aromas of the beautiful beef you are about to consume.

Also although the beef is apparently not frozen, it is cooked to well done. Nothing rare here today…

But for me, the overall balance of the burger, although the beef is very good, and the sub-standard fries in this market will not be able to persuade me away from the ever trustworthy and reliable Five Guys, particularly when you factor the peanuts into the equation at their non-mall venues.

The guys serving were great, although it did take a while for the food to be ready.

venues.name: Tanjia Restaurant
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Found a real hidden gem in Stratford: Tanjia, a Moroccan restaurant literally right outside the station. We tried a bit of everything – couscous, fish tagine, chicken livers, a few starters – and everything delivered. The fish tagine was a standout, rich and perfectly cooked, full of flavour. The chicken livers were another hit (definitely don’t skip them).

The staff were genuinely lovely, prices very reasonable, and the whole vibe felt authentic without trying too hard. Funny enough, we only discovered it through an Instagram Reel, and now I’m wondering how I’d never been before considering I’ve lived in East for ages.

Definitely one I’ll be coming back to – and bringing friends next time.

Absolutely recommendable! It was our first time trying Moroccan cuisine – and we were positively surprised! I had the Couscous Deluxe: a delicious variety of tender meats, from beef to chicken, served with a mix of flavorful vegetables. Truly outstanding! The caramelized onions on top added the perfect finishing touch. But be warned – the portion sizes are definitely not for those with a small appetite!

Prices are around £20–25 per person, which is honestly a steal for the quality and quantity you get.

Also worth mentioning: the place is very child-friendly. A sweet little girl was sitting at the table next to us, and the owner treated her with such kindness and warmth. She was clearly having a great time – it was lovely to see.

A big thank you to the very attentive waiter and the friendly owner (I assume?) – you made the experience even more enjoyable!

Really beautiful restaurant I must say! Simply breathtaking traditional pieces and cuisine.

In the back of the restaurant there is shisha area. Restaurant was not busy at the time of my visit, but calm and relaxed atmosphere.

Prices are fair as well as portions, cooked very well and delicious. On the table we had ordered beef tanjia and kafta meshwi (my personal favourite), the dishes are well seasoned, brings out true Moroccan goodness! Worth a try to taste true cuisine!

Restaurant has private area for large gatherings. The plates, the tables, and the seating area is gorgeous!

The restaurant is easy to locate and access. The waitress serving us made sure we are comfortable and had everything we needed, very sweet.

Tanjia is authentic Moroccan cuisine the food has flavour and the gentleman a real brother named Mahedi whose a top man served me well the atmosphere is definitely old school Moroccan with Moroccan vibes the assist in the digestion of you well prepared food portion

great taste, amazing service and huge portions! everything so traditional and good quality.

The service, unbeatable… definitely will repeat!

venues.name: Cabana
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Came for lunch, really enjoyed it. Spacious inside with funky tunes and open kitchen providing all the atmosphere. We had one of each taco, big bowl of padron peppers, the gorgeous bean stew and winning casava with truffle + parm. Great price with offer; want the tomahawk next 😋
Shout out Aisha who was perfect professional waitress.

We had a lovely dinner at Cabana in Stratford. Started off with the grilled prawn tacos, which were fresh and full of flavour. For mains, we had the grilled chicken skewer and the flat iron steak—both were cooked beautifully and really satisfying.

The only downside was the cocktails, which didn’t quite hit the mark for us taste-wise. Everything else was spot on though, and we’d definitely recommend the food—just maybe skip the cocktails.

Really nice place with surprisingly good food.

The burgers were both well-cooked and nicely presented. The desserts were excellent—especially the burnt cheesecake. I'm not sure if it was made in-house, but it was rich, cheesy, and full of flavor.

That said, the service and cleanliness could use some attention. We noticed a cable above our table that was covered in dust, which made us a bit uncomfortable.

Overall, a good experience with great food—just needs a bit of polish on the service and cleanliness.

The chicken thighs were tender and lovely but missing the ‘X factor’. The chimichurri sauce was decedent. Service was attentive and the overall environment is vibrant without being overwhelming. Service from the French waiter was excellent!

Exceptional Dining Experience
I recently dined 1st time here and I must say it was an amazing experience from start to finish! The atmosphere was warm with a beautifully designed space that made for a comfortable and enjoyable meal.
Our server, Delia, was absolutely fantastic! She was attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our visit. Her recommendations were spot on, and she went above and beyond to make our dining experience special.
The food was simply outstanding—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish we ordered was cooked to perfection, and you could tell the ingredients were of the highest quality.
Overall, I highly recommend Cabana to anyone looking for delicious food, great ambiance, and top service. A special thank you to Delia for making our visit so enjoyable.

venues.name: Tripti's Thai Pie Stratford
venues.description: Where Thai tradition meets London sophistication - expect fireworks in every bite. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
VISIT DATE: FRI 13/12/2024
VISIT TIME: 19:30

Situated a short walk from Stratford (and even closer to Maryland station), this is a nice enough looking establishment, which seems popular with locals.

Portion sizes were reasonable and the food tasted nice, but wasn’t outstanding.

Has a lot of seats as there is another area to sit downstairs, but points lost for the fact that upstairs you will get cold during winter as no inner door to prevent the cold coming in when people come in and go out, plus no sign of an accessible toilet. It also wasn’t very clean and the waiter misgendered my female friend based on her having short hair.
The food was absolutely delicious and full of authentic Thai flavour. The staff were incredibly warm and welcoming, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Came here before West Ham game. Was not very busy, I imagine is busier in the evening. Food was great, although I accidentally ordered 2 mains as I picked a rice that was a main to go with my red Thai curry. So very filling! Crackers were nice and fresh also.

Outstanding Thai Flavors in the Heart of Stratford!

Thai Pie is an absolute gem. From the moment you walk in, you're greeted with warm hospitality and a cozy, modern atmosphere. The menu offers a fantastic range of authentic Thai dishes and Traditional pies and a fast food menu for the kids,  With  each bursting with flavor and beautifully presented.

I tried the Pad Thai, Green Curry, red curry and some of the appetisers, all were exceptional. The ingredients were fresh, the spice level was perfectly balanced, and the portions were generous.

Service was prompt and friendly, and the staff clearly care about making every guest feel welcome and attentive to their needs. Whether you're a Thai food connoisseur or trying it for the first time, Thai Pie is a must-visit in Stratford. Highly recommended!

This has been one of the best Thai restaurants I have ever tried to. Their pineapple rice was my first time and I loved it. The chicken, pad Thai and fried rice were outstanding. Winner of Thai restaurants in east London

venues.name: The Solo Kitchen & Bar
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I looked for a restaurant for a ketosis friendly lunch. This mediterranean restaurant fitted my purpose. We ordered one Solo breakfast for my wife and one Mediterranean for myself.  Except its sourdough toasts, everything on the plate are just good. Very convenient location.  Just at the exit of the tube line.

I hosted a party here for 80 people last weekend on the rooftop and it was simply amazing. The communications with Leo and his team were spot on from the outset. Leo answered all of my questions really quickly and provided such a great space and atmosphere on the night. The night ran smoothly, the bar was fully stocked, my DJ was able to set up really quickly, the sound was great, the food was delicious and the staff were so friendly and respectful. I would not hesitate to host another party here and the feedback from all of my guests was incredible! 10/10 would recommend. Thank you!

I hired the rooftop area to host a wedding party with 50-60 friends, and it was a great success. The venue was stunning with green garden as a background, and food was good and affordable. Leo and bar staffs were absolutely accommodating and flexible to our requests!
An unexpected treat. Given the incredible proximity to the tube station the food here and the atmosphere was sunny views onto the park really really passed our expectations.

I had my Wedding After Party on the terrace here yesterday afternoon and it was absolutely gorgeous! Not only was it a delightfully sunny day in London, but the rooftop has a lovely view of the church in the background. The service was great, and Leo was a fantastic host, barman, and all-round service manager - he makes a great cocktail too! The staff were friendly and attentive. Vibes were high! Thanks team!

venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I have been several times eating in Fatto a Mano in Bethnal Green and it was great every time we went! The food is amazing and the staff is wonderful, specially Amanda and Jess who were very kind and helpful all the time. We also have a treat from a promotion/prize!

Thank you and see you soon!

A fabulous pizza restaurant with outdoor and indoor seating. It was lovely to enjoy the late afternoon light. The pizzas were amazing, the chewiness of the crust is stunning and the toppings were flavourful and juicy. I loved the ‘njuda pizza, it had the perfect amount of heat. I found the desserts less notable than the pizzas.

I finally made it to Fatto a Mano in Bethnal Green, and wow, what an experience!

Now, let’s talk about the Arrabbiata Pizza. As someone who loves a little spice, this was an absolute game-changer.
Every bite was a perfect balance of heat and freshness!

Beyond the food, the service was fantastic. The staff were super friendly, passionate about their menu, and made sure everything was perfect.

If you’re a fan of authentic Neapolitan pizza with a bit of spice, this is THE place to go. I’ll definitely be coming back

Brilliant new local place. Such amazing vegan pizzas (and garlic fries), great drinks and lovely pizzas and dips. Highly recommended and our servers (one was called Ayeesha and the other was a lovely and tall person) were amazing.

The special Ti Amo Napoli is one of the most disgusting pizzas I’ve ever eaten. It has an extremely sharp taste most likely from the green sauce that makes it inedible. However what made this one of my worst culinary experiences was the two long brown hairs in two of the slices. See photos, absolutely disgusting, will never be ordering from here again.

venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Wonderful Breakfast Experience at Maples!

A group of six ladies, we went to Maples for breakfast and had an amazing time. We ordered a variety of sweets, breakfast dishes, and other options — everything was absolutely splendid! The food was delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. Yum yum! We left feeling very happy and satisfied. Highly recommended for a delightful morning treat!

We came in right around 8:20 on a Sunday and there was only one staff member working the front. She was really quick at getting us a table and taking our order. We had a change of plan so this was a pleasant surprise for us. The food was visually appealing as well as tasty. Everything tasted fresh and well seasoned. The portion sizes were also huge. The restaurant came alive as we waited for our food. It felt more like a local hangout spot. There were families, groups of friends and just locals stopping by for their morning coffee. We definitely stumbled upon a local hidden gem.

The restaurant is not far from Bethel Green station and it is quite close to young V&A museum.

It is quite busy and crowded on a Sunday morning, however it doesn’t impact the food quality.

We were able to walk in and get a seat for two persons. We decided to have Bénédict’s and avocado on sourdough with scrambled eggs.

The presentation of the dishes was beautiful, and they tasted great as well. They definitely taste healthy if you would like some more seasoning you can add salt and pepper.

There was no service charge and the price was so affordable in London. Staff were very helpful and friendly. Please tip them.

I will definitely come back.
Gorgeous plates of homemade fresh food that could be art! Generous portions and delicious. The staff is kind and attentive, and the service was very fast. Fresh juices yum! Highly recommend.

I kept on walking past here and noticed there’s always a queue so finally decided to try and I do not regret nothing I queued maybe for about 20 mins max was seated and i ordered a chai latter / coconut french toast as well as toast with smoked salmon and eggs.

The food came out quickly the french toast was perfect just how i like it moist flavorful not too sweet the coconut added texture to it and the berries compote gave it the right amount of sweetness it needed. The toast was beautiful personally would of loved more feta but that’s personal preference! Nice place definitely worth trying at least once! The staff was nice and quick. No complaints.

venues.name: Palmers Restaurant
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: A friendly and busy neighbourhood restaurant. We went to check out their Sunday roast. The place has 4 outside tables if you want to brave the weather. They also have wheelchair access to the inside and seating space for disabled. The place is friendly, clean and has a cool feature wall with 100s of wine bottles. Sunday roast is good, however i recommend the beef, the chicken for me was questionable. Drinks menu is also good and they have some reasonably priced lemonades in case you dont drink alcohol. The place accepts both card and cash payments. Reservations recommended on sundays.

Some friends said it was one of the best roasts in London and the hype was real. Me and my partner ordered the pork belly and the beef one. The amount was generous, the veggies were good, specially the roasted potatoes. The beef was super tender, flavourful and good amount. The pork belly was super crispy, but the meat itself also was soft and melted in your mouth. They usually give a small piece for pork belly but this one was big too. Amazing roast and one of the best ones I've had!!

Excellent service, food, and staff. I’m proud to be local to this gem. I often enjoy calm solo dinners here since it’s just around the corner. They are truly different from any other modern European restaurant. Their menu is great and changes from time to time, but it never disappoints. I especially get excited when they include more seafood, as their chef really knows what they’re doing. Their steak is almost legendary — my neighbors and I always talk about how they make the best steak. Recently, I tried their cauliflower dish as my main (trying to cut back on meat), and oh my word... the flavors, the sauce — you MUST try it. Also if you can , finish your dinner with their chocolate pudding… just saying.

Finally went to Palmers Restaurant after living around the corner for almost two years and kicking myself I didn’t go sooner. Ordered the prawns and sirloin steak and the prawns were delicious, whole prawns, plump and grilled so had that lovely char, and the steak was on par with Hawksmoor or even Devonshire. My friend had the chicken and couscous and she loved it. They make a mean raspberry GnT and it’s great value for money. Highly recommended local spot.

My partner and I went to Palmers Restaurant for the first time on Sunday and we were really impressed! The restaurant was clean and tidy with a great atmosphere, the staff were really friendly and polite and the food was exquisite! We both went for a Sunday roast and by the end of it, decided that it was one of the best we had ever had (even better than Hawksmoor!). We will definitely be visiting again!

reviews.text: Food & atmosphere were exceptional! The service was top tier and the staff made a birthday soooo special! Will definitely be back and will pass on as a recommendation to my friends!!!
Super great food and service. We had the arepa, fried egg sandwich and a Bloody Mary and it was amazing! Thanks
Loved the ambiance of the place. Everything we ordered was tasty. The Humita and the Pineapple tart dessert were excellent. Simple menu, but overall we loved the experience of dining there.

I’ve been for both dinner and brunch and had a great experience both times! The staff are lovely and accommodating, particularly in light of the hangovers me and my party were nursing during the brunch service. Make sure to go early for a more peaceful atmosphere at the weekend, as it’s a popular spot and can get a little overwhelming.
Fantastic place, loved having the pianist playing while we ate. Great food and service, couldn’t ask for better! Will be back soon

venues.name: Arepa & Co Venezuelan Restaurant - Bethnal Green
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We went to Arepa & Co and had such an amazing experience, it was our first time trying Venezuelan cuisine, and we loved it so much we went back two days in a row! We started with the Palm Salad, which was fresh and flavorful with grilled palm hearts, cherry tomatoes, shallots, capers, and lettuce. For our main dishes, we tried the Arepa Pabellón, filled with shredded beef, black beans, ripe plantains, and cheddar cheese, and the Pabellón Reina, a rice bowl with chicken, mayo and avocado mix, black beans, fried plantains, and cheese. The flavors in both dishes were incredible, especially the fried plantains, they were absolutely amazing! The restaurant also had tons of gluten-free options, which was perfect for my mum. Overall, it was a wonderful introduction to Venezuelan cuisine, and we can’t recommend it enough.

I had a wonderful afternoon at Arepa & Co, sharing a special event with my family. We attended a VR experience where we got to see our country, and both before and after the show we enjoyed some fantastic food and drinks.
We started with a few cocktails, including a Diplomatico that was the perfect way to begin. The tequeños with sauce and the arepitas con nata were absolutely delicious. We then followed up with cachapas, empanaditas, and a refreshing passion fruit juice — all bursting with authentic, incredible flavors. Every dish was full of taste and felt like a true celebration of Venezuelan cuisine.
The restaurant is always lively and busy, so I recommend booking a table in advance. While the service could be a little quicker, the staff are friendly and the food more than makes up for it.
Overall, a fantastic experience that I’d highly recommend for anyone wanting to enjoy great food in a vibrant atmosphere.

The food was great, it was definitely authentic and scrumptious. It wasn’t overpriced and it was definitely worth a try. I highly recommend the guava juice (the best guava juice i’ve ever tried), yuca fries which is sooo delicious i nearly asked for another one, and the texture of their rice is really great i would recommend anything with rice in it with this restaurant!!

It was a wonderful dining experience!
I had never tried Venezuelan food before, and since this restaurant was close to where I was staying, I decided to give it a try.
As a foreigner, it was hard for me to imagine what the dishes would be just by looking at the menu. The server was incredibly friendly, patiently explaining the dishes to me and even recommending some of their specialties.
What touched me most was that he didn’t just recommend the most expensive items. Instead, he suggested dishes that were both unique and suitable for me. When I wanted to order more, he even considered whether I, as a solo female guest, might not be able to finish everything, and explained the portion sizes to me.
But I still wanted to try everything! So I ordered an arepa to take away. The arepa with banana was absolutely amazing, such a delightful surprise!
The service was thoughtful and warm, and the staff’s attitude made the whole experience even better. This is truly a great restaurant! I will definitely recommend it to my friends!

Great food, lovely waitress and peaceful atmosphere.
We took the tasting menu (one regular and one vegetarian) to try as many dishes as we could. Each was flavoursome and copious.
There was a little mix up with our reservation but our lovely waitress went above and beyond to make up for it.
We highly recommend it and won't hesitate to go back!

venues.name: Restaurant Elis
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Just happened to stumble upon this on Google maps on a Saturday evening, not having had (up to this point) good Brazilian food in London.

The restaurant is in a hotel, which made me a bit sceptical at first. But by the end of the dinner we weren't disappointed.

The place is small. Service was very friendly and welcoming. There were surprisingly few people there for a Saturday, which was even more surprising considering how good it was.

We ordered two of each of the Bolinhos de Bacalhau, Pastel de Pizza, Pão de Queijo sliders, and lamb skewers. We also ordered their special rice and seafood dish as a main.

The Bolinhos were nice and crisp, and the sliders were a fun take on Pão de Queijo (Brazilian cheese bread). The lamb was so tender and flavorful. The star of the show was the rice and seafood. The seafood and the rice were cooked to perfection. The amount of flavor in that rice was amazing.

All the while service was very attentive. The food came fast, but as a good pace -- they waited until we were done with one dish before getting the other.

I would definitely go there again, especially since it seems that they have different specials.

This place was a little different. Not a lot of selections on the menu and the larger dishes are specials. The lamb skewer special was amazing. The cheese bread slider was pretty good as well. The bread baskets was good and my colleagues enjoyed their drinks. I almost gave it a 4 cause some of the dishes weren't as good, but the lamb was so good I had to round up to a five for this one.

Decided to visit this lovely little restaurant for a client lunch.

I wanted to find somewhere with an exciting menu that was also quiet and cosy to aid discussion.

We struck gold with Restaurant Elis. Chloe was wonderful, covering all our needs the moment we arrived and giving us a perfectly situated table.

The location is convenient but as this is on the first floor of the hotel I can see that some may be less aware of the place.

The menu was lovely, light and flavorful with a terrific range of options. We felt spoiled sharing a range of starters and then tucking into some excellent mains like the Pork Chop pictured.

Would happily return again, it was an excellent meal!

I saw this place on google maps when looking for somewhere new to try. We visited for lunch today, May 24th.

The restaurant is located discreetly on the 1st floor of the hotel. There aren’t any signs so you have to ask the hotel reception for directions, it’s up the stairs on the left.

We were greeted by Chloe. We were presented with the lunch menu and chose a few small plates. Chloe was really friendly and attentive.

We opted for several small plates from the lunch menu and settled in for what became a leisurely lunch. We found ourselves continually ordering more, ultimately we had 8 small plates and a pudding between the two of us over a relaxed two hour period.
All the food was great. We had Wagyu skewers, Meatballs, Cassava chips, Mortadella, Asparagus, Artichoke, Bread, Olives and a pudding plus one glass of wine, bottle of sparkling water and 2 coffees and the total bill was a few pennies over £100. £50 per head for this food is amazing value.

The only point of criticism would be the phone number on google connects to the hotel and you have to ask to be put through for the restaurant.
Just wow. Incredibly tasty and some unexpected flavours, we had an amazing meal with brilliant service. The beef tatare was honestly the best I’ve ever had and the mussel linguine was to die for 🙌👏

venues.name: OMBRA
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful Sunday lunch at Ombra. From the first snack through to dessert, every dish was authentic, beautifully prepared, and bursting with flavour — true Italian cooking at its best. The girolle mushroom tagliolini was delicate and full of depth, the monkfish main was perfectly cooked and full of flavour, and the apricot, mint and yoghurt dessert was a refreshing finish. Compliments to Chef Alessandro, whose skill and passion really shone through in every plate.
For drinks, we trusted our waiter Red, who paired each dish with the perfect wine recommendation. Each glass lifted the food even further, and it made the whole meal feel carefully curated.
We enjoyed it all out on the sunny terrace, where the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere made it a truly memorable family lunch. Ombra delivered on every level — excellent food, thoughtful service, and a beautiful setting. We’ll definitely be back!

I took my parents here for lunch , it was their first time and only my second time. Absolutely impeccable! We had the chef’s menu for 3 with wine pairing. Big shoutout to Phil (certified sommelier) for perfectly pairing every unique dish.

**Oysters with blood orange and olive oil
**Olive oil, lemon mussels with fennel
**Grilled White asparagus with sardines
**Gnocco fritto (house staple!)
**Lamb’s heart on whipped feta (!!)
**Fresh pasta (made daily on-site) with beef shin ragù
**Basil & raspberry cake (mind-blowing flavourrrr)
**Tiramisu (rightly praised as London’s best.  My mum demolished it solo!)

The team at Ombra just get it- full of heart, bold flavours, and warming energy.

P.s.: the chefs menu changes with season as they source the freshest ingredients! worth going back!

(To the tune of oompa loompa)

Ombra loompa I am now fat
We got lots of plates now can you top that!!

Ombra loompa doo pa de de
We had a great time now listen to me!!

So myself and my wife came in as she had seen this spot when she visited the last Tuesday society. And oh how pleased I am she saw it.

Tonight we had the chefs menu and it was not only incredible value but an immersive culinary experience. The staff were very knowledgeable and very attentive but the food really was the winner of the evening. I never knew asparagus could taste soo good!!

The tasting menu allowed us to try food we would never usually choose such as the lambs heart but honestly it’s worth every bite.
Great Sunday lunch plenty of delicious and unusual dishes, lovely combination of flavours and attentive service, a must try.

I rate very highly the experience of my daughter's wedding ceòabration at Ombra. A friendly, cosy restaurant, almost unassuming, but the food was superb, certainly much better than  at most wedding parties. We had an octopus salad as a starter, followed by courgette flowers, then a pasta dish with an exquisite fish sauce. I am not a pasta eater, yet I loved their dish, whose sauce was based on minced fish that beautifully blended with the tomato sauce. The main course was mullet -sarago in Italian- a very tasty white fish, cooked in a chinotto sauce. Delicious. The staff, all young and friendly, were very flexible , prompt and helpful. I highly recommend Ombra, the intimate atmosphere is suitable for events and gatherings of up to 40 people. Thank you, Alessandro, I loved your cooking style.

venues.name: Desi Lounge
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
We started with the poppadoms, which came with three delicious sauces and freshly sliced onions – 10/10, full of flavour and the perfect way to begin the meal. For our mains, we ordered the Tawa for 3, which was excellent. The lamb chops were tender, the meats were packed with flavour, and the portion was generous. The passion fruit mojito was refreshing and paired perfectly with the food.

Service was fantastic. We were greeted by the owner, Zakariya, who was very friendly and attentive, making sure we were well looked after. The whole venue was spotless, including the toilets, and the décor gave the restaurant a modern and welcoming feel.

Overall, it was a brilliant experience. This time I went with friends, but I’ll definitely be returning with my family. The food, service, and atmosphere were all top-notch, and it’s great that they accept both card and cash payments. Highly recommended!

We went there as a large group, and the food was excellent. We pre-ordered everything, and the mixed starters were flavorful with generous portions. They also offer a £23 set meal, which we chose—it included lamb korai, chicken jalfrezi, dhal,two types of rice, dessert, and drinks. It was definitely worth it for a big group.

The staff were very friendly, and the place was spotless throughout. The toilets were clean and up to a good standard, and the décor was modern and stylish. I’d highly recommend this place—it’s worth a visit. The only drawback was parking, but we managed by using the side roads.

AVOID MOUSE SEEN!!! I understand this is a long review but please read! We were on the hunt for a restaurant serving tawa and we came across desi lounge, upon coming across good reviews and good videos we decided to visit for a special occasion. We drove past and saw it was empty and despite that being helpful for me due to my anxiety it should’ve been the first red flag. Upon entering we were seated by a kind hijabi waitress who by the way made the experience less of a shitshow than it was. We were admiring the decor and had finished placing our order when my partner had noticed a mouse run in, now not only is this a concern of hygiene but was a concern of it running around us! when the kind waitress was informed she immediately let higher ups know. We weren’t expecting much we thought they would at least try to get that one mouse out instead the owner or manager came and started trying to talk his way out of it?? He said if we went to any of the other restaurants we would see the same even nandos have them and despite having pest control come often they can’t do anything about it? Not even an apology that we had to witness that even if an apology wasn’t offered he could’ve spoken in a better manner than to think we were born yesterday that should have been the second red flag. Despite wanting to leave by this point we decided to switch tables and just try the food 1.Because of the good reviews and 2. Because i really didn’t want to deal with that guy again and explaining why we were leaving i wish we left! The samosa was burnt, the sheekh kebabs were frozen ones i have previously made at home, the chicken tikka starters were burnt and everything had oil dripping off it like they didn’t even cook anything fresh it was all deep fried, frozen and pre cooked. The chips were alright in the beginning i then noticed i was eating oil i had to spit it out, they were drenched in oil and nearly made me throw up when i left the restaurant, the actual plate that the tawa was served on had the burnt bits off the meats and they still decided to serve it?? The rice was nice unfortunately couldn’t enjoy as it was also burnt at the bottom and the lamb chops had flavour but unfortunately i had to break my jaw to rip it off and chew it. The only decent food i managed to have was the lamb from the curry, some of the dhall as some lentils were hard, the naan and some of the chicken tikka also from the curry. The owner asked the kind waitress we had to apply 10% off the bill now as kind as that was i will never EVER be returning in’sha’allah things get better for this business as it definitely has potential but my experience not only ruined a special occasion for me but also left me physically sick and upset. As for these good reviews i genuinely don’t know if it was just my experience or these people leave fake reviews but i will be more cautious next time.
As you can see from photos all looks great but when you move it out of the way it is burnt and drenched in oil!

Very good food we tried their Lamb Bhuna and starter chicken Tikka both are really good. Service also good.
We will definitely come back. This restaurant is very close to our hotel.

Beautiful food and great service
Recommended meals too which was very helpful
Specials thanks to shanju who was very attentive
Everyone was so lovely - amazing food and very authentic give it a try ❤️

reviews.text:
Incredible meal - one of the very best in London
From start to finish the experience was well balanced, well paced and felt intimate and comfortable
You start in the lounge which is a lovely space and we enjoyed a few glasses of champagne to kick things off. Leading into the dining room it’s an open kitchen and the chefs themselves serve and present each dish. Happy to engage in chatter it made it all the more memorable.
Each course was fantastic, super balanced and overall a really strong tasting menu
Coupled with a brilliant 80’s soundtrack throughout the evening - 3 hours whizzed by - we were sad to leave
Will definitely be going back!

This was hands down the best meal of our lives. Food, service, atmosphere - everything was a 10/10. We went for my birthday and were so looked after by everyone. It was very special to meet the chef and discuss the food with him. I even got a birthday card!! Providing the menu at the end was also a lovely touch. We sadly forgot this & the card because we were so overwhelmed and giddy about the whole experience. Thank you so much!

Probably one of the best fine dining experiences in London in a long time. The food and its presentation were outstanding, the staff very friendly, but not too much. A beautiful, intimate space for dinner with a great playlist in the background. I highly recommend dining here, if you are into special eating experiences!

Absolutely stunning food！Had the full tasting menu.
Every single course tastes amazing！
The whole dining experience was fantastic. The service is very professional. The environment is very well designed and decorated. Guests can watch the chefs cooking in the open kitchen.

The taste of the food is complicated also very well balanced. My favourate dishes are quail，fish stew and the wagyu.

Absolutely stunning food！Had the full tasting menu.
Every single course tastes amazing！
The whole dining experience was fantastic. The amuse bouche was served in the bar area，and then we were led to the dining room. The dining tables are big and between tables it is very well spaced.
The service is very professional. The environment is very well designed and decorated. Guests can watch the chefs cooking in the open kitchen.

The taste of the food is complicated also very well balanced. My favourate dishes are lobster rice，quail，fish stew and the wagyu.

reviews.text:
Been wanting to go for ages, didn’t disappoint. From the warm greeting to the airy setting m. Our server was knowledge about the food and wine do advised us with ease. The quality of the food could not be understated , from the rosemary oil with the anchovies to the bread and butter.
We started with a martini which was served perfectly , worked with the anchovies .
Main we both picked the squid and Bourdin noir which was beautiful.
Dessert was just as good too.
If you like your wines ask for the big book
We had an amazing experience here. Some of the best food I’ve ever had and the staff were so lovely and recommended some beautiful wine. There was also a relaxed but buzzy atmosphere.

WOW
the whole meal was unbelievably good.

I travelled to London from Manchester for the day to see my brother, who choose brawn to visit. The restaurant has a cool chilled atmosphere whilst outside is busy. The staff were so friendly and lovely. The food was honestly some of the best I’ve had. I had the seafood pasta which was so so good! All the starters and nibbles were also 10/10

Would highly recommend visiting!

The food was very good, however my only complaint (minus a star) would perhaps be a little more attention to detail is needed in terms of flavour. All the ingredients were there, presented beautifully, but felt a little rushed. Lets say the umami hit did not quite deliver. Nonetheless I would go again. Fantastic service.

We loved the vibe overall and the food was fantastic. We particularly enjoyed the Vitelli tonnato, the veal was so tender and the octopus as well. We tried all the starters on the menu which was fantastic and had the ice cream for dessert which was good too

venues.name: Mum Likes Thai Food (Bethnal Green)
venues.description: From Thai street food to contemporary dining - authentic flavors with modern presentation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I really liked this place. We ordered veggie spring rolls (4). Pad Thai with prawns and red curry also with prawns and an egg fried rice. The flavour was veeery good! Would come back here / recommend.

The staff was very friendly. The food came out quite quickly. The pad Thai was a generous portion.

Quite place nice and cozy good food portions were nice and big, everything was well presented the fried chicken wings were amazing and the beef dish , the curry was ok would’ve preferred it a little more spicer , the lychee soda was very nice not to sweet overall three people ate for £76 including service charge not bad will return again

Rating: 5/5

I recently visited "Mum Likes Thai Food" restaurant on my birthday, and what a wonderful surprise it was! The restaurant is conveniently located just opposite our flat, but it was the excellent hospitality and delicious food that truly made our visit special.

The staff were incredibly welcoming and attentive, ensuring that we felt right at home. The service was top-notch, and the ambiance was cozy and intimate.

But the real star of the show was the food - oh, the food! We were treated to a culinary journey through Thailand, with each dish more flavorful and aromatic than the last. The portions were generous, and the prices were very reasonable.

I'm so glad we decided to try "Mum Likes Thai Food" on my special day. It was a truly memorable experience, and I highly recommend this hidden gem to anyone craving authentic Thai cuisine. We'll definitely be back for more!

Pros:

- Excellent hospitality
- Delicious and authentic Thai food
- Cozy ambiance
- Reasonable prices
- Convenient location

Cons: None!

I highly recommend "Mum Likes Thai Food" to anyone looking for a fantastic dining experience.

We’ve been getting Thai food from this place as a takeaway for years, and it’s always consistently good. This time, we decided to eat in the restaurant for a change, and it didn’t disappoint. The staff were really friendly and welcoming, and the interior was actually quite nice too. We went for the starter platter, pad Thai, and green curry, along with two mai tai cocktails. The food was just as good as the takeaway we get. It’s similar to many other Thai restaurants, but the big difference here is consistency – it’s always tasty, on time, and at a good price (though not the cheapest).

If you're looking for a delightful Thai meal, Mum Likes Thai Food should be at the top of your list. Nestled in the charming Roman Road near Bethnal Green Station, this hidden gem is just a short stroll from the tube station. The atmosphere here is incredibly soothing and inviting, making it an ideal place to unwind. One of the highlights of dining here is being able to witness the talented chef expertly preparing the dishes right before your eyes. The food itself is absolutely scrumptious, which is why I find myself returning to this restaurant time and time again. Additionally, if you're planning a birthday celebration or a business dinner with your colleagues, this place is perfect. However, due to their popularity, it's highly recommended to make a reservation in advance. Excitingly, they are also expanding their reach by opening a new restaurant, spreading the joy of Thai cuisine to other parts of town. For a truly exceptional dining experience, Mum Likes Thai Food is a must-visit destination.

reviews.text: We came for dinner but considering the small portion sizes, it didn’t quite justify the price. We each had the octopus and jambon beurre gildas (nice bites) then between the two of us, we shared the cauliflower tartlets (fine), pink fir potatoes (like patatas bravas which were tasty), cured monkfish (the flavour didn't work for me), cecina with ricotta (ok), black pudding with hen of the woods (good), bitter chocolate with olive oil and salt (didn’t wow) and the smoked maple bikini (surprisingly delicious). The peach gimlet and wines were also good. The service was friendly and helpful but occasionally inattentive as we had to flag staff several times.
Great place to come for lunch and drinks. Brilliant cocktails, food was lovely and service really attentive. Will come back for sure

Phenomenal flavours and excellent service, everything looks amazing too - i was roo busy drooling to think about pictures! Just 2 mins walk from Bethnal Green station. Definitely try the black rice sake and the octo-dog!

Style over substance. The food was experimental and some dishes were interesting, but not delicious. None of the food went together, so was a strange experience. The staff were nice but incredibly inattentive. The cocktail was watery. Really poor value for money, spent a lot and went home hungry. It is a really nice vibe for wine though.
Amazing cocktails and Food. Oliver was fantastic and served me some exciting new cocktails, I loved them all. The food was delicious, the staff are very attentive. Great Bar well done.

reviews.text: Afghan Grill offered a delightful culinary experience with truly good, flavorful food that hit the spot. While the service was competent, it leaned more towards adequate than exceptional. Despite this, the delicious dishes and cozy atmosphere made for an enjoyable meal. Perfect for a casual Afghan food craving!

Today’s experience was good. Food was very good.
Kebabs were marinated and grilled to perfection, mouthwatering.
Salad was fresh, juicy, tangy.
My child also enjoyed the food.
Service was prompt and attentive, not like described by reviews below.
We will return.
Many thanks Afghan Grill.

My family and I came here for lunch. We ordered the Grand Grill and really enjoyed it. Everything is delicious, the prices are very low as well. The service was also very good. Anas was our server, he was very kind and took care of us.

I recommend everyone to come here and have the barbecue, it’s authentic, fresh and definitely the best I’ve had for a very good price.

Had the whole chicken with rice, rice (kabuli pilao) was very nice! Whole chicken is rotisserie then on a grill, so wasn't as good as the chicken shish.

Chicken shish and the Chaplin kebab was very nice. Would recommend!

3 people £38 and had food left to take home.

We went to restaurant after seeing Instagram food blogger reviewing the restaurant highly  and was greatly disappointed. It’s does question how authentic these so called food bloggers  are. On arrival the restaurant was smokey. The table we were seated at was dirty and we had to stand for it to be cleaned. The waiter was not attentive to the order in which customers came in. The restaurant is not an authentic afghan restaurant.It is a Bengali owned restaurant with Afghani chefs. We wish to order chips and at 7pm they had run out of chips. The lamb kebab was soggy with sauce and bengali style tomato salad with fresh chillies.  The kabuli pilau barely had any meat only bones and fat. The Chappli Kebab meal was the only meal we enjoyed. The staff really need to work on customer service as the waiter started taking plates and cleaning the table before we had even left. Will not be returning again.

reviews.text: Attended with a group of four, very accommodating, food came within good time and was absolutely delicious! I had the Sarma Beyti, a big portion cooked to perfection and absolutely packed with flavour. Great little restaurant, staff were friendly and helpful, highly recommended. Also the baclava was too die for 🤤

Stopped here after work for a quick dinner. Staff was very lovely and the food was delicious! 💥we ordered one main meal that comes with rice and salad, one cold and one hot starter and some bread. We couldn’t finish it all so got some takeaway boxes in the end.

The restaurant offered delicious and flavorful food with a vast menu variety. The service was excellent, with attentive servers who efficiently explained and delivered dishes. The beautiful beige and brown decor created a comforting atmosphere. Overall, it was an incredible dining experience that comes highly recommended.

Haven't been here in a few years now but it's just as good as ever.
had the wings with rice, bulgar wheat and salad.

Service is amazing. We had a guide dog and the staff not only welcomed us but were so accommodating. My friend felt welcomed unlike many places where she feels a she is a liability. We dined in comfort. The food is superb. Credit to all the cooks and chefs, everything is cooked to perfection.
The prawns were just divine. Plump, tasty and juicy.
Meats are all cooked to perfection. Not dry, full of flavour and tender.
Sucuk is hit and miss due to it being over cooked, however, once again, these were cooked to perfection. Juicy.
Highlight has to the homemade baklava. These were simply incredible.
No doubt we will be returning and since our experience many of our team have ordered take away.

reviews.text: I had a great meal here while staying in the area for work. I didn’t know Nigerian food but  the owner explained the menu to me really well and his recommendations (moi moi and jollof rice with fish) were delicious. Nigerian Guinness was great too! Very relaxed and friendly place, highly recommended.

The staff was lovely. He gave us a choice of music to listen to during dinner and served us the most delicious jollof rice even though it was quite late in the day.
I would come back!

Warm welcome from the moment we walked in & the service was attentive and kind all night. The food? Absolutely delicious. I had the okra with pounded yam (so good I had to take some home in a doggie bag!) and my friend had the egusi with pounded yam, plus plantain and moi moi. Everything was fresh, flavourful and felt like home cooking. Fantastic portions, excellent quality for the price, and the musical soundtrack in the background gave it the perfect West African vibe. I’ll be back, and I’m encouraging everyone who reads this to go. Absolutely delicious!
I had an amazing experience here! The owner was extremely welcoming, kind and helped guide my sister and I on the best food to order. The food was prepared fresh to order and was delicious!!

It's definitely delicious, but I'm not a great judge of African food so I can't tell if it's authentic 🤣

Extra points that the staff is incredibly friendly, and a couple of fun African beers (or "spirit mixed drink") available.

reviews.text: The Star of Bethnal Green is a great place to come back to. The cozy atmosphere, thoughtful furniture and soft lighting create a feeling of homely warmth, and the location next to the station makes the pub convenient for meetings both in the evening and on weekends. The staff is polite and attentive — the service is fast, while never intrusive. The food and drink pubs are of high quality: a good selection of beers and cocktails, fresh and delicious classic snacks and main courses. The portions are adequate, the price-quality ratio pleases. I recommend it for meetings with friends, a relaxing evening together or an inexpensive dinner — it definitely deserves a positive assessment.

I went with a large group of friends on a Saturday evening where we went to book karaoke. I was helped by Chonni, who was in charge that evening. She was very accommodating, progressional, and lovely to deal with. We all had a great night and the atmosphere in the pub was fabulous. Definitely recommend!

A good East London boozer with warm and friendly staff, and some great burgers.
A good choice of beers, including local craft breweries. I did not stay for any events, but I bet it is.lots of fun in the evenings.
For me it was a nice quiet spot for a drink on a Saturday lunchtime, away for the bustle of Bethnal Green Road

We went to the pub quiz on Tuesday with Margarine and what a night it was! Only great vibes, lots of laughs, the amazing Margarine with her grace, and the staff were great and super friendly. We’ll definitely be back! Brazil loves you, Margarine!!

Hired this venue for an album launch party and it was nothing short of amazing. The space is perfect and the venue managers and staff we're incredibly accommodating of our niche requests and ensured the entire evening ran perfectly. Could not reccommend them more! Big shout out to Laura and Archie specifically!
