venues.name: Wahaca Canary Wharf
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: I recently had dinner at Wahaca and it was amazing! We started with the guacamole and hummus. The guacamole was okay, a little bland, but the hummus was absolutely delicious. For our mains, we ordered the sweet potato...something (I can't remember the name!), buttermilk chicken tacos, and beef tacos. Everything was so flavorful and tasty. We also got the chorizo quesadillas which were beautiful. To finish, we shared the tiramisu for dessert, which was lovely. The service was great, our waiter was really helpful, and the atmosphere was cool. I'd definitely recommend Wahaca to anyone looking for a delicious and fun dining experience

Overall food is acceptable , except for the churros it was a bit too oily and not enough cinnamon sugar on it. The sweet potatoes side dish was pretty good. Tacos are not bad. Service wise is a mix feeling, as either they are in rush and just put all orders on the table at the same time or when you order extra dishes the service is super slow……….

Excellent. Superb tacos. The chicken and avacado was surprisingly good - I’d even say the best. Nice specials with the sweet potato and the spicy Margarita was really good too. Nice vibe and place as well. Mega bonus - Cocktails were

Our waiter, Tyler, was fantastic! He was attentive the entire time and had a great sense of humor that made our evening even better. We were stuffed by the end, but he was already ready with the dessert menu the moment we finished eating—so thoughtful and on the ball. We didn’t have room for dessert, but we definitely appreciated his perfect timing. Thanks, Tyler, for making our dinner such a fun experience!

One of the best Wahaca experiences. The food was just outstanding. Tastes delicious and so fresh. Presentation was great too. The service was impeccable. Such polite staff and so attentive. Didn’t have to look around to find anyone at any point. Simple things like water always being topped up was executed perfectly. 5* service in a chain restaurant is rare. Our server Sasha was the perfect server, outstanding service. The manager Milan was also extremely polite and helpful. Very impressed.

venues.name: Yolk
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: No seating, quick ordering via self service screen, amazing healthy sandwich salad and hot food options also general cafe drinks coffee and matcha. Food prepared quickly, had steak Benedict which was amazing, would try other dishes again

This is the most revolting food I have ever been presented with in my life. An “egg box” with two “poached eggs” comes as a soup of raw egg and hollandaise and cooked spinach. So gross why are you serving raw eggs?? At least give it a try to cook them. Horrible

I was the only customer on a Friday morning. 3 of the 5 digital order machines weren’t working. I ordered a smoked salmon and cream cheese bap and it was atrocious. There was a few dabs of cream cheese, some rocket and what looked like leftover salmon. Not to mention the bap was cold and tasted half baked. Absolutely disgusting for £5. If this is the quality you deem satisfactory, I hope to see you out of business soon.

During my recent visit to this Yolk branch, I ordered my drink ahead of time, but it took over five minutes to receive it, even though there were no other customers waiting. I appreciate the variety of food and drink options available to takeaway. I particularly enjoy the cherry matcha with oat milk, and I believe a quicker service would enhance the overall experience.

The shop looks great and is well maintained, the ingredients are good quality as well, but
the sandwich I had was awful. There was barely any chicken and too much sauce/tomatoes. The ratio of bread to meat to salad was completely off tbh and I would highly recommend trying somewhere else as there are several other options.

venues.name: Smoke End Steakhouse
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic dining experience at Smoke End Steakhouse. The Argentine sirloin steak was cooked to perfection—tender, juicy, and full of rich flavor. It was easily one of the best steaks I’ve had in a long time. To finish, I tried the tiramisu for dessert, which was light, creamy, and absolutely delicious.

The service was just as memorable as the food. Kamal, the owner, was incredibly warm and accommodating, making us feel truly welcome. The staff were attentive, friendly, and went out of their way to ensure everything was perfect.

Overall, Smoke End Steakhouse is a real gem—wonderful food, a welcoming atmosphere, and outstanding hospitality. Will definitely be seeing me again!

The food here is insanely good!! Every bite was full of flavor and so worth it. The service and atmosphere are both really welcoming and professional — you feel comfortable the moment you walk in. A special shoutout to Kamal, who greeted us with such warmth and looked after us so well. Definitely recommend!

First visit and thoroughly impressed.
The service was attentive, the atmosphere welcoming, and the overall experience very well put together. Staff were hospitable throughout, and the food was of a high standard.

We ordered a selection of dishes: duck taco, calamari, steak, chicken sauté, seared salmon, and the Wagyu burger,  all well-prepared and nicely presented.

Drinks were also excellent, with the bartender’s special, Oreo milkshake, mango drink, pink paradise, and passion fruit mojito offering a good variety for different tastes.

Would definitely recommend for both casual dining and special occasions. A great place to book for family gatherings or group events.

Had dinner at Smoke End Steakhouse today and it was absolutely fantastic! The steak was one of the best I’ve had in London – perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The service was excellent, attentive without being intrusive, and the overall experience felt really special. Prices are also very reasonable considering the quality. Most importantly, it’s Halal, which makes it even better. Highly recommend this place for couples or friends looking for a great dining spot!

The food was absolutely delicious! The steak was cooked to perfection-tender, juicy, and full of flavour. The lamb chops were just as impressive, perfectly seasoned and expertly prepared. What truly elevated the experience, though, was the service. It was nothing short of impeccable attentive, friendly, and professional from start to finish. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an exceptional dining experience!

venues.name: Darling's Eatery
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Took my boyfriend for a celebration yesterday and we really love this little hidden gem on Fish Island!

Loved the food, the atmosphere and how quick the service was! Will definitely come back another time.

I recently enjoyed the most gorgeous dining experience at Darlings, over a long lunch with friends. Every detail was carefully thought about, and the food and drinks flowed throughout which is credit to the incredible service and staff. Stand out dishes  included the tuna melon starter, focaccia, the anchovy pasta and of course the tiramisu!! Most importantly, don’t skip the amaro at the end, it’s the perfect pairing with desert. So looking forward to my next visit already!

Darlings is an absolute must. A true hidden gem in Hackney. Charming little restaurant with gorgeous interiors, very relaxed and chic vibe. Service was incredibly attentive and didn’t skip a beat.The food was perfect. Best focaccia I’ve had in a long time. Don’t miss the tuna melon dish. The truffle burrata and the sausage leek and fennel mafaldine was heaven, finished with the tiramisu with their house amaro. This spot is so fab for any occasion. Looking forward to coming again!

Had the most amazing night at Darlings! The food is 10/10, fresh flavours and ingredients and beautiful presentation! The restaurant is warm and aesthetic and the perfect place for a date night or to catch up with a group of friends. The pasta was some of the best I’ve had ever and tiramisu is a game changer. The staff are lovely, you have to go and try it yourself!

A lovely restaurant hidden somewhere in Hackney Wick. The atmosphere is good, staff are friendly, but the pasta were not 100% our type, a bit too dry, taste of sauce could be better and more. The truffle burrata is amazingly delicious. Good spot for local to chill.

venues.name: The Bourbon
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Great place to come and drink bourbon (obviously). We came on a Friday night after dinner. The place was busy but there were a couple of tables free. We asked the barman for bourbon recommendations and his recs were great. He was very knowledgeable on the different bourbons and could explain what made them special. They have a good looking cocktail menu too. We will definitely come back!
£20 for burger, fries, 4 wings and a pint - great value for tasty food. Barman very friendly and welcoming. Would definitely go back, some of the best value in the area.

Stopped off here for drinks with friends and it was a delightful experience: great cocktails, an owner who's hugely knowledgeable about everything he stocks and a superb atmosphere. Highly recommend, will definitely return if I'm in the area again.

I have been a frequent customer in the past 5 years. Dominic the bartender is extraordinarily professional and good at chatting. Good selection of the bourbon, wonderful live music on Saturdays and decent food (I prefer the smokehouse though).
The location is not quite ideal. But it is a good American bar for residents in Hackney and Tower Hamlets.

venues.name: Dead Pedro's - Mexican Kitchen at The Bow Bells
venues.description: Mexican flavors that bring the fiesta to London - bold, beautiful, and absolutely delicious. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: This place was such a pleasant surprise.  We went on a Friday night and found out really quickly that it was a hosting a karaoke night by the hostess with the biggest funniest personality.  As an American couple just visiting the area all the locals were awesome and friendly.  This was definitely like any of the stuff bars.  So many patrons from other tables were friendly and chatty with us and made us feel like we were a local.  The bartenders were nice and the food was very good.  We recommend the birria tacos and the fish tacos.  They both were very flavorful.  This was a great pub.  Beer on tap was average price and cold and yummy.  Karaoke night was soo fun and everyone sang along.  Highly recommend this place.

1 word…AMAZING!

Was really craving some birria tacos yesterday, and this place looked unreal. First thoughts wasn’t expecting a pub, but the vibes were nice. We ordered the fish tacos, birria tacos (duh), Jalapeño bites, loaded nachos & quesadillas.

Now let’s break it down:
1. quesadillas - Nothing crazy just plain cheese quesadillas, however you can add birria meat to it which i would be keen to try next time.
2. Jalapeño bites - So good, they were super creamy, would maybe like a bit more jalapeño but delicious either way
3. Loaded nachos - Incredible! they also add a layer of their sauce in between the nachos so you are NOT left with dry flavorless nachos at the end. Which not many places do that.
4. Fish tacos - Unreal, never actually had fish tacos before but these did not disappoint, burst of flavour in each bite. Will be getting again.
5. Birria tacos - and finally the birria tacos. I have had this craving for possibly over 6 months, but no place looked good until i found this one and boy was it good. The meat was so juicy, so tender not too chewy. Really set the standard for birria tacos, I am obsessed.

In terms of atmosphere, the staff seemed so lovely, music was playing, they even had some board games which we ended up playing some trivia with. Was a lot of fun!

Lucky for me, this place is only 1 stop away from me, so i will most definitely be back over and over again. If you come across this area, you MUST give it a try. It will not disappoint :)

You might be put off by the bar it's located in; I was when I first stepped in - it's dated, a little tired and could do with a bit of loving (but then again I guess we all are).

But the welcome from the bartender was so warm and you immediately feel like this place has been your local for years.

The menu is simple - which I like - and we ordered (almost) everything on it.

The taste was absolutely incredible. Wow.

Their portions are huge, fresh, and delicious; and their prices are refreshing for London.

Their fish tacos were my favourite.

10/10
Very full bellies without feeling like I had just been mugged.
Very decent Mexican food considering the location! The birria tacos were pretty good & the churros were excellent. Well worth it on a Tuesday for taco tuesday

Best Birria Tacos in London!
Totopos with guacamole are fresh and tasty.
Always come back for the cosy pub atmosphere and great food😊
P.S Finish off with churros

venues.name: Momlette
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
British-Bengali fusion café, very unique. Stays true to the classic British-style breakfast diner yet characteristically Indian-inspired both in dishes and in vibe.

What I liked most about this place was the atmosphere and how it welcomes people of all backgrounds; there's something for everyone on the menu to enjoy.

Huge cafe, compared to the one in Brick Lane. Very clean loo. Food was not bad (we tried the Half English). Unfortunately we couldn’t eat the French Toast as it was very burnt. Fair enough they were kind to not charge us for that. Lady staff from Ukraine was very helpful and friendly.

Try Bengali brunch at Momlette, a cosy café just off Brick Lane. They serve English breakfast with masala beans alongside all-day plates like Deshi half roast chicken. I ordered the Vegan Momlette,  a chickpea omelette with vegan feta, spinach and mushrooms wrapped in vegan paratha, finished with truffle oil and served with fresh spinach, grilled mushroom and tomato. It was delicious, filling and a really unique brunch option in East London. A great spot if you’re looking for vegan brunch or something different in Shoreditch. The space is small and cosy. Service was friendly.

Wow!! This takes comfort food to a new level. The scrambled eggs are unmatched to any other brunch spot I've tried. REALLY authentic bengali flavours which leaves you full and grateful. Sausages were spicy and well seasoned, all around this dish has the small tweaks to a full english that makes it a game changer. Staff were welcoming and quick. Thoughtful and symbolic decorations - loved the carrom board tables!! Will definitely come back :)

Mass produced half English breakfast.
Disappointing. Everything on my plate was half warm when I received my order.
Have had better brunch and English breakfast. Okay to visit for hot drinks not for full breakfast.

venues.name: Bibimbop Bow
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I’ve ordered from Bibimbop twice now, and both times the food has been excellent. The kimchi fries and wings combo was packed with flavour — the wings stayed crispy even after delivery, which was a nice surprise. The corn dogs were also delicious and the cheese inside was still stringy.

I’ve had bao buns from a lot of different places, and Bibimbop’s definitely ranks in my top three — soft, full of flavour, and pretty to look at.

Bonus review from my mum: she really enjoyed the unique fusion twist in the dishes. We’ll definitely be ordering again!

my second visit to bibimbop and had an amazing experience yet again. the food is packed with bold, rich flavours and everything we tried was absolutely delicious. the beef brisket bibimbap was a comforting classic, perfectly balanced with a touch of sweetness. the kimchi fried rice had just the right balance of spice and umami. the vegetable kimbap was fresh and light, and paired with the soy chilli dip it was quite different to the usual sauces i’ve tried. highly recommend if you’re looking for tasty halal korean fusion!

Ordered two Korean loaded boxes with a brisket bao bun, buldak mayo wings, kimchi chilli fries and an a cheese and sausage corn dog, as well as a drink.

Total came to £29.98 - reasonably priced 💰

-

Everything worked perfectly together and was full of flavour. I will definitely be a repeat customer 😋

One suggestion for improvement would be to have the cheese in the corn dog slightly more melted for a better cheese pull, everything else was spot on 👏🏽

If you’re in or around Bow, this isn’t a place you should miss out on! 🍲

The food here was 10/10 and beautifully presented. The spice level for me was spot on and not overpowering and it was a very generous portion. Loved the bao buns, they were soft and packed full of flavours with each bite. Would definitely recommend

I had a fantastic experience at this place!
Specially The Chicken bibimbop,Bao buns,Cheese Corn Dog , was delicious, Juicy, fresh, and full of flavor.
and also the price is preety decent
I’ll definitely be returning—and recommending this spot to friends and family!

venues.name: The Angel of Bow Public House
venues.description: Proper British grub with a modern twist - where Sunday roasts meet culinary innovation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
What a superb, charming, amazing and authentic hidden gem! Michael and his team are outstanding! Tasty food , wonderful vibe and such incredible selection of drinks. Well worth going from one end of town to the other, and again, and again, and again….

Keep up the good spirits! See you hopefully very soon again and well worth booking the tastefully decorated , quirky rooms to stay the night ! T
All the rooms look fabulous in the photos but beware, none of the rooms has a bathroom and toilet as the photos seem to show. I booked for 6 nights but couldn't stay. Bathrooms and toilets are shared

The review is for the bar only. We went here spontanously after a canal walk. There were no non-alcoholic drinks on the menu, but I got a nonalcoholic cocktail on request. It tasted so good that I got a second one. My friend had some beers and seemed happy too.

We booked a room for two nights. We booked for two guests. The bed was so small that it was really difficult to get sleep. The bathroom was common outside not en-suite. The service for the rooms was really bad. Our room cups were not cleaned even at check in. We were told that the cleaners would be cleaning the room the next morning but that also was not done and all tea cups beds etc were left untouched. There was no one to collect the keys at checkout and no instructions to drop the keys. My son stays close by so eventually the keys will reach them but for any other guest the keys would never be returned. Really not worth the price and would rather book a hostel at these prices which are better equipped.

Rooms 5 star is actually for the food, to be specific their Sunday Roast. I can see their ethnically Chinese chef did a wonderful job here, I’m not gonna lie, this is my favorite roast dinner so far in the UK, it’s just amazing, I can easily taste how he used some traditionally Chinese cuisine cooking skills and method from the roast, and it’s just made everything to another level. Well done chef!

Service has more potential though, I would love to see the guys behind the bar being more proactive such as passing me a menu after I sit down so I don’t have to come over asking for one after a while. Hence 3 stars for the service.

Another good thing about this pub is that they have a decent collection of whiskey there. And I had a fun quiz night, which i didn’t expect.

venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Came here for the first time with my family for take away. Very lovely service and good recommendations, we got the XL chicken box, 5 BBQ wings, combo box and single and double cheeseburger and chicken sharwarma.

All were very good no complaints will definitely come again.

Went there for the first time yesterday. Got a meal 5 of my friends. These guys to amazing food. Loved every bit of their grill chicken. Service was great. They make fresh so we had to wait a bit for the food. Highly recommend.

Tried Bow Grill recently – it’s a small new spot with potential. The double cheeseburger was pretty standard, nothing special, but the grilled chicken wrap was really nice and full of flavour. They accept both card and cash, and the sauces were on point.

They’re currently offering a limited-time 20% discount, which makes it great value. I’ll definitely go back again and try more items next time!

The peri peri wings were perfect! Juicy, tender and full of flavour. The garlic sauce is super addictive. Grilled chicken burger with the soft bun can’t be faulted. Definitely a more healthier and better alternative now in Bow. Customer service by the brothers was lovely. Respectful and attentive workers. A must try if you’re trying to be healthy without comprising on taste.

Paid £7.50 for a shawarma box it contained the a small amount of meat covering it up with there salad would not come back here again feel like i couldve gone to stroudley grill to get a better portion

venues.name: Smoke & Pepper (Bow)
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Tried Smoke & Pepper for a quick takeaway and was pleasantly surprised! The food was hot, fresh, and came out pretty fast. We ordered a box of Bbq chicken tenders with sweet potato fries and Korean chicken tenders with spicy rice.

The chicken tenders were nice but they were quite trashy, which meant that we didn’t really get to enjoy the tenders as much. The sweet potato fries were bang on and tasted amazing. The spicy rice was really nice, but it wasn’t spicy (not that I’m complaining), it is definitely worth getting both the fries and the rice.

Everything was packed well for takeaway, and still hot when it arrived. I really like the takeaway boxes they are aesthetically pleasing and efficient. Another thing to mention is the cutlery that came with our order was plastic forks, which is way better than the wooden ones.

That said, it’s a solid choice for a quick, satisfying meal, and I’ll definitely be ordering or hopefully visiting Smoke & Pepper to try a few more things from the menu.

I got the brisket burger at smoke and pepper it was so juicy and packed with so much flavour. It wasn’t busy we around 6pm. The service was fast the food is very very reasonably priced. The only downside is that it’s in the middle of nowhere but other than that it’s a great halal takeaway option!!

The burgers are juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The staff were friendly and attentive, and the service was quick. If you’re a burger lover, this place is a must-try. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I love smoke and pepper in general, I'm a regular customer but today I was disappointed when I ordered spicy mayo 5 chicken tenders and got wings instead, yes it's a completely huge deal when the wings hardly got any meat in it ,and dipping it in their signature sauce was completely pointless, as all I could bite into was bone.

If I wanted wings ,I could have gone to a local chicken and chip shop and got em for £3.

But smoke & pepper decided to scam me with these and I paid a whooping £8+ for low end tasteless wings. (on uber eats).
I've requested a refund on uber eats, but got declined instantly for no reason.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I had the Meaty Beast Burger and it was hands down the best burger I’ve ever had! Succulent, saucy, fresh, and sizzling with high-quality beef patties... miles better than Meat Up. The chicken inside was juicy and flavourful too, all wrapped in a soft, perfectly baked bun.

The wings? Honestly better than Nando’s... packed with flavour and grilled to perfection. Service was fab, friendly and quick. From now on I won’t be going anywhere else for a beef or grilled chicken burger and grilled wings. Smoke & Pepper really sets the bar high it's on an addictive level!

venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Really nice family pub, feels very local but also classy, if that makes sense, in terms of not grubby pub vibes but not gastro either.
Good selection on Sunday roasts and the dessert was to die for!!

Classic English pub. Well off the tourist areas, so it requires a bit of determination to get there. Staff is super friendly. It's a great place to immerse yourself in real life London. Enjoy the authentic fish 'n chips!

Great slap up roast! We arrived at 7:30pm and they still weren’t sold out, gravy was so delicious we ordered chips to soak up the leftovers. Roast came out super quick and we were served almost immediately. Ellie, Phoebe and Isla were all super attentive, friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!

The vegan selection was disappointing, so I didn't have high hopes, but this was the best meal I have had all year. I was dancing as I was eating cause it was so blooody nice! I had the mushroom hoison spring roll for starter, and the tomato salad for main. .. way more then just a salad, the vegan cheese was amazing, the flavours were fresh and rich all at the same time. I will deffo be back!!!

The best pub in the area, 10/10, serves  the best of the best staff and managers.
Still has that unique old school pub feel with everything else that makes a neighbourhood brilliant.

#bowE3

venues.name: MILAGROS BOW
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: The Smash Burgers were excellent, while the wings were satisfactory. Although the lamb ribs were initially disappointing, the team responded to feedback with great professionalism, offering a complimentary Smash Burger as a goodwill gesture. To my surprise, they also provided another serving of lamb ribs, which were significantly improved. Their sincere apology and efforts to rectify the situation truly turned the experience around. The front-of-house staff were exceptionally friendly and professional. Wishing continued success and blessings (barakah) in their new business venture. Ameen.

I ordered an array of deserts from here and here what I think:

First of the Oreo milkshake I really enjoyed it. It wasn’t too sweet and didn’t leave a nasty aftertaste. It was very cream and tasted like the made it fresh 9/10

I enjoyed the strawberry and white chocolate waffle.
The waffle wasnt too thick and the inside was cooked really well.  I think the size and potion was good and it doesn’t leave you feeling sick. The strawberries were nice and fresh and I love the fact they weren’t stingy with their sauces !! 💯

I ordered two milk cakes: one normal and one biscoff. The size of this was reasonable for the price and I loved that it had lots of milk. It wasn’t too try and the cream tasted fresh.

Lastly the cheesecake was very creamy and tasted fresh. It was a great treat especially after fasting.
Overall I enjoyed the desserts part of this small restaurant.

the staff was super sweet and welcoming and extremely accommodating. the food was surprisingly so good considering the price being so reasonable. i recommend the burgers there for sure, and in my opinion they’re a lot better than a lot of other food places in devon’s. the pasta is also really good. it was a very pleasant environment and the staff was friendly the whole time and had very open communication

Cannot express how delicious the mushroom pasta was! I was a wee bit sceptical however Devon’s road only has lots of fried chicken shops around. I just wanted a change! The waffle was amazing. Milkshake was thick as it should be! Welldone guys 😀

Really delicious food here, I got grilled chicken paninis for my mum and sisters and they were really tasty. The owner is so lovely too. This is an underrated place, if you live in the area come here and support your local business 💕💕💕

venues.name: Far East Kitchen
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Highly recommend Far East Kitchen, the value and quality is exceptional! I got the Korean Box and it comes with so much for the price. The k-dog is delicious and fresh, the wings are great, and the brisket fries were super filling! The staff are very friendly if you collect and it did not take long at all.

The gyozas were also very good, they were in a nice honey glaze. The dessert bao buns were very indulgent, covered in sugar! They come with a custard and chocolate dip, really enjoyed the custard.

Far East Kitchen never disappoints! I tried their Korean box with corn dog, wings, and loaded fries and wow, it was so good! Everything was crispy, flavorful, and super satisfying. Their customer service is also amazing  , so friendly and generous. They even sent me a free dessert once because I ordered a lot. Highly recommend!

We ordered a Half and half corn dog, a Chicken bao bun, a K dog meal, some vegetables gyoza, some Dessert bao bun, a freshly made mango drink and a fizzy mango drink. The half and half corn dog had more cheese in it than sausage.

The sausage itself was even halved, I ask even before I ordered if there were poorly half and half. As in inside is cheese and sausage but the sausage is in the middle cheese around the sausage, and the batter around them both and I was told yes. Which was not the case.

The Chicken bao bun was decent, the dessert bao bun was mid, it tasted alright, but there was nothing special about it. I think what made it nicer was the cinnamon and sugar as the dessert itself was flavourless and dry. The sauce that was given with it was chocolate and custard, but they were very running and diluted.

The vegetables gyoza, tasted more like onions than vegetables, which was not nice. The freshly made mango juice was alright but it could have been sweeter. The mango fizzy drink was good. The customer service was friendly, and we didn’t have to wait too long for our food which was good.

The food was not worth the amount of money we paid, I would not go back here and I wouldn’t recommend it either. Really nothing against the people who work here and the person who owns this placement. But the food could do with some improvement.

All I can say about this place is—wow! Truly one of the best food spots I’ve come across. I’ve visited multiple times, and the quality has remained consistently excellent.

I’ve introduced friends and family from different cities to this place, and every single one of them has been genuinely impressed. In terms of food, the Bao Bun Munch Box and the Korean Box are my go-to choices—they never disappoint. The flavours are bold, well-balanced, and absolutely delicious.

Service is always quick, and the staff are friendly, welcoming, and professional, which really enhances the overall experience.

Price-wise, it varies depending on your order. On average, the boxes are around £20 per person, but there’s a wide range of options available to suit different preferences and budgets.

To anyone reading this review: don’t hesitate—give them a try. You won’t regret it!

The combo box with beef corn dog, chicken and prawn gyozu, chicken wings, chicken strips, grilled chicken boa bun, and loaded fries. The boa bun was phenomenal, and I recommend eating this whilst it's still warm. The chicken wings came second with the crispy batter, gyozus next, and then the strips. Everything else was just alright.  For the money you pay, though, well worth it!

venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Can’t comment on atmosphere, but this burger was far from good, not even okay. The patty was tasteless, almost dry.  Overall the sauce overpowered the flavour. I had extra bacon added to my burger and it was terribly chewy and hard to swallow. Lastly, the fries were dreadful , dry chewy , it seemed as if they weren’t cooked well.

I believe this is the worst burger I’ve ever had. Meat felt like rubber and tasted off. Loaded fries were just sad. I had a big surprise, I’ve never seen packaging like that and thank you for that experience I guess

Didn't realise that this branch was takeaway ONLY. Food was good, but not worth the journey. The big rib burger was the best thing I had from there. 4/5. Too small and too expensive to give 5/5. The burger was very delicious though. Ribs were good, but not amazing. 3/5. I expected more for £12. The animal fries 🍟 were DEAD!! 2/5.
Ordered for collection and both burger and chips was really underwhelming unfortunately, I was really looking forward to this. The onions and sauce were really sweet. I don’t think I’ll order again.

Extremely oily burgers.
Wouldn’t order again. I got delivery and they were scrambled up. Pattys had come out of the burger! Really not impressed. Will never order again. Sorry. Not impressed at all. Can see why you struggle to even exceed 4 stars.

venues.name: Meat Up
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
This place was recommended to me to try when I'm in London. So I went to check it out for myself and I gotta say it did not disappoint, it's one of the best chicken burger I had so far.

The takeaway is a dark kitchen so there is seating available but there is a waiting area where you can sit while your food is being prepared.

The burger itself is well balanced. Nicely cooked chicken thighs with a yummy brioche buns with cheese and garlic mayonnaise.

The meat is halal of course and reasonably priced compared to more popular places in London.

The Truffle Double burger was delicious! The balance between everything was great and the meat portion was generous. You can remove fries from their set menu which I recommend doing as the fries don’t look as appealing. The atmosphere inside is not super nice and there are no tables. There are no good places to eat outside as well. However the burgers are still tasty and if you are around it’s a good spot to pop by

Buttermilk Fried Chicken Burger - this was really delicious. I personally love myself a big patty in a burger, and it has a very nice peanut-y flavour that makes it unique to its competitors. But I did find the burger bun to be too big which makes it a little difficult to eat.
Steak on Chips - the chips were very flavourful and the chimchuri sauce was a delight. However, the portion size for this is considerably small for the price. Plus I found the steak to be quite difficult to eat as you have to chew it A LOT before swallowing. It was rubbery but at least it was juicy. Mind you, this is my first time ever having steak so I'm not sure if it's always supposed to be like that.
The packaging is wonderful and hopefully reusable. I believe a lot of care went into this food but unfortunately it's not very memorable.

Ordered the Double Cheese burger + Fries and their Buttermilk chicken strips. First of all, ordering this meal gets you a lovely well designed takeout box and the strips come separately in another.
The burger was by far the best thing out of the 3. Up there with the best burgers I've tried. Decided to get the double pattie instead of the single because deep down I know I'm a growing boy- just horizontally, not vertically. The first bite let's you know you're in for a good time. It was so unapologetically juicy- the kind that drips down your hand and leaves a puddle of juice in the foil. The burger wasn't just juicy, it practically assaulted your taste buds with care. Each bite was messy, greedy and a little bit reckless-the kind of burger that doesn't just feed you, it dares you to keep up.
The fries were better than bog standard. They were seasoned like they'd been tortured by a Michelin-star chef with a salt fetish, but in a good way. Where the order felt short on was the Buttermilk chicken strips. Looking at them they looked brilliant but they were as crispy as a damp paper towel left out in the rain. They were caught red handed with a puddle of oil in the container which looked disheartening. The chicken tasted sub par but definetly lost some points on texture.
Overall, Burger is GOAT. Fries are Aight. Buttermilk Chicken Strips are a Probably Not.

I genuinely cannot recall ever enjoying a better burger! The double truffle with fries was outstanding, and the strawberry shake was perfect. The staff were friendly and accommodating as we had not realised that this location was supposed to be takeaway only 😬

I ordered pasta many times and it is wow ❤️amazing like always.

Really good food and amazing waitresses! Food came fast and was amazing. Waitresses were very energetic and helpful. Atmosphere was amazing. Would recommend it to anyone who wants to have an amazing night singing, laughing and enjoying delicious food!✨🇮🇹🇬🇧

Huge portion, that is a massive plus nowaday,  but the food quality is so so.  I had bolognese posta and honestly... i make it better.

I think they’re closed now. The place is impossible to reach by walk, they don’t answer the phone and the order via apps are getting cancelled.

venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We popped I for Sunday roast. One of the best places for service and food quality in the area. Roast is reasonably priced £22 for beef and £17 for vegan (i think the chicken is £20). Overall very good, we are here regularly. They take both cash and card payments.

Booked here for Sunday lunch. Lovely busy pub, family friendly. We had a table in the conservatory which was lovely. Ordered two roast dinners- pork belly and roast beef. The pork belly was fine but the beef was a little fatty so couldn't eat one of the slices. Was told that this can happen sometimes. Didn't enjoy the beef at all and so wished I'd had the chicken. The cauliflower cheese was delicious. The sticky toffee pudding was sitting in a very oily sauce which looked liked it had split. We declined that. The staff comp'ed our drinks which was a nice gesture for the fatty beef.

Food is pretty good, the people who work there lovely and the pub is very nice :)

The roast is of decent size (a lot of meat, vegetables less so, to be honest): I suggest to go for the half chicken roast.

The scottish egg was good too :)

The atmosphere and design of the place are fantastic! Our food took a little while to arrive, but we weren't in a rush. It was clear that the food was delivered with love. A big thank you to Juliet and the team for being so accommodating! We appreciated it!

The Coborn is a really solid pub; modernised but still welcoming. The refurbishment means it is more gastropub than an old-school boozer, with bright interiors and a lovely garden terrace for when the sun’s out. Food is good and there’s a decent range of beers and wines. Prices are a little higher than a classic local, but the service is friendly and the atmosphere is relaxed. If you’re after a rough-and-ready East End pub this isn’t it, but if you want something comfortable with good food and drink, the Coborn is a safe bet.

venues.description: Italian soul food that transports you to the streets of Rome, one bite at a time. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: As an Italian (born and bred) I was incredibly impressed with the quality of food at the Pizza Room, one of the best pizzas I’ve had in the UK by far! The quality of the ingredients was amazing, I genuinely felt like I was back home in Italy for a night. The quality of service was also impressive, both Ashok and Debora are super kind, patient (especially with recommendations) and attentive. Also loved the choice of music (some of my favourite songs ever!) and Halloween decorations were a plus, loved the atmosphere. I will definitely be going back! Grazie ancora

Had this pizza delivered on Friday night. I quickly realised that there was something wrong with the pizza. 2 slices seemed to not belong to this pizza but added to fit in it, but you can see from the colour and the cut that don’t match with the rest of the pizza. Disgusting! I was forced to bin and order from somewhere else. First and last time that I order from here.

I was here with my cousins to try their pizza. The last pizza ( Truffle and mushroom pizza) was the best I ate till now. The cold mozzarella on the top was the plus and it was like a blast of taste in my mouth❤️. It’s worth trying.

Late in the evening, warned me that they would close soon but let me order. And excellent thin base authentic pizza. Served promptly, a sign of quality. Excellent work by the cook Likita and friendly and practical server Nicholas.

Not the worst pizza but also not the best. Table space near the fridge means one doesn't have enough elbow space when cutting the pizza. I lived in Italy for 10 years, I know good pizza. Their pizza is on the same level as reasonable tourist pizza.

Service was as should be expected, staff were polite and professional.

Restaurant is so small, it is difficult have an atmosphere

venues.description: Where traditional pub fare gets a gourmet makeover - comfort food elevated to art. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
A great combination of a good pub and excellent Thai food. There are lots of interesting beers on draft and the service is really quick and efficient.
The Thai food is extremely good. We absolutely loved the Jantaburi pad Thai it was full of plump perfectly cooked prawns and lots of interesting flavors and textures, it's a brilliant dish. We also enjoyed the lamb maasaman curry and red curry sirloin. Excellent food, great pub, lots of space inside and out, highly recommended

A great East End pub, just east of Mile End underground station. The Rusty Bike is a modern pub with a large front garden and an even larger indoor area. The focus appears to be sport and Thai food to keep the drinks company. This is not an obvious destination for real ale drinkers but there is a very healthy selection of keg beers and ciders. The staff are very friendly and efficient. Great place to stop for a pint
delicious chicken pad see ew! salt and pepper squid was really oily but everything else was good, definitely recommend it a casual yet flavorful dinner
Best Thai food in East London! All staff are friendly and efficient. Super dog friendly too - my favourite place to stop by after dog walks 🐶.

Great bar, great mixture of music, great demographic, great staff, great food and Thai food and that!! Which you can order up till 23h which saves you having to leave after a great time drinking to look for food and good, really good food at that!! Will definitely be back!

venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: The restaurant offered a truly authentic Lebanese experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented—especially the mezze and grilled dishes. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. The staff were attentive and made great recommendations. A wonderful spot for anyone who loves genuine Lebanese cuisine!

Insanely good. Proper Lebanese food. Vine
leaves were soft and succulent with impeccable filling, the arrayes was pure deliciousness, the chicken shawarma absurdly tasty. Hard recommend.
Have been here a few times for the lunch menu. Fresh food and good-sized portions representing excellent value for money. Food tastes good too, the moussaka is a particular favourite.
Really fresh and tasty Lebanese food. I had the mixed grill, tabouleh and babaganoush...all fantastic. Good value for money and the service was great.
I had to get food for my young people while we were on a youth group trip and the service was very quick and friendly.

venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: The food was perfect! Hot, tasty and good portion size. We left feeling full and satisfied. My little brother really enjoyed the smoke on the table too. Shoutout to Umayer for his amazing service, he was efficient and friendly. Would highly recommend this place, we have visited a few times already and plenty more in the future.

I recently had the opportunity to visit Afrikana Mile End, a restaurant that has been generating quite a buzz in the area. With high expectations, I stepped inside, eager to experience what this place had to offer. They had vibrant and inviting ambiance, blending modern decor with a touch of cultural flair. The warm lighting and lively music created a welcoming environment. It’s a great spot for both casual dining and special occasions. I decided to try their jerk chicken, which is often highlighted in reviews. The flavors were indeed delightful, with a nice balance of spice and smokiness. However, I did feel that the prices were a bit on the higher side for what was served. The portions, while decent, left me wanting a bit more. They weren't the smallest I've encountered, but they certainly didn't feel generous either. I would recommend going there if you're a fan of jerk chicken and enjoy smoky flavors. While the food was enjoyable, the pricing and portion sizes might be a consideration for some diners. If you’re in the area and looking for a lively spot to enjoy some flavorful dishes, this restaurant is worth a visit.

Visited for the first time and was highly impressed with the food. It being fusion, you don’t know what to expect but the waitress Dariia was kind enough to give me a good recommendation and it did not disappoint. Price is very reasonable, spent £20.80 which was for a meal and drink plus customer service. I would say it was defo worth it. Thank you for the great service Dariia!

It was my first time visiting this restaurant, and I wasn't disappointed. We didn't reserve a table but was offered a table within 1 minute. Service was good, just that you've to prompt the workers to attend to you but that was fine as they do attend when you ask for something.
For food? I love it 10/10. We ordered a sharing platter, and it was 💯. Mocktails on point. I will definitely recommend it and will go there again.

Had an amazing time at Africana London in Mile End! The food was fresh, full of flavour, and really well cooked. Every dish we tried was spot on and you could tell it was made with care.

The ambiance was so cool — loved the vibe of the place. It had a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere that made the whole experience even better. We really enjoyed our food and will definitely be coming back again soon!

venues.name: The Victoria
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
‘Above’ at The Vic ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

An absolutely superb new dining environment and experience, set above an already delightful and well-established quality pub.

Raw & fried oysters, fried chicken with caviar, steak tartare, monkfish curry, and perfectly cooked turbot. Not to mention a great pint of Guinness downstairs beforehand, followed by a fat-washed Old Fashioned and a very nice Bacchus.

The food was executed incredibly well, and the front-of-house team were exceptional!

Open Friday and Saturday evenings. It’s not big, so book early to be delighted—and to avoid disappointment.

Beautiful garden with plenty of tables - book in advance if sunny because it get very busy. Cocktails are delicious and have a few deals on weeks days 4-6pm including oysters for £2 a pop. Inside is gorgeous and the staff
is always so friendly and knowledgeable; there’s always Amazon specials in the board. Super seasonal menu but what never fails are the Croquettes… sometimes lobster, hake, mackerel or cheese… Always yes!
Missing the shrimp burger though…
We came here for the seafood and it was amazing! Many options, plates to share, mains. Everything is fresh and the pub is cute. They have a nice garden 🙂

Great gastropub that had the vibes of a cosy pub but the food of a fancy restaurant. Our waiter was so helpful and friendly and gave us an amazing recommendation from the day's specials--a brill with cockles and new potatoes. It was delicious. The potatoes especially were insanely good, i think because they absorbed the juices from everything else. The drinks selection is also great with multiple english wines.

Fantastic dining experience! I came here for lunch with my whole family and we absolutely loved it. This restaurant is so beautiful! The food was delicious but what really stood out to me was the service. Our waiter Danny was exceptional, so attentive and friendly. He even showed us the gorgeous showroom upstairs, which I would love to book at some point!
Thank you so much to the whole team :)
I highly recommend The Victoria.

venues.name: Mile End Pizza and Kebab
venues.description: Italian soul food that transports you to the streets of Rome, one bite at a time. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
One of the best takeaways in Mile End! The food here is always fresh, tasty, and made with care. The kebabs are full of flavour, perfectly cooked, and come with generous portions of salad and sauces. The pizzas are just as good – loads of toppings, plenty of cheese, and served piping hot every time.

Service is excellent too – the staff are friendly, welcoming, and quick with orders whether you’re collecting or getting delivery. Prices are very fair for the quality and portion sizes, and you definitely get value for money.

If you’re in East London and craving pizza or kebabs, this is the place to go. Consistently delicious, reliable, and easily a favourite spot. Highly recommended!

Hands down one of the top takeaways in East London! The kebabs are packed with flavour and served with fresh salad and warm bread. The pizzas are generous with toppings and perfectly cooked. Portions are huge, prices are great, and the service is always welcoming. Can’t recommend enough!

This place never disappoints. The chicken doner is juicy, the naan is soft, and the pizzas come out cheesy and hot every time. Staff are proper friendly too – feels like they really care about their customers.
Amazing food and excellent service. The kebabs are always fresh, pizzas are loaded with toppings, and delivery is quick. Best takeaway in Mile End!
The pizza here is absolutely amazing,the toppings taste fresh and flavorful, the staff is super friendly and welcoming. the service is very quick.

venues.description: Mexican cuisine that's as vibrant as Mexico City itself - authentic flavors, modern style. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
We have been meaning to try
TacoSmash for a while
But haven’t had a chance to
Until tonight.

We were welcomed by the very
Friendly Farhad
Who helped us to choose
Our French taco.

We ordered a large taco
That came with a choice of
2 fillings & 2 sauces

We went for
Cajun Chicken / Lamb Doner

We requested for separate sauces
But they had ran out
So gave us the sauces in a small tray
We tried Scotch Bonnet / Garlic Mayo.

We requested for the Taco to be
Cut in half & They did

We also ordered some
Karak Chai which was delicious
& He was kind enough to give us
Another cup so we didn’t have to share.

Overall it was a really pleasant experience
The place has a lot of potential

Just needs to be given a chance
If you haven’t tried.

The sauces were good
& The Cajun Chicken was banging

We will definitely be back again
Best wishes to everyone at
TacoSmash Mile End.

AWFUL FOOD! The food came up small and there was NO flavor my partner got cheesey chips and there was barely and cheese and they were cold 2 tacos, chips and 2 milkshakes cost us £45 we could’ve got a nice curry or something for that price, we contacted them for some form of compensation and no reply …don’t bother wasting your money here

If I could give it 0 stars I would, came here a few days ago I ordered a smashed burger why is the patty looking like this?? Looks like crumbled piece of mince meat ???? Salty mess. The vibe in the shop was even worse, was sat in the shop and could hear an argument at the back of the shop? Management obviously can’t run the place properly and it shows through every part of the store, disgusting food wouldn’t recommend. The man with glasses who served me was rude and condescending hence my one star review on the service.

Really pleasant experience. Nice clean & airy interior, and we played a bit of Tekken while we waited for our food.

The loaded fries were good, karak chai was really tasty, but the real winner was the burger: perfectly cooked, juicy, and a good ratio of sauce and onions.

The service was efficient and friendly too.

Food was amazing!! Portions were super large and staff were super friendly and welcoming! Clean shop and friendly atmosphere made it an amazing place to visit! Especially with the welcoming games. 10/10 food would 100% come again! The lovely hijabi at the front was super friendly and offered us desserts for reviews, which we would have regardless because the food here was amazing. Visit if you can!

reviews.text: Only snapped a photo of the salad and bread, but don’t be fooled — the bread was absolutely delicious, and the lamb chops were phenomenal. Perfectly cooked, full of flavour. One of those meals where the photo doesn’t do it justice!!!

Delicious Afghan food and great value too. I simply can't refuse a plate of mantoo (the dumplings), and these were delicious.

It was the first time we'd had Shirin Palouw - Rice with orange peel, almond slivers, pistachio, and grated carrots. It was incredible.

I've walked past this restaurant for years but finally went with 7 other friends out of curiosity. It was incredible! I had the rice, which soaked up all the lamb shank juices, and the flatbread which we being made and cooked on the tandoor/clay over right next to us. The service was so friendly and I was so grateful to find such a local gem!
The restaurant needs more lighting. The food is average to below average, the hot salad is not fresh.

Food is really good and fresh. I like it very much. Outside set area is really lovely and nice. The only small notice, I would say, is the staff working there are in need for more training. While I understand they may be tired, but we are all. I think if they can have better manners and more respect to the customers that will make the restaurant perfect ☺️

reviews.text:
The breakfast sandwich was delicious!! And the service was so good and kind that I am leaving this review. They have a lot of options. It is only a few steps off mile end’s tube station. I ordered the sausage, egg and bacon one with ciabatta bread and it was perfect and delicious. Nicely prepared, cut in half, generous amount.
The place is very clean, has sitting inside and outside. Came back the next day :)

Such a shame this you to be my favourite spot. The lady had mistake my order and charged me from an extra item and I notified her not even after ordering and she then stated she had already started which was a lie. She was then rude and said she can not offer a refund and in all honesty I would have accepted the fact if she wasn’t rude. We were the only customers and she take a long time to prepare the food and the food was subpar. I miss the other workers who usually work here who have great customer service such a same as this has always been a great cafe. Will not be coming here again there are other halal options available with better customer service.Chips were completely inedible.

Excellent staff,great value and lovely food.
The omelettes were a particular favourite for us. Well done to the staff. You made our trip to London especially memorable for our son John.

Loved the breakfast the halal sausage was very nice, as it’s kinda hard to fine good halal sausage. Not big of a caffeine person, so that was meh. The 5 star is for the sweet lady ( Shonda) there - thanks for the impeccable customer service ! How can one person manage this whole cafe on their own - Madd!

I was thoroughly impressed. The service was outstanding – friendly, fast, and welcoming. The quality and quantity of the food were both excellent, exceeding my expectations. Every item was fresh, generously portioned, and full of flavour. Prices were very reasonable, making it great value for money. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a satisfying meal with top-notch service!

venues.name: Simply Smashed - Quality Smash Burgers
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We stopped here for an early dinner on one of the days of our visit to London from Melbourne, and I can say it was definitely worthwhile. Muaz was so helpful, making sure we got the best of what was on offer based off our personal preferences, it made for a great experience and all his suggestions were 11/10. Would definitely visit again!

Absolutely amazing Food! Friendly family atmosphere. Great selection on menu and drinks!  Enjoyed our food thoroughly . Great service from Rahman , Very Polite and well spoken! Thank you for a wonderful Meal this afternoon. Keep it up!

Tried out the Angus beef 🍔 ⭐️⭐️⭐️
-Overpriced and tasted like a normal burger. There were only two and a half pickles in the burger topped with lettuce and some sickeningly sweet sauce.

Price 💵 ⭐️⭐️⭐️
- Not VFM. £7.00 for a mid burger.

Drinks ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ -
- Disappointed that they were selling Aldi and Lidl drinks for £1.50 which is absurd even though they cost £2.00 for a six pack

Toilet facilities 🚻 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
- Decent, provided with hand wash and adequate water pressure. Clean as well.

Customer service 💁‍♂️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
- Friendly and helpful staff. Very attentive and manager was helpful.

Overall, I wouldn’t return. Food is mid nothing special. Wings were ok. Been here once in 2023 and food is still the same. Overpriced and under delivered. Unfortunate because the staff are attentive and caring.

Came to this place as my husband recommended it. We were not disappointed, I ordered the wagyu burger and it was very tasty. We were served by a gentleman called Shuvo, he was very polite and attentive. The service was really good and I'll definitely be back.

The meal was good - definitely filled me up. I got a double wagyu bacon burger - it was nice but I wish the patty was smashed more as it wasn’t as crispy as I’d prefer my smash burgers to be. The Sahara sauce is nice - not as spicy as I expected but tasty nonetheless. The seasoned fries were yummy - maybe a bit too salty though.

Masoom was friendly and polite.

reviews.text:
We popped by on our way back
From visiting the underwhelming launch
Of the another establishment.

The staff were very welcoming
& Guided us how to use the app

We placed the order
& Watched them make everything.

We ordered the following items
From their mini menu
So we can try out different items:

2 Wingz & Chips
2 Chunks & 3 Wings

Mini Mojito Strawberry
Mini Shake Choco Nut

We didn’t select any sauces or dips
So they were kind enough to include
Some for us to try.

Everything was made to order
They changed gloves everytime
They were making something different

The presentation was good
The food stayed at a good temperature
Until we got in to eat.

We enjoyed everything
& Will definitely be popping by again

Thank you to everyone at
WNGZ Mile End for the
Exceptional service ✨

I popped in today for lunch with a friend, I walk past this place quite often but mostly see it empty.  So thought we would give it a try and also my friend was super hungry to walk anywhere else.

We ordered loaded chips, which were very loaded with enough chicken on top.  We also went for the strips with choice of two flavourings of sauce on top.  Both were 10/10.

Surprised that this place is not more busy, food is flavoursome and came out piping hot! Service was good, did take a while for the food to come out, but that’s because they cook everything freshly once order is placed.

Will definitely revisit again.

YES YES AND YES. I just came here for the wings and I was beyond satisfied! Here's why...

FLAVOUR: I got the Maple Siracha and the Buffalo, both on fried and let me tell you the flavour is 10/10. Both sauces taste super fresh and home made (they are made in-house) with some good body and complexity. Both these flavours had a good level of heat/spice, so if you're on the touchy scale of spice go for Mango or something else. They have the perfect amount of sauce to really sink into the fried chicken (which isn't too thick or heavy). Getting the wings fried means the sauce really sinks in and they're still a bit crunchy but not too crunchy which is good.

QUALITY: I've lived in the USA (and I'm from Australia) and I've traveled a lot, these are some of the best wings I've tried. In my top 5 for sure. To be fair, they weren't busy so I know they were really able to make them with care. The chicken wings are meaty enough, but not too large (like the gross super hormone-pumped ones out there). I was really happy with the quality of the chicken.

Blue cheese dip: It was delicious and went perfectly with these spicy flavours but it had more of a mayo like texture than your typical in-house made blue cheese dip.

SERVICE: They were accommodating, efficient and friendly. I can't fault them in any way for service.

CONs: I really wanted to try the coleslaw with my wings, but they had run out which was the only downside.

VENUE: Inside the venue was clean and cool (was a stinking hot 34 degree day), AC worked, thank God. But there's only two tables, so ideally not for dining in at this location. (hence why it's just a 4 star rating instead of 5).

OUTCOME: This is a really great place for when you have those wing cravings! Get them fresh and get them hot. I imagine eating them within 10 mins of them being made will give you the best experience.

I will be going back to try the other flavors and some loaded fries, and hopefully coleslaw.
Lovely food, crispy wings and saucy loaded fries! Would say there was a bit too much sauce on the fries so can be over powering. But otherwise great food.

Habib is the best server I’ve ever had! He prepared the food to perfection! The shop was busy but the man is a one man army, he handled it with no stress and the food was delicious. Definitely money well spent if you decide to eat here

reviews.text:
Visited this laid back café for some lunch. I was not disappointed.
I ordered the pesto mozzarella focaccia sandwich. The bread was freshly made, gorgeous sandwich.
Cappuccino was smooth and mellow. 75% arabatic and 25% robusto. Very good coffee!
They have a large array of desserts locally made.
Great barista, lovely mocha & turmeric late. Half-price pastry after 5pm makes so much sense. "Garden" space in the back is a nice touch.
Lovely little coffee shop, with charming seating areas. Service is really friendly with attention to detail and they make lovely cappuccinos. Bonus they have lots of tasty vegan treats

I visited this coffee shop a few months ago and really enjoyed it. I went with my husband and we ordered coffee, sandwiches, and desserts. I loved that they had vegetarian and vegan options. The food was super delicious, the staff was very attentive, and the music and atmosphere made our visit just perfect. Highly recommended!

The atmosphere was great and so was the service. I bought a mini red velvet cake and it was kinda hard to bite into, but the peach and green tea was super tasty. I loved the ambience inside the seating area. But no sockets! When I went, there was construction,it was extremely loud for over an hour due to the drilling. It didn’t bother me too much but my friend was a bit bothered, but not the fault of anyone. other than that, it was nice and quiet! Overall great!

reviews.text: As always with Nando's, classic peri peri chicken grilled to perfection, but customer service in this branch was not as good as expected. Regardless, loved the meal.

Had to write a review because the service was excellent. Also so wonderful to see a team who work well together and that are so polite and friendly.
Martin, Raju and a couple of female front of house staff whose names I didn’t catch.

Food was fresh, tasty and served very promptly as always. Thank you

Nando's is a bit of a household name... thought I'd give it a go after a long hiatus. Ordered delivery though, but I've put 4 for atmosphere as it's well know to be the type of cooker cutter restaurant style which is traditionally Nandos. Quick delivery!!

Great selection of food both veg and chicken. I had the hot grilled burger with chips and corn side and got a slaw (yum and fresh tasting with nuts). Chips cooked pretty and seasoned well, always a tough item to courier...  The grilled chicken was a bit dry, also due to the bun being dry. It's worth noting you pay about a £1 more on most things when ordering online (and the deliveroo user service fee which I have no problem paying for as a user, may w the restaurant is charged a high % to be on Deliveroo). I think it's better as a dine in food... And I'll get the pitta next time not chicken in a burger bun 😊
Always fresh and tasty, Khai delivered excellent customer service aswell as the rest of the team! Highly recommend if in the area

Great aesthetics and music. Loved the Afro Portuguese music as an Angolan myself.

The server was attentive, however originally sat me at a dirty table and the floor was wet but it was great that the manager moved us to another table to resolve the situation and apologised. Food was made within 15 minutes which I think is a decent time, had two portions four chicken thighs one with peri chips and grilled halloumi with mac and cheesse along then the other portion with rainbow slaw and peri chips with the new strawberry + dragon fruit. The food was 10/10, my partner said so also but wasn’t fans of the drink.

Cons :
- Went to use the toilet and it nearly cut my bum as the toilet seat is broken. Toilet checks hadn’t been done cause there was a lot of toilet paper on the floor.

venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
recently ordered from Damal Restaurant through UberEats, and I’ve got to say – it was a top-tier experience. I went for the lamb shoulder meal, and it did not disappoint. The meat was incredibly tender, falling right off the bone – just the way it should be.

The meal came with a side of salad and rice, both of which complemented the lamb perfectly. The flavours were well-balanced and satisfying. They also included two sauces – a green and a red one (I forgot the names), but both were bursting with flavour and paired brilliantly with the meat.

To top it all off, I ordered a Shani drink, which surprisingly went really well with the whole meal. It added a nice sweet contrast to the savoury dish.

Honestly, I’d give it a 10/10. The food was absolutely on point. It’s not your everyday meal – it’s a different experience, and definitely worth trying if you’re after something special.

A party of 11 booked a table.

We ordered starters and 2 sharing platters, which were massive! We could take left over home in containers.

These grilled lamb and chicken were so tender, moist and delicious.  The rice was flavourful.

The restaurant opened less than one month when we went. It looked a bid disorganised and the service was really slow!

We waited nearly 2 hours before the main came to our table, but it was worth waiting.

The Somali tea was really nice.

It’s great for a large group.

Toilets however needed improving despite it was a new restaurant.

There is a room with carpet and stools to sit on. It looked really nice and I suppose it’s for a special occasion.

Happy to go back any time.
The food was very delicious and really big portions!! The place is really nice inside reccomend for a somali place to eat!!

I would of given 1 star but I managed to get a bannana with my meal after asking numerous times. Upon ordering I asked for a lamb shoulder, but recieved a lamb shank. When I asked why the change of meat it's because "there wasn't enough" but I saw lamb shoulders being served on other tables. The meat was a really dry one. I was chewing like a cow. It was overcooked. This consistency followed with my friends meal also. The rice was so hard, it wasn't cooked properly and the amount of times I asked for a drink but didn't get one.. It wasn't even busy like that.. Never coming here again. Al Kahf is miles better. (I also found foil in my food that I nearly consumed)

Great food with excellent value.
Although I found the main meals a bit dry and could do with a moist sauce base or side sauce. Perhaps chunky veg pieces would work better with the shank with milder flavours than the small veg pieces the taste of it did not compliment the shank.

Rice was fresh, hot and fragrant. Shank could be more tender...

Seating and atmosphere is clean and vibrant. Bathroom is clean with another hand wash basin for usual hand wash.

Excellently priced.
Hughly recommended place.

reviews.text: Seriously tasty food, generous portion sizes can feed 2, really nice atmosphere inside the two brothers working behind the tills are very polite and respectful. Only thing i can say is the prices are a bit steep. Nevertheless would recommend.

Foods are very good here. It gets super packed and crowded, so I wanted to see if the hype was really worth it honestly but I don’t really think it is. The food is tasty, no doubt, but not on the level of all the hype. I also had a fruit punch which cost around £4.80–£5, and that felt like a rip off because it tasted exactly like Bigga fruit punch that you can buy for £1.

Overall, I still enjoyed the food and would go back for the dishes I liked. Just don’t expect it to live up to all the hype, and maybe avoid the fruit punch you can get Bigga fruit punch that tastes exactly same

After seeing reels about FoodComa, we had to give it a try — and it didn’t disappoint! We ordered the Box Meal No.1, which came with loaded fries, chicken wings, mac and cheese, a waffle burger, and salt & pepper prawns. Everything was absolutely delicious — I ate it all and honestly felt like I was in a real food coma afterwards! Definitely one of those meals that keeps you full for the whole day.

The staff were friendly, and although the card machine wasn’t working and I had some issues trying to order through Uber Eats, it was worth the journey to collect. We’ll definitely be going back — though maybe after a few weeks (or months!) to recover!

Food is good, very big portion for one person. I went for the box meal 2 I changed mac and cheese for chips. The wings were nice and crispy, same were the prawns rice has a lot of flavour. Highly recommend this place.

Really good food spot. Brothers have excellent service didn’t have water so they gave us 2 soft drinks free of charge. Food was on point. 10/10 and a huge portion. Will definitely be coming back. Note: Cash only

venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Great place for late night bite went there after our football session I had peri peri grill fish & peri peri wings highly recommend full of flavour perfectly spice sea bass was perfectly grill with peri peri flavour taste was awesome. Peri peri wings fantastic perfectly grill & spiced. Alternative from traditional Pfc very good option for grill fish lovers definitely recommend try their peri peri fish grill either have with sea bass or sea bream. Plenty seating area also they do Bangladeshi fish rupchanda grill next time will give a try.

On the way back from Genesis Cinema, we found this place open about the midnight and ordered a portion of chicken with rice to share.

I wasn’t expecting much, but it was really good! The chicken was very tender and full of flavour and so was the rice that came with it.

I saw sea bass on the grills and they look really nice and it was reasonably priced.

There is more seating at the back and downstairs.

What an incredible culinary experience! I had the pleasure of visiting this establishment on 30 November 2023, accompanied by three local friends from East London. Specifically seeking a dining spot that deviated from the  trendy fried chicken, we decided to explore something different, then my friend Masum recommended this place. I was on a day grip to London.

Our order included two distinct fish dishes, a delectable king prawn, and a serving of chicken. The grilled fish proved to be a standout, boasting exceptional flavor and quality. I also opted for a side of corn cob, which complemented the main courses perfectly.

The commitment to food hygiene practices at this place was truly commendable, evident in their impressive 5-star hygiene rating. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone in search of an unique menu and delightful dining experience. The fusion of options and the delightful flavors make it a must-try for food enthusiasts (Fish mongers are highly recommended)

(N.B Thanks to Masum and Samrul bhai for hosting the meal)
Kind regards
Mizan Rahman
Scotland

Best Peri Peri chicken around.
Also tried their Burger; mine was beef and wife has taken Chicken burger and both were delicious.
I like well done chips.
They had that.

Friendly environment and awesome service.
Will be back again with my friends.
They got private seating arrangement at basement as well.
Very nice food and atmosphere great, the private seating area in the lower part basement is very good for small meeting, gathering and parties well decorated and quite environment very good overall

If you want a good vibe and good Nigerian Food … this is the place for you !
I love their presentation and the customer service is immaculate.
Let’s get into the food - they have the best Jollof rice I have ever had !!
The suya taste like street suya from Nigeria,
Massive prawns, delicious fish , fresh yummy snails, perfectly spiced Asun 🤤
Everything on the menu just tastes so good!!!
I would highly recommend. Can’t leave without a takeaway pack.

I ordered pounded yam and eforiro last night, it was really bad and it totally dashed my hopes of eating a nice dinner, the pounded yam was so watery 😭 I’ve never seen such in my life, the vegetable soup was also watered and filled with oil, I believe £25 should fetch me a decent, good and well prepared meal even if it’ll come in a small quantity. This is a bad experience that is so hard to forget

Nestled in the heart of the city, "Jollof Delights" is a vibrant celebration of African cuisine that immediately transports you to a world of rich flavors and warm hospitality. From the moment you step inside, the colorful decor and rhythmic music create an inviting atmosphere.

Ok so i ordered something they called Grilled turkey. I saw a pic that showed 2 pieces of this with sides of my own choice and hot sauce. I understand side to be maybe fried or even rice ot plantain? I paid a whooping £13.00 and guess what? When the item came, it was a tiny piece of turkey like this, i regretted ordering from this shop. No sides, no hot sauce like it said on their menu. Why wld anybody order a small piece of turkey that i can comfortably cover in my palm £13.00? That was a reap off? I cld have ordered better food with that money. Honestly, if this turkey has been like a large portion, i probably wouldn't have minded. I wish i cld add the photo hwre but no option for that. So since i can't get my money back, i have to warn others to steer clear, don't get reaped off. Since they had the mind to do this to me, i will also have the mind to spread this reap off to anybody who cares to listen.
Don't normally leave reviews but the best jollof and suya beef so soft, I've ever had, relaxing seating only one thing left me a little hungry after the meal of jollof rice and beef
