venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Great spot for solo, couples or groups and families.
Have tried various dishes from the menu and every single one was nice.

Halloumi, mini quesadilas, sweet potato fries, king Prawns - all very tasty.

Chicken is halal as far as I know. Please check if any other meats are halal.
Always have good offers on - always check these out via the app, or your last receipt.

Had a lovely experience at the Las Iguanas in Stratford - it was a Sunday so wasn’t extremely busy. Service was brilliant by Monika, very patient with answering all our questions about the sharing options & was so kind! We ordered the taco sharer board and a portion of bbq wings and it was more than enough and very delicious. We also had a strawberry daiquiri and they do not skimp on the alcohol. Lovely experience, will definitely be going again soon.

The restaurant is vibrant, bright, colourful, rustic, comfortable, sleek, elegant, modern, huge, spacious, tidy, clean and hygienic. The staff are friendly, respectful, supportive, sociable, well mannered, polite, professional, knowledgeable about food, understanding, organised and very welcoming with smile that makes you feel welcome there without having to worry about fitting in a place that serves you best experience and food. The food was fantastic, fresh, flavourful, delicious, mouthwatering, colourful in good ways and great quality but the drink and service cost threw me off which is reason why I was shocked I received the receipt. You should go there and try their food because it will remind you best time especially if you’re going to date, anniversary, family day out or catch up with friends that you have not seen in a while in your lifetime.

Our group of nine visited the restaurant and found the food overall to be decent, with a good variety of dishes to suit different tastes.

We waited for 20 minutes for the original host to return to order our food but because she didn’t return we asked the nearest host called Esther to assist. A special mention must go to Esther, who was a fantastic host throughout our visit. She was attentive, friendly, and made sure our experience ran as smooth as possible given the circumstances. It was clear that she was the key person managing not only our table but also others in the restaurant during the several hours we were there. From taking orders to serving food, she maintained a good standard of service despite being visibly stretched.

We hope that management recognises the value she brings and provides her with more support in her role. Her dedication and hard work stood out and made a real difference to our dining experience.

The main downsides were that some menu items weren’t available, they don’t accept Amex, and the staff seemed like they could use a bit more support to keep service running smoothly. On the plus side, if you’re a Blue Light Card holder, you get a generous 40% off for up to six people.The

I recently visited a charming cocktail bar that completely exceeded my expectations! The ambiance was really lovely, creating the perfect backdrop for a relaxing evening. The decor was stylish yet cozy, making it an ideal place to unwind with friends or enjoy a romantic date night.

What stood out the most was the exceptional service, particularly from a gentleman called Stefan who was not only friendly but also incredibly welcoming. His warm smile and engaging personality instantly made us feel at home. He was knowledgeable about the menu and offered fantastic recommendations, which really enhanced our experience.

The cocktails themselves were nothing short of delightful. Each drink was expertly crafted, bursting with unique flavors that delighted our taste buds. It was evident that the bartenders take pride in their craft, which made every sip a pleasure.

Overall, this cocktail bar is a hidden gem that I can’t recommend enough. It’s a lovely place to enjoy great drinks and even better company, thanks in large part to the friendly and lovely staff. I can't wait to return for another round!

venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Very yummy (& filling) dinner at Shoryu this Sunday evening, my friend always comes here and recommended this spot. Lovely staff, a little bit of a wait for the food but is fresh & good quality. 🍙

I got the “White Natural” which was tasty but think the Tofu could have had more flavour, I would opt for the spicer option next time. I am looking forward to trying more items from the menu. 🍚🍥 The Melon Soda is YUM.

We visited this restaurant in Stratford Westfield's food court and had an excellent experience. The spicy vegan ramen was absolutely delicious with rich, flavorful broth and perfectly cooked noodles. We also tried the tempura and rice dish, and the vegetable tempura was outstanding - crispy and light with fresh vegetables.

What impressed us most was how clearly the vegetarian options were marked on the menu, making it easy to navigate for plant-based diners. The portions were generous and satisfying - exactly the kind of filling comfort food you want. The staff were friendly and helpful throughout our visit, adding to the positive experience.

This spot is definitely worth checking out if you're looking for quality Japanese cuisine with great vegetarian options.

I visited a few days ago and was served by Rushaa, she recommended the Chicken Katsu Curry (halal!) and the Chicken Karaage (also halal!), I also ordered the spicy cucumber salad. I ordered the curry and karaage as part of the set for £16.

This was my first time trying chicken katsu curry and it was lovely! The pickled ginger wasn't too strong compared to other places I've been, which is good for me, and had a nice sour flavour that went well with the curry sauce. I found it to be a big portion and was very full after, I had to take away the chicken karaage for later (which Rushaa kindly provided a box for).

The chicken karaage was crispy and light, and came with a lemon slice and japanese mayo with shichimi (Japanese powder spice), all of this combined tasted great! The chicken pieces themselves were big, and I was also given a free sample to try. The spicy cucumber salad (which had shichimi) complimented the karaage nicely and added freshness to the meal.

I was also given a loyalty card which, upon completing, you get free ramen!

I definitely recommend Shoryu especially if you've never tried japanese food before, Rushaa was friendly and kindly answered my questions, and the other staff were also friendly and helpful.

Slightly well eaten version of the noodles!! We ordered the futsuu (Standard firmness of the noodles) chicken paitan noodles. Flavor, quantity everything is on point!!! Absolutely delicious and I would highly recommend again .. This was at the Westfield Stratford mall.
Very tasty and enjoyable meal. I got the Original Tonkotsu but I wish I got the next level up. Pork was super soft and melt in your mouth. The broth was good but could have been a bit more flavourful

reviews.text:
Guys, please avoid for now ⛔️.
They seriously need to improve the quality of their food. I’ve tried their various dishes even after my friend had bad experience with their service and food and have heard so much about their poor cleanliness and quality. The service is ok and pricing is good. However, for a restaurant, it’s the quality food and hygiene that matters the most. Last week, I had a burger from her and got food poisoned. It was at that moment I realized that I am not getting my food from here anymore !

A Carnivore's Paradise: 3am Delight at BBQ Express!

Let me preface this by saying I'm a total gym rat, and finding healthy, delicious food late at night can be a struggle. But let me tell you, this particular branch of BBQ Express has become my new late-night savior! They also allow you to eat in!

First and foremost, the meat is phenomenal. It's incredibly tender and juicy, regardless of what you choose - and believe me, I now come multiple times and I've tried almost everything on their amazingly diverse menu. Even at 3 am, the selection is fantastic, offering a variety of protein options to satisfy any craving.

Speaking of the menu, it's truly a feast for the eyes. They have something for everyone, whether you're a hardcore carnivore like me, or looking for lighter, healthier options.

But what truly elevates this branch is the staff. They're incredibly friendly and helpful, even at those late hours. They're always patient with my indecisiveness (trust me, it's hard to choose with so many delicious options!), and always make sure I have everything I need. Ali always provides well!

Now, let's talk about the most surprising aspect: the prices. Considering the quality of the food and the late-night convenience, their prices are incredibly reasonable. I can fuel my workouts without breaking the bank, which is a major win in my book.

Overall, this branch of BBQ Express is a game-changer for late-night diners, especially those seeking healthy, protein-packed meals. From the tender meat and diverse menu to the friendly staff and affordable prices, they truly tick all the boxes. I highly recommend checking them out, especially if you find yourself craving some delicious food after a late-night gym session!

My favourite here is the Best Bits Grill Box!

Fried chicken was crispy
Interior is run down tables aren't properly clean and sticky. The benches are wobbly. The stools are suitable to be sit down on. Service was satisfactory.
The shop needs renovation. The sink tap's head is also tapped! Slacking!

starve!

venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
From the moment I walked in, I was met with rudeness and a complete lack of care from the staff. The man at the counter couldn’t be bothered to greet or even acknowledge customers properly, it felt like serving people was a burden to him.

When I went to place my order, I was rushed aggressively despite clearly trying to browse the menu. I finally settled on a 1/4 grilled chicken with rice in the hot flavouring — which was displayed as roughly £6 — but when I checked the screen, I saw he was charging me over £11. When I politely pointed this out, I realised he had rung up a whole chicken instead. No apology, just an annoyed grunt as he changed it. Already not a great start.

After paying, I wasn’t told how long the food would take, wasn’t given a number, wasn’t told to wait — nothing. I just stood there confused, hoping I wasn’t forgotten. At least in most takeaways you get some basic communication. After about 10 minutes, I saw a seat open up and sat down.

While walking to my seat, I saw an older lady finally getting her order — but what was strange was that she’d clearly been waiting for a while, and all she received was a hot wings meal straight from the hot holding oven. If the food was just sitting there, what exactly was she waiting for all that time?

Anyway, I ended up waiting a total of over 40 minutes for my order — during my one-hour break. I kept looking at the staff hoping to catch someone’s attention, but they were too busy chatting with their friends behind the counter. Finally, after about 45 minutes, the guy calls me over — only to ask why I took so long!? He never called my number, never shouted my name, nothing. He simply left my food somewhere behind the till and forgot.

The interaction was rude and dismissive, and by then I was just trying to eat quickly before my break ended. But the worst part? The food was awful. I received chips instead of the rice I ordered, and they were cold, soggy, unseasoned, and frankly just sad. No salt included, and the bag only had one tiny ketchup packet. When I politely asked for more, the same rude staff member said, “You only get one” — like I was asking for a gold bar.

The chicken thigh was also cold. The “hot” sauce I requested was nowhere to be found. Instead, it looked and tasted like the lemon and herb one — which had already solidified into a congealed mess on top of the meat. There was no spice, no flavour, just a cold, dry piece of chicken slapped onto the plate like an afterthought.

I didn’t even have time to complain properly because my break was nearly over. So I left, still hungry, still annoyed, and honestly just disappointed that I wasted my money and time here.

There are plenty of better options in the 5 Continents food court nearby — far better service, actual respect for customers, and food that’s edible and served with care. This place? A complete disgrace.
Do yourself a favour and eat literally anywhere else.

I ordered the Smashed beef burger (buy 1 get 1 free) through Ube. The pattie/burger was dry, and it took nearly an hour for the food to be ready.
The only positive was that chips were hot and chrispy.

The sauce on the hot grilled wings was next level flavour! So good. Very friendly staff at this place. It's essentially a stall in a sort of mini food-court. Great atmosphere. I loved it. If I was local, I'd go here every day.

I was waiting for my loaded box for about 40 minutes, and when I went up to the guy in the register he said that he didn't prepare my food yet and might have accidentally given it to someone else, I then had to wait another 10 minutes for the order. So in total, it took them about 50 minutes to prepare my food and give it. Food was good but they made the prices more expensive for less food. My box barely had any fries and the smallest chicken wings in the world. The burger was decent-ish, the best thing about the whole order was the drink that they didn't make (it was the pepsi can drink).
Hardies Peri Peri offers delicious food at a very reasonable price, and the staff provide excellent service with a friendly attitude. Great value for money and a place I’d definitely recommend.

venues.name: SMASH
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Got take away late at night. Took a while for the food to become ready. Customer service was great. The restaurant was nice and clean. The cola is tasty.

I found the smash burger not as tasty. The chicken burger was really good. Needs more spice. Get naga in there.
The Double Smash was well-made and tasted delicious. The spicy chicken burger was also great, with generous portions of chips and fresh ingredients.

I can't talk about the atmosphere or service because I ordered the food.

Smash burger was amazing the meat was juicy and melted in the mouth. The bun wasn't soggy. It was genuinely a 10/10 burger.

The spicy chicken burger was definitely spicy but not too spicy enough for your tongue to tingle and the chicken was juicy and not chewy it was perfect. The only thing I would say is could've been crispier but that might be because it was delivered.

Fries are perfect crispy and fluffy and perfectly seasoned. No complaints.

The chicken strips were 5/10 they were crispy and had a great flavour but it was very dry and stringy. I think it may have been over fried so if it wasn't it might be a lot nicer.

The chicken bites were amazing, great flavour and the chicken was juicy they did that one properly it was amazing.

Chilli cheese bites standard perfectly cooked and the cheese was melted.

The Algerian sauce is really nice it's like a spicy mayonnaise with good heat though but not hot enough for spice lovers. But will be enough for your average spice eater. Good flavour.

Overall, I'd definitely eat from here the food was really good.
Had spicy chicken wrap for takeaway and all I got was 90% lettuce and 10% chicken stripes.Moreover,it was supposed to be a spicy but it was sour by all.

Nuggets were tasty.

Burger didn't taste last a smash burger, more like a knock off American fast food burger. Closer to a 1/4 pounder from the boss man shop.

Staff were very nice and knew the menu well.

Tables were clean.

Lots of delivery drivers coming through and they seemed to have a good system going to keep things moving.

Food was in good portions. Burger was a tad small for the price.

Pictures meal was £17 and they charged 40p for a tiny garlic sauce which I thought was a bit cheeky for a place that charged me almost £20 for frozen chips, 1/4 pounder and some chicken nuggets.

Overall, would go back, but not in a rush to. Hopefully they sort out the little kinks.

reviews.text: The food was delicious, and the service was amazing. Staff were attentive, hospitable and offered alternatives if we didn't like our side. We ordered jerk chicken and rice, beef ribs with chips and dumplings. All dishes were tasty and we were glad we came. The lychee mojito was perfect size and we really enjoyed it. Would deffo recommend you give it a try if you havnt been. Overall happy with our visit :)

Food was good, specially beef ribs. We ordered jerk chicken with rice and two mojitos.
Jerk chicken was average, chips portion quite small. Mojitos were very average.
We went there after reading reviews with high expectations probably that's why we were a bit disappointed, I personally think the reviews have been hyped a bit.
But all in all its a nice decent place to eat. Small portions and prices on high end.

Friendly staff and fresh food cooked to order.

I had a Jerk chicken thigh with rice & peas and also a very fresh and well balanced mojito.

Great dining experience!
Very succulent jerk wings and tender shrimps. Food was in good portions and nicely seasoned.
The staff was hospitable and generous. Guava & watermelon Mojito tastes tropical and fresh. Give it a try if you are in Stratford.

Very attentive staff, delicious food, we had steak and Mash, Chops and salad,  kids had burger and chips. Great quality and flavour. We have ordered take out during Ramadan and done multipul pit stops for shakes and cake!

reviews.text: Food is always delicious here. Quick service and waiter Irina was amazing and helpful, would highly recommend this place. Everything is worth a try :))

Elina was an excellent waitress – warm, attentive, and welcoming. The food was fresh, delicious, and full of flavour. The atmosphere was relaxing, making it a very enjoyable dining experience. To top it all off, we were even treated to a complimentary dessert, which was a lovely surprise.

Really nice food. Really tasty and fresh. Definitely recommend and will definitely go back.

On the other hand, the atmosphere was a bit of a kill. The lights were too bright and the space smelled a bit due to the kitchen being in the open. Chairs were a tad uncomfortable. We went dressed up before we go out and the vibe felt a bit off.

Tips:
dim the lighting/ change the light bulbs at the eating area.
Add candles
Create atmosphere with 2/3 tones in the space as the walls were flat and monotonous.
Menu seemed a bit too colourful and tightly made and the colours didn't match the room or the tables or the fancy plates.

Eating good food for a good price while also feeling comfortable to dress up will definitely triple the customers.
Food is really good & portions are also on point. Stefanie the serving lady greeted me with a smile on her face & was very nice & helpful 🙌🏽  They make the best tasting pinacolada everrrrr 🍹🫶🏽

Fresh , tasty food . If you love Turkish food, this is the perfect place for you. We ordered lamb shish kabab, chicken doner kabab and chicken soup. We didn’t like the chicken soup . Kababs were top notch though. Loved the ambience and their service . The restaurant was clean and spacious.

reviews.text: We came as a big group of 10 people plus children to celebrate my graduation🎓, and I had such a wonderful time. I had pre-booked a table, and the food arrived fairly quickly and almost all at the same time. The atmosphere was really nice, and the prices were excellent considering the quality of the food. I highly recommend this place! I’ve been coming here for years, and although it has changed management, the new team is doing a great job as well.❤️🇲🇦
What a great find, step into Morroco, really friendly staff, I had  a chicken tajine, came with flat breads, dips and traditional morrocan bread. Really good price and large portion. Defi recommend.

I visited Dar Marrakesh today and was very disappointed. The food in particular the chicken and calamari, was undercooked and flavourless. When we raised these concerns, we were made to feel like it was our fault that the food was raw. Undercooked chicken, (photos show pink inside and bleeding) is not only unacceptable but can make one very unwell.  The mince in pita, with very little mince in it. The service was poor, the food was bland, with inattentive staff, and the atmosphere lacked any real charm. Overall, a very unpleasant experience that I wouldn’t recommend, especially given the serious health risk.

Went for out team Christmas meal and made several calls pre ordering what we would be ordering on the day and advised them of allergies as requested, only, for them to completely change our requests and ignore order. We were given sharing platters which were extremely small and not enough peices to share, some of us went without. When we questioned our order request which we had rang through multiple times they said they had in control and were preparing our food and not to worry. Not wanting to ruin the night we didn't protest at the time but can say we will not be going back and definitely will not be a place any of us would recommend. Avoid.!

Worst experience in my life. Came to have lunch with my wife and sister as we waited for a meeting with the solicitors for Conveyancing. Wasted money here and the chicken was all raw, squid calamari was very raw. It was disgusting. Please avoid unless you want food poisoning.
I’m disgusted by the service too as the lady lacks the service, instead of fixing the issue, she made it like it’s our fault. Disgusting behaviour and trust me I am very sympathetic as I own a restaurant myself. I know how hard is to run a restaurant but when you get disgusting undercooked food, you can’t blame customers. Change chefs or close down the restaurant and get waiters whom are sympathetic or customer focused.

venues.name: Kolapata
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
As a Bengali girl living away from home, I’m always on the lookout for places that truly capture the flavours of Bangladesh, and this restaurant absolutely delivered!

I tried their kacchi biriyani and khichuri, and both were simply wonderful. The biriyani was fragrant, rich and perfectly spiced, just like the kind we enjoy back home on special occasions. The khichuri was hearty and comforting, with that authentic homely taste you can’t fake.

But the real star for me was the fuska. Every Bengali girl knows how special fuska is, and this one instantly transported me to the bustling streets of Dhaka. The crisp shells, the tangy filling, and the spicy, flavourful water were spot on, it felt like I was right back in Bangladesh enjoying it with friends.

If you’re craving genuine Bengali flavours, this place is a must visit. It’s more than just food, it’s a little taste of home.

I frequently visit here if I am in London, and this place never disappointed me so far. The staff are polite. Tried their kacchi today, and shout out to the lady server who recommended that one to us, it was lovely. Nice cool running Bengali musics will definitely make you nostalgic! I know you don't add service charge, but do a little check back please if you can (Your food can't go wrong, but as a regular guest it's my suggestion). Hope to visit you soon.

Wow, Kolapata totally blew me away! The food was amazing, like, seriously delicious. Every single dish tasted like it was made with love, you know, full of those real, comforting flavors. It's hard to find a place that nails both the taste and the feeling.

And the service? Incredible! The staff were so friendly and made me feel right at home. If you're looking for some good Bnagla food or just a great meal, you HAVE to check it out.

Seriously recommend it, I'm definitely going back!

Brought my wife for the first time in a Bangladeshi restaurant in London. And she was wowed by the quality and flavor of the food. To start with we took fuchka, my wife loved it so much. And for the main we took bhorta platter, rupchada fry, Ilish fry, Sorshe Ilish, Beef bhuna, lamb kabab, regular boiled rice, polao rice. And finally we finish it off with firni. Alongside the food itself, the ambience and environment of the restaurant is quite nice. The staffs were very polite and well behaved. We  hope to come visit this place again.

Went with a group of 16 (including me)- 15 were non-Bangladeshi friends and everyone loved everything about Kolapata 🫶. The ambience was warm and lively, and the team handled our big table with genuine care. We started with chicken tikka and warm naan- just fabulous: juicy, smoky tikka and soft. For mains we shared beef, lamb, and king prawn curries with  white rice; every dish was fresh, well-spiced, and delish. Desserts were fantastic across the board.
We all left happy and full! Would happily return with friends and families inshaAllah.

reviews.text: The Chicken Kiev is the GOAT! I’ve been coming here for a while now and I absolutely love it every time. Consistently tasty, perfectly cooked, and full of flavour. Great service and a nice atmosphere too highly recommend!

This restaurant offers an exceptional dining experience, characterized by attentive staff and supportive management. The food is outstanding and provides great value, with generous portion sizes that are sure to satisfy. The vegetarian options are also commendable. I highly recommend this establishment.

One of the best Sunday roast meals I’ve had in my life. It was very reasonably priced too. The total bill for two of us with drinks was 28£. Will definitely go again.

Bit dark inside.
Delicious Sunday roast! Service from staff is absolutely amazing and prices are very affordable. I got the large mix roast- massive portion for £18, would recommend!!!
Delicious food, attentive staff and quick service. The portions are good and food is hearty and tasty for a good price!

reviews.text: Took my family to Needoo’s in Whitechapel, London. The restaurant is a short walking distance from Whitechapel railway station and is accessible by bus. There are a number of bus stops scattered around. On entering you will notice the bright lights and the red colour scheme interior-reminiscent of the 1970s disco era. We were welcomed by one of the wonderful staff member and taken to our table. We ordered, king prawn biriyani, king prawn karahi, chicken biriyani, kebab roll, Dahl mash, chana dahl and chicken karahi, half chicken and chips, naan, fried fish and mango lassi. We were given popadoms without ordering them and were charged for them. Beware they are not complimentary dishes. The food was good but a little on the spicy side. Both biriyani’s were okay but they weren’t proper biriyani - they were pilau rice mixed in a lot of sauce. The king prawn curry was excellent and so was the kebab roll and dahl mash. The fried fish were 4 tiny portions of fish in a large pile of fried onions. A bit disappointed by this. Overall, it was a lovely experience. The food is on the pricier side so bear that in mind. Our server Usama made our day even better by being a great host and patient whilst taking our orders. We were served with complimentary Zarda (sweet rice) at the end. My mum, nephew and I enjoyed the food the most and will be visiting them again. Thank you Needoo and Usama for a wonderful experience.

We had an amazing experience at Needo’s and the food did not disappoint. For starters, we ordered kebabs and samosas – both were fresh, full of flavour, and set the tone for the meal perfectly. The crispy samosas paired with the tender, spiced kebabs were a great beginning.

For mains, we went with the Dry Lamb Bhuna and Daal. The lamb was beautifully cooked, rich with spices, and packed with flavour, while the daal was comforting and hearty – exactly what you’d want alongside a meat dish.

The real star of the evening, however, was the Lamb Chops. Perfectly marinated, juicy, and grilled to perfection, they were without a doubt the highlight of the entire meal – smoky, tender, and bursting with flavour. Easily the best item we tried, and highly recommended to anyone visiting.

The service was warm and welcoming, and the sizzling platters added to the lively dining experience. Overall, Needo’s delivered on both taste and atmosphere – a must-visit for anyone craving authentic, flavourful South Asian food.

Ali bhai (owner) please look at this review. Service is poor food quality has gone down Curry doesn’t taste like authentic Pakistani cuisine anymore.

We ordered mix grill the lamb chop chewy and robbery. Not Fresh felt like preheated and topped with sauce when I tried telling the waiters they were giving us dirty look and they run away, instead of giving us dirty look, they should’ve rectified the problem or maybe give a feedback to other members.

When we complained, they gave us two replacement lamb chops which was fresh and nice and tasted good, so therefore it can be done but they’re choosing not to do.
Try to understand I don’t mind paying extra if the food quality. Mix grilled with small shish kebab and no meat piece anymore. You’re charging £22 and the quality isn’t there.

Please provide good service and good quality food. I’ve been going into Needo since opening I could tell the quality has for sure gone down and the service bad. I’m a Bangladeshi and I am sorry to say this “workers you have which are mainly Bangladeshi they have no customer skills”

For two of us paid £50 didn’t enjoy food at all. Sorry I am leave review like this it just so improvement can be made.
Visited 13/10/25 @ 10pm

Not great. The restaurant was quite dirty as was my glass! The music was extremely loud. The lamb chops were nice but the tikka lacked flavour. Service was unfriendly. Tayyabs round the corner was much better who also give you salad and dips by default.

Visited with my guests from Manchester (Bolton) here based on a recommendation. I assumed we get 20 percent discount however due to some misunderstanding that couldn't be applied. I massive Good Will gesture was given where tea and desserts were on the house. The food overall was very nice. Definitely would come again. Thank you to Ali bhai who was quick to help us get settled in with 2 buggies. Food came lovely and hot within 15 mins. All starters and mains where served quick. I can't fault the staff or food. Family place to sit and dine. My only concern was the downstairs toilets, they could do with a clean. Upstair toilets were fine. Nappy changing facilities available upstairs toilets too. Pretty cool I say

venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
We had our friend's baby shower for 20 here, and it was a lovely experience.

The private room space was nice with very cute 'green' wall, decor was tasteful and space did not feel cramped. Staff were nice and friendly.

Food was tasteful and good portions. Came out warm and decorated nicely. The service for dessert was a bit slow, and the menu did not include all options (juice and coffee not on main menu) but staff were accommodating.

This place is part of Hyatt hotel but we did not stay to have lunch here. Note there is a separate venue hire of £200.
Part of a Hyatt Hotel. Food and Drinks were ok but nothing special or extraordinary. You can eat there but there are definitely better italien restaurants in the area and in town.

We are currently staying at the Hyatt Place. The food in both Sotto Cucina Bar and Pocket Square is remarkable. Fresh ingredients, attention to detail and the flavours are beautiful.

All the staff are attentive and helpful. Our breakfast beauty Daniel is genuinely one of the loveliest people we have ever met. Such a flair for hospitality and clearly loves what he does. We really felt it should be recognised. Thank you Daniel for making our morning memorable and for the amazing service and smiles!

Highly recommend a stay here and you will not be disappointed with the choice of food and the excellent customer service.

Service in London has diminished so much since brexit, not here the team are so helpful, positive, funny and knowledgeable. Food was far better than expected, wine list is limited but expertly chosen, I’ve just ordered two cases of the montepulciano, very good.
We enjoyed the cured meat, just one saucisson, looked unappealing but was very tasty, anchovies good too.
Mains, cod cheeks were excellent, super hot and crispy and the chilli in the broccoli was perfect.
Sirloin came over cooked to our liking but there was no issue getting it replaced, and it was worth it, very good.
Chocolate chilli tart was lovely.
Strange place to have in the Hyatt hotel, but we will definitely be returning to try more of the menu. Great food, excellent staff

Excellent service and delicious food! A hidden gem located on the lower ground floor of Hyatt Hotel. We went on a Friday night and it was not too busy, nice atmosphere. We went during The Fork Festival so we had 50% off food which was amazing value. Spent £83 between 3 of us including a bottle of wine and orange juice.

reviews.text:
Delicious buffet. Great service.
Here is what I ate (see pictures).
Staff was friendly. One water bottle (or pop) was included in the buffet. Cost was £16 in 2025. Bangladeshi style food.

Very nice food, tandoori chicken and paratha and kebaab and roti. Food was hot and came quick, with sauce as well. Staff are friendly and there is plenty of space. I would recommend ordering from the menu over the buffet and choose what you want from the menu.

If you like bones in your curry then this is your kind of buffet but not mine,not a very big selection of food but what you do get has bones in it,the taste of the food was ok but I have had better for less money..for me £15.99 was expensive…

This is the best buffet. There's more food than what I'm showing in the picture. Food was the best! How can anyone leave angry, they'll only come hungry and leave happy.
Im so full, taste of Bangladesh! When it comes to the buffet you have to be full, this buffet didn’t disappoint!

Visited the place on the recommendation of one of my friends and must say for £15.99, the buffet is actually pretty decent. I was just disappointed with the lack of dessert and starter options in the place. The food options were also not that many and surprisingly, it was just one drink person. The staff was too polite and helpful and it was really nice interacting with them. I think there’s definitely room for improvement in what they bring out from the kitchen and the dessert section needs to be expanded for sure.

reviews.text:
The worst chicken burger I’ve ever had. this place needs to shut down!

I ordered a chicken burger meal and honestly, it was the worst burger I’ve ever had. The chicken was literally raw inside completely unsafe to eat. The burger itself was tiny, looked like something from a kid’s menu, and had zero flavour. I wouldn’t even feed this to a stray cat.

And don’t even get me started on the customer service absolutely useless. Rude staff, no manners, and they clearly don’t care. I ordered 5 meals and they gave just ONE sauce. When I asked for more, they acted like I was being difficult. No apology, no professionalism.

This place is a health hazard, and I genuinely don’t know how they’re still allowed to operate. It needs to be shut down immediately. Never going back, and I’d warn anyone thinking of eating here just don’t.
The wings size too small. They provide the middle part of wings not normal wings. They don’t accept card now.

The biryani was OK, for £3 you get what you pay for, although the beef was very tough.

The fried chicken was dry and bland, avoid.
Food was terrible. Burnt chicken burger. Taste rubbery and small piece of chicken.

To anyone reading this, PLEASE avoid this place. It is truly disgusting. Before I get to the food, the shop is extremely dirty wherever your eyes land on. There is years of build up on every surface and the place looks stuck in the 90s. You can see into the kitchen area which looks like biohazard. There is brown gunk absolutely everywhere and the cooking surfaces are dirty. The staff are rude and very dismissive. The food tastes awful and the chicken can’t even be real. Very rubbery and smells off. The people running this shop need to consider closing down for the of Allah as this can’t even be considered Halal at this point!

reviews.text: I was very disappointed with my recent order. The curries were served cold and lacked freshness. The dal tasted flat, while the other curry had an overpowering tangy taste that made it unpleasant to eat. For the price, I expected hot, flavorful, and properly prepared food, but this was far below standard. Definitely not worth repeating.

I'm disappointed to say that the quality of the food seems to have significantly declined. My recent order, particularly the fried chicken, was quite poor. The coating was crumbly and the overall impression was that the standard I've come to expect is no longer there.
I recommend lamb biryani. It was super delicious, with well seasoned aromatic rice, tender and flavourful meat👍 the portion is big and comes with an optional veggie curry or lentils soup

It's totally cheating. Today I took bhuna lamb & chiken .I got 2/3 piece lamb and 2/3 piece chiken.
Food quality was also very bad.
I suggest every one try to take order in spice hut.

Absolutely revolting.

Got home and opened the bag to find chips covered in a visible, greasy slime not just soggy but coated in some kind of congealed gelatinous muck. It was stomach turning. No crisp, no seasoning just wet slimy filth.

The guy at the counter barely gave any sauce, and what little he handed over was just as disgusting. Complete waste of money.

venues.name: The Munch
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the trendy surroundings of Hackney, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: This place was across the street from our hotel (One Hundred Shoreditch) and it did not disappoint. Greeted with a friendly staff and a warm smile by all. The lamb doner kebab was delicious and the cheesy fries were a great add. Def check this spot out if you’re in the area!

I really enjoyed my lunch stop at The Munch. My lamb doner wrap was fresh and extremely tasty, and it came out quickly. The place was spotless, and the staff were fun and helpful. A solid choice whether you want to sit down for a quick meal or take it to go — note, there's additional seating upstairs.

Very nice to have a proper döner! Well seasoned and very succulent. The adana is nice too and portions are very good for the price point.
Staff are friendly and attentive. Lemon drink was nice although a little pricey imo.

Great service, Great Atmosphere, Great Food!
If you want healthy, cheap, fast authentic Turkish food this is the place to go to.
I ordered the lamb shish, with rice and all the vegetables. It was succulent and severed very quickly. 10/10

The Munch delivers tasty, well-prepared food in a casual and welcoming setting. We tried the lamb doner and chicken doner both were fresh, tender, and full of flavour. The portions were generous and satisfying. The staff, who were Pathan, were exceptionally polite and hospitable, adding a warm, personal touch to the experience. A great spot for a quick, delicious meal with excellent service.

venues.name: Liverpool Street Chop House & Tavern
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Wonderful time at Chophouse

Had dinner at Chop House the other night. Wanted a quiet evening, planning my business and treating myself with some great food and it turned out to be so much more. The place was busy with good ambient vibes perfect for me. I had an absolutely amazing lady looking after me, Zsuzsanna, one of the managers. She was very pleasant with an extensive knowledge about the food menu and also about the drinks. Nothing was too much trouble to her and I could even choose one of their special steak knives for my main course which came with a fascinating story. The quality and presentation of the food was absolutely amazing. It's been a long time that I was impressed as much as I was with this place. Even the manager Martin came to my table for a friendly chat to check on me and to make sure I have an excellent time and thanks to all these personal touches, I had one of my best dining experiences in London.
Thank you for all the Chop House staff for making my evening so special, will be back soon. Fabulous time

I can not rate this restaurant highly enough, the atmosphere is lovely, the staff are incredible and so attentive especially our waiter last night Ali, he went above and beyond complete with talking us through the meat cabinet that he brought to our table and even down to the knives to use for our meats we chose. And now for the food it was incredible from start to finish the melted butter and bread, starters and the chateaubriand and pork chop along with sides to finish off with sticky toffee pudding. Over all absolutely incredible. Thank you for an incredible experience and fantastic food.
Victoria Gibson

Had such a great meal here. The food is simple and classic but done so well. Stand out dishes for me were the Beef & Bone Marrow Crumpet, Lamb Chop and surprisingly the Pea Soope which was a recipe from 1600’s 🤯 Loved it and will be back!

This place is absolutely incredible in so many ways. Firstly, the service from everyone was fantastic with a special mention to Karim who was so friendly - he couldn’t do enough for us. Secondly, the food. Honestly the best steak that we’ve ever had. Cooked to perfection and seasoned beautifully. Finally the menu, there is such a wide choice to choose from, all of which was incredible. We will be back for sure.

Great food, unfortunately dessert took a while to come out. We ordered a selection of steaks, including lamb and pork chops. These were excellent, some of the best I’ve had. The rib eye on the bone was particular great. However they then took an hour to bring out dessert, for which they apologised and gave us a credit on the bill. It was a business dinner though so good food promptly would have been preferred. It was unclear why it took so long.

venues.name: Polo Bar - 24 Hour Great British Cafe
venues.description: Where traditional pub fare gets a gourmet makeover - comfort food elevated to art. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: My party of 7 kids included all enjoyed our food. So much we returned twice in four days! Great 2 for 1 deal! Don’t hesitate, live vibe and good food.

Disappointing experience overall. I was required to pay before receiving my food, which already set a strange tone. I ordered the "Breakfast Club Sandwich," but it arrived without the egg, the literal first ingredient. I pointed this out to the waiter, who offered no acknowledgment. After waiting several minutes with no resolution, I requested a refund. I was then told the egg was on the bottom half of the sandwich—what I found instead was just bacon and cheese. Still no egg. Finally they acknowledged it.

The seating area was quite small and uncomfortably warm, which made the experience feel cramped and unpleasant. On a positive note, the drinks were good, and the chicken tenders were decent.

Whenever myself and my partner visit London we like to stop at the Polo Bar, this was the best experience by far all due to Athena! My partner is disabled and uses a walking aid we had finished our food and were paying, however the heavens opened when we were nattering with Athena she took one look at us and said you're not going out in that, she sat us in our own area away from the other tables, my partner is very self conscious of the walking aid and I’ve never seen her look quite so comfortable, thank you Athena for making the difference, making someone feel normal and being fabulous if we could rate higher, we would! The food was great but the service made the experience 100 x better
The interior is stylish! It's a nice place where you can feel at ease. The hot dogs are the best! The bread and sausages are delicious! Recommended🌭

Food was good, I quite liked their hot dogs and the cocktails were okay. I got an espresso negroni which was good but slightly too sweet for my test.

Overall a great spot to meet people and refresh in a busy night.

venues.name: Eggslut Liverpool Street
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I visited Eggslut at Boxhall Liverpool Street fairly early on a weekday (around 9:15am), and it was nice and quiet at that time. The food was freshly made, so there was a short wait, but everything came out hot and well-prepared.

The hashbrowns were easily a 10/10 - perfectly crispy and delicious, though a little over-salted for my taste. The egg and sausage roll was excellent too: soft, cushiony brioche with perfectly cooked filling that made for a really satisfying bite.

Overall, a brilliant breakfast spot and one I’d happily come back over & over.

What a superb find. The egg and bacon muffin was amazing. Bacon was nicely done, a little crispy, but not incinerated. Egg was cooked perfectly. Service was friendly.

Considering how much the fast joints have put their prices up recently, it was well worth paying that little extra for some decent food.

Saw this place on TikTok and had to try it out. The food was so delicious! We really loved the soft buns and the hashbrowns were also so yummy! The person at the counter was also very helpful and friendly. Next time we're back in London we'll stop here again for sure.

My husband has been making the Fairfax at home in the States, but I got to try it from the source in the UK. Absolutely delicious. Pictures don’t do the flavor justice! You can’t feel how soft the bun is and how creamy the fresh eggs are. Must have for any meal.

Wow… The food was absolutely incredible! I had the pork romesco sandwich, and it was paired with the most delicious hashbrowns I’ve ever had. The service from CJ was so friendly and genuine. It was a heavenly combination together with Blueberry Matcha . I highly recommend it - it’s a must-try!

venues.name: Eastway Brasserie
venues.description: Where French technique meets London innovation - classic dishes with contemporary flair. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Had breakfast here for few days. Loved the foods, coffee, everything and the famous bagel from Beigel Bake Brick Lane is here too! Everyone was so nice, attentive and friendly. Always feels welcomed. Thanks again to Karim for the lovely service.

During my time in London, many beautiful mornings and memorable dinners were spent at Eastway. The food was delicious, and the service—especially from Joe—made me feel truly at home. His kindness and attention created a warm, comforting atmosphere. I hope to return someday.

Despite the friendly staff and beautiful location, I found the breakfast rather unappetizing. My wife and daughter had the brioche French toast, and I had the bacon pancakes. The brioche was fine, but the pancake was so dry it literally fell apart - not in a good way - while cutting it and kept falling off my fork because even small cut pieces broke off.  After I pointed this out to the staff, they offered me extra jam and added the suggestion: "Use a bit more syrup."
All in all, I don't consider this worth 57 GBP in total.
(It looks delicious in the photo, but unfortunately the reality was different..)

When my parents were visiting from California, we came here for lunch on a Friday and were served by Rosalie and Ali. Rosalie was especially lovely—so welcoming, cheerful, and attentive. She took the time to explain the menu and really made us feel at home, which made the experience even more special.

We’ve also visited for afternoon tea and were served by Carlton, who provided equally outstanding service—friendly, warm, and professional.

On both visits, we left full and happy. The cakes and sandwiches were delicious, and the overall atmosphere was relaxed and inviting. Can’t recommend this place enough—looking forward to coming back!

One of the best buffets I've experienced, the quality was great, they even have fresh juice and smoothies.  Ginger shots and cookie press juices are a huge plus.  The staff could be a bit more attentive and management seems unbothered but overall a great place to visit.  Good quality foods overall

venues.name: Lucky Cat by Gordon Ramsay - Bishopsgate
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: The food was superb. We went with the £80 per person sharing menu. My personal favourites were the fish and chicken. There was plenty of food, we took some home. The service was rushed, and we had to tell the server not to remove dishes from the table on several occasions. The views are phenomenal!
Had a great dinner to celebrate the last day of our trip. The food and views are impeccable. Our waiter Yasin was very attentive and provided great service. Would definitely recommend!

The views from the Building are breath taking. The service was fast and well served. The food quality was excellent and also the food presentation.
We went there for a Birthday party of my friend.
Would definitely recommend specially for Dates and romantic vibes.
A must go to for celebrating special occasions.

My daughter and her boyfriend visited us in London, and of course Lucky Cat at Bishopsgate is the must go place. With perfect service as always from the staff, the best view and food in London, it’s a safe bet that it will be an unforgettable evening. We were lucky having Andres as our waiter who made it even more unforgettable, always willing to take photos and videos and sharing his knowledge about the food and the drinks.
We started with the must have Zanmai sushi platter, the Wagyu maki is out of this world. The next on the menu was the Tempura and dumplings where I want to make a shoutout for the mushroom tempura and especially the sauce that is a true sensation. For meat we had the Spiced Lamb, Ribeye and the Iberico Pork. Everything of course top notch, but the pork was the the one that positively surprised us the most.
For signature cocktails, don’t miss the Lemongrass Cha, it’s a masterpiece.
Can’t wait to be back soon again!

✨ Incredible views, delicious food & unforgettable hospitality

Dining with a view of Tower Bridge sparkling at night was magical. The food was flavorful, fun to share, and beautifully presented. Each dish brought something unique to the table – from tender meats to crispy bites and vibrant cocktails.

A huge thank you to  Ali, who went above and beyond to make sure we had the perfect evening. His hospitality made everything even more special.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy great food and drinks with one of the best views in London. 🌃🍽️🍸

venues.name: Yauatcha City
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Yauatcha City is tucked away in Broadgate Circle, and while the entrance can be a little tricky to find, the location itself is excellent, it is right in the heart of a vibrant, corporate hub. The restaurant’s layout is slightly awkward, however, with the bathrooms tucked away in a far corner, but this is a minor inconvenience.

The atmosphere inside is lovely, and the staff were attentive and helpful with their recommendations. The food was excellent (the Singapore Noodles and Kung Pow Chicken were particular highlights). The desserts were just as impressive; the Hazelnut Praline was especially delicious.

Overall, a fantastic dining experience. I would definitely recommend it.

Unlimited dim sum here is worth popping in for. Not too bad value if you’re particularly hungry and know you’re gonna do a few rounds.

Variety is less than what it used to be when they first launched their dim sum brunch though, so for those returning they may notice that.

Quality is still there, with everything being freshly made as and when you order. All the dim sum tasted fresh, delicious and had just enough seasoning to highlight the ingredients. Especially the seafood dumplings.

Service is also good and I feel the multiple staff looking after you genuinely want you to feel well catered for.

Drinks get expensive though. A bottle of water for the table is pricey as are all the soft drinks. Think I spent the equivalent of a brunch on the drinks alone.

I’d still return as I like the food, unlimited dumplings and the location. Definitely worth trying at least once.

I visited with a group of colleagues for Friday lunch. Thanks to people working from home the place was fairly empty and we got very good service and food was served promptly. Some of our group shared a duck and I had the vegan mapo tofu dish with the jasmine rice and the green beans and both were very tasty. I also had the orange juice which I wouldn’t recommend. Quite expensive as well so as someone who isn’t particularly fond of Chinese food I would give it a miss.

I wanted to go here for a very long time, but we hadn’t had a chance to. I’ve seen this restaurant for many years and for the first time I did the booking. This was simply because my boyfriend has been so busy with work etc and given the fact that I was now officially his girlfriend (this was our first date in London now being his girlfriend),  I wanted to take the reins a tiny bit and at least book the restaurant. 😄

I did love the decor here, there was a nice atmosphere but it was very busy.  It was airy and tranquil as you walked up the stairs. I thought the orchids with the incense was a lovely touch. As we we got upstairs, we were not taken to our table straight away as our table was not ready which I found a bit odd considering it was booked. We had to wait 10 minutes even though arrived on time a d I was told on the reservation that we would only have the table for two hours. Meanwhile, In the meantime, we ordered a drink and we were enjoying the view overlooking Broadgate circle. We were then taken to our table and given our menus. I was shocked at my boyfriend’s  menu for his gluten-free options as he had he didn’t have much choice which was a real shame. However, the options he did have I actually thought sounded delicious and something that I would’ve ordered for myself. I ordered a mocktail and my boyfriend had his wine.

They were extremely busy so it took them a while to get to us, that would be my only criticism. We ordered our starters of prawn crackers which were really nice. The prawn crackers were lovely and I then went for the Kung Po chicken and my bf went for the steamed prawns which I actually did have my eye on. I would’ve ordered that for myself! He ordered the egg fried rice which we shared. Our waiter was really helpful as recommended one rice to share between us and that would be plenty for both of us. I also ordered a side salad of cucumber which was really nice. I was really impressed with the food though. My kung po chicken was fantastic. I tried some of my boyfriend‘s chilli steamed prawns which tasted fantastic. They were really tasty and if I were to go back there again that is exactly what I would order.

As I looked at the dessert menu, the desserts did look really good and but my boyfriend could only have ice cream.

I was pleasantly surprised that they did a birthday decoration plate for me because it was my birthday the following week (in a few days time) but I was actually really impressed with the fact that they did that and it added a lovely touch. My chocolate raspberry mousse dessert was fabulous.

I was very aware of the time because I  needed to get my train as I didn’t drive into London on this occasion so the end was a bit rushed which was a shame.

But we had a really lovely evening and I would return for sure. The food was of a high standard and I loved the decor, surroundings and atmosphere. I’d go back for the atmosphere and I would order the chilli steamed prawns for myself next time with steamed jasmine rice.

It was a very hot night in London and busy around Broadgate Circle but I really loved the atmosphere and the vibe; The scenery and the decor were stunning.😍 💕

Yauatcha still has some of the best Chinese / Asian food in London. I have been to both their branches many times over the last 12+ years and have never been disappointed.

At my latest visit in January 2025, we started with Scallop Shui Mai, Seafood Dumpling, Edamame Wakame Puff, Soft-crab Bun, and my two all-time favourites and must-haves: Prawn Toast and Prawn & Beancurd Cheung Fun. For the mains, we had Steamed Chilean Seabass, Stir Fry Scallop & Prawn and Egg Fried Rice.

While everything tasted great, the Steamed Chilean Seabass was completely out of this world and worth its price tag (£48). My only complaint for Yauatcha is that their Egg Fried Rice has never been as good since they changed their recipe a few years ago, and I'm never genuinely happy with it now.

The service was attentive, polite and friendly. We had Viktoriia take care of us and she was very good.

The restaurant is nice and warm in the cold winter months despite full glass walls overlooking Broadgate Circle. But they seem to have built their toilets in the tundra - no heating, blisteringly cold water, and even the hand dryers blow out freezing air. This, weirdly, was the only off-putting thing in the entire experience!

venues.name: The Drift
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I have been coming to the drift for years and it never disappoints! Duck & waffle and Sushisamba get all the attention being on the top floor of the building, but people forget about this hidden gem on the ground floor! Food is always delicious, service is always great and the music & vibes are excellent.
I took my best friend for bottomless brunch and we loved it. I really liked that they had bottomless aperol spritz as an option. The service was great and they even gave us a complimentary dessert with “Congratulations” written on it because we were celebrating my friend’s engagement.
We stayed after brunch for extra drinks in the bar area and Gustavo made sure we were looked after, recommending loads of lovely cocktails to us!
I will definitely be back, and I’d highly recommend The Drift for your next lunch, brunch, dinner or /special occasion!

My friend and I stayed across the street at the Pan Pacific and stopped in for a cocktail after we had checked out, after saying for days we would stop in. The vibes here are amazing, and the drinks and food were delicious. We got the Garden Spritz and duck baos and they did not disappoint. Shoutout to Yovani for the great service as well!
Highly recommend this bar. Lovely outdoor area and the tall guy behind the bar had great customer service. Perfect for girls drinks in the city!
Love it here! The bottomless brunch was amazing atmosphere with great music. Moni was our server and was amazing, couldn’t ask for better service! Overall recommend!

Delicious cocktails and nice vibes. My friends booked an area upstairs  here for their engagement party and it went great. I especially liked the new york sour. The cocktails weren't outrageously expensive for central london, around £13 each. We also ate a few nibbles which were good.

venues.name: The Ivy City Garden
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: My wife and I stopped in for lunch on s Saturday... The overall ambiance was nice, but it was fairly busy and loud.  There was no wait and we we r e seated right away.  The service started well, but deteriorated quickly.  Our order was taken, but we surmise that we only wanted water to drink, that we weren't worth their time.  The food arrived in a reasonable time. That was the last we saw of the waitress  I had their Shepard's pie and my wife had a Burger.  Everything was prepared well and tasty, but in my case, just too little portioned.i am not a big eater. But I have to admit that I was still hungry.  For the price. I would have expected a little more.  ($60 is pretty steep for what we ordered... no drinks, or desserts.)

Exceptional meal, exceptional service!

We booked a table for a birthday celebration and what a wonderful night we had. Our server, Madhi, was attentive and polite, he made sure we had everything we needed, kept our drinks topped up without asking and provided a quick, efficient service all night. The food was delicious! Everything presented well, at a good speed & hot & tasty. The birrhday profiterole with candle was much appreciated and topped the night off. We can not fault our night and look forward to dining with you again in December

I recently visited The Ivy City Garden and had a lovely experience overall. The atmosphere is beautiful and the service was warm and attentive. The food was absolutely delicious.

I had the calamari for my starter and the fillet of fish for my main, and both were cooked perfectly and full of flavour.

The only downside was the drinks — while they were nice, I found them quite overpriced, which made the final bill higher than I expected. Apart from that, I can’t fault it. I’d definitely recommend The Ivy City Garden for a special meal, just be mindful that the drinks can add up!

Besides the food being a tad bit dry… the decor ambience & treatment in the Ivy was astounding. I was beyond happy with how bubbly and courteous the staff were. Just ensure you order the right items for happiness in every aspect

Perfect spot for a celebration lunch near Liverpool Street – attentive staff, excellent food, and even allowed us to decorate the table and have our own cake presented beautifully.

We visited The Ivy City Garden to celebrate a university graduation, and it didn’t disappoint. I started with the Duck Salad, light yet packed with flavour, followed by The Ivy Steak and Chips with peppercorn sauce, plus Creamed Spinach and Creamed Mashed Potato. Everything was cooked perfectly, presented beautifully, and portion sizes were spot on.

Drinks were just as impressive – a Rhubarb Negroni, fresh grapefruit juice, and a pot of coffee with cream to finish. A small slip meant sugar wasn’t offered with the coffee, and there was a brief mix-up with drinks, but staff handled it brilliantly, apologising and removing the items from the bill – a professional touch that left a great impression.

The Ivy were also happy to let us add our own sprinkles and personalised cookies to the table for the occasion, and they presented our cake wonderfully (note: outside food can’t be eaten on-site, likely for health reasons).

Stylish décor, lively atmosphere, attentive service, and high-quality food make this an ideal celebration spot in central London. Highly recommend and will happily return.
#LondonDining #LiverpoolStreetRestaurants #TheIvyExperience

venues.name: Luca Dsq.
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Every time my family and I travel, we’re lucky enough to be served by Tina and she never fails to impress. She’s warm, professional, and genuinely attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we board. What stands out most is how well she knows her job she is

knowledgeable about the food and service, always ready with helpful recommendations, and remembers our preferences without us even asking. Her combination of expertise, efficiency, and personal care turns a simple journey into an enjoyable experience. Tina is a credit to her team and a big reason we always look forward to experience here.

Had dinner with work colleagues.
I would say it's ok. The food wasn't bad but it was a mixed bag, the steak was good but had an interesting butter in it and nothing encouraging me to return. The risotto looked more like soup but tasted ok. The pasta was a relatively small portion.

The staff were friendly, the atmosphere pleasant and inviting, and the wine good.

Don't regret going, but equally not eager to return.

Discover by recommendation  📍
was a memorable experience. 🤍
We started with delicious burrata and arancini, which set the tone for the evening. The highlight was the steak with some sides that was more than enough with 1 kg , juicy and cooked to perfection. The staff, especially Sam and Tina, provided attentive service in a warm and inviting atmosphere.
I highly recommend Luca Cafe for special occasions, conveniently located
near Enoteca da Luca.
This will be my place for steak from now on 🥹
Love it, definitely I will come back ✨

We came to Luca after trying to go to the Humble Grape down the road but we had booked the Fleet St branch by mistake.  That was our downfall.

Service was excellent.
But the food was well below average.  We have still not got over a bill of £173 for 3 of us for 2 starters, 3 mains, 2 cocktails, one wine and one soft drink. Very much a big waste of money for such a poor meal.
The arancini came and the rice was raw so it felt like chewing grit.  We complained to the wonderful waitress and she took it away and asked if we wanted to order something else. We ordered the calamari which was fine but the dip was so sweet. We get calamari a lot and this dip was definitely wrong!
I had the chicken schwarma and it was sweet too!  My daughter had the steak plus a side of broccoli but this was on a bed of puree which was so sweet too! So most of this £8 side dish got left.

The waitress was good enough to confirm back to us that the arancini rice was raw and said that the chef was new. Maybe this chef also loves to put sugar in all the dishes.

It was one of those meals where you have complained once and then all the other problems don't feel bad enough to complain about because the food is still edible, but you then leave with a bad taste in your mouth.

A cosy and pleasant atmosphere, with friendly staff who pay attention to every detail, making you feel great about being there. However, what is truly special is the food. The authentic menu clearly reflects the chef's experiences and adventures, combining ingredients from all over the world to create dishes that are true explosions of flavour—not something you can find just anywhere. The care taken with the presentation also makes the whole experience unforgettable. Every bite will leave you speechless. I will keep coming back and can't wait to be surprised by next season's menu. Definitely one of my favourite restaurants in London.

venues.name: Eataly London
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Oh my goodness, it was such a lovely late dinner! The food was absolutely fantastic, and the Italian hospitality was simply divine. The menu was so tempting, with so many delicious options that it was hard to decide what to order.

What an incredible place this is! The first thing that caught my attention, was the sheer size of it. The building is absolutely massive.

There are many types of Italian products for sale, and several places to eat and drink too, including outdoor dining areas.

The shop is really spacious, which makes it easy to browse. The food is all displayed in a very visually-appealing way too. There are lots of fresh food counters, and the food looks and smells amazing.
There are plenty of staff around, and they are friendly and happy to help.

The shop is priced at the higher end, but I didn't mind too much because I found all kinds of products which I would struggle to find outside of Italy. I really enjoyed it in here and can't wait to go back!

My first time in this expansive space over a number of floors. We chose the least busy restaurant with a small but varied menu...Terra.

Huge windows with big sky views (sunny mostly) and comfortable seating.

My main course seemed on the smallish side but my friend's starter was enormous.

Roamed the Italian supermarket afterwards, which offers nice browsing.

Eataly London is definitely a must-visit, especially for anyone who loves Italy and the cuisine of this region. The staff is very friendly, the store is clean and well-organized and it’s absolutely worth a visit - especially if you’ve never been to Eataly before because it’s simply beautiful! During my next trip to London, I’ll definitely come back and visit Eataly again. You’ll find a wide selection of food and authentic Italian products here.

I’ve visited Italian shops in New York and Paris before, but this was my first time in London. Being right next to Liverpool Street Station made it very convenient, and the place was bigger and more pleasant than I expected. The toilets were cleaner than anticipated, and what really surprised me was the huge selection of alcohol.

There were several times more organic wines than what I’d seen in France, so from now on, I’ll come here when I want to buy wine – I’d definitely recommend it.

One disappointment was that I wanted to buy truffles, but there were no whole truffles – only oils, salts, and other truffle-flavoured items, mostly cheap truffle additives.

On the other hand, there was a huge range of pasta and ingredients, and the canvas bags looked sturdy and affordable. Just don’t buy on impulse, and enjoy your shopping!

reviews.text: The atmosphere was great as soon as we walked in, good music and people were up dancing and singing. Our table wasn't ready for when we arrived as the group sat there were previously told they'd have to move for the next booking but they hadn't. The staff quickly tidied and cleaned the table and area while we sat on some seats next to it. The drinks service was really quick and our waiter kept coming back to make sure we were topped up with drinks. The food was delicious however one person in the group said the portion sizes of the birdcages sharers weren't big enough as that was our dinner. The DJ had us up dancing the night away with some throwback songs. Thanks for a great night, the bride to be really enjoyed herself!

What a delightful find this air-conditioned cocktail bar was. I took advantage of their Happy Hour and had an old fashioned for £7 (usually £11.80). Happy hour runs till 8pm weekdays, till 5pm Saturdays and all day Sunday. This is in a great location opposite Liverpool Street station. It is a basement bar which has plenty of seating. For the less mobile there is a lift to take you down to the bar. I enjoyed sharing my love of whisky with the barman, the service was excellent. They do sell bar snacks. My only niggle was that the music was a little on the loud side. T

We went for bottomless brunch and honestly such a great time! The drink options were PERFECT. Oh the service was 10/10. We had such a good experience and Badal was so patient with us! He’s such a good waiter, which isn’t easy with 3 drunk girls. But he was kind and nice to us.

The food is good, the chicken burger and shrimp probably the best out of it all. Could be better with more meat options.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Had an amazing Sunday bottomless brunch here with friends and it was perfect from start to finish. The cocktails were the star of the show – the Pornstar Martini and berry cocktails were both delicious and kept flowing. The brunch menu had plenty of choice, and the vegan options were surprisingly tasty and excellent value for money.

The vibe is beautiful – stylish but relaxed, with a fun atmosphere that’s ideal for groups. Staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure our table was well looked after.

If you’re looking for the best bottomless brunch in Liverpool Street London , this place is a must-visit. Great cocktails, delicious food, and amazing staff – one of the top brunch spots in [City Name] for sure. Highly recommend!

A perfect afternoon at Dirty Martini! We had an amazing service by Ashley, who was so attentive and kind. We had the bottomless brunch and the food was very nice, and the drinks were delicious and always flowing. Definitely worth a visit! ♥️

venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We had the beef lasagna and beef ragu, it is one of the best ones we have ever had! It’s full of flavour, soft and melts in your mouth. I could come here every day for the lasagna, it has a truffle flavour, homemade pasta! We have been twice now and will be coming back! Lovely location and excellent service. Thank you!

This is my second time have been here and I decided to leave a 5 stars review.

The restaurant it’s pretty, really good for special occasions especially and they have friendly staff to serve you the best food. I ordered crab meat ravioli this time, and the sauce was quite unique which add an extra point to the dish. Surprisingly the portion was bigger than I thought !!

I had good food and experience for the both time I went !

Piccolo Exchange is one of those rare places that instantly makes you feel both welcome and intrigued. The food is creative, beautifully presented, and full of flavor this is truly something special.

A real highlight of the evening was the pistachio tuile: paper-thin, nutty, with just the right hint of sweetness and a touch of berry glaze. It’s the kind of thoughtful detail that sums up the whole experience.

Special mention to Fadil our server who made the night even better. Warm, knowledgeable and effortlessly attentive - he brought a personal touch that made us feel genuinely cared for.

Whether you’re there for a cozy dinner or a celebration, Piccolo Exchange offers something memorable. Highly recommended!

What a lovely surprise! My husband and I popped into Piccolino Exchange Square for lunch and ended up having such a beautiful experience. As an Italian, I can be quite picky about food, but everything here was spot on. The ingredients tasted fresh, the flavours reminded me of home, and the whole atmosphere was warm and inviting.

A big shout-out to Mila, our waitress, who made the meal even more special. She was so friendly, professional, and genuinely kind, the kind of service that makes you feel taken care of.

We left with full bellies and big smiles. Can’t wait to come back! 🍝✨

I came here the first time and was served a very salty carbonara that was not to the standard i keep this restaurant at. After making a review about my experience, i was approached by their team in Google and they asked me to give them a second chance, assuring that this was a one-time occurrence.
I had a conversation with the manager over the phone and we agreed on another day.
I went there today and was left nothing but happy.
The carbonara came perfectly salty and it tasted even better with their house wine.
Will definitely be back.

The first picture is from the first time and the second picture from today.

venues.name: Canto Corvino
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Canto Corvino is a great spot! The atmosphere is inviting, and the pasta dishes are delicious, made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. I had the Seared Beef Fillet Carpaccio, Parmesan & Rocket as a starter with Tuscan Sausage Tubetti & Broccoli as a main and I was full to the brim!

They also have a good selection of wines, and the staff can help you find a great pairing.

Overall, it's a sophisticated place that's perfect for a special night out or a memorable meal with friends. Highly recommended.

Had a lovely dinner with friends here. We were sat in a quiet corner table beside the kitchen window, and could see the chefs do their magic.

Food was great, drinks and wine selection abundant… and pricing appropriate for the quality and surroundings etc in the City.

We had a mix of starters (get the arancini), pastas (monkfish spaghetti) and desserts (tiramisu)… and my friends and I had no complaints.

Our waitress (sorry I didn’t catch her name, but our receipt had Toni on there) was so friendly, fun and welcoming. She made the evening even better.

Thanks for a wonderful dinner!

We happened to walk into this place on a Saturday early dinner time. Not only did we receive 50% off cocktails but another 30% off the food.
The cocktail was delicious- a rhub and roll ( a refreshing gin based cocktail) but the food was outstanding. The stand out was the lobster ravioli. Definitely come back again and would highly recommend this place to sample some great food
Lovely restaurant. Delicious food. The aubergine steak was lovely just very small for the price.

Came here for dinner, was quite suprised to see that the resturant wasn’t filled on a Saturday evening.

Nevertheless we enjoyed our experience. Presentation of the food and flavours were great. We ordered artichoke and two fish pastas.

The small portion was decent in size, I would recommend trying the cheesecake!

If you’d prefer somewhere a little more peaceful, would recommend !
