reviews.text: Absolutely amazing food, and lots of it, we were completely stuffed! The staff were very nice and welcoming, and the restaurant had a lovely atmosphere. Great value for money, we will definitely be back.

This family owned restaurant is a gorgeous and peaceful vegan spot.
The food was out of this world, local vegetables cooked to perfection.
The chef and waiter were super friendly without ever being intrusive. We really enjoyed chatting to them. The chef even gave out to give us some cooking tips!
I’d highly recommend a visit to taste their seasonal dinner. Hopefully we will be back again, soon.
Thanks so much!:)

Had a great time at E3, great service and a good range of flavoursome food.

A solid vegan place with a weekend tasting menu.

We had a delicious lunch at E3 Vegan, the food was super fresh, tasty and full of flavour. The quiet, sunny garden is a lovely place to sit and the atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming. The service was excellent - friendly, attentive and knowledgeable. We will definitely be back!

Visited today for Sunday lunch. First impression nice contemporary but comfortably decorated.  Plenty of room between tables. Wide variety of choice on the menu. When food arrived it was well presented and the seasoning was perfect.  Delicious and would highly recommend to everyone even no matter your dietary choice

venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Ross and the team at The Hogless Roast catered for our wedding this year, and they were absolutely brilliant from start to finish. The liaison was really smooth and hassle-free, they made things as easy as possible, liaising with the venue for us so we could completely relax about everything, and all we had to do was choose the delicious food. The team were so lovely, and a real pleasure to have as part of our wedding day - very friendly, helpful, and kind to all our guests. The food was absolutely awesome! So many of our guests commented on it, and a lot for whom vegan food was an uttery alien concept stating it was "the best wedding food ever!" Certainly a lot of minds changed about what they could expect from vegan food, which really made us smile as a vegan couple. And when your guests include some retired animal farmers, an entire fire watch, and a mass of people with multiple different food issues - a huge win full stop! Cannot recommend highly enough, the team and the food were total stars. Just wish we could do it every year!

I had the fries and the Hogless burger. The burger on its own is ideal if you are not really hungry but if you are, better get a side dish. The fries are like smashed potatoes balls, they were really nice. There is plenty of seating, shared with the other food venues. Some of the seating area is covered.

Phwoar, look at this sexy beast! Double vegan cheeseburger with paprika fries.  I got this before watching Knocked Loose at Outbreak festival.

I asked the server if she recommended the double cheeseburger, she said yes but get fries. So being easily led, I did. It was fantastic.  Great service. Great burgers.

Wowowow.
Ordered the Hogless Roast Burger, Smash Burger and the plant based nuggets. 10/10 everything.
The Hogless Roast Burger truly is faultless and incredibly flavoursome- I just wish I had another one.
This is now my new favourite vegan spot. I need to try everything on the menu now.
(I forgot to take a picture of the burgers but had some nuggets left.)

Genuinely incredible food. I had the hogless burger and it is hands-down the best vegan or non-vegan burger I’ve ever had. So moist, rich, juicy and delicious. I also had the beef brisket loaded fries and couldn’t believe how meaty the beef was. One of those moments you have to double-check that it really is vegan! But, rest assured - it is. Thanks for a great experience and I can’t wait to visit again!

venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
FANTASTIC VEGAN PLACE!

The absolute highlights for me were:
1. 15C Bun Cha President- I asked the lovely waiter for a recommendation and he suggested this one. It was superb 10/10!
2. Crispy Pancake- The filling combined with the light, crunchy pancake was incredible. Highly recommend this!
3. Fried Rice (side) I saw a previous review mention how good this was so I had to try it. They were right, it’s super flavoursome- I ate it on its own!
4. Sierra Yogurt Smoothie was my favourite drink of the night. Creamy, refreshing and delicious.

Honestly, everything I tried was great, but these are my must haves! The food is fresh and satisfying, you leave feeling full but not heavy.
I’ll definitely be coming back again and again!

Had an amazing lunch here. All the dishes we had were top notch. Served quickly and with a smile. Love this place.

Recommend the pho and the tofu and lemongrass dish.

Also does a 15% discount at lunchtimes (Mon to Fri).

What a lovely place I stumbled across by chance! Really nice and quiet atmosphere. Very hospitable and great service. The food was great! Great location just around the corner from the Museum of the Home. I was in the area for a week long training session for work and kept going back here for lunch everyday. It was really good Vegan food and gluten is clearly labelled on the menu which is great!

Last Friday night, we were craving Vietnamese food after work and found Sen Viet Vegan Restaurant through a quick Google search. With a high 4.8 rating, we decided to give it a try—without realising at first that it was fully vegan.

Once seated and looking through the menu, we noticed everything was plant-based. We figured it might be a good opportunity to enjoy a lighter meal and do a little detox. We ordered the vegan spring rolls, fried noodles, and a stir-fried vegetable dish. All the dishes were flavourful and well-prepared, and for a vegan restaurant, the taste did not disappoint.

However, shortly after we returned home, we both began feeling extremely thirsty—and that feeling lasted the entire night. This left us concerned that the food may have contained a significant amount of MSG, which was quite disappointing after what initially felt like a healthy, light meal.

While the taste was good and we might have recommended it to friends looking for vegan options, the after-effect changed our minds. Unfortunately, we wouldn’t return due to this experience.

This restaurant is a special place! It is a simple, carefully curated space, which is exactly what I love!
The food was exceptionally good and the staff was so friendly and patient with me. I asked them so many questions and took such a long time deciding what to order and they were nothing but lovely!
In the end I chose a green curry with banana and it was very delicious!
Even the tea I had was really good. On top, the price was less than what I paid in other restaurants!

venues.name: Siddhi Pure Veg Restaurant
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Just a few minutes from East Ham Station, this pure vegetarian South Indian restaurant offers tasty and affordable food. We tried Masala Dosa and Chilli Paneer—service was quick, one dosa wasn’t crispy but the other was perfect, and the condiments were great. The Chilli Paneer was slightly sweet, spicy, and very tasty. Décor is simple and doesn’t quite match the exterior, but the food makes up for it.
Only downside is the toilet, which needs better maintenance. Overall, I’ve visited twice and had a pleasant experience both times.

We had the worst experience .. if v had an option of giving negative review I would be the happiest to do that .. we just had dosas in the name of buffet restaurant .. the sambhar was watery .. no no taste at all .. poori masala looked like besan not potato .. chutney was the only good thing I would have had to drink .. my children were waiting for puris and was as which v never got to even see.. The seats were looking terrible .. plates were all discolored and old .. worst place to ever eat.

We visited Siddhi restaurant for lunch as the menu looked so delicious. We arrived just after 1pm, and this seemed like a popular time to come, but there were still plenty of seats available. We ordered two dosas, one with cashews and the other with paneer and spinach. Both were absolutely delicious, as were the chutneys that accompanied them. My favourite was the coriander. The dosas were extremely filling and a decent price too, the bill came to £13.50. The restaurant is located opposite East Ham station, although we came from Manor Park and took a bus down. We will definitely be going back to try some more of their delicious dosas.

The restaurant is very good and the atmosphere is just so lovely. They serve pure vegetarian dishes and you can find South Indian vibes which I like very much. And Reception Man “Madhu” is very kind, generous, gentleman with a smile he served the foods :) we tried the masala dosa and pani puri.. so good and yammy.

I tried the unlimited breakfast buffet here, and it's fantastic! The options for the price are really great. Madhu recommended what to try, and I loved the paneer. I also tried the afternoon chaat unlimited buffet, which was really good as well. Definitely a must try for vegetarians!"

venues.name: Bubala Spitalfields
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Oh my gosh! AMAZING FOOD. This was an experience. Everything was so, so good certainly a recommendation for any foodie. And if you’re a vegetarian you have hit the jackpot. The orange wine here was also super peachy and a big recommendation to anyone who enjoys orange wine. I would certainly recommend to book a table prior though.

Hands-down the best vegetarian set menu I have had in London. So much variety, nearly everything extremely tasty. Very friendly and caring staff. Strongly recommend to reserve a table and come with a group of 4 as you then get the best mix of both the vegetarian and the vegan set menu. One thing they could improve is the ventilation in the place, which can get quite warm when it's very full.

we had such a lovely evening at Bubala! we had been gifted the set menu for our engagement by a friend and absolutely everything was incredible! they have a vegetarian and a vegan version and they were very accommodating when we asked to swap a dish from the veggie menu for a vegan one! Special thanks to Kat who took care of us so well and even gave us a free glass of champagne each when we mentioned we were celebrating an engagement! we will definitely be back :)

Yum. Annoyingly only the the set menu at £44 per head was available The three of us agreed there was far too much food but we tried to rise to the challenge as everything was delicious. Stand outs for me were the dark cherry salad and the pickles.
The staff were charming. Do go but go hungry! Rose was also good.

I vaguely knew about Bubala, but mostly came in on a whim. And I can honestly say this was the best meal I've had in memory. Every course was delicious, creative, and memorable. And the wine list was excellent and surprisingly affordable. Next time I'm in London, I'll definitely come back.

venues.name: Essential Vegan Cafe
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
A Hackney Wick hangout from DIY party collective The Cause. I love that this cafe is nestled in with other food places, an upstairs bar and a record shop.

I only stopped in for a coffee and cake. I was warmly greeted and ordered the peanut butter caramel latte (it's as good as it sounds) and the mocha cake. 100/10.

Also green flags for being dog friendly. I can't wait to come back for lunch!
Great place with an amazing view to the river. I love their seitan bacon sandwich and matcha latte. Portions are really big and affordable.
Great vegan options. Good to sit on the terrace overlooking Stratford and the Olympic park.
I had the feijoada and a coffee, and both were delicious. Super chilled atmosphere and plenty of indoor and outdoor seating.

I love this local spot with great coffee and pastry options. I haven't tried the brunch and would look forward to trying that in the future.
It's hard to find a great plant-based café so I'm thankful for having this place close-by.
The owner is super friendly, and I love the spacious seating area with good music that's not too loud. Highly recommend.

venues.name: Sangeetha Veg Restaurant Indian
venues.description: Where Indian tradition meets London sophistication - expect fireworks in every bite. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Came to East Ham for dosa, but the place we’d been recommended wasn’t serving it - we walked up the road to find Sangeetha and I’m glad we did!

The dosa itself was incredible - so crispy, and the paneer masala was delicious. The sambar might be the best I’ve ever had too.

Service was very friendly and our food arrived very quickly. The prices are also very cheap for London!

We’ll definitely be back.

The food and vibe was very similar to any Sangeetha in Chennai. The Dosa and chapati kurma were excellent. Mini idli was a bit disappointing. The service could also be better. We had to ask for water, and missing items in our order multiple times as it seemed like they kept forgetting. The prices are very economical!

While I was in various meetings in London, I was looking for the best vegetarian restaurant in East London—and I am so glad I found this place. Tasty, quality food, reasonably priced, a clean and welcoming environment, and excellent table service from the waiter Manoj (I think that was his name). Would strongly recommend if you're in the mood for great vegetarian food! Cheers.

Sangeetha is yet another standout gem in East Ham for anyone craving top-quality South Indian food. The flavours here are bold, authentic, and absolutely satisfying—and the best part is how perfectly priced everything is for the quality you get.

The Gobi Manchurian is hands-down a must-have—crispy, spicy, and packed with flavour. It was the highlight of our meal! We also loved the sambar vada, which was comforting and full of depth. The poori masala was light and delicious, and the ghee roast dosa had that perfect crisp and richness you expect. Even the mango lassi was spot on—refreshing and not overly sweet.

If you’re in East Ham and love South Indian food, this place is a no-brainer. Delicious food, great value, and a menu full of dishes that’ll keep you coming back for more.

Wonderful and cheap food here. Everything is vegetarian and so tasty. The thali has about 9 different dishes and came with rice and roti. The chickpeas were delicious and the puris the size of the table. Plenty of room and have a downstairs as well for private events.

venues.name: Facing Heaven
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Thanks a lot for being so welcoming and nice making the experience of having dinner more enjoyable. We loved the food so much, you can tell is made from fresh ingredients and with love. Tasting and powerful flavours. Also we loved the cocktails! We I’ll be returning for sure.

Such a fantastic place. The whole menu is vegan and the three dishes we tried (cabbage, cauliflower and the Dan Dan noodles) were fantastic. The service was quite quick, and the food was spot on. Very spicy though, so ask about it if you can't handle your spice.
I need to go back to try the other dishes. The rotating menu sounds great to keep the novelty when you visit again.
The place is quite small, so if you don't book be aware that you might not be able to get a seat, or might have to wait a bit.
Loved it! ❤️

This has got to be my current fav Chinese restaurant in London! Excellent food and so much variety. Only downside is that some dishes can be oily but everything was tasty nevertheless.
Recommend the scallion pancake, crispy cauliflower, stir fry cabbage, and dan dan noodles
My new favorite restaurant. The kind of place that can convince even the most stalwart carnivore that vegan food actually tastes good. Eat everything, but especially the sesame toast.

We've had food here twice. It was really good the first time, but this last time the mapo tofu was absolutely swimming in oil which we did find a little unusual and not the best. It might have been us but we did get two dishes on our table and both were like this. The other dishes were good. We had Dan Dan and the Cauliflower; highly recommended.

venues.name: Taste of India Pure Vegetarian LTD
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Very good service by saadik and great food. Everything was fresh and delicious. Must try this place for best South Indian varieties..!!!

This is our favourite resturant in east ham!! We love eating here the food is amazing and the staff too. They always greet us with a smile! Never forget to give lolipops to our kids. We all love it here. The idli is so soft and fresh! The punjabi food is great too!!
Our favourite dishes are gobi manchurian, dal makhani, panner chetinad and garlic naan 👌
Best food  and totally recommend it!!❤️❤️❤️
The food is consistently excellent with rich flavours that never disappoint (the Dosas especially), and the service is always warm and attentive. A spot I’ll happily return to again and again

The Taste of India Pure Vegetarian LTD never disappoints. It’s one of the best,if not the best ,vegetarian Indian restaurants in East Ham and beyond. Whenever we crave Indian food, this is our go-to place. The dishes are authentic, portions are generous, prices are fair, and the menu offers a wide variety of choices.

Absolutely amazing place, always come here with my family and we only have good things to say about this place. The food is clean and tastes amazing. The service here is also good. We ordered food for 5 individuals for only £49, so its definitely worth coming here.

venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Nice little stall. We loved the pani puri.

Authentic Indian food and good value, any dish with the tofu is a must try.

The attention to detail with the sauces was exceptional. We loved the spicing on the mince and tofu, it’s great what’s been done with the fake meats/tofu.

We go to Bricklane nearly every weekend and the tofu wrap is the best dish we have ever tried. Wish this was on Deliveroo!
I can't rate this high enough. Specifically went here today after a friend's recommendation. Friendly, welcoming customer service. And beautifully, flavoursome food. What a gem!

A Gem in Brick Lane Market!!

We had a walk yesterday in Brick Lane Market, my wife and my son.

As we heading to the main road, our eyes have been caught by this little stand "PlanXology"

When I have read it's vegan I was kinda, ok.....I love my meat but I also love trying....

My little one wanted some chips, and I only wanted a hot drink, my wife wanted to try the samosas....

While I was drinking my massala/chai latte, the flavours of the drink really got into my throat....the ginger....the spices ...was all well balanced...

And this is where I said ok,.  Let's try few more.

So we have ordered, the burger,  called Vadapav....my goodness this was sooo delicious once again full of flavour, the bun was tender inside crispy in the outside, not too hot for you to actually devour it like I did as I even forgot to take a pic for this review 😅

The main ingredients I think was potatoes and peas (hope I got this right but feel free to check and taste it as this the main subject). So delicious!!! One of the best burger I have eaten!!!

We have steamed rice with pommegrenates....along with the chickpeas curry for our main....once again ..well balanced flavour, well cooked chickpeas.
You would probably think because the chickpeas curry remains the pot this will be mushy or very weak ..in fact the chickpeas are properly well cooked and the rice...wow! It seems only them can cook the rice like this, all grains were separated none sticky you can count them 1 by 1 if you wanted to😅

The Samosas, packed of delicious spices my wife found it a little too hot but for me it was just perfect👌🏾

And we also bought their take on Carrot Cake. To take away.
This was divine!  The most delicious carrot cake I have eaten by far!
It is sweet yes...but the sweetness isn't coming from the icy sugar you have from a normal carrot cake which feels very heavy.
We have been told to warm it for a minute ...and if we can serve it with a scoop of vanilla ice cream which we did OMG!! This is must!!!

The guy made us taste one of their product which I can't remember the name, it is for what we understood is a starter or "amuse bouche" I will be going back there to buy and make a proper review on this one.

So if you ever go to Brick Lane Market trust me, please do stop by and try whatever you want. From their Massala Tea, or the VadaPad Burger, the curry or the sweets.
Whatever you try, either you are vegan or not, I can guarantee you would love this gem.
We had the best Indian food here! It tastes like the curry’s in India and Sri Lanka, very original, tasty, spiced up so so good! And try the chai, also so so good ☺️

venues.name: Vegan Biosphere (Vegan Buffet)
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: We stumbled across this lovely hidden gem and would highly recommend it! We had a lovely time here, the service was amazing and the owner was very warm and friendly. The food is all delicious. You get served huge portions of delicious vegan food and can request to repeat any dishes you want. 100% worth a visit

Amazing dinner and experience, highly recommend! Every dish was so thoughtful and the host was such a delight to talk to. We especially loved the summer rolls and the grains mix. We left feeling very full and we will definitely be back.

So glad I found this spot! Thank you for the delicious food and kind service. My partner and I miss Vietnam, and you brought us back for a moment! The owner shares the space at Viet Hoa and hopes to open his own place soon, so he needs all the support. Book in advance for week days, or walk in on Sundays. Cannot recommend enough, we will be back 🙏🏼

The food is exceptional and the head chef/host is very warm and welcoming. He puts in the effort to come and speak to you and the food reflects his attention to detail. The portions are very generous, great value for money. Can't recommend this spot enough. Thanks for a wonderful experience!

It's truly a special thing when you go to any restaurant and they become - one of the Defining points of your visit to any one place. Vegan Biosphere is that monumental experience. Rarely have I had such pure *joy* tasting every single plate placed in front of me; and you truly cannot meet a more Wonderful human being than Chef Tuyen. Run. Run to this place.

Beyond it being incredible finding an all vegan buffet(!!), the mastermind behind each dish really brought back that intimacy missing from so many restaurants today. Each course was a conversation; it was a link to Tuyen's homeland, his history, his journey -- and you could feel the passion and genuine interest as he watched you take that first bite or asked how it was. It's the kind of curated dining you'd pay an Obscenely large amount for -- offered for an extremely modest sum. Even after I ate (and I genuinely wished I had more stomachs so I could keep eating - Everything), Tuyen didn't rush me out; we ended up having an incredible conversation on what led us both to veganism and where we wanted to go from here.
I will never forget my evening at Vegan Biosphere and if this review can get even 1 other person to try it out, then I'm all the happier for it (as you'll be!). Wishing this amazing innovator all the blessings and good fortune this world can bring his way. (P.S. Try the exclusive 1 billion pound dish - you won't regret it. ;))

venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Went here for breakfast on a Sunday, and it was hands down some of the most flavourful South Indian food I’ve had. The spices were spot on - bold and fiery, but not overwhelmingly so (spicy without feeling like an endurance test).

The weekend special South Indian Thali was the highlight - an absolute feast of textures and flavours, with each dish complementing the next perfectly. Everything tasted fresh, authentic, and deeply satisfying.

The service was excellent too. Every single staff member was genuinely friendly and polite, which made the whole experience even better.

If I’m ever in the area again, I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend!

A2B is a delightful place for south Indian food. I was surprised with the menu and the food quality. It's absolutely authentic in taste and reminds me of home. The rameshwaram special ghee podi masala soda was the highlight of our dining.
Abhishek at the host stand was a star just as much as the rest of the staff members who were very professional and prompt in service.

I look forward to coming back soon.

I recently attended a conference in Kensington and couldn’t resist visiting A2B in East Ham. Every dish we ordered had an authentic vegetarian taste that truly stood out. The service was excellent, and a special thanks to Dharani for the warm and sweet gesture. It was a delightful experience that brought out the true flavours of authenticity.

We tried only chaats - and they were quite average. Pav Bhaji - 4/5, Pani Puri - 3/5, Dahi Puri - 2/5. We also ordered Watermelon juice and ABC juice - both were a bit watery, but they were alright. I’d given them 3.5/5.

They have a lot of things on their menu - from chaats to juices to South Indian cuisine to North Indian dishes, you can have a variety of dishes here.

This place is in East Ham - so you’ll find a lot of Indians in this restaurant - I think it’s a good place if you want to mingle with other Indians.

It’s in a busy area, so you won’t find parking easily.

The staff were very polite and friendly, and quick to take orders.

One of the best service i ever had in london. Good and trained staff with polite behaviour, they served with a pleasant smile and Treated with atmost respect.

Service did attract me specially the one managing Lady felt higgly professional and very polite tratement.

venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Delicious Vegan Scandinavian in London!
I had a lovely experience at DAUNS – such a cozy little restaurant with a warm atmosphere. The sourdough and toast were exceptional – probably some of the best I’ve had in London. The chef was incredibly kind and even came out to serve the food himself, which made it feel really personal and special.

There were so many great options on the menu. I especially enjoyed the pickled dishes and the vegan cheese – full of flavor and beautifully presented. The restaurant is also located near a nice market area, perfect for a stroll after your meal. Highly recommend for anyone who enjoys good bread, thoughtful dishes, and a welcoming vibe.

What great place for vegans! Super delicious all plant based food.

I am sad I just could try two dishes and didn’t head enough time in London. Definitely come back next time in town.

We were on the hunt for some plant based cafes and tried this spot for breakfast today and really enjoyed it! We had scrambled tofu with seitan sausage, it was delicious with so many flavours, it’s the nicest scrambled tofu we have had! We will definitely come back again

Such a lovely little place! I've visited a few times now and it has become a regular spot for me when I visit London. The food is fresh and delicious, staff are friendly and it has a lovely warm atmosphere. Plus the cinnamon buns remind me of trips I took as a child to Sweden! UK cinnamon buns can't even begin to compare

Really fantastic cafe with a great menu of totally plant based vegan food. I had the beetroot salad with meatballs and a sparkling rhubarb drink - my daughter had the ‘ham’ and Brie toastie and then a brownie. Unbelievably delicious and frankly ridiculously cheap.  Very relaxed vibes and you can buy a few cheeses and other vegan goodies too. Can’t recommend highly enough.

venues.name: Shinde's Pure Veg
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Shinde's (Green street branch) was recently renovated and I was surprised to see the very elegant interior and beautiful selfie wall.

We ordered chilli paneer and dabeli. The sauce and paneer was so delicious 😋. The softness of the paneer with the tangy / spicy sauce was so good.

The dabeli was one of the best I have had in a long time. The sweetness of the pomegranate seeds, the spicy peanuts, the buttery pav and masala potatoes were such an excellent combination.

The staff were friendly and efficient. Definitely recommend for groups of friends, families, couples or even if you are going solo.

If you’re craving authentic Indian flavours with a touch of elegance, this pure vegetarian Indian restaurant in London is an absolute must-visit. From the moment you step in, you’re greeted with stunning decor that blends traditional Indian elements with modern flair—warm lighting, intricate patterns, and a vibrant yet cosy ambiance that sets the mood perfectly.

The menu is impressively diverse, catering to both classic favourites and creative innovations. Every dish we tried was packed with flavour, but the sizzling platter truly stole the show—served piping hot, aromatic, and beautifully presented. The spices were perfectly balanced, and the textures were spot on.

Don’t leave without trying their homemade mango pistachio ice cream. Creamy, nutty, and bursting with real mango flavour—it’s the perfect finish to the meal.

From food to atmosphere, everything here felt thoughtfully curated and genuinely delicious. A true haven for vegetarians and Indian cuisine lovers alike. Highly recommended!

I recently had a very enjoyable meal at your lovely restaurant near Upton Park station. The food was absolutely delicious and served in a timely manner, which I greatly appreciated. Please extend my congratulations to your talented kitchen staff!
While I was impressed with the quality of the food and the overall ambiance of your establishment, I did notice a few areas that, with some attention, could further enhance the customer experience.
During my visit, I observed that the waiting staff's uniforms appeared to be unclean. Maintaining clean and presentable uniforms is crucial for creating a positive impression.
Additionally, I noted some minor cosmetic issues that could be addressed. On the left wall, the texture from previous paintwork is still quite visible and could benefit from another coat. Similarly, on the lower right side, there is a crack in the wall near the tree decoration. I have attached photographs that illustrate these points.
The bathroom has a stylish design; however, ensuring it is consistently clean, thoroughly disinfected, and includes a freshener would be a valuable improvement. Lastly, the bar area, being directly visible to customers, would benefit from a fresh coat of paint and should be kept impeccably clean.
Overall, your restaurant has a wonderful vibe and a nicely designed interior. Addressing these finishing touches would undoubtedly elevate the overall impression you make on your guests.
The reason for my one-star rating for service on this occasion is solely due to the issue with the cleanliness of the waiting staff uniforms. I genuinely look forward to returning in the near future and hope to see these points addressed so that I can provide a more comprehensive review of your service.
Thank you for considering my feedback. I believe your restaurant has great potential, and these suggestions are offered with the intention of helping you achieve even greater

I tried Shinde's Pure Veg on Green Street recently, and honestly, it was such a great experience from start to finish. The place is super clean and well designed, which made a really good first impression. It’s got that modern but still cozy feel, not too flashy, just simple and tasteful. You can tell they actually care about the atmosphere. It felt welcoming the moment I stepped in.

The only downside I noticed was that the tables were a bit sticky. Not dirty exactly, just that slightly tacky surface that makes you wonder if they were cleaned with the wrong spray or not wiped down thoroughly. It didn’t ruin the experience, but it was noticeable and kind of stood out given how clean the rest of the place was.

Now onto the food, which is really the star of the show. I ordered the pani poori, samosa chaat, and a mango lassi. Each one had its own thing going on, and I loved them all for different reasons.

The pani poori was absolutely on point. The pooris were super crisp and fresh, none of that soggy or chewy stuff you sometimes get elsewhere. They had that perfect crunch when you bite into them. The filling was flavorful, a nice mix of spiced mashed potatoes and sprouts, and the pani itself was tangy and spicy in all the right ways. They didn’t go overboard on the spice either so you could really taste the mint and tamarind in the water. It came chilled, which just elevated the whole thing especially on a hot day. Honestly I could’ve had two plates of just that.

Then came the samosa chaat, which was kind of the comfort dish of the trio. The samosa itself was nicely fried, golden and crisp without being too oily. When they broke it up and mixed it with the chole, chutneys, yogurt, and all the toppings, it turned into this crazy good mix of flavors and textures. There was the warmth of the chickpeas, the sweetness from the tamarind, a little kick from the green chutney, and the creaminess from the yogurt pulling it all together. Plus that bit of crunch from sev sprinkled on top. Every bite tasted a little different in the best way. It had this layered flavor profile that kept me going back for more even after I was full.

And finally the mango lassi. This one surprised me the most because I didn’t expect to enjoy it as much as I did. It was smooth, thick, not overly sweet, and had a real mango flavor to it not that artificial syrupy stuff. And it was cold and super refreshing which just hit the spot because it was such a warm day. I swear I could’ve sat there for another hour just sipping that and people watching. It was the perfect balance to the spices from the chaat and pani poori too so I’m really glad I got it.

Overall I’d say Shinde's did a fantastic job. The service was good too, friendly but not hovering. Everything felt relaxed and well thought out, like they actually want you to enjoy your time there. Aside from the sticky tables, it was a really great visit. If you're looking for a clean spot with really flavorful vegetarian Indian street food, this place should definitely be on your list. I’ll be going back soon to try the rest of the menu.

Visited Shindey’s Pure Veg and tried the Rava Masala Dosa. It was crunchy and served with less oil as requested, which I appreciated. However, the portion was small, the sambar was minimal (as seen in the photo), and there wasn’t enough aloo stuffing—didn’t feel worth the price. I also had a small karak chai, but despite asking for less sugar, it was overly sweet. The server laughed at my request, which felt disrespectful. Needs improvement in both portion and service.

venues.name: THE COVEN of WICHES
venues.description: Where innovation meets tradition - expect the unexpected in every beautifully plated creation. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Really enjoyed my sandwich, potato salad, and spicy margarita in the outdoor dining area! Very friendly service! The Mr. Bangs Hot Sauce has been great with meals at home! Thoroughly recommend

Looking at previous reviews I decided to try this place out because I love a good pastrami sandwich. So I decided to make the time to do it because it’s about an hour away by bus and train for me. Thankfully, I’m retired and visiting London and I figured it would be a good way to see another part of it and I wasn’t disappointed. The only problem was that I thought it would be a storefront and when I was looking for it I didn’t see it even though there’s a free standing sign out front but I wasn’t looking for a free standing sign but a storefront. Finally, I looked more closely at my google map and saw that it could be inside this store front that says, Wood Street Indoor Market and then I saw signs of The Coven of Wiches. I ordered the signature pastrami sandwich and it was very good. I had been in Paris recently and had a pastrami sandwich at a popular place there called Chlew and it was alright but wasn’t made with the quality of the meat the Coven uses. I highly recommend this place because the food is great and the atmosphere with all the other businesses around is something we just don’t have in South Florida very much and it’s one of the things that makes London great.

Over an hour and a half travel one way for the sole purpose to have this divine Philly Cheese Steak… it was more than worth it. This was perfectly seasoned and the cheese smothered the steak to the point of climax but not killing. I would sell my soul to the devil to have it again. The au jus was a gushing success. 10s across the board for food!
Sensational sandwich! I had the Banh Mi and it transported me back to Vietnam in the best way possible! A must try in Wood street - £11

The best sandwiches in the UK.  666% Vegan.  Their signature huge sandwich is with Vegan pastrami.  Authentic and amazing service.  As most of their sandwiches contain soy and I am intolerant. They kindly made me the most amazing flavoursome sourdough sandwich with asparagus, tomatoes, avocado, spinach and rocket.  These sandwiches are a complete meal. Memorable.  Thank you

venues.name: The Spread Eagle
venues.description: Contemporary cuisine that's as Instagram-worthy as it is palate-pleasing. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Went for a Sunday roast and it was spectacular. Beet Wellington was umami and a perfect centrepiece, the roasties were crispy, the veg were cooked perfectly, and the gravy was plentiful. Shared a side of cheesy leek gratin which was unctuous and I would heartily recommend.
Also shared a bottle of red wine
Staff are all happy, friendly and helpful. Amazing vegan pub.

It's a vegan pub with a lovely atmosphere.
I was part of a large group and we all got served fairly quickly. The garden area is lovely, especially in warm weather. The staff was nice and smiley and there was a good vibe on the Friday karaoke night.

The decor is very nice but you can tell it hasn't been recently refurbished, just as you would expect from your average pub. The music playing was also good and in line with the pub's atmosphere.

The food was varied and interesting although choice was very limited when it came to mains (see website for more details). I had the Beyond beef burger and despite not being vegan, I thoroughly enjoyed it, though the toppings were a bit scarce and the "meat" a bit burnt in places. The fries were tasty and not greasy at all. Shame they ran out of the fried aubergine at 7pm as it looked really good.
Overall, all dishes looked tasty, though I didn't get the chance to try anything else.

(I posted this review on other websites too)

This is a lovely, queer friendly, all vegan pub that you don't expect to find on a highstreet. People working here are always friendly and welcoming, I've always been welcomed with a big smile. Food is delicious 😋 it's my favourite local by a mile.

Such a cute pub, lovely staff and delicious food.
The roast was so delicious and it’s great they had so many gluten free options. Staff were all so friendly, it’s just a really nice vibe. Definitely recommend. Creamy leeks are a must!

Pictures of the Sunday menu.
Beautiful place, friendly staff, good food and good music.

venues.name: WAVE
venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Absolutely loved this coffee spot! Tried their Peanut Butter Coffee, and it was simply superb—creamy, nutty, and really unique. The friendly staff and cozy atmosphere made my day even better. Highly recommend stopping by for a special treat!

Delicious food at a surprisingly reasonable price for a fully vegan place in london.
Perfect for a vegan breakfast.
I had the croissant with scrambled tofu and bacon. It was really tasty, - good sized portion for £8, and the coffee is good too but nearly £5 for a flat white seems a bit high in comparison to the food price?
The service is kind of distant and cold (however stick polite and friendly!) in a very typical, edgy east london way, but a beautiful cafe with a court yard if you want it.
There were so many other things on the menu and in the display that I would love to come back and try- it all looks delicious!

100% vegan cafe with English style bruch menu and pastries.

Shakshuka was as delicious as it looked, and the Coronation Sandwich was nothing like I tasted elsewhere. They had about 10 different beautiful pastries, and many of them were gone while I was deciding what to have!

Oh, the coffee, atmosphere, decor, outdoor space, and the staff were also fantastic.

Big thumbs up! 👍

The staff are lovely kind and understanding however the food wasn’t fresh and the drinks weren’t anything. The pancakes were uncooked and like rubber. For the price this place is overpriced for the quality of food served

Matcha tasted of plain oat milk. The matcha is missing. Bear in mind it cost £4.70 for oat milk.
Pancakes are not cooked and overpriced. This used to be my go to place and favourite place whole of London. Would never ever go again.
Two people over £30 and could not eat or drink anything.
Waste of money.

venues.name: Tofu vegan Spitalfields
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Super yummy, tasty, flavoursome, colourful, and varied - all words I’d use to describe this gem of a place. Whichever one you go to you’ll be happy with your choice - all super friendly staff and the same great menu. Quirky dishes too and all Vegan!

Really good place to come for delicious vegan food. The portions are a good size and great for sharing. We had the sizzling black bean tofu, special noodles, wontons and chick’n&sweetcorn soup. So tasty! Good location to shops and underground station. Highly recommend ☺️

First time visiting Tofu Vegan in Spitalfields and I was really impressed.

The standouts of the meal were the Peking “d’ck”, the deep-fried “chick’n” with salt & Sichuan pepper, and the stir-fried water spinach with chilli & Sichuan pepper, all packed with flavour and absolutely delicious.

We also tried the soupy xiao long bao (tofu & mushroom) and the mixed mushroom & tofu soup, which were both comforting and well-made.

Great value at around £25 per person, dog-friendly, and plant-based food so good you honestly wouldn’t know it’s not meat. Highly recommend!

This is probably the 80th time since I have come here and it’s never disappointing, it’s probably the best meal you would have in many days. Yet to bring a vegan or non-vegan person who is not fully amazed after eating here 😄😄😄

truly the best chinese food ive had in a while, and this is coming from a non-vegan chinese person. really great flavors in every single dish, but the salt and pepper tofu and wontons in house special sauce are not to be skipped

venues.name: iViSecrets Vegan Fine Dining Lounge (iVeganiT) - Caribbean Asian Fusion Food
venues.description: A sophisticated escape from the ordinary, where every dish tells a story of culinary craftsmanship. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
What an incredible night, food, and company! I went to celebrate a significant birthday, and the food was amazing. The WingTing had me licking my fingers. The dishes were well-presented and tasted amazing. The service provided by the young team was great; they were always ready to help and assist. They have amazing service, well done. Compliments to the chefs for a great menu.
If you're looking for something different and classy, this is the place to go.
Looking forward to my next visit really soon! 😄👍🏾

We had a New Years Eve dinner here and everything was just amazing. The place had super chill vibe. The staff was friendly, the food had a reallt awesome taste and also the presentation details were really well thought out. Definitely well worth the price. Hope to come back again one day.

This was fine dining to the max and I just loved it. From the amazing welcoming waiters, the beautiful scenery and then the food.  The vegan dishes I had was out of this world and i'm not Vegan at all.  The drinks, well all I can say, is that I really thought I was drinking Champagne.   This lovely family set up is just divine and I would go there again and again just to be treated like the Goddess I think I am.  I really am happy to know about this place because all in one Sunday I learnt a great deal about Vegan food and now I believe its the only way.

The best vegan meal I have ever had. Freshly made and served in the most appetizing and sophisticated classy manner. The champagne is a must have it's non alcoholic I had a whole bottle the atmosphere was perfect cozy romantic . I experienced live music. It's a experience every couple must have or for individuals rekindling check it out. For friends who just want to chill it's the spot. I would have given a ten star rating however I was only allowed five. A brilliant well enjoyed Christmas eve dinner

The delectable food was served with class,
the ambiance  cozy with an intimate atmosphere
Each course had its own creative appeal with truly a fusion of flavours
Those who waited on us were charming and happy to cater to our requests ...and with the right company it was just perfect

A wonderful evening💯
To believe it you'll just have to be there .

venues.description: Where contemporary London meets European flair - think Michelin-starred techniques with a side of British charm. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
Great and pleasant service, pleasant atmosphere, the food is great and portion size is large! The preparation takes a bit of time, so take it into account.
I took the cat breakfast as I was pretty hungry, but in retrospect the kitten breakfast would've been better for me, finished pretty stuffed!  Would definitely recommend and come back here :)

I had the best time going to this Cafe. The staff were incredible and so lovely! I had the pleasure of having the salad bowl and easy to say it was one of the best I’ve ever had, all was so tasty and the serving size was great. Such a nice environment with  a lovely decorated and spacious setting. The toilets were also very clean and the decor were lovely! Would 10/10 recommend if you’re looking for tasty vegan food 😊

I had the Spice Tofu Jerk Burger (£15) – 100% vegan and served with chips, slaw, and salad – and it was absolutely delicious! The tofu was full of flavour with just the right spice, and the sides made the meal complete. The service was friendly and the girls were really great and helpful, which made the experience even better. A generous portion, totally satisfying, and amazing value for a full vegan plate. 🌱🍔🍟🥗
Very friendly, laidback vegan cafe with tasty large portioned meals. I would definitely visit again so I can grab one of their milkshakes.
I was worried that I wouldn’t find as good of a place as Black Cat Cafe so I was pleasantly surprised when I went to a private event hosted here. Cannot wait to be back to try their drink selection

venues.name: Mildreds Dalston
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: What a treat! Everything we had was so delicious we could not fault it. Best vegan food ever! We had the 6 course taster menu, and the portions are not small at all, so very filling. The menu changes every few weeks so keep an eye out for the next supper club menu.

An absolutely lovely waitress made me feel welcome and looked after. The menu was full of dishes I’d not seen elsewhere, so I was happy to try new things. The cheesecake in particular was great.  I would have liked a separate plate for the corn rib cores, but apart from that, all the food items were great. The cappuccino was a surprise, as it was the best coffee I’ve had in my life!
The only thing I didn’t like was the music that suddenly got turned up really loud toward the end of my meal.

Came here for sunday roast, there were a lot of free tables so isn’t necessary to book. Super friendly and attentive service! The roast was good, but not the best I’ve had - I was really looking forward to the Yorkshire pudding but it was a bit stodgy (but I was thankful to have my first Yorkshire in years nonetheless!)
Lovely Sunday Roast. Just what we were looking for. There were 3 options and we went for the Harissa Carrot & Seed Loaf. Couldn’t have asked for more. Roasts after 3pm on a Sunday would be a bonus

We visited Mildreds at Dalston Junction on Christmas Eve for the second year in a row, and once again, they exceeded all expectations! The food and cocktails were absolutely delicious, and the service was truly unforgettable.

We loved the festive touches on the Christmas menu—temporary tattoos, Christmas crackers, and fun photo props—it all made the evening extra special. It’s safe to say I’m making dinner at Mildreds my new Christmas tradition!

A huge thank you to Ana, Léo and all the staff for looking after us so well. They went above and beyond to make sure all our requests were met. Can’t wait to come back next year!

venues.name: Fed By Plants
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text:
I had the meatless burger and chips and it was the best vegan burger I ever had in my life!!! So flavorful and satisfying.  The atmosphere is wonderful too.
If I lived in London, I would definitely be a regular.  Too bad I live in Japan.

This was an amazing meal after an afternoon walk through the city! I haven’t had fish and chips since becoming vegan, so I jumped at the chance to have them here. It did not disappoint at all. As a matter of fact, the music and service didn’t either. Definitely stop for a bite if you’re hungry and in the area.

The service was lovely and the chef/owner was very friendly and helpful. The food was incredible, and the vegan cheese especially was unlike anything I thought I could have as a vegan. The flavors are amazing, the plating is beautiful, and the prices are good! We got the nachos and the buckwheat waffles with the tofu for dinner, then came back the next day for the full vegan English breakfast. We got the hot chocolate too! Everything is homemade and the store is conveniently in Gabriel’s Wharf, toward the back. All in all, a lovely place to eat, and definitely worth a visit!

The food was alright, the service was very nice, the music was definitely too loud. I'm 99% sure my friend and I got food poisoned there. It was definitely the most suspicious place we have eaten during our stay in England. I was struggling with my stomach the next day when we were flying back from vacation. I didn't eat anything the whole day and survived without any drama but my friend wasn't so lucky. We were both weak with fever for a few more days so it could have been salmonella.
Usually I am always a bit skeptical of vegan pizza, but this was truly amazing! Really wonderful people as well! Definitely recommend a visit ☺️

venues.name: Baba's Village Restaurant
venues.description: Modern European dining that doesn't take itself too seriously, but takes your taste buds very seriously indeed. Located in the heart of London, this is where London's food scene comes alive.

reviews.text: Came in and was seated at the back of the restaurant which was nice as front part was a bit tight. Waiter came and took order after a couple of minutes. Our stater (dahi balla) came which wasn't that great and then had to wait another 30m for our mains to arrive. We had to ask the waiter where the food was and when it did come, the food was a bit bland and the Pina Colada seemed like it was drenched with ice and lost all of its flavour.

Went here as a part of the 50% off all meals and items.

Food was good, fresh and tasty.
Customer Service was on point.

The few mere reasons this is a star short of a five star review are the following:

Hygiene was not top notch for the type of restaurant it is, waiters dropping onions and handling them with their bare hands.

Insane prices for the quantity served and portion sizes. I had only ordered a large grill platter, a small chicken curry, a few cokes and three buttered naans and the total accumulated to £55 which I count as daylight robbery CONSIDERING I paid half the price due to the 50% off.

Lamb chops were quite meagre, uncooked, raw and chewy.

A few weeks ago, I stumbled upon this restaurant and decided to have dinner there, and I was pleasantly surprised. The friendly staff and inviting ambience immediately set a positive tone. It was a tough choice, but I opted for some classic dishes, and they exceeded my expectations.

The samosas, Tarka Dahl, Paneer Tikka, and Chicken Biryani were some of the best I've had in a while. I couldn't stop thinking about that biryani, with its perfectly spiced, fluffy rice and tender chicken. What's more, the prices were quite reasonable. I recommend visiting on a weekday.

Leytonstone is gradually becoming a hub for amazing restaurants, and these folks truly deserve more recognition.

It was a wonderful way to conclude a long workday, with exceptional food, great service, and genuinely warm-hearted individuals.

Had to try a proper Pakistani chapli kebab! Unfortunately, I ate it before I even thought of photographing my food! It was authentic 👌 and tasty with some nice chilli sauce. They've just opened, and there's that getting into your stride phase to go through for everyone! I will return for sure because I want to try their lamb chops 😋 I had a chicken korai which was ok and could have been great if only a couple of chillies had been chopped into it, the rice was really good 👍 the fish was a bit too salty 🧂Looking forward to next time 👍yeah next time was even better 👌

Came here on the 11th with my brother and mum. Was so lovely guys I don’t understand why some haven’t reviewed it that well. Everyone was lovely, the service really stood out to us. We just had to tip! Staff were so friendly and accommodating loved every moment till the end. Food was good too. Decor was so nice too, very modern and effortless. Great place. Thanks to everyone working! Will definitely be back
